bodyHtml:
Pizza is one of America’s most beloved foods, enjoyed by all ages, and perfect for any occasion. From deep-dish delights to wood-fired perfection or classic pizza by the slice, it’s easy to see why it remains a favorite.

Imagine sinking your teeth into a crisp, golden crust topped with farm-fresh ingredients and gooey, melty cheese—an unbeatable pizza experience awaits in Chandler!

Whether you’re in the mood for a custom creation or a chef’s signature pie, Chandler’s top pizzerias offer something for everyone. Ideal for a family-friendly dinner or a casual night out with friends, we’ve curated a list of where to get the best pizza in Chandler. To make your search even easier, we’ve broken it down by neighborhood—whether you’re looking for pizza in Downtown Chandler or exploring West Chandler, these must-visit Chandler pizza joints will have you craving another slice.

Bella Gusto Urban Pizzeria

Located in Uptown Chandler, Bella Gusto Urban Pizzeria serves a classic, Neapolitan-style pizza featuring house-made ingredients in their scratch kitchen. Complement your pizza with wood-fired eats and hand-crafted pasta dishes and salads.

Address: 1964 N. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85224

Vero Chicago Pizza

Featuring a cozy atmosphere and family recipes featuring their signature, rich tomato sauce, Vero Chicago Pizza has two Chandler locations, one in north Chandler and one in south Chandler. Try their Chicago-style deep-dish pizza, meat lovers will enjoy the Sears Tower pie featuring sausage, pepperoni, mushroom, onion, green pepper, and black olives or build your own pizza and customize your pie with a wide variety of meats and veggies. If you prefer something lighter, their Street Beach pizza with sliced fresh mozzarella, basil, and tomato sauce or the Italian Beef Sandwich are great choices, paired with their Pizza Fritta, featuring handmade pizza dough, lightly fried and served with their house marinara as an appetizer.

North Chandler location: 2855 W Ray Road #5, Chandler AZ 85224

South Chandler location: 5070 S. Gilbert Road #400, Chandler AZ 85249

Pesto's Pizzeria and Wine Bar

Pesto's Pizzeria and Wine Bar is a real gem in Chandler and perfect for a date night. Select from classic pizzas including a meat lovers or Hawaiian option or be slightly more adventurous with one of their specialty pies like their Tex-Mex, Shrimp Scampi or Greek pizza. Pair up your pizza with a great glass of wine - with more than 50 wines available by the glass, you're sure to find the perfect match!

Address: 1960 W. Ray Road, Suite 4, Chandler AZ 85224

Yo Pauly's New York Pizza Co.

Famously known in the Valley for their New York-style pizza, Yo Pauly's has a new location in North Chandler serving up whole pies and pizza by the slice. Enjoy crave-worthy pizza along with pasta, sandwiches, appetizers and more served up in a vibrant dining space or on the patio.

Address: 4040 W Ray Rd., #13, Chandler AZ 85226

Craft 64

In addition to being a craft brewery, this Craft 64 is a "50 Top Pizza" pizzeria in the USA as rated by 50 Top Pizza. This Downtown Chandler pizza restaurant features locally sourced ingredients on its menu and each day, makes their own mozzarella cheese and pizza dough.  The award-winning pizzeria has two wood-fired pizza ovens and a 60-ft. bar, generous indoor seating and back patio with an urban flair.  Diners will find the Craft 64 pizza offers a bit more chew and a signature char for seriously good pizza when in Downtown Chandler.

Address: 68 W. Buffalo St., Chandler AZ 85225

Crust: Simply Italian

Crust: Simply Italian is located adjacent to the courtyard of the Crowne Plaza San Marcos Golf Resort in Downtown Chandler.  The restaurant features a generously sized patio for outdoor seating and a large indoor area perfect for groups of all size.  New York-inspired pizza offerings include a variety of signature pizzas or diners may customize their own pie and opt for the individual pizzas or a 20-inch round pie with a thin crust or Sicilian-style.

Address: 10 N. San Marcos Place, Chandler AZ 85225

Floridino's Pizza & Pasta

A staple of the Chandler community, Floridino's has been serving pizza alongside a full menu including oven-baked sandwiches, pastas and calzones. Customize your pizza by selecting a red or white pizza in a rand of sizes from the small 10" to the x-large 18" size. For a tasty alternative, try Floridino's gourmet white sauce! And while not technically a pizza, the pizza muffins are a must-have!

Address: 590 N. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85224

ToScany's Coal Oven Pizza

Find a subtle, smoky flavor added to the handcrafted pizza at ToScany's Coal Oven Pizza in south Chandler. Find scratch-made pizza dough, sauces, and bread all made from the finest ingredients and freshly prepared in their 1,000 degree coal oven, creating delectable 'roni cups' where the pepperoni is crisped on the edges. 

Address: 4960 S. Gilbert Road, Chandler AZ 85249

Oregano's Pizza Bistro

Oregano's is an Arizona original, with its Chandler location located off Dobson and Germann roads. The trendy, family-friendly restaurant specializes in Chicago-style pizza and sandwiches. Be sure to save room for dessert and try The Original Pizza Cookie to complete your meal.

Address: 1960 W. Germann Road, Chandler AZ 85286

Chicago Pizza with a Twist

Diners will find “authentic Indian-style” pizza at this hot spot.  Featuring an extensive selection of toppings…diners are lining up for their Indian variations including paneer (a fresh cheese), desi meat (hamburger with spices) and naan (flatbread) pizzas.  Located in west Chandler, Chicago’s Pizza with a Twist is sure to delight with their unique toppings.

Address: 3950 W. Ray Road, Chandler AZ 85226

bodyHtml:
Summertime is all about creamy ice cream, frosty drinks, and cool, sweet treats. Fortunately, Chandler is the perfect place to chill out with your favorite cone, scoop, popsicle, or smoothie after a day of summer fun. From neighborhood ice cream locations and dessert boutiques to top Chandler boba spots and juice bars, a refreshing, frosty treat is always just around the corner.

Scoop, there it is: Classic Chandler ice cream and custard

The Screamery

A top contender for ice cream in Downtown Chandler, The Screamery is the place to go if you’re serious about your frozen treats. That’s because they make everything in small batches using hormone-free milk, pasteurized on-site. Flavors like Sweet Cream Honeycomb and Ooey Gooey Butter Cake aren’t just delicious; they’re borderline addictive.

Bruster’s Real Ice Cream

This place is a staple for a reason. Rich, creamy, and made fresh daily, Bruster’s keeps it simple and satisfying. Their waffle cones? Baked in-house and worth every single calorie. When it comes to the best Chandler summer treats, Bruster’s is hard to beat.

MilkShake Factory

Straight from the East Coast, this South Chandler MilkShake Factory brings an assortment of handspun milkshakes that are oh-so dreamy. Try the signature Chocolate Dipped Strawberry shakes and the gourmet Salted Caramel Pretzel. They’re all your sweet tooth could ever want.

No passport required: Sweet treats from around the world

SomiSomi

Korean dessert fans, this one’s for you. SomiSomi is famous for ah-boong, soft-serve ice cream swirled into fish-shaped cones. Pick your flavor (ube, matcha, milk, black sesame, the list goes on and on) and stack on toppings from rainbow sprinkles to Oreo crumbs.

Snowtime

What do you get when you combine a taiyaki (fish-shaped cone) with creamy soft-serve ice cream and colorful, yummy toppings? The perfect dessert photo opp. Walking into Snowtime is like entering dessert paradise. It’s also a top spot for Chandler shaved ice and other playful treats.

Dulce Churro Café

Soft serve meets warm churros, and it’s as dreamy as it sounds. The mix of hot and cold hits all the right notes and lands this churro café on the list of best Chandler summer treats.

BelAfia

There's something for everyone with a blend of three international cuisines served at BelAfia. In addition to the Indian, Persian, and Mediterranean fusion food, this unique little cafe offers both vegan and organic ice creams that can be customized to include all of your favorite toppings for something cool and delicious.

Shave it off: Shaved ice and Italian ice

Jeremiah’s Italian Ice

Among Chandler’s ice cream locations, Jeremiah’s is a go-to for smooth, flavorful Italian ice. Pro move? Order a Jelati, soft-serve ice cream and Italian ice swirled together into a heat-busting masterpiece. Jeremiah's is located in West Chandler just east of I-10.

Bahama Buck’s

If you like your frozen treats fluffy, fruity, and fun, Bahama Buck’s is your spot. With more than 90 flavors of Chandler shaved ice and tropical vibes to match, it’s a summer essential for both kids and kids-at-heart.

Whether you’re craving something rich and creamy, light and fruity, or just need a reason to step inside a chilly shop to escape the heat, Chandler’s frozen dessert scene has your back. So treat yourself. You earned it!

Let Us Help you Plan the Perfect Arizona Family Reunion

bodyHtml:
Chandler is well-known as a great place to raise a family—which makes it a perfect family reunion destination in Arizona. Whether you’re planning a fun getaway with your brood, or a gathering of family members from far and wide, here are some suggestions to make your next family reunion in Arizona all the more memorable and how are tourism office may assist you.

Family Room

Chandler has family reunion accommodations covered with numerous hotel options that will fit every budget and preference. Make yourself at home in the two-bedroom suites, which sleeps seven at the Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center hotel located off the highway loop 101 with easy access attractions, a resort-style pool, free breakfast daily and a complimentary evening social on Wednesdays. 

The family-friendly, Drury Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center hotel, located just two miles from Chandler Fashion Center offers event space for groups to gather and features spacious king suites with separate bedroom and living space, and queen sleeper-sofa making it an ideal home-away-from-home. There’s also free hot breakfast and 5:30 Kickback happy hour daily.

The TownePlace Suites by Marriott Phoenix Chandler/Fashion Center, also near the Chandler mall, is an extended stay property with flat-screen TVs, and distinct living and sleeping areas with fully-functional kitchens stocked with cooking essentials to make complete meals. Both properties can host special events like family reunions.

Activities for Everyone

Fill your itinerary with exciting group activities the whole family can enjoy. For starters, orbit the galaxy in the Solar System Walk at Veterans Oasis Park, a 2,500-foot path next to an urban lake with educational markers every foot charting the actual distance between the sun and earth.

Explore local art and culture at the Chandler Museum, offering engaging, community-focused programs in addition to national traveling exhibits, or challenge the family to locate clues, solve puzzles and work together at Escape: Chandler, an award-winning escape room.

More of a social media wrangler? Then load your collective selfie sticks and head to Downtown Chandler, one of the best places for family photos, to capture the vibrant street art, including a 225-foot mural spanning part of the Commonwealth Canal, which provides an expressive storytelling glimpse into the colorful history and diversity of the city.

Sights Worth Seeing

Chandler and the surrounding area also offer unique attractions for any age. Enjoy a ‘hole’ lot of family fun with a visit to Swingin’ Safari Mini Golf, an indoor glow-in-the-dark mini-golf course or race across multi-level tracks in a little friendly-competition to see who will be the go-kart family champion at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games.

A quick hop on the freeway to downtown Phoenix lands you at the Arizona Science Center, where kids and adults delve into the wonders of nature, science and technology through self-guided and guided tours, exhibits and live demonstrations. Take a walk on the wild side with a visit to one of the largest non-profit zoos in the country featuring more than 3,000 animals at the Phoenix Zoo.

And be sure to visit the Desert Botanical Garden, the Southwest’s answer to NYC’s Central Park. The urban “jungle” in the heart of Phoenix boasts 50,000 thriving desert plants covering five themed trails in a one-of-kind ecological outing.

Family Dining

The dining scene in Chandler has exploded with several restaurants that cater to families’ diverse appetites. Hop Social Grill, located near Chandler Fashion Center, is a casual, locally-owned scratch kitchen and bar that serves fresh, chef-crafted plates. For high-quality breakfast and brunch, head to east, near the Chandler Airpark, where Eggstasy serves scratch pancakes, waffles, eggs, crepes, and soups.

Day Trippin’

Chandler’s geographic coordinates make it easy to explore other popular Arizona towns in one day. Tucson, located 90 minutes south of Chandler, is known as the Old Pueblo and is a heritage-rich, multicultural hub of authentic Mexican food, art galleries, giant saguaro cacti, biking trails and unobstructed stargazing.

For a unique change of scenery, head north to witness the rugged red rocks and steep canyon walls of Sedona, a high desert mecca for local artisans, New Age sensibilities and hiking amidst some of the most picturesque scenery in Arizona.

Speaking of jaw-dropping canyons, travel 100 miles north of Sedona through the most breathtaking scenery in U.S. to the south rim of the iconic Grand Canyon, one of the seven natural wonders of the world and an unforgettable bucket list item for all family member.

Let Us Help you Plan the Perfect  Arizona Family Reunion

Reunions come in all sizes and the Visit Chandler staff is here to help you plan the best family reunion and create memories that your family will talk about for years. Our staff can make it easier from start to finish – contact us today and let’s make plans and find the right hotels, restaurants, things to do and Chandler family fun that everyone will enjoy.

bodyHtml:
Sometimes all you need is a weekend with your favorite people. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, planning a bachelorette getaway, reconnecting with lifelong friends, or simply craving sunshine and good conversation, Chandler, Arizona, offers everything you need for an unforgettable girls' trip.

 

Located just 20 minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, Chandler combines boutique charm with upscale hotels, award-winning restaurants, vibrant nightlife, shopping, wellness experiences, and plenty of opportunities to slow down and enjoy time together. From brunch and spa treatments to rooftop cocktails and local shopping, here's how to plan the ultimate girls' weekend.

Check Into Chandler: Your Perfect Home Base

Start your getaway by settling into one of Chandler's stylish hotels.

If your group wants a luxurious stay with resort-style amenities, the Marriott Phoenix Chandler offers a beautiful pool, modern guestrooms, and easy access to Chandler Fashion Center. For a charming stay in the heart of the action, book the historic Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort, where you'll be steps from Downtown Chandler's restaurants, boutiques, and nightlife. Looking for contemporary comfort? The Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center, Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center, and Drury Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler are all excellent choices for groups looking to relax after a day of exploring.

Start the Morning with Brunch

Every girls' getaway deserves an unforgettable brunch.

Begin your morning with fresh coffee from Peixoto Coffee, an Arizona favorite known for serving beans grown on the family's Brazilian coffee farm. Prefer a leisurely patio brunch? Head to Maple House, a seasonal favorite for specialty coffee and fresh-baked goods in a beautifully restored historic cottage with ample lawn, or gather around the table at Over Easy for classic brunch dishes and mimosas.

 

After breakfast, take your coffee to-go and wander through Downtown Chandler's colorful streets lined with murals, public art and locally owned boutiques. It's one of the most walkable districts in the East Valley and perfect for catching up between shopping stops

Shop Local (and Find Something Unique)

Skip the ordinary and discover Chandler's mix of local treasures and favorite retailers.

Browse handmade gifts, home décor and artisan goods throughout Downtown Chandler before making your way to Merchant Square Antique Marketplace, one of Arizona's largest antique destinations. With thousands of vintage finds, collectibles and locally made goods, every member of your group is sure to leave with something memorable.

 

If retail therapy is calling, Chandler Fashion Center offers more than 180 stores featuring national brands, along with restaurants and beauty services—perfect for an afternoon shopping break.

Indulge in a Little Self-Care

A girls' weekend should include time to recharge.

Book relaxing massages or facials before heading back out to explore. Chandler's growing wellness scene makes it easy to slow down and treat yourselves. Pair a spa appointment with an afternoon by the hotel pool, complete with frozen drinks, sunshine and uninterrupted conversation.

 

Looking for a little movement? Try an aerial yoga or bungee fitness class at Tough Lotus, where your group can laugh, stretch and create memories together while trying something completely different.

Get Creative Together

The best trips create memories you'll talk about long after the weekend ends.

Design your own home décor project during a workshop at AR Workshop or create a one-of-a-kind pottery piece at Burst of Butterflies. Both offer fun, hands-on experiences that make for perfect group activities—and you'll head home with a personalized souvenir from your Chandler getaway.

Sip, Savor & Toast the Weekend

As the Arizona sun begins to set, Chandler's food and drink scene comes alive.

Start with a beautifully crafted charcuterie board from Mingle + Graze before heading to George & Gather, a modern, made-from-scratch eatery featuring sourdough-crust pizzas, creative cocktails, and more. Looking for locally brewed favorites? SanTan Brewing Company remains a must-visit for Arizona craft beer lovers, while Pedal Haus Brewery offers a lively beer garden atmosphere perfect for gatherings.

For a memorable evening, enjoy rooftop views at The Perch Brewery or discover Downtown Chandler's energetic nightlife filled with live music, cocktail lounges, breweries, and late-night conversation under twinkling patio lights. Visitors and locals alike frequently recommend Downtown Chandler for its walkability and variety of restaurants and nightlife options, making it easy to explore several spots in one evening.

Add a Little Adventure

Looking for something beyond shopping and dining?

Challenge your friends to high‑speed racing at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games, enjoy laughs at a Mic Drop Comedy Chandler show, soar above the Sonoran Desert in a Rainbow Ryders hot‑air balloon, or spend a peaceful morning exploring Veterans Oasis Park or nearby hiking trails before temperatures rise. Whether your group prefers adrenaline, comedy, or nature, Chandler offers activities that fit every personality.

Sweet Endings

No girls' getaway is complete without dessert.

Celebrate the weekend with handcrafted ice cream from The Screamery, gourmet pastries from Paris Baguette or one last coffee and dessert while reminiscing about your favorite moments together.

 

Because let's be honest—the best part of any girls' trip isn't just where you go. It's the laughter shared over brunch, spontaneous shopping finds, sunset selfies, unforgettable dinners and the memories you create together.

Chandler Girls' Weekend Itinerary

Friday

  • Check into your hotel
  • Dinner in Downtown Chandler
  • Rooftop cocktails or local brewery hopping
  • Live music or comedy show

Saturday

  • Brunch and coffee
  • Boutique shopping and murals
  • Spa or pool time
  • Creative workshop
  • Dinner and cocktails

Sunday

  • Morning walk at Veterans Oasis Park
  • Coffee and pastries
  • Last-minute shopping
  • Head home refreshed, reconnected and already planning your next Chandler getaway.

Why Chandler is Perfect for a Girls' Getaway

Whether your group loves great food, shopping, wellness, nightlife or simply spending quality time together, Chandler offers an easy, relaxing escape in the heart of the Sonoran Desert. With more than 300 days of sunshine each year, award-winning, local restaurants, welcoming hotels and endless ways to connect, Chandler makes every girls' weekend feel like the perfect getaway.

A Simple Mother’s Day Weekend Plan
Day One: Ease Into the Weekend

bodyHtml:
A Mother’s Day weekend in Chandler brings together thoughtful dining, welcoming stays, and shared moments that feel grounded and unhurried. Our desert city offers a setting where things slow just enough to focus on connection, whether that means brunch on a shaded patio, a quiet walk through downtown, or a restorative massage. The pace here supports meaningful experiences with Mom and without the pressure of a packed schedule.

 

This guide highlights trusted hotels, standout dining spots, relaxing ways to spend time together, and a clear itinerary that helps you shape the ideal Mother’s Day getaway.

 

Top Hotel Picks She’ll Love

A comfortable stay sets the tone for the entire weekend, and Chandler has several properties positioned near dining and shopping hubs. Crowne Plaza Phoenix - Chandler Golf Resort situates Mom downtown, within walking distance of several local restaurants and boutiques. At Crowne Plaza, historic character meets updated amenities, and the adjacent golf course adds an extra layer of leisure.

 

Hyatt Place Phoenix/Chandler-Fashion Center is ideal for her if she enjoys having everything close at hand. Located steps from Chandler Fashion Center, it makes browsing shops, enjoying a leisurely lunch, or fitting in a little self‑care feel effortless. Spacious rooms, casual common areas, and an easygoing atmosphere create a stay that feels relaxed and unhurried, perfect for a weekend centered on time together.

 

Another establishment near the Chandler mall, Drury Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center, adds extra comfort touches that make a Mother’s Day stay feel especially accommodating. Complimentary evening refreshments and a generous breakfast simplify planning and leave more room for quality time. Its central location near restaurants and entertainment allows the weekend to unfold smoothly, blending rest, dining, and celebration without feeling rushed.

 

Brunch, Bites, & Special Meals

Brunch anchors any Mother’s Day weekend, and Chandler’s dining scene delivers a range of inviting choices. Start the day off with something delicious. George & Gather is a fantastic choice if you want something a little fancy, picture shareable plates stacked with goodness, and heavenly cocktails.

 

Over Easy focuses on breakfast and brunch classics, serving dishes such as Eggs Benedict, pancakes, and hearty morning plates in a bright, casual environment. Its consistent menu makes it a dependable choice centered on comfort and familiarity.

 

The Brickyard Downtown provides a refined setting, with elevated brunch selections and craft cocktails fitting for a celebratory meal, while Hidden House is a solid option for a midday bite, with a great appetizer list in a restored 1939 cottage downtown. The space and menu make it ideal as a casual pause between activities.

 

DC Steak House makes an excellent choice for dinner, offering a menu centered on expertly prepared steaks, pork chops, and seafood in an intimate, polished setting. The atmosphere encourages lingering over a well‑paced meal and meaningful conversation, giving the evening a sense of occasion.

 

To finish the day on a sweet note, make plans for dessert at The Screamery. This small‑batch ice cream shop offers thoughtfully crafted flavors that invite you to linger a little longer, whether after dinner or during an evening stroll through the area.

 

Relaxing Activities to Enjoy Together

Downtown Chandler invites exploration through its collection of boutiques, public art, and shaded gathering spaces. A casual walk through the area creates space to browse, chat, and enjoy unstructured time, with plenty of places to pause over laughter.

 

Chandler Fashion Center expands those options with a mix of national retailers and dining destinations, plus an indoor alternative during warmer parts of the day, giving you and Mom a centralized place for quality time.


 
Take a pit stop at Aristocrat Coffee Roasters with expertly crafted coffee, easing you into a post-shopping stretch. When it comes to wellness and restoration, The NOW Massage has customizable massages that feel in sync with the weekend’s flow.

 

Veterans Oasis Park provides open space, walking trails, and quiet surroundings, serving as a peaceful alternative to busier parts of the city. These spots lend structure to the day without overfilling it, allowing the weekend to remain focused on time well spent rather than constant movement.

 

A Simple Mother’s Day Weekend Plan

Day One: Ease Into the Weekend

Begin the morning slowly, taking advantage of your hotel’s amenities or enjoying a walk downtown. Late morning transitions naturally into time at Chandler Fashion Center, where shopping and nearby dining create a nice way to spend a few hours.

 

Take a break over coffee and conversation at Aristocrat Coffee Roasters, then return to your accommodation in the afternoon to recharge ahead of the evening. This built-in pause keeps the day from feeling continuous while still allowing time to get out and explore.

 

As the afternoon shifts into evening, head out for dinner at The Brickyard Downtown and enjoy the irresistible food, drink, and upscale setting. Wrap up the night with a short walk nearby or relax back at your hotel.

 

Day Two: Brunch and Unwind

Head to brunch at Over Easy before hitting the shops downtown or getting massages at The NOW Massage. Always remember to check Chandler’s local events calendar to see if a live performance, market, or seasonal gathering is happening that weekend; an easy way to add something unexpected and memorable to the itinerary.

 

Later in the afternoon, visit Veterans Oasis Park to step outside and enjoy the fresh air in a quieter environment. Evening plans can remain flexible, with options to revisit downtown or enjoy a relaxed dinner close to your hotel.

 

A thoughtful Mother’s Day getaway in Chandler comes together through small, well-chosen moments instead of a packed schedule. Start planning your weekend to make the most of your time with Mom on her special day.

bodyHtml:
Memorial Day weekend is the unofficial start of summer—and there’s no better place to kick it off than in Chandler, AZ. With sunshine-filled days, vibrant dining, and hotels designed for poolside relaxation, Chandler makes it easy to turn a long weekend into a memorable getaway.

Located just minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, Chandler offers the perfect blend of accessibility and escape. Whether you’re planning a quick trip or a staycation close to home, you’ll find plenty of ways to relax, explore, and celebrate the long weekend.

 

Make It a Long Weekend in Chandler

Turn your Memorial Day plans into a full weekend experience with a stay that fits your style. From walkable hotels in Downtown Chandler to modern stays near Chandler Fashion Center, you’re never far from dining, shopping, and things to do.

Spend your mornings exploring, your afternoons poolside, and your evenings discovering Chandler’s growing culinary scene—all just steps from your hotel.

Soak Up the Sun (and the Pool Scene)

Long weekends are made for lounging, and Chandler’s hotel pools set the scene. Think shaded cabanas, sparkling water, and a laid-back vibe that defines the start of summer.

Whether you’re unwinding with a good book or enjoying time with family, a pool day (or two) is essential to your Memorial Day weekend plans.

Get Outside and Explore

Make the most of early mornings and golden-hour evenings by spending time outdoors. Chandler’s parks and open spaces provide a refreshing way to enjoy the season. Here are some activities to consider:

  • Stroll scenic trails and spot local wildlife at Veterans Oasis Park 
  • Let the kids play at Tumbleweed Park’s Playtopia
  • Cool off at Desert Oasis Aquatic Center
  • Pack a picnic and relax under shaded ramadas
  • Discover adventure and fun at the Phoenix Zoo, home to a variety of animals across its 125 acres

It’s an easy way to balance relaxation with a little adventure.

Dine, Sip & Unwind in Downtown Chandler

As the sun sets, Chandler comes alive. With patio dining, local breweries, and chef-driven menus, Downtown Chandler creates the perfect setting to unwind after your day.

From casual bites to elevated cuisine, Chandler’s dining scene encourages you to linger a little longer—whether you're celebrating a holiday weekend or simply enjoying a night out.

Celebrate the Spirit of the Weekend

Memorial Day is a time for reflection and honor, and Chandler offers meaningful ways to commemorate this occasion. While you're in town, consider visiting local memorials or community spaces that pay tribute to those who have served.

 

One notable place is the Field of Honor at Veterans Oasis Park in east Chandler. This tribute celebrates the past, present, and future veterans of the valley and is particularly stunning in the evenings when the illuminated cubes and wall lights represent the American flag.

 

In 2026, the significance of Memorial Day will be even greater as communities across the country begin celebrating America’s 250th anniversary, deepening the sense of connection to this weekend.

Your 3-Day Memorial Day Weekend in Chandler

Day 1: Arrive & Unwind
Check in, explore your hotel, and head to Downtown Chandler for dinner and drinks.

Day 2: Play & Relax
Start with a morning park visit or light adventure at the Phoenix Zoo, then spend the afternoon poolside. Wrap up the evening with dining or a casual night out.

Day 3: Brunch & Browse
Enjoy a relaxed brunch, fit in a little shopping at Chandler Fashion Center, and soak up the last moments of your weekend getaway.

Start Summer Your Way in Chandler

However you spend it—poolside, outdoors, or exploring downtown—Memorial Day weekend in Chandler is all about starting summer your way. Stay a little longer, soak up the sunshine, and discover just how easy it is to turn a long weekend into something more. Organize your Chandler trip today by exploring our planning tips.

bodyHtml:
Each March, the annual Chandler Chamber Ostrich Festival brings big energy to the Valley with live music, carnival rides, festival food, and plenty of family fun. Why not make a weekend out of it and turn your Ostrich Festival outing into a full spring break weekend getaway with plenty to explore long after the gates close?

Here’s how to plan the perfect Ostrich Festival weekend in Chandler.

Stay the Weekend in Chandler

Whether you’re planning a romantic getaway for two or a spring break family adventure, Chandler offers comfortable hotels located just minutes away from the festival grounds.

Couples Getaway Hotels

If you’re turning the festival into a fun weekend for two, these Chandler hotels offer stylish spaces to relax after a day of rides and music. Each of these hotels offers great on-site amenities like resort-style pools, modern lounges for cocktails, and convenient access to Chandler dining and nightlife. All three are short and easy drives to the festival site.

  • Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center – the hotel offers a boutique-inspired option featuring a large pool with cabanas and offers easy walkability to restaurants, shopping, and entertainment at Chandler Fashion Center mall.

  • Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort – features expansive grounds and resort amenities in the heart of Downtown Chandler, within steps of nearly 50 local restaurants and bars, and direct access to PGA-quality golf.

  • Marriott Phoenix Chandler – an upscale, modern hotel featuring some of the best desert views in Chandler provides on-site dining at Proof 19, a restaurant and bar specializing in handcrafted cocktails and chef-driven plates.

Family Spring Break Stays

Traveling with kids in tow? These family-friendly hotels provide plenty of space and comfort after a day of carnival games, concerts, and more at the Ostrich Festival. These hotels are located a short drive from the festival grounds.

  • DoubleTree by Hilton Phoenix Chandler – your stay starts with DoubleTree’s sweet signature welcome: a warm chocolate-chip cookie, not only for the kids but for visitors of all ages. The hotel features large, comfortable rooms and a quiet courtyard for swimming and play.

  • Fairfield Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler / Fashion Center features spacious, newly renovated guest rooms and a free daily breakfast buffet with hot items like eggs, bacon, waffles, and more.

  • Hampton Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler-Fashion Center - find spacious, freshly renovated guest rooms with a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, on-site laundry facilities, and a year-round heated outdoor pool and hot tub.

  • Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler – the unique garden-courtyard layout offers a comfortable, laid-back pool area, which travelers celebrate. The hotel is also just minutes away from Makutu’s Island, the Phoenix Zoo, and a short walk from Taroko Sports, a high-tech baseball attraction.

Explore more lodging options on the Visit Chandler hotels page.

Keep the Fun Going Around Chandler

The Ostrich Festival may be the main event, but Chandler offers plenty more ways to fill your weekend.

Play Into the Night

For late-night fun, head to Round1 Bowling & Arcade, where bowling, arcade games, karaoke, and billiards make it easy to keep the energy going after the festival closes.

Feel the Need for Speed

At Andretti Indoor Karting & Games, you can race high-performance electric karts, enjoy immersive games, and compete in a variety of thrilling attractions.

Catch a Spring Training Game

Enjoy world-class baseball under the desert sun with a cold drink in hand at this quintessential pre-season warm-up featuring a robust Spring Training schedule of more than 200 games this spring. All the Cactus League Spring Training Stadiums are located within a 5-45 minute drive from Chandler. The closest spring training stadiums are Tempe Diablo Stadium, Sloan Park, Hohokam Stadium, and Scottsdale Stadium.

Explore the Desert

Looking for a unique Arizona experience? Saddle up for a guided trail ride at KOLI Equestrian Center, where desert scenery and wide-open trails offer a peaceful change of pace to round out your weekend.

Stroll Through Downtown Chandler

Be sure to spend some time in Downtown Chandler, where colorful murals, locally owned shops, and lively patios make it a great place to wander between meals or evening activities.

You can explore murals, shopping, and more in the Visit Chandler Downtown Chandler guide.

Where to Eat Before or After the Festival

We know that festival food is part of the fun—but Chandler’s dining scene is worth exploring while you’re in town.

Start the Day with Breakfast

Fuel up before heading to the festival with a hearty breakfast. Two options in West Chandler, both near the intersection of I-10 and Ray Road, are a short drive from the Ostrich Festival grounds.

  • Over Easy serves creative twists on classic breakfast favorites and is known for many “As Seen on TV” features, including: The Best Thing I Ever Ate and Food Paradise. The Waffle Dogs, breakfast sausages dipped in waffle batter and fried, then served with powdered sugar and maple syrup, are a favorite alongside the freshly squeezed orange juice prepared per order.
  • Bisbee Breakfast Club is a local favorite known for generous portions and classic, scratch-made comfort food, including its signature biscuits.

Discover more morning spots on the Visit Chandler Breakfast & Brunch guide.

Lunch or Dinner in Chandler

When the festival appetite kicks in, Chandler has plenty of memorable dining options.

  • The Mexicano, located near Chandler Fashion Center, delivers a lively, interactive dining experience with vibrant, authentic Mexican flavors and playful presentations. Insider tip: on Fridays and Saturdays, make dinner reservations for 6:30 p.m., which should have your food arriving as the glowing, dancing, Transformer-style robots perform.
  • Craft 64 is a premier artisan pizzeria, recently ranked #26 in the U.S. by 50 Top Pizza, where nearly everything is made from scratch, from the mozzarella to the beer, featuring locally sourced ingredients.
  • Chase’s Diner features an authentic retro vibe, complete with red vinyl booths and neon signage, but it’s the made-from-scratch comfort-food dishes that you’ll crave long after your visit.
  • SanTan Brewing Company is the perfect place for a cold Arizona craft beer and a laid-back bite after the festival crowds wind down. The Downtown Chandler brewery features an expansive patio for outdoor dining and a lively indoor dining room with TVs for sports fans.

Explore more local places to eat on the Visit Chandler local restaurants dining page.

Make It a Chandler Festival Weekend to Remember

With live entertainment, carnival thrills, and unique Arizona charm, the Chandler Chamber Ostrich Festival is already a highlight of the season. Add in Chandler’s welcoming hotels, standout restaurants, and exciting attractions, and it’s easy to turn a single day at the festival into a full weekend getaway.

Check out our 2026 visitors guide, plan your trip, book a hotel, and come to experience why springtime in Chandler is something worth celebrating.

Crowne Plaza San Marcos Golf Resort

bodyHtml:
Maybe you haven’t said “yes to the dress” yet, but choosing the right wedding venue is an important decision to make early in the planning process. After all, it’s the backdrop that sets the stage and captures all the memories of your special day. Check out these unique Chandler wedding venues to make your wedding a signature event.

Greenhouse Gardens

Dreaming of a natural, farm-to-table inspired wedding? Greenhouse Gardens ticks all the earthy ceremony and reception boxes—without having to drive to the country to get hitched. The urban, organic farm sits on four acres and specializes in seasonal vegetables, fruits and herbs in south Chandler. The rotating crops are chemical- and pesticide-free, and depending on availability, can be incorporated into the wedding menu. The property includes tractors, roaming chickens, a barn and historic World War II buildings for a photo-ready, vintage wedding theme on the edge of town that everyone will remember.

Map: 13103 E. Chandler Heights Road, Chandler AZ 85249 or (480) 664-4220

Crowne Plaza San Marcos Golf Resort

The famed property listed on the National Register of Historic Places in Downtown Chandler has been hosting weddings since 1912. For good reason. The timeless sophistication of the property, recipient of numerous industry awards for wedding expertise, makes it a romantic spot to tie the knot. The property has 32,000 square feet of dedicated event space, including distinct venues for rehearsal dinners, wedding ceremonies, receptions and post-wedding day brunches. Promise to love and honor in the fountain courtyard under a grand white arch, or in the pergola with a vine-covered walkway, or inside in one of the stately ballrooms. Whether it’s a casual ceremony or black-tie affair, Crowne Plaza event planners can help arrange every detail, from flowers and catering to photography and room accommodations for an unforgettable wedding.

Map: One South San Marcos Place, Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 812-0900

The Ashley Castle

Every bride wants to feel like a princess on her wedding day. At Ashley Castle, you can say, “I do” to your prince in a medieval hall that promises a magical fairytale wedding experience. The castle includes outdoor gardens with fountains, statues, columns, pathways and an intricately crafted gazebo where ceremonies can be held. Inside the 200-year-old entry doors is a foyer with private dressing room suites guarded by armored knights, a grand ballroom perfectly suited for receptions with sparkling chandeliers, stone tourets, polished marble floors, and towering 30-foot ceilings. Different wedding packages are available and event specialists can help coordinate basic venue rental needs to all-inclusive planning, catering, flowers and decorations. To really make it a spectacular event, you can light up the skies with fireworks since the space is the only one of its kind to carry a fireworks permit in Arizona.

Map: 1300 S. Price Road, Chandler 85286 or (480) 857-8030

Ocotillo Golf Club

It might be located in the Sonoran Desert, but the Ocotillo Golf Club is a lush, evergreen wedding destination with a rustic touch and legendary five-star service. The country-club style venue is situated on a golf course, with cascading waterfalls, charming footbridges, a glimmering pond, and thick shade trees with both outdoor and indoor ceremony and reception options. You can exchange vows on the lawn with an arched stone wall background framed by towering conifers and palms or at the waters’ edge—all with stunning photogenic possibilities and perhaps one of those famous Arizona sunsets. Or select the grand ballroom complete with wood-paneled ceilings and exposed arched beams with tons of natural lighting and serene views.

Map: 3751 S. Clubhouse Drive, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 917-6660

SoHo63

At SoHo63 in downtown Chandler, it’s possible to have a hip and historic wedding with big-city vibes. The 12,000-square-foot event space offers both modern and elegant options to accommodate 175 to 200 wedding guests. Choose from the open-air Tribeca Terrace, modeled after a NYC rooftop promenade with bistro lighting and a fireplace; the Plaza, a romantic indoor space with hanging crystals and hand-lit candle wall; the Gramercy Ballroom featuring glass doors, chandeliers and flexible floodplains that opens to the Tribeca Terrace; or the Brix on Boston with exposed bricks and urban library surroundings—the perfect spot for a cocktail hour or after-ceremony lounge. Private, get-ready rooms also are available on property for the wedding party. And experienced staff can assist with every detail.

Maps: 63 E. Boston St., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 878-5663

City of Chandler Parks

For a budget-friendly wedding venue in the great outdoors, Chandler Parks offers many open-sided pavilion rentals throughout the park system for groups up to 200 +. Pavilions can be rented a year in advance; check the convenient Search Tool  for availability of a picnic site. Beer permits must be obtained in person at the Recreation Services Desk at Tumbleweed Recreation Center with a valid government-issued ID. Or consider using one of the unique and affordable Chandler Parks multi-purpose facilities to host your nuptials: Chandler Community Center, Chandler Nature Center, Chandler Senior Center, Snedigar Recreation Center, Chandler Map: Tennis Center or Tumbleweed Recreation Center or (480) 782-2752

Wedding Help

Wedding planning can be overwhelming. The staff at Visit Chandler are happy to offer a helping hand for free, from finding a Chandler wedding venue that suits your needs and budget, to arranging hotel room blocks, rehearsal dinners and pre-wedding events such as bachelor/bachelorette parties.

For more information about planning your Chandler, AZ wedding or celebration, contact staff today!

bodyHtml:
When it comes to hosting a youth sports tournament, location is everything—and Chandler, Arizona has it all. With state-of-the-art sports facilities, a variety of team-friendly hotels, delicious dining options, and plenty of activities for young athletes and their families, Chandler is a winning choice for your next event.

Top Sports Complexes in Chandler, AZ

Snedigar Sportsplex

Spanning 90 acres, Snedigar Sportsplex is one of Chandler's premier parks for youth sports events in Arizona. The complex features: 

  • Two professional-sized baseball fields
  • Four softball fields
  • Four Little League baseball fields
  • 12 soccer fields
  • Full-sized cricket field
  • 9,000-square-foot recreation center
  • Skate park
  • Fully-fenced dog park

The Snedigar Sportsplex is conveniently located near Chandler hotels, family-friendly restaurants, and entertainment.

 

Chandler Sports Complexes & Fields

Beyond Snedigar, Chandler offers additional venues for tournament play, including:

  • Tumbleweed Park - featuring large, open fields with playgrounds and shaded areas perfect for soccer and multi-sport use.
  • Chandler Gilbert Community College facilities - ideal setting for basketball, volleyball, soccer, baseball, and softball. The indoor Coyote Center Gym can accommodate up to 1,600 spectators.
  • Local high school athletic complexes - available seasonally, Chandler high schools rent additional fields and courts for larger tournaments.

Team-friendly Hotels in Chandler, AZ

Chandler is home to a wide range of hotels that regularly host youth sports teams and their fans, many of which offer complimentary breakfast, group options, and sparkling pools for a team refresh. 

  • Holiday Inn Phoenix Chandler - Located near the Snedigar Sports Complex, this south Chandler hotel features beautiful views of the Ocotillo Golf Club's rolling fairways, on-site dining where kids eat free, pool, fitness center, and daily housekeeping service.
  • Home2 Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler - Perfect for extended stays, these suites feature kitchens, a saltwater pool, BBQ grills, free breakfast, and HiltonLink, making it easy to book team accommodations.
  • Marriott Phoenix Chandler - Featuring Chandler's largest meeting space, the hotel offers a state-of-the-art fitness center, outdoor pool with sunset views, on-site dining with a Starbucks coffee and market. 
  • Hotels near Chandler Fashion Center - Nearly a dozen family-friendly hotels make up this cluster, featuring easy access to shopping, dining, and post-game entertainment. All the Chandler hotels feature fitness centers, outdoor pools, and most offer a complimentary breakfast.

Where to Eat: Restaurants for Youth Sports Teams

Chandler’s dining scene makes it easy for teams to fuel up before or after the big game. Many restaurants offer large group seating and kid-friendly menus.

  • First Watch (Fulton Ranch) - This team favorite for breakfast and brunch features fresh, made-to-order meals with healthy and indulgent options.
  • Stone & Vine Urban Italian - The restaurant is renowned for its homemade pasta dishes, wood-fired pizzas, and classic entrees that showcase traditional Italian family recipes. Diners will enjoy the lakeside patio, and the craft cocktails are a hit for parents.
  • Jeremiah's Italian Ice - The perfect cool-down spot after a long day at the fields, Jeremiah's offers a selection of house-made frozen treats: Italian Ice, Soft Ice Cream, and their signature Gelati that combines any of dozens of refreshing Italian Ice flavors and creamy soft serve ice cream.

Things to Do Between Games

When athletes aren't competing, Chandler offers family-friendly attractions and activities to keep the fun going and focus on teambuilding. 

  • Andretti Indoor Karting & Games - This massive indoor entertainment complex features go-karting, laser tag, and Virtual Reality (VR) games. The family attraction offers in-house dining options and group packages, including those with and without dining options.
  • Big Air Trampoline Park - Find high-energy fun with trampoline dodgeball, slam dunk courts, foam pits, and climbing walls.
  • Escape the Room Chandler - A great team-building activity for young athletes and parents alike.
  • Majestic Chandler 9: Dinner, movies, and interactive screenings make this a fun group outing.
  • Round1 Bowling & Arcade - Located at Chandler Fashion Center, Round1 offers boutique bowling, an expansive arcade, Karaoke and more. Party packages are available that bundle activities and food.
  • Rush Xtreme - This indoor adventure facility features rock climbing, bungee jumping, dodgeball, zip line, foam pit, and VR games.

Families and teams can also explore Chandler's upscale shopping mall, Chandler Fashion Center, or enjoy the outdoors with a desert walk at Veterans Oasis Park.

Plan Your Youth Sports Tournament in Chandler, AZ

From soccer tournaments to basketball competitions to flag football and more, Chandler is a great option for your next sporting event. Find top-tier sports facilities, family-friendly hotels, restaurants, and activities ready to host your next youth sports tournament in Chandler. Let Visit Chandler help you with venue selection, accommodations, and local recommendations to help you plan the perfect events.

Contact our staff or call us at (480) 782-3037 for personal assistance.

headings.text: Planning an Epic Guys' Trip in Chandler

bodyHtml:
Contrary to popular belief, guys’ getaways can be more than just your typical bachelor party. A guys weekend or “mancation” in the Southwest is the perfect way to reconnect with old friends, bond with good buddies, and explore new experiences. If you’re planning a fun getaway for you and your pals, check out all that Chandler has to offer, from hitting the links, to feasting on barbecue, to seeing how your favorite spirits are made in the desert and a short distance from your Chandler hotel.

Tee Time

Nothing encourages male bonding better than a round of golf. And while Chandler has its fair share of fabulous courses, the San Marcos Golf Course is as iconic as it gets. Since opening in 1913, the grounds—the first one in Arizona to feature grass instead of sand fairways—has hosted a slew of celebrities, dignitaries and professional golfers. The 72-par, 6,500-yard course boasts wide fairways lined with century-old tamarisk and palm trees, appealing to golfers of all skill levels. No time for a full round? Take a swing at the Little Marcos Pitch and Putt course, a 9-hole round that takes less than an hour.

Map: 100 N. Dakota St. or (480) 963-3358

Make a Splash

Need to cool off after hitting the links? You’re in luck. Steps away from the San Marcos Golf Course is the resort-style pool at the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort. Complete with cabanas (first come, first served) and outdoor bar, the pool area is the perfect place to ease back, relax and enjoy some quality time with friends. For more pool fun, check out the crystal-blue pool waters at the CAMBRiA Hotel Phoenix Chandler-Fashion Center. Lounge under the shade of a cabana/poolside umbrella, or enjoy drinks and nosh around the modern fire pit.

Map to the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort: 1 San Marcos Place or (480) 812-0900

Map to CAMBRiA Hotel Phoenix Chandler: 3165 W. Frye Road or (480) 899-2203

Game On

Sports fans, rejoice! If you’re looking for a great place to catch the game, get your boys over to the Ginger Monkey Gastropub, a neighborhood sports bar that serves up great food, cool drinks and a fun time for all. Enjoy all the sports action on the big-screen TVs as you get your fill of sports-inspired fare, including homemade pretzel bites, short rib sliders, and crispy pork shank wings. And just in time for baseball season, sink your teeth into the Diamondback Sonoran dog made with a quarter-pound all-beef hot dog wrapped in bacon and topped with avocado, pinto beans, tomatillo relish, cilantro crema and cotija cheese.

Map: 135 W. Ocotillo Road or (480) 802-6659

Pit Stop

For the meat lovers in your group, head over to West Alley BBQ & Smokehouse, a family-owned barbecue joint that takes it ’cue seriously. Known for its dry-rub, Tennessee-style barbecue, the Downtown Chandler restaurant cooks all its meat in an onsite pit, from pork, brisket and chicken, to ribs and smoked sausage. Kick things up a notch with one of their vinegar-based sauces and enjoy a tasty side such as green beans, baked beans or creamy coleslaw. When the meat feast is done, sit a spell and enjoy a cold drink while listening to live entertainment.

Map: 111 W. Boston St. or (480) 248-8819

Grand Tour

For an up-close-and-personal look at how whiskies, vodkas, gins and beers are made, reserve your group’s spot at a SanTan Distillery Tour. The 10 stops on the tour give an overview of the brewing process, from distilling and fermentation to barrel aging and canning. See walls of stacked grains and get a bird’s-eye view of the beer tanks in the 35,000-square-foot space, all while sampling vodkas and gins along the way. The tour ends in tasting room, where you can continue to enjoy beers and spirits, and even get a bottle of your favorite to take home and enjoy.  It is recommended to secure your tickets in advance through their website.

Map: 495 E. Warner Road or (480) 534-7041

Great Outdoors

While Chandler is all city, it’s still nestled in the desert, surrounded by all that nature has to offer. To take advantage of the area’s natural wonders, there are a number of recreation areas you can enjoy. Trek through the 113-acre Veterans Oasis Park complete with 4.5 miles of trails, or hike safely along the 6.5-mile Paseo Trail, a popular spot with walkers, joggers, cyclists and even horseback riders. The trail also gives you access to the Paseo Vista Recreation Area, which has a disc golf course, 40-foot-high lookout point and 360-degree views of the East Valley.

Map to Veterans Oasis Park: 4050 E. Chandler Heights Road

Map to Paseo Vista Recreation Park: 3850 S. McQueen Road

headings.text: ‘Pop’ Into The Best Chandler Boba Bars

bodyHtml:
Not since the latte has a drink made such an impression on the beverage scene. Originating in Taiwan, boba made its way to the U.S. in the ’90s and since then, boba bars have “popped” up all over. Chandler, especially, has seen an influx of shops and, honestly, we couldn’t be happier. Perfect for a quick pick-me-up between meetings, on your way back to your Chandler hotel or enjoying one of the great community parks, here’s a look at some of the city’s must-try spots.

Boba Tea House

Tucked in a cozy corner of the Lee Lee Supermarket retail and restaurant center, Boba Tea House is where locals go for their favorite boba drinks. That’s because this popular spot offers a vast array of beverages—from milk teas and flavored teas, to slushies and smoothies—any of which you can add those pop-able boba treats to. Soft and chewy (never stale or soggy), boba comes in such flavors as strawberry, lychee and mango. Or for something different, try such add-ins as mini boba, pudding, red bean or jelly. And if you’re in the mood for snacks, Boba Tea House offers a small menu of munchies, including popcorn chicken, jalapeno poppers, and—for the truly adventurous—fish or squid balls.

Map: 2055 N. Dobson Rd, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 821-4008

Snowtime

Known for their unique and eye-catching Korean desserts, Snowtime specializes in “snow,” also known as shaved ice, served in their signature golden fish cones. But if you’re in the mood for a refreshing boba drink, you’ve come to the right place. Snowtime offers a variety of fresh leaf teas—from lychee green and mango black, to peach oolong and aloe green—that you can add “popping pearls” to. Available in passion fruit, mango, strawberry and lychee, these little gems will dress up any drink. And before you go, don’t forget to take a snap of your boba creation. The shop’s chic and homey vibe makes for the perfect backdrop to your latest like-worthy selfie.

Map: 2095 N. Dobson Rd., Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 268-7711

Rewind Ice Cream & Boba Tea

Part ice cream parlor, part cereal bar, part tea shop, Rewind rolls all these great things into one. Indulge with a signature ice cream swirl, milkshake, or cereal bowl…the combinations are nearly endless. But for something truly authentic, have one of their matcha drinks. Made with a finely ground powder of Japanese green tea leaves, the antioxidant- and mineral-rich drinks have a variety of health benefits. Flavors include the sweet matcha (made with sweet milk), strawberry matcha latte (homemade strawberry puree), and the matcha coffee (cold brew coffee). Add boba or crystal boba—and a scoop of ice cream for good measure, of course!

Map: 3245 W. Ray Rd. #3, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 466-0079

Sharetea

Feeling right at home at its new digs in Overstreet in downtown, Sharetea is the latest spot to join Chandler’s growing lineup of specialty tea shops and boba bars. Featuring drinks made with high-quality tea leaves shipped directly from Taiwan, the menu is filled with refreshing teas, including fruit, brewed, milk and ice blended. Signature selections include passion fruit, orange and grapefruit tea; lime or mango mojito; Okinawa pearl milk tea; and matcha red bean ice blended tea with ice cream. And if you think the tea flavors are impressive, check out their toppings, which include pearl boba, mini pearl, red bean, and an assortment of jellies (herb, aiyu, and lychee).

Map: 140 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 588-2181

DaYung’s Tea

Located in south Chandler, DaYung’s Tea is a quaint, neighborhood spot that offers a wide selection of made-to-order teas and beverages. Classic and seasonal teas are made with fresh fruits, while milk teas come in a variety of flavors. Signature drinks include the wintermelon lemon with chia seeds, the caramel boba latte, and the green milk tea with coconut jelly. Or try a macchiato made with black or green tea. All drinks can include such add-ins as boba, chia seeds, and jellies.

Map: 4055 S. Arizona Ave. Suite 3, Chandler, AZ 85248 or (480) 793-7733

Rapha Tea

If you like a little (or in this case, a lot) of variety when it comes to beverages, Rapha Tea is the place for you. Categorized by series, the menu offers everything from milk teas (original and flavored), special teas, fresh teas, coffee, juices, slushies and refreshers. But it’s Rapha’s “butterfly series” that has us thirsty for more. Composed of a juice made with lychee, wintermelon, passion fruit, rose lychee and guava, and butterfly tea, which is brewed from sweet pea flowers, when it’s poured, it creates an ombre effect. Toppings include golden boba, crystal boba, and star jelly, just to name a few.

Map for Chandler Blvd location: 1900 W. Chandler Blvd. #17, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 917-2900

Map for South Chandler location: 5025 S Gilbert Rd Ste 3 Chandler, AZ 85249 or (623) 920-7568

Hi 5 Tea

Hi 5 Tea, located in Uptown Chandler, boasts a full menu of tea flavors and boba selections. You'll find the classics, like Taro Milk Tea and Oolong Tea with lychee, or Hi 5 Signature drinks that include a Peach Mango Mojito and a Peach Kiwi Tea with jelly. Pair your tea with any fresh spring rolls or crab rangoons for a treat to satisfy. 

Map: 225 W. Warner Rd. #102, Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 534-4269

Boba Cutea 

You'll find a bright and colorful boba shop called Boba Cutea near Chandler Fashion Center. When you order a Strawberry Milk Bubble drink, you'll get it in their staple cup which is a clear cup with their logo and cat ears shaped into the lid! Their Strawberry Milk Bubble drink is made with fresh strawberries, strawberry jam, milk, and brown sugar boba. Don't forget to try the Mochi ice cream that comes in brown sugar, green tea, strawberry, chocolate and mango flavors! 

Map: 3400 W. Chandler Blvd. Suite 3, Chandler AZ 85226 or (480) 306-6847

Tea Fresho

Newly opened, Tea Fresho is serving freshly brewed tea along with great customer service. You'll find your new favorite boba shop in West Chandler where you can lounge in a modern space, that's decorated with plants everywhere you look. Tea Fresho's menu is full of blended, coffee, tea, and brown sugar drinks with the option to be made with milk alternatives, like almond, soy, and oat milk! 

Map: 6140 W. Chandler Blvd, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 207-1177

Sumo Snow

Sumo Snow is on a mission to deliver premium handcrafted boba teas as well as Korean street food and Asian desserts to customers in West Chandler. Some drinks they serve up at Sumo Snow include a Thai Tea Cream Foam, Strawberry Matcha, a Creme Brulee Milk, and more. Don't forget to try an original cheese dog or a Japanese Mille Crepe with your tea. 

Map: 5055 W. Ray Rd. #7, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 590-6624

RareTea

 

RareTea offers a wide variety of fresh brewed teas prepared in-house including milk tea, matcha, fruit tea and smoothies. Add a variety of different jellys and bobas to give your tea an extra "pop".

Map: 2990 E Germann Rd. #3, Chandler AZ 85286 or (480) 687-5723

Discover More Dining in South Chandler

bodyHtml:
Full of hidden gems, South Chandler is home to many fantastic dining, shopping, and entertainment experiences. Whether you’re trying to plan a trip or a local looking for things to do in Chandler, spend the day uncovering everything that the south side of Chandler has in store.

 

Dining in South Chandler

Mama Thai

They say nothing is better than a home-cooked meal, but nestled deep in South Chandler is a wonder that might just be better -- Mama Thai Kitchen. Get a taste of the authentic flavors of over 70 popular Thai dishes, including stir-fries, curries, Thai fried rice, noodles, and more. Relax on the patio or enjoy a meal inside this cozy little restaurant.

Location: 4995 S Alma School Rd #1, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 895-1499

 

 

Acai Republic

Fresh and healthy is an understatement at Acai Republic. Using all organic acai berries and freshly cut fruit, this is the perfect spot to pick up a refreshing acai bowl or smoothie for a healthier alternative. The bowls at Acai are even dietary friendly featuring a dairy-free base with many vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free add-ins. Stop in and experience the healthy lifestyle at Acai Republic.

Location: 4991 S Alma School Rd #11, Chandler AZ 85248 or (602) 805-7821

 

 

Cuisine & Wine Bistro

Upscale dining is at its finest here at Cuisine & Wine Bistro in South Chandler. Find an excellent selection of wines from around the world to pair with a classic charcuterie board and a French-cuisine-inspired menu inspired by the chef-owner's native roots. This fine-dining experience wouldn’t be complete without a certified sommelier on staff to help pair wines with some of the chef’s tasty offerings like the Berkshire pork shop or the famous escargots.  

Location: 4991 S Alma School Rd #101, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 275-6700

 

St. Amand Kitchen & Cocktails

It’s never too hot (or too cold) to dine on the luxurious patio at St. Amand’s where diners can relax year-round on this cooled and heated patio or dine and sip on delicious cocktails in this contemporary restaurant. Enjoy uniquely flavored cocktails paired with a wide variety of dishes that are sure to satisfy any appetite. Bring a friend or loved one and stop by to enjoy live music and specials every week.

Location: 3990 S Alma School Rd #3, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 782-5550

 

Turmeric Express Indian Grocery and Restaurant

Get a taste of all of South Chandler’s flavors and stop in to Turmeric Express for a delightful range of Indian food offerings. Dine-in and enjoy a hot traditional Indian meal like biryani, curry, or Pulav along with many other Indian classics. Don’t have time to dine? Turmeric Express also features a specialty ethnic grocery store with classic South Asian goods to add to your grocery list.

Location: 995 E Ocotillo Rd, Chandler AZ 85249 (480) 802-6879

South Chandler Shopping

 

Hornacek’s Golf Chandler

Looking for the perfect, sunny summer outfit for the golf course? Make your way to Hornaeck’s to find the latest in golf apparel, accessories and gear. This locally owned and operated store is a full-service Chandler golf shop offering everything from lessons to the ultimate in golf accessories, which makes it a snap to find great Father’s Day gifts for dad.

Location: 4975 S Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 802-5555

 

Precious Elements Jewelry & Coin  

Whether you are looking for the perfect graduation gift or celebrating a milestone anniversary, discover a hidden gem with a visit to south Chandler’s premier jewelry store, Precious Elements Jewelry & Coin. The one-of-a-kind jewelry store features a great selection of rare coins, consignment pieces, on-trend unique jewelry pieces and both gold and silver bullion.  

Location: 4980 S Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 659-6984

 

My Sisters’ Charities

The lazy days of summer make it a perfect time to visit Chandler thrift stores and you’ll discover a bevy of upscale, luxury furnishings, home decor, rugs, lighting and more to complement your eco-chic design alongside women’s and men’s clothing and accessories at the new My Sisters’ Charities. Thrift the day away with your best pals and celebrate the best of reduce and reuse knowing that 100 percent of the stores net profits are donated to local charities. This is a must stop for thrift shop enthusiasts as almost everything is priced from $1 -$10 and there is no sales tax. Talk about a feel-good shopping adventure!

Location: 4955 S Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 758-5286

South Chandler Entertainment & Recreation

 

Majestic Theater

The days of dinner and a movie are in the past at Majestic Chandler Movie Theater. Enjoy a variety of different movie selections all year long while trying a taste of the delicious dine-in menu served right to your seat. This savory menu features bottomless popcorn, pizzas, brunch (served all day), sandwiches, and so much more. Don’t forget to leave room before the end of the film to get your favorite candy or dessert.

Location: 4955 S Arizona Ave, Chandler AZ 85248 or (520) 213-8129

 

 

Ocotillo Golf Club

Explore the desert oasis at this premier golf course in South Chandler, featuring 27 different ranges of holes, a luxury golf shop, and dining at the club’s upscale restaurant, Tillo’s Kitchen & Patio. Take a swing around acres of luscious fairways, waterfalls, and desert landscape while enjoying a round of golf with friends or colleagues.

Location: 3751 S Clubhouse Dr, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 917-6660

 

Mix Cooking School

The days of over-salted and burnt dishes are over, with Mix Cooking School coming to the rescue. Learn how to put the fun and flavor back into your kitchen with a hands-on cooking class at this premier studio. Mix is the perfect place to bring out your inner chef and take home the skills you need to make healthy, delicious meals at home.

Location: 4995 S Alma School Rd, Suite 6, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 825-5293

 

 

Snedigar Park

This expansive South Chandler park has everything you need to enjoy a day outside in Chandler, AZ. Snedigar Recreation Center and Sportsplex is home to 90-acres of space featuring a mix of sports fields for athletes, a dog park for furry friends to play, a huge skate park for all skater levels, and lots of picnic tables and pavilion space for all kinds of activities.

Location: 4001 S Alma School Rd, Chandler AZ 85248

 

Rediscovering South Chandler is just the beginning. From lively downtown streets to serene desert parks and innovative culinary experiences, Chandler offers something new to enjoy with every visit. Make time to explore more of the city’s hidden gems and start planning your next Chandler getaway.

headings.text: Safety Tips for Hiking in Arizona

bodyHtml:
You can feel it in the air...it's near-perfect weather and time to enjoy the great outdoors! From outdoor dining to exploration of Chandler's desert parks, and nearby mountain preserves it's a great way to feel the sunshine and take-in the desert scenery.  Arizona has a reputation for offering excellent hiking and biking, and it's a great add-on to any Chandler trip.  However, it's important to be prepared and follow some basic safety guidelines before stepping out to enjoy the beautiful Sonoran desert.

Assess Yourself

Don't push yourself and if you have a medical condition; asthma, heart conditions, back problems, knee pains, etc. - check with your health care provider before going out. Keep in mind, if you have a doubt whether you should climb a trail or mountain - DON'T! Many may think that the climb up is more difficult, but the climb down is always the most challenging. It's important to not exceed your normal level of physical activity.  Chandler is home to a number of walking trails that are not as strenuous and ideal for a desert walk and are easily accessible by most people. 

Monitor the Weather

Arizona's temperate climate can be deceiving due to its generally low humidity, but it's easy to be caught off guard by an Arizona monsoon or sudden shower.  Even though Arizona is known for having a "dry heat" plan hikes for when the weather is cool in the early mornings or when early evenings bring more shade.

Dress Appropriately

Be mindful of the terrain and climate and wear proper clothing and outdoor essentials:

  • Lightweight and light colored clothes
  • Proper shoes
  • Hat
  • Sunglasses
  • Sunscreen

Water! 

This can't be said enough! Hydrate before you go and be sure to bring plenty of water; you will need more than you think. Drink constantly even if you do not feel thirsty and avoid caffeine and alcohol as these dehydrate the body. Another great tip - don't overindulge the day before on caffeine and alcohol.

Fuel Up

Take a break and eat before you are hungry to replace electrolytes that you are sweating out.  Granola bars are convenient and pack up nicely and taking periodic breaks five to seven minutes for every 30-60 minutes is a good idea to rest the body and take in the scenery.

Bring a Friend

Team up and hike Chandler desert parks and walking trails in groups of at least two and put slower hikers in front and pace the group to match that person.

Don't be a Trailblazer

Follow designated trails to avoid injury and be aware of your surroundings.

Stay in Contact

Plan your hike and make sure someone knows where you will be hiking and your estimated return. It's always a good idea to bring a cell phone.

Tag @VisitChandler

Be sure to tag @VisitChandler or use #VisitChandler for a chance to be featured on our social platforms or website galleries.

headings.text: Seven Ways to Explore Chandler's Sonoran Desert

bodyHtml:
The Sonoran Desert covers roughly half of Arizona, but standing in downtown Chandler, you really don’t see much evidence of it. And, that’s too bad because if you don’t experience the Sonoran Desert on some level while visiting Chandler, you’re missing out on a big part of what makes the area so unique.

Not sure how to experience the Sonoran Desert (or even where to go)? Here are seven ways you can explore and plenty of places to immerse yourself in the Sonoran Desert while visiting Chandler, Arizona.

Go for a hike

Hiking is one of the best ways to explore the Sonoran Desert, and Chandler is a short drive from two of the Valley’s most popular options: South Mountain Park and San Tan Regional Park. South Mountain Park spans nearly 17,000 square acres and has more than 50 miles of trails. Begin your visit with a stop at South Mountain Environmental Educational Center, the park’s visitors’ center, where you’ll find exhibits on local flora and fauna.  

Just south of neighboring Queen Creek, you can explore the Sonoran Desert in San Tan Regional Park. The park has several trails, including the 2.5-mile Goldmine Trail with its views of the East Valley, and a visitor center with a desert tortoise habitat.

Other options for Sonoran Desert hikes include Camelback Mountain, Piestewa Peak, and McDowell Sonoran Preserve. 

Before you head out, review some great safety tips for Hiking in Arizona!

Pedal the trails

Mountain bikes are welcome on most trails at South Mountain Park and San Tan Regional Park, as well as the McDowell Sonoran Preserve in Scottsdale. You can also ride a cruiser or bicycle along much of the Maricopa Trail, a 315-mile trail which cuts through Chandler and passes Sonoran Desert as it loops the Valley.

Several shops rent mountain bikes, cruises, and street bicycles, including Arizona Bike Rentals in Chandler. Arizona Outback Adventures in Scottsdale offers guided rides in addition to rentals. If you want to explore South Mountain Park on a mountain bike, Cactus Adventures will meet you with your rental at Arizona Grand Resort, just minutes from the park’s Pima Canyon Trailhead.

Ride the open range

You’re more likely to see wildlife on horseback than on foot or bike. At Koli Equestrian Center, watch for jackrabbits, quail and even wild horses as you ride through the Gila River Indian Reservation. Along the way, native guides point out the plants of the Sonoran Desert and share stories of their people and culture on daily group rides. Private rides can also be arranged.

If you want to ride in South Mountain Park, Ponderosa Stables is the only guided horse rental concessionaire permitted to operate in the park. You can book a 1-hour, 2-hour, 3-hour, 4-hour, or full day ride as well as breakfast, lunch, and dinner rides. Ponderosa also offers wagon rides if you’re traveling with small children. Whichever option you choose, your guide will tell you about the Sonoran Desert and its wildlife.

Take flight

For a bird’s-eye view of the Sonoran Desert, book a hot air balloon ride. Most rides begin at a low altitude allowing you to see jackrabbits, quail, roadrunner, and maybe even a coyote or deer. As the ride progresses, expect to reach approximately 3,000 feet (although some flights go as high as 5,000 feet depending on weather conditions). From this altitude, you can gain an appreciation for just how immense the Sonoran Desert is.

Three of the Valley’s most trusted balloon companies—Hot Air Expeditions, Rainbow Ryders, and Aerogelic Ballooning—launch north of Phoenix, but Aerogelic Ballooning offers south of the Valley launches, too.  Depending on the weather and the wind, you may fly over Chandler on an Aerogelic Ballooning flight.

Stroll through a desert park

You don’t have to go any further than Veterans Oasis Park in Chandler to experience the Sonoran Desert. The 113-acre park has 4.5-miles of trails through both arid landscapes and lush wetlands. While visiting, you can meander past the butterfly and hummingbird habitat, watch wildlife from camouflaged viewing areas, and take a selfie at the small waterfall.  

Discover desert plants

To learn more about the Sonoran Desert, drop by the park’s Chandler Nature Center. On display, you’ll find several desert exhibits, including actual desert animals. The center’s gift store is a great place to pick up books about the Sonoran Desert, native seeds, and other fun souvenirs.
If you’re interested in the plants of the Sonoran Desert, head to the Desert Botanical Garden. This world-renowned botanical garden five trails—Desert Discovery, Plants & People of the Sonoran Desert, Desert Wildflower, Sonoran Desert Nature, and Center for Desert Living—all of which provide information on the desert’s plants as well as its animals and people.

Several tours and classes can add to your understanding and appreciation of the Sonoran Desert. From October 1 through May 14, the botanical garden offers free, docent-led tours and sets up stations manned by docents who can answer questions. On Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday from October 3 to May 10, you can also take a free, behind-the-scenes horticulture tour of the Hazel Hare Center for Plant Science. These tours begin at 10 a.m.

 

Learn about desert animals

More interested in the animals of the Sonoran Desert than its plants? Head to the Phoenix Zoo instead. Located next door to the Desert Botanical Garden, it is home to more than 1,400 animals, making it the largest non-profit zoo in the nation. (It’s also one of the top five zoos for kids.)

For those interested in the Sonoran Desert, the zoo’s Arizona Trail is dedicated to native animals, including the Mexican grey wolf, coyote, Sonoran pronghorn, cougar, javelina, and rattlesnakes in the reptile house. Not only will you see these and other animals, but you’ll also learn how they have adapted to conditions here and continue to survive. 

Chandler is considered one of Arizona's premier birding spots with over 150 identified species calling Veterans Oasis Park home,

headings.text: Sip the Best Margaritas in Chandler

bodyHtml:
When life gives you limes, don’t just make margaritas—go out and find the best ones in town! Chandler has a seriously sippable margarita scene, and whether you’re into sweet, spicy, frozen or straight-up classic, there’s a glass (or pitcher) calling your name. We rounded up some of Chandler’s top spots where the margaritas are strong, the vibes are solid, and the happy hour deals are on point.

 

The Mexicano

One of Chandler's newest Mexican spots, The Mexicano is already a scene. Envision a DIY margarita bar (with garnishes galore) and DJs spinning while you sip on your very own Fuego Margarita served in a souvenir piñata cup. It’s extra and it knows it. Hit their daily happy hour in the bar area from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. for peak marg joy.

Address: 3095 W. Chandler Blvd, Chandler AZ 85226

 

Nando's Mexican Cafe

This family-friendly restaurant in south Chandler is a great spot for Mexican and Mexican-inspired dishes in their large dining room or on dining al fresco on their lush patio. Pop in for National Margarita Day on February 22nd to enjoy $6 Nando's Margaritas and $2 off all specialty margs, or score their delicious house margarita Monday through Saturday during happy hours.

Address: 1890 W. Germann Rd, Chandler AZ 85286

 

Taqueria Factory

Raise your glass and toast to a good margarita at Taqueria Factory. Their margaritas come in many enticing flavor options, including fresh lime, strawberry, mango, tamarind and pineapple! Each mouthwatering margarita is served with a salted rim and lime slice for a refreshing classic margarita. There are also several premium upgrades you can add to your margarita, including adding Herradura Tequila (for an additional $3) and Don Julio (for an additional $5). While you're there, be sure to enjoy a delicious quesabirria taco.

North Chandler Location: 55 E. Ray Rd, Ste 2, Chandler AZ 85225

South Chandler Location: 1155 W. Ocotillo Rd, Ste 1, Chandler AZ 85248

 

Valle Luna

If you’re the “give me a marg and a view” type, Valle Luna’s got you. It’s lakeside (yes, in Chandler), and the vibe is super relaxed. Order a La Pina marg, grab a seat with a view, and enjoy some Sonoran-style Mexican eats while the breeze does its thing.

Address: 1949 W. Ray Rd, Chandler AZ 85224

 

La Ristra

This place is for the tequila lovers. With more than 100 tequilas to choose from, you know they know their margaritas. Try the Jalapeno Margarita for a spicy kick or the Sangrita if you’re keeping it chill. Bonus points for the patio, where you can catch dusk turn to night while sipping something tasty.

Address: 140 N. Arizona Ave, Chandler AZ 85225
