headings.text: Six ethnic restaurants that may become your new favorites!

bodyHtml:
Walking around Chandler, it's easy to see how globally connected the community is, filled with adventurous and curiously minded foodies. In Chandler, Ariz., it's easy to dine locally and taste globally. Whether you're looking to shake things up a bit, introduce the kiddos to a new flavor profile or answer adventure's call - there are a number of top ethnic restaurants in Chandler for you to explore. We've unearthed a small sampling of six must-try restaurants in Chandler.

Chodang Tofu & BBQ - Korean fare

501 N. Arizona Ave.
480-855-7712
Discover authentic Korean fare at Chodang Tofu & BBQ in Uptown Chandler. House specialties include their Beef Bulgogi; tender, marinated beef with a definitive sweetness and sliced onion; and their Bi Bim Bap - a delightful, mixed rice dish served in a stone bowl. Upon ordering, all are served six small side dishes to whet your appetite, including kimchi, potato and apple salad, a potato stew and more.

Chou's Kitchen - Chinese cookery

910 N. Alma School Road
480-821-2888
Recognized by Travel & Leisure as one of the best Chinese restaurants in the U.S., Chou's Kitchen specializes in northeastern Chinese cuisine at this local, non-descript restaurant that makes you feel like you walked through a portal and right into Liaoning, where the owners originated. House specialties are the Xiao Long Bao (soup dumplings), green onion pancakes and spicy braised beef.

Elvira's Belizean Cafe

2386 N. Alma School Road, Suite 116
480-899-9024
Perhaps Arizona's only Belizean restaurant - Elvira's is best described as a blend of Latin and Carribbean-influenced dishes that will have you hungry for more.  From a  tasty appetizers, a variety of fresh fish dishes and delectable entrees served with your choice of seasoned coconut rice and beans or while rice with stewed beans, you'll be glad to pop in for a visit to this casual, family owned restaurant in Uptown Chandler.

  

Thai Rama - Thai food

2040 W. Chandler Blvd.
480-855-8989
Whether it is your first experience with Thai or you're a veteran of Thai cuisine, Thai Rama is a great family owned option where you can be adventurous or stick with tried and true Thai favorites. If it is your first visit - let the staff know and they will offer recommendations and help you select a comfortable spice level to personalize your dish. Local favorites include the savory, Jungle Princess Curry and their Paht Thai - flat rice noodles fried with chicken, shrimp, bean sprouts and scallions then topped with crushed peanuts and a lime wedge. Daily lunch specials include soup, spring roll and won-ton chips.

Tumi Fine Peruvian Cuisine - Peruvian cuisine

961 W. Ray Road
480-821-1717
Culinary offerings at Tumi Fine Peruvian Cuisine come by way of Chef Oscar Graham, born and raised in Lima, Peru who takes great care in his meals and serves flavorful dishes that will sweep you away to Peru. From the savory, Peruvian grilled chicken that has been marinated for a full day to the bright and expertly prepared ceviche - you're sure to find something to delight your taste buds!

Woodlands Vegetarian South Indian Kitchen- Indian restaurant

4980 W. Ray Road, #10
480-820-2249
A great place to enjoy a dosa, a paper-thin crepe made from a rice and lentil batter that provide that are filled with a variety of toppings and are a hallmark of South Indian cuisine.  Woodlands Vegetarian South Indian Kitchen offers a number of signature stuffing options along with a complimentary chutney bar brimming with various chutneys, pickled vegetables and savory/sweet sauces to customize your entrée to your specific tastes.

Tuesday, while to some may be known as the second day of the work week, for many has gained its fame and glory as Taco Tuesday. And we’re here for it – between Taco Tuesdays and National Taco Day, just about every day is perfect for enjoying a Chandler margarita paired with some of the best tacos in Chandler, Arizona.

Looking for tacos near you in Chandler, AZ? Here is a list of the best places to find tacos in Chandler. From Uptown and Downtown Chandler to South Chandler and the Chandler Airpark area – it’s easy to find great local taco shops throughout Chandler, AZ.

AZ MUCHO TACO – Hidden Gem for Authentic Mexican Tacos

Off the beaten track, AZ Mucho Taco is a surprising little gem in Chandler, offering great Taco Tuesday specials starting at $1.99/taco.  The family-owned restaurant is a popular lunch spot, offering casual, counter-style service and straightforward Mexican dishes with flavorful meats and sauces.

Map to AZ Mucho Taco: 914 N Alma School Rd, Chandler AZ 85224

BACKYARD TACO – Authentic Street-Style Tacos in South Chandler

Backyard Taco brings the flavor to South Chandler with its street-style tacos. The Chandler restaurant is known for its casual, backyard-like atmosphere, serving a variety of mesquite-grilled meat, including carne asada, pollo, pork pastor, and birria tacos, all in fresh, handmade tortillas. Don’t miss their unique Papa Loca, a baked potato loaded with taco fillings for a fun twist!

Map to Backyard Taco - Chandler: 2400 S Gilbert Rd, Chandler AZ 85286

CALITACOS – Game Day and Tacos in Uptown Chandler

Calitacos Restaurant serves traditional street-style tacos in a lively, game-day atmosphere.  This family-friendly restaurant in Uptown Chandler offers classic street-style tacos, birria, and rolled tacos, complemented by a full bar and TVs, making it an ideal spot for casual dining and game-day eats.

Map to Calitacos: 225 W Warner Rd, Suite A-101, Chandler AZ 85225

EL SOL MEXICAN CAFE & BAKERY - Homemade Tortillas & Sweet Treats

A Chandler favorite, El Sol Mexican Café & Bakery opened its doors in 1988 and has a local reputation for its authentic Mexican dishes and handmade tortilla pastries. The restaurant features a nice variety of tacos, including crunchy, soft or street-style tacos filled with assorted meats, including carnitas, pastor, grilled or shredded chicken & steak, and shrimp with house-made salsas. But be sure to save room for dessert, as El Sol makes fantastic Mexican sweets, including their fruit-filled empanadas, pan dulce (Mexican sweet bread), and traditional wedding cookies, baked fresh daily.

Map to El Sol: Mexican Cafe: 760 N Arizona Ave, Chandler AZ 85225

ELMER’S TACOS– Sonoran-Style Favorites Since 1974

Armed with his mother’s Sonoran-style recipes, Elmer Cuen opened this Chandler staple in 1974. It’s still going strong today, thanks in large part to its tacos. Diners have the option of ordering taco combination plates complete with beans and rice, or can opt to buy tacos individually and select from chicken, beef, pork, or potato-filled tacos. And on Taco Tuesday, you’re sure to find a special or two.

In addition to tacos, you’ll find an extensive menu for this little restaurant, complete with burros, flautas, taquitos, tostadas, burgers, and Indian fry bread at Elmer’s.

Map to Elmer's Tacos: 355 N Arizona Ave, Chandler AZ 85225

ESPO'S MEXICAN FOOD– A Chandler Classic for Over 50 Years

Espo's has a rich history in Chandler, having served the community for over 50 years. Diners flock to this Chandler restaurant for its fresh and flavorful Mexican cuisine, made from treasured family recipes. The menu features tacos filled with a variety of meats, served in crispy or soft tortillas, accompanied by fresh toppings and handcrafted sauces. 

As for Taco Tuesday, Espo's Mexican Food is practically an institution, offering its famous Taco Tuesday special: 10 street tacos for $12.50. This is a perfect option for dining with friends or colleagues on their cozy and inviting patio.

Map to Espo's Mexican Food: 3867 W Chandler Blvd, Chandler AZ 85226

MASKADORE’S TACO SHOP– Lucha Libre Fun and Flavor

Decorated with lucha libre masks, Maskadore’s Taco Shop serves up fun and fresh tacos, crafted to order. Start by selecting your favorite taco style: street, hard shell, flour, rolled or the quesadilla-inspired tacodilla. Then choose your meat: asada, barbacoa, chicken or carnitas, or for $2 more, opt for shrimp or fish. As you move through the line, you’ll be able to adjust the heat level and pick your toppings — and if you love spice, Maskadore’s knows how to spice it up, so be sure to order a beer, Mexican soda, or their delicious horchata to cool things down.

Map to Maskadore's Taco Shop: 2100 W Chandler Blvd Ste. 38, Chandler AZ 85224

MORENO'S MEXICAN GRILL – Local Favorite for Mexico City-Style Tacos

From its humble beginnings with a hot dog cart to multiple Chandler locations, Moreno’s Mexican Grill has become a top spot for authentic Mexico City-style cuisine and street tacos for Chandler locals. Choose from carne asada, adobada (pork marinated in red chili), or chicken, all topped with cilantro, onions, and cabbage for true street-style flavor.

  • Map to Moreno's location in North Chandler: 601 N Arizona Ave, Chandler AZ 85225
  • Map to Moreno's location in South Chandler: 4981 S Arizona Ave, Chandler AZ 85248
  • Map to Moreno's location in the Airpark Area: 2100 S Gilbert Rd, Chandler AZ 85286

THE TACO SPOT - Family Recipes and Instagram-Worthy Tacos in Chandler

This Chandler original now boasts several restaurant locations throughout Arizona, including their first-ever brick-and-mortar location, located just east of Downtown Chandler, and another in West Chandler. The Chandler-based taco chain, The Taco Spot, is popular with taco fans near and far for its selection of authentic tacos, birria, quesadillas, burritos and snacks from precious family recipes. Want to see why so many love this spot? Check out their Instagram for their crave-inducing pics that will have you craving tacos every day you are in Chandler!

  • Map to The Taco Spot location east of Downtown Chandler: 698 E Chandler Blvd Suite B, Chandler AZ 85225
  • Map to The Taco Spot location in West Chandler: 885 N 54th St Suite 3, Chandler AZ 85226

TAQUERIA FACTORY – Authentic Mexican Street Food

Taqueria Factory serves authentic Mexican cuisine made fresh from family recipes, where the meats are marinated for at least 24 hours for full flavor. Tacos are served in freshly made tortillas with fresh vegetable toppings and several homemade salsas. Upgrade your taco meal by ordering a refreshing mangonada, a sweet and spicy mango slush with chamoy, lime juice, and chili powder, or a michelada for a full treat! Taqueria Factory has two locations in Chandler, one in Uptown Chandler and the other in South Chandler.

  • Map to Taqueria Factory location in Uptown Chandler: 55 E Ray Rd, Chandler AZ 85225
  • Map to Taqueria Factory location in South Chandler: 1155 W Ocotillo Rd Ste #1, Chandler AZ 85248

TAQUERIA MI CASITA  – Authentic Tacos and Weekend Menudo

This casual eatery is a go-to staple for authentic Mexican cuisine at affordable prices. Choose from a variety of taco meats, including chicken, carne asada, pastor, carnitas, shredded beef, chorizo, tilapia, lengua (tongue), or buche (pork stomach). Each taco is topped with fresh cilantro, onions, and house-made salsa, along with optional extras such as guacamole, sour cream, cheese, pico de gallo, radishes, or fried chiles.

In addition to tacos, Taqueria Mi Casita offers burros, enchiladas, tortas, quesadillas, and tostadas, as well as special menudo on weekends. Don't miss the flan made from Abuela’s (Grandma’s) recipe for dessert!

Map to Taqueria Mi Casita: 2050 N Alma School Rd, Chandler AZ 85224

VALLE LUNA MEXICAN RESTAURANT - Lakeside Tacos and Margaritas

Enjoy tacos and a view when you make your way to Valle Luna Mexican Restaurant and are seated on their expansive, waterfront patio. The best way to enjoy tacos is by ordering their tasty and classic taco basket, which comes with your choice of six mini shredded beef or chicken crispy tacos. Can’t decide? Opt for a mix with half of each! In addition to the taco basket, options include tacos purchased a la carte or with taco combination plates paired with classic Mexican entrees and weekly specials.

Map to Valle Luna: 1949 W Ray Rd, Chandler AZ 85224

Chandler is home to many locally owned taco shops, many of which have a long history in the community, offering authentic Mexican flavors. Whether you're here looking for a Taco Tuesday meal, a late-night bite, or a weekend dinner, these Chandler restaurants deliver on bold flavors with fresh ingredients and Chandler hospitality.

Make a night of it — explore more local restaurants in Chandler, or plan your visit around a Chandler event this weekend for the ultimate local experience.

bodyHtml:
It's that special time of year we all love - where great weather and fabulous food come together for patio season! From brunch to cozy dates and everything in between, this is the time of year to find that perfect patio and the best outdoor seating for your next meal al fresco in Chandler, AZ. Check out our quick list of the most unique outdoor dining restaurants in Chandler right now.

Stone & Vine Urban Italian, located in south Chandler, is a contemporary Italian restaurant with a casual, yet refined vibe. The restaurant is known for its homemade pasta, wood-fired pizzas, authentic Italian dishes, cocktails and an extensive list of wine by the glass. The large, semi-shaded patio offers a great lakeside view and is perfect for an evening out with friends or for a romantic date.

A fabulous patio for celebrations and special meals, The Hidden House is an unexpected treasure in Downtown Chandler. Tucked away from the main square, but close to parking, the restaurant is set in a 1930s cottage and is the perfect mix of fancy and friendly. The patio features just the right amount of trees for a bit of shade, fabulous lighting and great sunset views. In addition to its amazing ambiance - the restaurant offers an excellent selection of seasonal, American dishes and has a strong reputation for its extensive cocktail program.

This creative brunch eatery offers Instagram-worthy food and drinks and is a go-to spot for Chandler foodies. Hash Kitchen's creative breakfast and bar dishes including its divine, build-your-own Bloody Mary bar are perfectly enjoyed on its lively patio.

Located in Downtown Chandler, Chandler's largest brewery first opened in 2007 and has an amazing vibe. Whether you are looking to relax and enjoy a beer on tap after a desert hike or meet up with friends to chat the day away, this great wrap-around patio offers fantastic views of the historic square. The Chandler brewery is also home to one of the many Downtown Chandler murals that dot the district.

Great for families and those with a craving for Mexican food, Valle Luna Mexican Restaurant offers one of the largest lakeside patios in Chandler in addition to its Sonoran-style dishes. The family-friendly restaurant features an expansive patio including a section of it is set aside for the cantina which offers not only the full menu, but happy hour food and drink specials.

Enjoy a unique dining experience at this fashionable yet inviting craft brewery located in Downtown Chandler. In addition to its upscale pub fare, locals celebrate The Perch for its lush, exotic bird-filled garden and expansive rooftop bar – offering unique views of Downtown Chandler.

Located near Chandler Fashion Center, Hop Social Grill is a family-owned restaurant featuring an entirely scratch-made American menu with 52 brews on tap, set in a modern, industrial space that is big on ambiance. The restaurant also has a Chef's table for eight that is adjacent to the exposed kitchen for a dynamic setting.

St. Amand Kitchen & Cocktails is a cocktail themed restaurant offering an elevated dining experience in south Chandler. Sip on a hand-crafted cocktail or a glass of wine with your meal while enjoying an incredible dining experience on their temperature-controlled patio.

This is just a start - discover more outdoor dining options or search a more complete listing of Chandler restaurants for your next visit to Chandler!

bodyHtml:
Labor Day weekend is the perfect time to savor the final days of summer, and Chandler, AZ offers a memorable mix of culture, family fun, entertainment, great food, and relaxing staycation vibes. Whether you’re catching a blockbuster, exploring local art, unwinding poolside, or discovering Chandler’s indoor attractions, this guide highlights the best ways to celebrate Labor Day weekend in Chandler.

 

Labor Day Events & Activities in Chandler

 

Catch a Laugh at Mic Drop Comedy

Kick off the holiday weekend with a laugh-out-loud set at Mic Drop Comedy in Downtown Chandler. This boutique-style venue offers an intimate indoor-outdoor atmosphere, no drink minimum, and a lineup of talented comedians, including Keith Pedro performing Sunday, September 6. Pair the show with dinner or drinks in Downtown Chandler, and you've got yourself a great summer date night in Chandler, AZ.

 

See a Summer Blockbuster

Cool off inside Chandler’s luxury cinemas and enjoy a Labor Day weekend film in comfort. Choose from three exceptional theatres:

  • Harkins Theatres at Chandler Fashion Center at 3111 W. Chandler Blvd., Chandler, AZ 85226
  • Harkins Theatres Crossroads at 2980 East Germann Rd. Chandler, AZ 85286
  • Majestic Chandler Neighborhood Cinema Grill at 4955 S Arizona Ave, Chandler, AZ 85248

 

From full‑service bars and elevated concessions to dine‑in menus at Majestic, Chandler’s movie theatres offer everything needed for a relaxing cinematic escape. Labor Day weekend showtimes fill quickly, so be sure to reserve tickets early.

Explore History, Culture & Art at the Chandler Museum

Spend an inspiring afternoon at the Chandler Museum, home to rotating exhibits that blend local heritage with nationally significant stories. Admission is free, making it a budget-friendly cultural experience for families, locals, and history lovers.

 

Featured Exhibits

 

Being Eddie Basha (March 10, 2026 – Summer 2027)
Discover the life and legacy of Eddie Basha, one of Arizona’s most influential leaders. This exhibit highlights his work as a businessman, education advocate, and arts champion whose impact shaped communities statewide.

 

Radio that Rocked the Valley (March 24 – September 27, 2026)
Travel back in time through vintage broadcast technology and stories of iconic voices like Pat McMahon and Al McCoy. Developed with the House of Broadcasting, it celebrates radio's role in shaping Valley culture.

 

The Mask of Lincoln (July 7 – December 2026)
Featuring ten Smithsonian-curated portraits, this exhibit explores how Abraham Lincoln used photography to shape his public image during one of the country’s most pivotal eras.

The museum offers a meaningful way to connect with history year-round and is a great indoor option during warm holiday weekends.

Discover Chandler’s Public Art: Choose Chandler Mural Quest

Add a dose of creativity to your weekend with the Choose Chandler Mural Quest, a free, gamified, mobile passport experience that leads you to some of Chandler’s most vibrant murals. Check in at each stop to earn points and explore colorful neighborhoods across the city.

 

Cool Indoor Fun for Labor Day Weekend in Chandler

If you’re looking to beat the heat, Chandler’s indoor entertainment centers offer hours of excitement:

  • Andretti Indoor Karting & Games - High-speed electric go-karts, virtual reality, 3‑D interactive games, and a massive arcade deliver non-stop fun for all ages.
  • Escape Chandler - Test your teamwork and puzzle‑solving skills as you race the clock to break out of themed escape rooms.
  • Game Show Battle Rooms - Step into a game show-style arena where you compete in fast-paced challenges inspired by classic TV favorites.
  • Round1 Bowling & Arcade - Enjoy bowling, billiards, karaoke, and arcade games late into the night — Round1 at Chandler Fashion Center is open until 2 a.m.

Dining & Drink Recommendations

 

Monday Brunch at SanTan Brewing

Wrap up the holiday weekend with a relaxed Monday brunch at SanTan Brewing in Downtown Chandler (9 AM–2 PM). Enjoy craft cocktails and hearty dishes like their rib & brisket combo plate, perfect for gathering with friends and family.

 

Craft Cocktails at The Ostrich

For an adults-only outing, head to The Ostrich, a speakeasy-style bar tucked beneath Crust Chandler. With expertly crafted cocktails served in a cozy, vintage venue, it’s an ideal spot to stay cool and savor Chandler’s craft beverage scene.

 

Cool Off with Refreshing Treats

Beat the heat with icy treats throughout Chandler:

  • 16 Handles - Artisan frozen yogurt and a nearly endless toppings bar.
  • Brooker's Founding Flavors Ice Cream - Premium ice cream with Revolutionary-era flavor.
  • Milk Shake Factory - Handspun milkshakes with housemade ice cream.
  • Snowtime - Award-winning shaved ice in delicious, creative flavors.
  • Tea Snow Boba & Coffee - Refreshing boba drinks with fruity and flavorful options.
  • The Screamery - Handcrafted ice cream featuring traditional and modern flavors with no preservatives.

Explore local shops

 

Labor Day weekend is a great time to enjoy some retail therapy.

  • Chandler Fashion Center offers more than 180 stores ranging from luxury brands to everyday essentials.
  • Downtown Chandler features unique boutiques and specialty shops perfect for discovering local finds.
  • Merchant Square Antique Marketplace brings treasure hunters more than 250 vendors of antiques, vintage décor, and collectibles.

Don’t forget to check for Labor Day discounts and seasonal sales throughout the weekend.

Where to Stay in Chandler

Make the most of the long weekend by staying at one of Chandler’s top hotels. With luxurious amenities, cooling pools, and summer packages, it’s the perfect time for a relaxing staycation.

  • Marriott Phoenix Chandler - Upscale accommodations, on-site dining, and modern style.
  • Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort - Resort amenities, poolside service, and access to the historic San Marcos Golf Course.

Plan your stay at these Chandler hotels for a relaxing Labor Day escape!

 

Plan Your Labor Day Weekend in Chandler

From cultural adventures and indoor excitement to brunch, chilled treats, and poolside relaxation, Chandler offers endless ways to enjoy Labor Day weekend. Start planning your visit now and make the most of summer’s final holiday in Chandler, AZ.

bodyHtml:
When the Arizona sun is shining, Chandler offers plenty of refreshing ways for families to cool off and enjoy the outdoors. From free spray pads perfect for little ones to full‑scale aquatic centers with slides and lazy rivers, the city makes it easy to turn a warm day into a fun‑filled adventure. Whether you’re visiting for the weekend or planning a summer staycation, these splash spots are must‑stops for beating the heat.

 

Top Chandler Parks to Splash & Play

Chandler’s spray pads are open seasonally and offer a safe, easy way for kids to splash, play, and cool down with plenty of on-site amenities. 

 

Desert Breeze Park 

Home to a colorful spray pad that attracts parents and children from across the city. The aquatic play area includes interactive sprayers, fountains, and splash zones, making it an ideal destination for mini-adventurers. Beyond the spray pad, the facility also features a playground, train rides, a scenic lake, and covered picnic areas. At this popular destination, spontaneous outings become lasting memories. Desert Breeze Park's splash pad is ideal for toddlers and younger kids who want to splash without going into deep water.

 

Espee Park Spray Pad

This modern spray pad offers interactive water features and plenty of open space for running through the fountains. Families love the nearby skate park, sports fields, and shaded picnic areas. It’s a lively and energetic setting that invites kiddos to explore and let their imaginations run wild.

 

Chuparosa Park

This hidden gem has well-shaded splash spaces perfect for sunny days. Older kids will appreciate the nearby playground and the basketball and sand volleyball courts, while younger ones will love the four spray rings. Restrooms and reservable picnic shelters make things easy, allowing the whole crew to stay focused on having fun instead of worrying about logistics.

Dive Into Chandler's Aquatic Centers for Water-Fueled Fun

 

Desert Oasis Aquatic Center

Discover variety and neighborhood charm with plenty of ways to stay cool at this water park. It offers a spacious pool, a zero-depth play area with a kiddie slide and water features, a twisting figure-eight slide, a deep-water drop slide, shaded seating, and a sand volleyball court, with year-round park access.

 

Hamilton Aquatic Center

This is a can’t-miss spot, with pools, twisting slides, a current river, and a towering interactive play structure. Ramadas and other amenities make it easy to spend an afternoon here. It’s among Chandler’s most well-rounded aquatic destinations, perfect for birthday parties or summer weekends.

 

Mesquite Groves Aquatic Center

Round out your water adventure options with something for everyone, from a lazy river and waterfall bridge to a play pool with a giant tumble bucket. With two waterslides, a water vortex, a spray pad, and a competition pool, it’s a top pick for both laid-back swimmers and adventure lovers.

 

Nozomi Aquatic Center

Nozomi combines classic swimming fun with spray attractions, offering something for every age and energy level. Playful explorers can have a blast in the spray play areas, while older kids may opt to unwind under the shade of the ramadas. With experiences ranging from zero-depth entry to a 112-foot water slide, this Chandler water park will keep the entire family entertained. 

 

Tips for Visiting Chandler’s Splash Pads & Water Parks

Before heading to one of these spray pads, splash zones, or water parks, pack like a pro and make the most of your visit with these simple tips:

  • Bring water shoes — surfaces can get warm.
  • Pack sunscreen, hats, and towels.
  • Visit in the morning or late afternoon for cooler temps.
  • Bring snacks and plenty of water.
  • Check seasonal hours before you go.

Make It a Full Day of Summer Fun in Chandler


Chandler’s spray pads and water parks are just the beginning. Many are located near playgrounds, shaded picnic areas, and family‑friendly restaurants, making it easy to plan a full day of summer fun. And with a variety of hotels offering cool pools and hot rates with comfortable amenities, Chandler is the perfect home base for your next warm‑weather getaway.

bodyHtml:
Chandler makes it easy to unplug, slow down and enjoy meaningful time alone. Peaceful green spaces, scenic trails, coffee shops and spa experiences give you room to wander, read, write, work or simply sit without having to plan around anyone else. When exploring on your own, choose one restorative stop or connect several, depending on how much you’d like to fit into the day.

Plans can remain light. A walk may last 20 minutes or an entire morning, and a cafe break can double as a remote-work session. The best things to do alone in Chandler leave room to change your mind.

Enjoy the Outdoors

Lakes, desert landscapes, wildlife habitats and miles of multiuse trails make Chandler’s parks and outdoor spaces natural places to clear your head. Whether you prefer a leisurely walk or exploring on two wheels, there are plenty of opportunities to move at your own pace while taking in the scenery.

Veterans Oasis Park

Choose Veterans Oasis Park when you want to trade indoor routines for wetland and Sonoran Desert habitats. Across its 113 acres, you’ll discover 4.5 miles of groomed dirt trails and paths, plus a 0.4-mile paved path around its 5-acre fishing lake. Opt for a compact lap or continue farther along the dirt-trail network.

Birdwatching gives a solo visit a natural point of focus. More than 153 species have been documented at the park, and the recharge basins, riparian areas and native plants attract local and migratory birds. Bring binoculars, pause at the wildlife-viewing areas or pop inside the Chandler Nature Center to see its nature displays.

Reflection comes easily beside the lake or along a dirt path. Sunrise and sunset also bring especially striking views across the water and nearby trails.

Desert Breeze Park

Open grassy areas give Desert Breeze Park a different rhythm. Paths wind around a lake and through the 47-acre park, and shaded pavilions provide places to rest. The Hummingbird Habitat introduces native and desert-adapted plants that often draw hummingbirds and butterflies.

Desert Breeze adds movement to your schedule without a major hike. Follow the lakeside path, sit near the water or take a book to an open lawn.

Settle In at a Local Coffee Shop

A cafe provides light structure: order a drink, choose a seat and decide what comes next. Several coffee shops offer distinct settings for reading, journaling, remote work or an unhurried break.

Maple House

Maple House occupies a former 1940s residence, lending it the feel of a neighborhood gathering place. Indoor and outdoor seating lets you match the space to your mood. Its Downtown Chandler setting also helps when the rest of your plans center on the district.

Coffee leads the morning menu; wine, craft beer and cocktails broaden the choices later. Use the time to concentrate on a passion project, read a bit or escape the hustle and bustle of daily life.

Sagebrush Coffee

Specialty coffee takes center stage at Sagebrush Coffee. The roastery showcases offerings from producers around the world through pour-overs, classic espresso drinks and small batch, freshly-roasted beans. Loose-leaf tea and a specialty and seasonal menu featuring house-made syrup mixes add more options to a Sagebrush stop.

Midcentury touches give the shop a stylish look and create a great spot to sip slowly, ease into the space, get some writing done or knock out a project on your laptop.

Coffee Rush

A lakefront patio sets Coffee Rush apart, adding water views to a menu of brewed coffee, espresso drinks, cold brew, iced coffee, chai, matcha, Italian sodas and blended drinks. Indoor seating offers another choice when the weather or your schedule calls for it.

Free Wi-Fi and available outlets support remote work, while the patio suits a screen-free break. Pick the view that matches your purpose and stay long enough to finish a chapter or one defined task. Later hours also accommodate solo plans after you’ve handled the day’s responsibilities.

Treat Yourself to a Relaxing Spa Experience

Self-care can provide the centerpiece of time alone rather than an activity squeezed between other plans. A scheduled treatment sets aside a protected block of time, while spa amenities allow the quiet to continue after the appointment ends.

The NOW Massage Chandler

Located near Chandler Fashion Center, The NOW Massage Chandler offers a quieter kind of reset. The boutique specializes in Swedish-inspired massage treatments designed to help guests relax and recharge. It works well as a standalone wellness stop or as a break between shopping, dining and other activities in the area.

The menu includes 25-, 50- and 80-minute sessions, making it easy to fit a treatment into your schedule. Choose The NOW for a classic Swedish-inspired massage, The Healer for an energy-balancing experience or The Stretch for a sports-inspired treatment that helps improve range of motion and reduce recovery time. Enhancements such as crystal hot stones, herbal heat therapy, gliding cupping and scalp renewal allow you to further personalize your session.

Aji Spa

Aji Spa at Wild Horse Pass combines contemporary services and the sacred doctrines of the Pima and Maricopa tribes. Aji’s Cultural Caretakers developed its Indigenous Collection, which includes a Nahtogig treatment using prickly pear, blue cornmeal, honey and salt. The full menu also covers massages, facials, body treatments, nail services and salon appointments.

An Aji Massage offers a straightforward place to begin. You can select a 50- or 80-minute session, and the customizable service uses light to medium pressure. Other choices incorporate body scrubs, wraps or Indigenous stories, so read the descriptions and select the service that best fits the kind of renewal you need.

Every booking includes day use of the fitness center, private indoor and outdoor whirlpools, saunas, steam rooms, spa pool and relaxation lounge. Guests must be 18 or older to receive treatments and use the amenities.

Tips for Enjoying Solo Time in Chandler

Give yourself permission to keep plans flexible. One of the perks of exploring alone is the freedom to linger over coffee, spend an extra hour at a park or change course entirely if something catches your interest.

Take advantage of Chandler's sunshine. Early mornings and evenings are often ideal for walks, bike rides and time outdoors, especially during warmer months.

Mix activity with downtime. Pair a visit to a park or trail with a coffee stop or spa treatment to create a day that feels balanced rather than over-scheduled.

Bring something to focus on. A notebook, book, camera or sketchpad can help turn a simple outing into a more intentional experience.

Solo time looks different for everyone. Some travelers find it on a quiet trail, others over a cup of coffee or during an afternoon at the spa. Chandler makes space for all of it, offering plenty of ways to slow down and enjoy your own company along the way. Start planning your visit and discover what a day designed entirely around your interests can look like.

bodyHtml:
Swing into Chandler this spring and catch more than just a baseball game when you make Chandler your home base for Spring Training. Each spring, 15 MLB teams play across 10 Greater Phoenix stadiums with a jam-packed Cactus League Spring Training 2026 schedule. Baseball fans revel in the intimate, pre-season games where it’s not uncommon to meet players and coaches, making it a memorable experience for friends and family.

Spring Training season in Chandler, AZ, is a home run for spring vacations, offering top-rated hotels, craft breweries, and family-friendly attractions. Our Cactus League Baseball Spring Training guide will help you make the most of your spring training trip with suggestions on where to stay, things to do in Chandler during Spring Training, and great eats along the way!

When is Cactus League Spring Training?

This year's Spring Training near Chandler runs from February 20 - March 24, 2026, featuring 15 MLB teams playing over 200 games.

Where to Stay During Spring Training

Chandler Hotels are an excellent choice for your Spring Training trip, offering convenient access to all 10 stadiums where you can catch a game. Generally, hotels in Chandler are only a short 20-minute drive from the airport, with stadiums located 5 to 45 minutes away by car. Furthermore, all Cactus League teams play at each stadium, ensuring you have the chance to cheer on your favorite team.

A perfect option for a spring training getaway with friends is the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort. This resort features spacious rooms, an 18-hole championship golf course, and a resort-style pool. It's located in a vibrant downtown district where you’ll find nearly 50 unique restaurants, bars, and entertainment options just steps away from the resort lobby.

Another great choice is the Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Phoenix/Chandler Fashion Center, located near the Chandler Fashion Center mall. This hotel offers comfortable rooms, complimentary breakfast, a heated outdoor pool, and easy access to freeways, making it ideal for visitors attending Spring Training games while also exploring the city.

Things to Do with Kids During Spring Training

It’s no surprise that Spring Training and spring breaks often overlap – but no worries here! It’s easy to find family fun activities in Chandler. Whether you’ve got rambunctious little ones or hard-to-impress teens, Chandler has plenty of things to do as a family.

From high-speed karting at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games to discovering vintage trains at the Arizona Railway Museum or an action-packed day at Round1 Bowling & Arcade for games, bowling, Karaoke, and crane machines – Chandler offers a large variety of things to do with kids. Adults and kids alike can also enjoy Slick City Action Park in West Chandler, an indoor family amusement park featuring indoor slides and attractions that are fun for the whole family.

Hit the Trails During Spring Training

Exploring the desert trails near Chandler is a popular spring activity and a great way to soak up the sun. Hiking offers breathtaking views, unique wildlife, and the chance to experience Arizona’s stunning desert landscapes. Hikers can visit San Tan Mountain Regional Park for scenic trails with rolling desert hills, or head to South Mountain Park for panoramic views of the valley. For a peaceful yet rewarding hike, Veterans Oasis Park offers nature trails, birdwatching, and serene desert scenery right in the city, which is easily accessible for most abilities. Be sure to review and follow hiking safety tips, including recommended attire, best practices, and bringing plenty of water.

Indulge in a Shopping Spree 

Who says shopping isn’t a major sport? Kick off your shopping spree at Chandler Fashion Center, where you’ll find more than 180 stores to explore. From high-end women’s fashions to the perfect athletic wear at Lululemon to fine leather goods at COACH, this Chandler mall has it all. Check out SCHEELS, where sports lovers will feel like kids in a candy store. After all that shopping, relax with a bite to eat or catch a movie at the on-site theater.

Take a stroll through Downtown Chandler’s pedestrian-friendly walkways and discover several things to do, along with a mix of unique shops and boutiques. Pop into d’Vine Gourmet for unique Arizona-made products, or Blue Planet Outdoors for eco-friendly gifts and gear.

In West Chandler, The Shoppes at Casa Paloma offers an upscale vibe with a blend of high-end national retailers and Chandler boutiques, perfect for indulging in a little retail therapy. Afterward, grab a relaxing meal at one of the shopping center’s cozy cafes – most of which feature inviting patios, including coal-fired, brick oven pizza at Grimaldi’s Pizzeria, or enjoy a made-from-scratch, health-conscious meal at Flower Child, catering to a variety of tastes.

Dine Alfresco at Chandler Restaurants with Patios

Patio season is happening now, and there is no better time to enjoy it. Outdoor dining in Chandler offers a vibrant mix of scenic patios, rooftop bars, and garden-style seating, perfect for enjoying Chandler’s 80-degree days. Visitors can enjoy a variety of dining experiences, including handcrafted pasta at The Sicilian Butcher, all set in a charming park-like atmosphere. Upscale cuisine is available at DC Steak House, along with many other Chandler restaurants that offer patio seating. Guests can bask in the sunshine during the day or dine under twinkling patio lights in the evening. 

Sip on Local Craft Beers During Spring Training

Chandler is home to several craft breweries and distilleries where beer enthusiasts can enjoy a diverse selection of handcrafted brews. Visitors can sip on award-winning IPAs and stouts at SanTan Brewing Company, savor top-tier European-style beers and enjoy a beer garden experience at Pedal Haus Brewery, take in the rooftop views at The Perch Brewery, or explore artisan taps at Helluva Brewing Company.

bodyHtml:
Spending St. Patrick’s Day in Chandler comes with its own kind of luck. Whether you’re plotting a full-on pub crawl or just craving a plate of corned beef and cabbage, the city leans into the holiday in all the right ways. Pints are poured properly. Patios fill up fast. And yes, there’s plenty of green to go around.

Here’s how to celebrate St. Patrick’s Day in Chandler in 2026.

Go Big: High-Energy Celebrations & Live Entertainment

Murphy’s Law Irish Pub

Why limit the fun to one day? Murphy’s Law stretches the celebration from March 13–17 with back patio festivities that feel more like a mini festival than a single-night party.

Expect live music, DJs, green beer (of course), and a crowd ready to celebrate. The pub fare is hearty, the pints are steady, and the energy builds as the weekend rolls on. Whether you’re catching up with friends at the bar or dancing it off outside, this is a go-to for doing St. Patrick’s Day the proper way. Wear green. Bring your crew. Have fun.

Address: 58 S San Marcos Pl., Chandler, AZ 85225

 

Pedal Haus Brewery

On March 17, Pedal Haus opens early — and they’re not slowing down. From 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., look for festive drink specials, Irish stouts and spirited shots to match the mood. The kitchen joins in with holiday favorites like corned beef and cabbage, fish and chips, and a hearty fish sandwich.

A live DJ keeps the patio lively in the early afternoon, followed by a live band that carries the celebration into the evening. It’s upbeat, a little loud, and exactly the kind of atmosphere some people look forward to all year.

Address: 95 W Boston St, Chandler, AZ 85225

 

Thirsty Lion Scratch Kitchen & Craft Cocktails

Known for eclectic scratch-made dishes and craft cocktails, Thirsty Lion brings a full lineup of seasonal specials to St. Patrick’s Day weekend. Expect Scotch eggs, Irish shepherd’s pie, Guinness beef stew, beer-braised corned beef and cabbage, and even corned beef mac & cheese.

The Chandler Fashion Center location adds live entertainment on Saturday, March 14, with Irish dancers at 3 p.m. and bagpipers at 4:45 p.m. Pair it all with an Irish Mule or Irish Old Fashioned, and you’ve got yourself a proper toast.

Address: 3077 W Frye Rd, Chandler, AZ 85226

Classic Irish Fare & Laid-Back Celebrations

Chompie’s Restaurant, Deli and Bakery

A family-friendly favorite that puts the focus on the food, Chompie’s serves up a corned beef feast on March 17 from 11 a.m. to close. The all-you-can-eat special features their famous corned beef, broiled red potatoes, cabbage and fresh-baked Irish soda bread.

Prefer something lighter? Single-plate options are available — and yes, Lovey’s Leprechaun dessert makes an appearance. It’s classic, comforting and exactly what you hope St. Patrick’s Day tastes like.

Address: 3481 W Frye Rd, Chandler, AZ 85226

Cork & Craft

This South Chandler favorite blends live music, craft cocktails and a welcoming neighborhood vibe. For St. Patrick’s Day, Cork & Craft features authentic Irish fare, including hearty staples like corned beef and cabbage and shepherd’s pie — ideal for those who want to celebrate without the full-on party scene.

Address: 4920 S Gilbert Rd #3, Chandler, AZ 85249

Can’t Pick Just One? Do the Bar Crawl

Downtown Chandler St. Patrick’s Day Weekend Bar Crawl

If choosing just one stop feels impossible, you don’t have to. The annual Chandler St. Patrick’s Day Weekend Bar Crawl lets you bounce between participating bars and breweries in one festive sweep.

Expect drink specials, themed fun and plenty of green attire in every direction. Grab your friends, map your route and settle in for a day (or night) of hopping between Downtown Chandler favorites. Be sure to check the official event page for participating venues and ticket details.

Plan Your Lucky Day

St. Patrick’s Day weekend in Chandler runs March 14–17, 2026, with some celebrations starting even earlier. It's patio season and patios will fill quickly, so plan ahead and check individual venues for updated menus and entertainment schedules.

More restaurants and bars are likely to announce specials as the holiday gets closer. You can also browse the Visit Chandler events calendar for additional happenings around town.

Whether you’re here for the corned beef, the craft beer, the live music or just an excuse to dress head-to-toe in green, Chandler makes it easy to celebrate.

headings.text: Stay Cool This Summer in Chandler, AZ

bodyHtml:
When the Arizona sun is shining bright, it's the perfect excuse to plan a refreshing, summer weekend escape to Chandler, AZ. Treat yourself to a getaway filled with cool aquatic fun, icy treats, and inviting indoor attractions that make beating the heat feel like part of the adventure. Whether you’re splashing with the family, savoring a sweet indulgence, or exploring the city’s vibrant culture, Chandler sets the stage for a weekend that’s equal parts relaxing and energizing.


Make it a true retreat by turning your visit into an overnight stay. Chandler offers a variety of welcoming hotels with sparkling pools, summer‑friendly amenities, and great weekend hotel specials to make your trip even sweeter. Explore current summer special offers and start planning your stay.

Pools and Aquatic Centers

Make a splash in Chandler, where a variety of pools and aquatic centers provide the perfect escape for summer fun. Start your adventure at Desert Oasis Aquatic Center. With its thrilling water slides and interactive water play features, it’s a mini-water park perfect for a family outing. Next, head to Hamilton Aquatic Center, where you’ll find a zero-depth play pool, water vortex, and “current river” that mimics a natural waterway. It’s an ideal spot to beat the heat while having a blast!

 

For a day of swimming and sliding, Mesquite Groves is a fantastic choice. Complete with a ramada and family dressing rooms, it’s ideal for families looking to enjoy the interactive water play areas in comfort and style. At Nozomi Aquatic Center, dive into fun with diving boards, a 112-foot figure-eight water slide, and numerous play features that ensure everyone gets thoroughly drenched and cooled off.

 

If you’re in the mood for a more relaxing swim, consider the luxurious pools offered by many Chandler hotels. The Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler-Fashion Center, Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort, and the Hilton Phoenix Chandler are excellent choices, featuring inviting resort-style pools perfect for a soothing dip.

Indoor Attractions

When the summer heat becomes too much to handle, Chandler offers a variety of indoor attractions where you can stay cool and have fun. At Exit 4 Escape Rooms Chandler, challenge yourself and your friends to themed escape rooms by solving puzzles and games. It’s a great way to stay indoors and have fun while staying cool. For even more friendly competition, test your wits at Game Show Battle Rooms or Taroko Sports Chandler, where you can engage in fun, competitive games with friends or colleagues in a cool, comfortable setting.

 

For an icy adventure, visit the Ice Den Chandler for public skating sessions. It’s the perfect way to cool down while gliding across the ice. And don’t miss Andretti Indoor Karting & Games, where you can race high-speed go-karts, play arcade games, and engage in thrilling virtual reality experiences. This indoor entertainment center offers a wide range of activities to keep you cool and entertained all day long.

 

Cool Treats

Chandler is a sweet‑seeker’s paradise, and its ice‑cold treats are reason enough to plan a visit. Start with Milkshake Factory, where classic shakes get a gourmet twist, think rich chocolate, creamy vanilla, and indulgent mix‑ins that turn a simple shake into a full dessert experience. And when in Downtown Chandler, wander over to The Screamery, an Arizona favorite known for its super‑premium ice cream made from scratch. Their unique ice cream flavors and ultra‑creamy texture make every scoop feel like a celebration, especially on a warm Chandler afternoon.


If you’re craving something playful and Instagram‑worthy, SomiSomi delivers with its Korean‑style soft serve swirled into adorable taiyaki cones. Flavors like ube, matcha, and milk create a treat that’s as beautiful as it is delicious. For a refreshing, fruit‑forward option, Frutilandia brings vibrant Latin‑inspired desserts to the table, including paletas, mangonadas, and creamy fruit blends that hit the spot when you want something cool and colorful. With so many unique stops, Chandler makes it easy to turn a simple ice cream craving into a full‑on dessert adventure worth traveling for.

Shopping

Chandler’s indoor shopping scene offers a refreshing escape from the heat while giving visitors plenty of ways to browse, discover, and indulge. Start your treasure hunt at Merchant Square Antique Marketplace, where more than 250 vendors showcase an eclectic mix of antiques, collectibles, and one‑of‑a‑kind finds, all in one comfortably cool setting. For something modern and delightfully unexpected, Teso Life brings Japanese lifestyle products, snacks, beauty items, and quirky gifts together in a vibrant, air‑conditioned space that invites you to explore.


If you’re looking for a full day of indoor fun, Chandler Fashion Center delivers with more than 180 shops ranging from high‑end brands to everyday favorites. Add in a movie theater and a wide selection of restaurants, and you’ve got an easy, all‑day retreat from the sun. Just steps away inside the mall, SCHEELS elevates the shopping experience with its indoor Ferris wheel, arcade games, and massive selection of sporting goods—making it as entertaining as it is cool and comfortable. Whether you’re browsing, playing, or simply enjoying the AC, Chandler’s indoor shopping destinations make staying cool part of the adventure.

headings.text: Summer in Chandler Means Refreshing Salads

bodyHtml:
As summer temps heat up, cravings for fresh, summery foods begin to set in. Fortunately, a refreshing salad is never far away thanks to a slew of Chandler restaurants that offer healthy and vibrant options filled to the brim with fresh greens, healthy vegetables, and all-natural proteins. If you’re looking to cool off with a crisp salad, try these delicious salads that deserve your fork’s attention.

 
 
 
 
View this post on Instagram
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

A post shared by Original ChopShop (@originalchopshop) on May 23, 2020 at 8:15am PDT

Original ChopShop

Nestled in a historic building that housed a former bank (check out the penny-tile floor with the word “bank” spelled out in tiles), Original ChopShop is where Chandler’s health conscious diners go to fuel up. Alongside protein bowls and fresh juices, the restaurant’s salad offerings are fresh and bountiful. Try the kale and quinoa with snap peas, smoked almond, corn and golden raisin; or the Danish heaping with greens, smoked almond, Danish bleu cheese, black currant and dates. For something uber healthy, order the raw vegetable, made with greens, carrots, tomatoes, avocados, broccoli, cauliflower, cucumber and corn.

Map: 35 W. Boston St. or (480) 426-0216

 
 
 
 
View this post on Instagram
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

A post shared by Frutahealthyeating (@frutahealthyeating) on May 13, 2020 at 11:21pm PDT

Fruta Healthy Eating

Specializing in preservative- and GMO-free foods, Fruta Healthy Eating is Chandler’s answer to good-for-you superfoods. While the menu varies regularly (to ensure the freshest ingredients and produce) you’re sure to find a variety of cold-pressed juices, superfood smoothies, and acai and fruit bowls. If it’s greens you’re craving, their small-but-mighty salad menu includes a strawberry salad (mixed greens, strawberries, feta), a Greek-inspired salad (romaine, black olives, peppers, tomatoes, cucumber, feta), and a caprese salad (mixed greens, spinach, mozzarella, sun-dried tomatoes).

Map: 222 E. Warner Road or (480) 361-4341

 
 
 
 
View this post on Instagram
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

A post shared by Salad and Go (@saladandgo) on Apr 27, 2020 at 8:08pm PDT

Salad and Go

If you like your food fast, healthy and at a bargain, Salad and Go is your go-to eatery. The drive-through-only locations offer seven to eight salads (depending on the season), from the BBQ Ranch and Buffalo Chicken, to the Bruschetta Caprese and Antipasto. Protein choices include chicken and tofu (included in the price), and steak and shrimp (for a little bit extra). There’s also a kid’s salad and protein box featuring grilled chicken breast, two items from the salad menu, and dressing for dipping. Complete your meal with an organic iced coffee or tea, house made lemonade, or organic tropical green smoothie.

Map: 3095 E. Queen Creek Road

Map: 5985 W. Chandler Blvd.

 
 
 
 
View this post on Instagram
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

A post shared by Pita Jungle (@pitajungle) on Nov 5, 2019 at 10:19am PST

Pita Jungle

An Arizona restaurant institution, Pita Jungle has been serving fresh, healthy and organic foods since 1994, long before eating healthy was on trend. The Mediterranean-inspired menu offers hearty pitas and wraps, healthy bowls, signature entrees and, of course, tempting salads. Standouts include the lentil fattoush made with lentils, turmeric brown rice, seasonal mixed greens and vegetables, pita crumbs and sumac; and the za’atar-dusted wood-fired Norwegian salmon salad featuring Tuscan kale, baby arugula, spinach, kalamata olive and feta. And since you deserve it, end your meal with an order of chocolate-dipped walnut baklawa rolls.

Map: 1949 W. Ray Road or (480) 855-3232

 
 
 
 
View this post on Instagram
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

A post shared by Cherish Farm Fresh Eatery (@todaywecherish) on Mar 27, 2020 at 3:35pm PDT

Cherish Farm Fresh Eatery

If a healthy salad is a priority, look no further than Cherish Farm Fresh Eatery. Its menu features vegan, keto, gluten-free and dairy-free options, as well as healthy dishes prepared from scratch with fresh, natural and, whenever possible, locally-sourced ingredients. Salad offerings include the Pink Lady made with rainbow chard, butter lettuce, pink lady apples, pink grapefruit and strawberries; and the Cherish Chop loaded with chopped kale, red cabbage, Brussels leaves, Beluga lentils and Mandarin oranges. Dress your salad up with grass-fed steak, all-natural chicken, sustainable salmon or organic tofu.

Map: 2551 W. Queen Creek Road or (480) 350-7245

 
 
 
 
View this post on Instagram
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

A post shared by Truland Burgers & Greens (@trulandburgers) on Apr 20, 2020 at 10:00am PDT

Truland Burgers & Greens

A welcome addition to downtown Chandler’s dining scene is Truland Burgers & Greens. Located in the new Overstreet development, the fresh and modern eatery is all about all-natural, fresh ingredients. While their hormone/antibiotic-free beef burgers are tempting, their salads are a feast themselves. Made with spinach, blue cheese, apples and dried cranberries, the Orchard Apple is surely one to try, as is the Brussels & Bacon featuring organic kale, warm Brussels sprouts, and nitrate/nitrite-free bacon. Give your salad a little oomph by adding all-natural chicken, grilled salmon or seared ahi tuna.

Map: 140 N. Arizona Ave. or (480) 597-7806

bodyHtml:
There’s nothing more comforting than the soul-warming scent of something sweet baking in the oven. Whether your treat of choice is a mile-high layered cake, a frosty ice cream cone, or a classic melt-in-your-mouth chocolate chip cookie, you won’t have to look far for the perfect fix. Chandler is home to a variety of dessert shops offering some of the most delicious and decadent goodies in town. Check out the "Chandler Like a Local: Treat Edition" video below to a few favorites in action:

Frutilandia

The dessert shop with the unique name, Frutilandia has become a favorite among those seeking to satisfy their sweet tooth since opening its first location in 2006. Since then, the family-owned eatery has been serving their signature brand of Latin and Mexican influenced desserts. One glance at the menu brimming with a variety of fruit drinks, ice creams, milkshakes and shaved ice will open up a world of refreshing possibilities. Try the Masedonia made with vanilla shaved ice, fresh mango and strawberries, and topped with ice cream and condensed milk. Or indulge in the Dulce Churro milk shake, blended with dolce de leche shaved ice cream, cajeta-filled churro and caramel drizzle.

Map: 55 E. Ray Road, Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 672-7000

Tattered Aprons Baking Co.

Tucked inside American Way Market is one of Chandler’s best kept secrets, Tattered Aprons Baking Co. Offering small-batch baked goods made from scratch, this little bakery serves up an array of fun and delicious treats. The menu changes regularly, but a few crowd pleasers have included carrot cake whoopie pies, Butterfinger cookies, rocky road brownies, and chocolate cherry almond scones. Owner and baker Shannon Tidwell isn’t afraid to push the envelope when it comes to whipping up unique creations guaranteed to leave you hungry for more.

Map: 1509 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 287-1827

Dulce Churro Café

Known for its subtle simplicity, the churro—fried dough sprinkled with sugar—is as humble and unassuming as a dessert can get. Taking this simple treat to a whole new level, however, is Dulce Churro Café. Thanks to a build-your-own concept, customers can choose a style (traditional, loops, Spaniard, bites or filled) then customize it with their favorite dip, glaze and topping. With such options as mango, chocolate or caramel dips; Oreo, sprinkles or Fruity Pebbles toppings; and strawberry or chocolate glazes, the possibilities are endless. Take your creation even further by adding soft serve ice cream that can be served inside a churro bowl or sandwich.

Map: 1050 W. Chandler Blvd. #4, Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 900-7038

The Screamery

With its nostalgic vibe that hearkens to summer days spent in small-town America, The Screamery is all you’ve ever wanted in an ice cream shop. Nestled in downtown Chandler, the shop is known for its hand-crafted ice cream made with all-natural ingredients. Clocking in at 24 flavors—including such standouts as the Sweet Sonoran Dessert (honey ice cream, peanut butter swirl, toffee pieces) and the Rough at Sea (sea salt base, honey butterscotch swirl, candied pecans, almonds, pistachios)—the shop offers scoops, pints and quarts, as well as milkshakes and floats. For the ultimate experience, indulge (with a few of your friends, of course) with the Farmhouse, featuring eight scoops of ice cream served on top of a warm cookie brownie and butter cake with toppings galore.

Map: 140 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 597-3322

Crispý Cones

Crispý Cones is a unique concept, which was featured on the entrepreneur reality TV Show, "Shark Tank," which specializes in Czech-style soft-serve ice cream cones known as trdelníks. 

This Downtown Chandler treat is a freshly made dough cone, grilled rotisserie-style and covered with cinnamon and sugar or a specialty powder. The cone is then filled with your choice of spread, soft-serve ice cream, fruit, and a variety of toppings for this highly customizable sweet treat.

Map: 180 S. Arizona Ave., Suite #110 Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 404-0339

Jake's Sweet Shoppe

Get ready to enjoy some of the most unique desserts on the market. This sweet shop puts a twist on classic ice cream treats and crafts them into masterpieces using cookies, brownies, cotton candy and more. Be adventurous and try something different or stick to the basics and choose your perfect scoop. Jake's Sweet Shoppe has it all for you to try from ice cream, to shakes, to your favorite classic candies.

Map: 58 W. Buffalo St., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 590-2690

Spooky’s Swirls

Truly unique in almost every way, Spooky’s Swirls specializes in gluten-free baked goods with a horror-themed twist. The celiac- and vegan-friendly sweet shop feeds a need for treats—and the macabre—with “creepy” cookies, “chilling” cakes, “scary” scones (you get the idea), and much more. You can even add a side of “scream” cheese frosting for an extra dose of sweet. Pastry chefs and owners Lola Forbes and Chris Szydlowski bring 20 years of experience to the shop. Szydlowski’s creations have been featured on MSNBC and “Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations,” while Forbes was a contestant on season eight of the Food Network’s “Halloween Baking Championship.”

Map: 3029 N. Alma School Rd., Chandler AZ 85224 (707) 776-6597

Creme de la Creme

Nothing beats hand rolled ice cream and freshly made crepes with all the fixings. The ice cream baristas at Creme de la Creme handcraft their desserts and their signature ice cream rolls. The handcrafted ice cream rolls are made with fresh milk poured on a cold plate, and then mixed with fresh fruit and assorted fillings and topped off with your choice of toppings. Want to feel like you're in Paris, France? Try one of their made to order crepes filled with any of their toppings and spreads. 

Map: 3111 W. Chandler Blvd. Suite 1028, Chandler AZ 85226 or (480) 803-0227

bodyHtml:
Business might bring you to Chandler, but that doesn’t mean you and your significant other can’t schedule a little fun in between Zoom meetings and project reports. Here are some ideas to spend quality time with the one you love.

Sunrise, Sunset

Even if your work calendar is jam packed, it’s possible to squeeze in a memorable adventure with your partner before or after work hours. For starters, you can lift off from Chandler in a hot air balloon ride with Aerogelic Ballooning, which offers scenic sunrise and sunset flights across the Sonoran desert, complete with post-flight champagne and gourmet hors d'oeuvres. Or saddle up at KOLI Equestrian Center in the heart of the Gila River Indian Community Reservation for a leisurely 60- or 90-minute private horseback ride through stunning desert terrain with jaw-dropping vistas and a chance to see wild horses. 

Happy Trails

Explore the outdoors as a couple with a trek through several hiking trails located in and around Chandler. An itinerary must: Veterans Oasis Park, an urban refuge that incorporates a park, lake and wetlands with 4.5 miles of trails to hike (or bike, run and even birdwatch). Looking for more wide open spaces where you also can observe desert flora and fauna close up? Visit San Tan Mountain Regional Park, just outside of Chandler, which has 8 miles of trails of varying difficulty for hiking, as well as mountain biking and horseback riding.

Retail Therapy

Ready for some retail therapy after a hard day’s work? It’s easy to shop until you drop with plenty of options for everyone’s style. The indoor/outdoor Chandler Fashion Center ticks all the retail marks with more than 185 stores, from high-end retailers to national chains, as well as several restaurants and a movie theater. If you want more of a local shopping flavor, browse the organic produce and artisan goods and crafts featured at the weekly farmers market held Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. in Downtown Chandler at Dr. A.J. Chandler Park West. While you’re there, check out one of the many unique boutiques and souvenir shops that dot the community hub, such as Sibley’s West: The Chandler and Arizona Gift Shop.

Arts & Culture Appreciation

Chandler’s vibrant arts and culture scene, which includes modern art galleries, museums, street art, festivals and performance venues, is the perfect diversion from business. One way to appreciate the artistic and cultural offerings is to tour Chandler’s Public Art Program, a collection of unique sculptures installed in municipal buildings, parks and on street corners; visit City of Chandler website for an interactive art display and public art locations. Also check out Vision Gallery at Chandler City Hall. The fine arts gallery represents more than 300 local and regional artists with evolving exhibitions that showcase ceramic, printmaking, drawing, photography, textiles, painting, sculpture and multi-media art.

Say Oo-La-La to Dinner

Celebrate a successful day of business in Chandler with an intimate dinner for two at Cuisine & Wine Bistro, an Open Table Diners’ Choice 2020 award winner. The upscale, family-owned restaurant focuses on French cuisine with a twist, with a menu made from scratch using the freshest ingredients. The lineup includes Chef Fabrice’s famed escargots, wedge salad, and entrée signatures such as sliced duck filet with a traditional French à l'orange sauce and wrapped bacon center cut filet mignon—all paired with impeccable continental service and an impressive selection of global wine, beer and cocktails.

bodyHtml:
Whether you find yourself in town visiting for America’s food-centric holiday or don’t want to spend Thanksgiving toiling over a hot stove – you can relax and leave the work to the professionals. And rest assured, there are plenty of Chandler AZ  restaurants open on Thanksgiving - serving the nation's favorite turkey dinner with all the trimmings and more this year. From a casual family restaurant to fine dining or meals to go - you're sure to have a fantastic Thanksgiving dinner experience in Chandler.  

Thanksgiving Day reservations are required for in-restaurant dining at most restaurants. In addition to restaurants open on Thanksgiving in Chandler, AZ, there are several that offer takeout or heat and serve options for the ultimate, stress-free Thanksgiving. These dinners must be made in advance, so make your plans early and get your pre-order in with these options for where to eat Thanksgiving dinner in Chandler, AZ. 

Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant

Celebrate the holiday with family and friends at Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant near Chandler Fashion Center mall. Opt to dine from the restaurant's full menu or the curated Thanksgiving meal with all the trimmings - including a butternut squash soup to start and Eli's pumpkin praline cheesecake to finish. The Thanksgiving menu is available for $36.99 for adults and kids (12 & under) $15.99.

Address: 7111 W. Ray Rd., Chandler AZ 85226

Chompie's Restaurant, Deli and Bakery

The Chandler location of Chompie's has dine-in and takeaway options this Thanksgiving. You can enjoy an individually plated, traditional holiday meal in the restaurant featuring sliced, oven-roasted turkey with stuffing, cranberry relish, mashed potatoes with pan gravy, savory yams, string beans, freshly baked dinner rolls, and a slice of pumpkin or apple pie ($29.99 per person, kids 10 & under $14.99). Chompie’s is open from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Thanksgiving. 

For added convenience, pre-order a complete meal. The Thanksgiving meal to go includes all the fixings (feeds up 12-15,Basic package is $249.99 or Traditional package for $299.99) or select a few items to supplement your meal as Chompie’s offers à la carte items ranging from stuffing and pies to matzo ball soup.  Whole turkeys and large dinner packages must be ordered by November 24, 2025.

Address: 3481 W. Frye Rd., Chandler AZ 85226

The Keg Steakhouse + Bar

Located near Chandler Fashion Center, The Keg Steakhouse + Bar is offering a delicious, traditional three-course Thanksgiving menu for dine-in or takeout. Added bonus - whether you opt to dine in or pickup a Thanksgiving Dinner to go - you'll received $25 off your next visit for select 2026 dates (conditionals apply). The meal starts with your choice of either a Keg Caesar salad or the Iceberg Wedge Salad then the traditional turkey dinner with stuffing, garlic mashed potatoes, maple glazed carrots, cranberry sauce, gravy and for dessert, cheesecake finished with a pumpkin drizzle served in this beautiful Chandler restaurant. The dine-in Thanksgiving Day menu is available for $47 per person, a kids plate comes with ice cream for $21, not including taxes and gratuities. And if your heart is set on one of their famous steaks, rest assured, their regular dinner menu is available as well. Added bonus - Open 11 a.m. – 9 p.m.

Diners also have the option to pick-up a Thanksgiving Day Family Dinner to enjoy at home or at your Chandler hotel with options for a family bundle dinner for four or six diners. The Thanksgiving Day family bundles include the Keg Caesar salad, traditional turkey entrée, turkey stuffing, cranberry sauce, gravy, garlic mashed potatoes, maple glazed carrots, and cheesecake with pumpkin caramel drizzle for dessert.

Address: 3065 W. Chandler Blvd. Chandler AZ 85226

Sea & Smoke Mesquite Seafood Grill

Enjoy a relaxing Thanksgiving dinner on the patio or in the dining room at Sea & Smoke Mesquite Seafood Grill in Downtown Ocotillo. For Thanksgiving 2025, the Chandler restaurant is offering a multi-course Thanksgiving prix fixe menu for $55 per person (not including tax and gratuity). Start your meal off with a butternut squash bisque, an Autumn harvest salad or cranberry & brie crostini and main course selections include your choice of a traditional, herb-roasted turkey breast, cider-glazed pork tenderloin or wild mushroom risotto. Top off your meal with the tasty bourbon pecan tart or the pumpkin cheesecake - both served with vanilla bean ice cream. 

Address: 2475 W Queen Creek Rd Suite 5, Chandler AZ 85248

Galeto Brazilian Steakhouse

It’s a one-of-a-kind dining experience at Galeto Brazilian Steakhouse and Thanksgiving is a perfect time to share it with your friends and family. Located in West Chandler in The Shoppes at Casa Paloma, the Chandler steak house will be offering a Thanksgiving Feast for lunch or dinner from 12 p.m. to 9 p.m. The meal includes traditional Thanksgiving dishes with a Brazilian twist. Make your reservation today.

Address: 825 N. 54th St, Chandler AZ 85226

Nana's Kitchen

This restaurant is a gem for vegan comfort food and is offering a special Thanksgiving holiday plate for takeout only - making it easy to enjoy a hassle-free holiday. Thanksgiving Meal Packages include your choice of three sides including potato burekas, butternut soup, stuffed mushrooms, lentil & quiona salad or roasted potatoes of every kind along with your choice of one main entrée. Main entrees include stuffed zucchini, lasagna, or a vegan meat casserole. Finish off your meal with a pumpkin pie parfait, apple strudel, or craisin & pumpkin seed cookies. Meal packages include the Small Gathering (serves 4-5) for $150 or Large Gathering (serves 8-10) for $260. For those looking for a smaller offering or an additional dish to add to your table, check out their à la carte menu. This restaurant is 100% plant based and was recognized as the PHX Best Vegan Restaurant in 2023. 

Orders must be picked up by 3 p.m. on Wednesday, November 26, 2025. 

Address: 777 N Arizona Ave Suite 7, Chandler AZ 85225

headings.text: The A-Z of Valentine’s Day Gifts in Chandler
Experiences That Last Beyond the Day

bodyHtml:
Valentine’s Day feels more meaningful when the gift reflects the person, not the calendar. In Chandler, that often means shopping local, choosing items made with intention, and pairing a thoughtful gift with an experience you can share. This guide highlights boutiques, florists, sweet treats, and activities that help you create a Valentine’s Day that feels personal and enchanting from start to finish.

Boutique Finds and Handmade Treasures

Head to Downtown Chandler, where locally owned boutiques line walkable streets, inviting unhurried browsing. Arrange a pre-Valentine’s Day stroll to notice what catches your partner’s eye: a color palette, a material, a style that fits them naturally. That heightened attention to detail turns your purchase into a beloved keepsake.

For presents with an Arizona feel, d’Vine Gourmet offers ready-made gift baskets and boxes with a range of pre-curated options featuring Arizona-made goods. Pair a treat with something practical or decorative to create a one-of-a-kind bundle.

 

Browse well-chosen pieces from an independent downtown retailer at Boutique on Boston, known for elevated apparel, accessories, and small-batch pieces. Look for jewelry, art, and unique finds at the Downtown Chandler Farmers Market, held Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m., where local artisans and makers showcase handcrafted pieces that reflect the community and give your present a sense of place and belonging.

 

To round out the day, let the shopping flow naturally into dinner. Reserve a table at Elliott’s Steakhouse for a refined, intimate evening, or choose Crust Simply Italian for a polished, relaxed meal.

Flowers With a Personal Touch

This year, instead of a standard arrangement, personalize the bouquet around a favorite color, a scent your partner loves, or a flower tied to a shared memory. That extra thought carries far more weight than size or cost. Several Chandler florists make this easy by offering custom arrangements and same-day delivery. Arizona Flower Company is an established florist known for its broad selection and reliable service. Cactus Flower Florists emphasizes distinctive floral designs, with arrangements created around exclusive styles and contemporary presentation.

 

When you order, ask the florist to design around a specific detail rather than a theme. A simple note explaining why you chose those blooms adds meaning without overexplaining. To extend the gesture beyond the day, combine the bouquet with a locally made candle or a small piece of art, letting the flowers mark the moment as the companion gift carries it forward.

Sweet Treats for Every Taste

Giftable indulgences never go out of style on Valentine’s Day, and Chandler’s sweet spots make it easy to tailor treats to taste. Looking for handcrafted chocolates well-suited for gifting? Chandy’s Candies has a range of house-made goodies and boxed assortments. Present them as a tasting with a favorite drink before heading to Valentine’s dinner.

 

If baked goods speak louder than chocolate, Pie Snob sells mouthwatering pies and cheesecakes that your special someone will adore. Choose a flavor you both enjoy and plan to savor every bite with a shared smile. 

 

Sweeties Candy of Arizona delivers a nostalgic surprise through classic candies and a wide variety of treats. The selection makes it easy to find a tasty gift that leans playful, familiar, or retro.

 

 

Experiences That Last Beyond the Day 

Experience-based gifts extend the celebration beyond a single exchange and create added anticipation. For relaxation, The NOW Massage Chandler offers several massage styles and other spa services along with gift cards that keep plans flexible and easy to schedule. 

If food and hands-on learning are shared interests, Mix Cooking School provides interactive cooking and baking classes, creating a fun, instructor-led setting to acquire new skills, spend focused time together, and further develop your cooking strengths.

 

Chandler Center for the Arts sells gift cards that can be used for shows throughout the year, making it easy to plan a cultural outing. Choosing the performance as a couple keeps the evening collaborative and ongoing. Or, surprise your better half with great tickets to an event you know they’d love to attend.

 

If you and your loved one enjoy pairing entertainment with a memorable meal, Warren’s Supper Club delivers an old‑school jazz club atmosphere alongside elevated American fare, with nightly live music setting the mood. Cork & Craft blends handcrafted cocktails, upscale gastropub dishes, and a charming neighborhood vibe, hosting live local music Tuesday through Saturday evenings, an inviting setting for lingering conversation, and an easygoing, romantic night out.

 

Plan Your Visit

This A-Z approach works because it lets you build Valentine’s Day around the city itself. If you are visiting to celebrate, start planning your trip today. Then check out our event listings and Valentine’s Day dining guide to see what else aligns with your plans for the year’s ultimate day of romance.

headings.text: The Best Bakeries in Chandler, AZ

bodyHtml:
Whether you’re after something sweet to go with your morning coffee or on a mission to find the perfect croissant, Chandler’s got you covered. From cozy cafés to quirky themed shops, the best bakeries in Chandler, AZ are serving up the goods—flaky, gooey and everything in between. Here’s where to go when dessert cravings strike or when you just need a little pastry-powered pick-me-up.

Café 86

Ube lovers, this is your happy place. Café 86 brings bold flavor with its signature purple yam desserts. Think ube butter bars, truffles, crinkles, brownies and more. It’s a creative, colorful twist on the classic bakery lineup and one that’s quickly become a local favorite.

Map to Café 86: 1100 N. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85224

 

Chompie’s Restaurant, Deli & Bakery

Part bakery, part New York–style deli, Chompie’s has a little of everything: rugelach, bagels, cookies—it’s all fresh and full of flavor. Need to feed a crowd? This is one of the top Chandler AZ dessert spots for office catering or breakfast spreads that make a statement.

Map to Chompie’s Restaurant, Deli & Bakery: 3481 W. Frye Road, Chandler AZ 85226

Downtown Chandler Café & Bakery

Tucked right in the heart of downtown, this spot feels like home. Grab a jumbo cinnamon roll (yes, it’s massive), settle into a window seat and enjoy one of the city’s busiest—and best—neighborhoods for people-watching.

Map to Downtown Chandler Café & Bakery: 40 S. San Marcos Place, Chandler AZ 85225

 

George & Gather

Part café, part bakery, all chill. The vibe is minimalist, but the pastries? Big on flavor. Their orange sourdough scone hits that perfect tangy-sweet balance. It’s no surprise this one’s a favorite among local bakeries in Chandler, Arizona.

Map to George & Gather: 336 S. Washington St., Chandler AZ 85225

 

Paris Baguette

Bright and modern with a café feel, Paris Baguette nails the French pastry game. The strawberry croissant is light, has just the right amount of sweet, and pairs beautifully with a hot latte. Mid-morning cravings? Consider them solved.

Map to Paris Baguette: 3450 W. Chandler Blvd., Chandler AZ 85226

 

Quiches & Pies

This local gem feels like a slice of Europe tucked into the Arizona sun. If you’re wondering where to get fresh pastries in Chandler, start here. Their caramel pecan roll has that perfect nutty essence, while the almond croissant delivers sweet, buttery layers you’ll remember long after breakfast.

Map to Quiches & Pies: 961 W. Ray Road, Chandler AZ 85225

 

Spooky's Swirls

Into horror memorabilia and desserts? Spooky's Swirls combines both—and every treat is 100% gluten-free. It’s one of those Chandler AZ dessert spots you won’t forget. Expect cupcakes, cookies and fun, themed treats that taste even better than they look.

Map to Spooky's Swirls: 3029 N. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85224

 

The Sicilian Baker

Classic Italian pastries done right. The standout here are the cannolis. Flaky, shell-shaped and filled with luscious sweet cream, it’s a must for impressing guests or just leveling up your coffee break.

Map to The Sicilian Baker: 3151 W. Frye Road, Chandler AZ 85226

 

The Kind Bean

Looking for something sweet but still mindful? The Kind Bean has it figured out. As one of the top Chandler coffee shops and bakeries, it offers gluten-free and plant-based options that actually taste amazing. The cinnamon spiral is gooey, comforting and kind of perfect. Made in-house daily, varieties include sweet orange, maple walnut and chocolate peanut butter.

Map to The Kind Bean: 1020 E. Pecos Road, Chandler AZ 85225
