bodyHtml:
Easter brunch in Chandler is almost here, and with it comes an opportunity to enjoy delicious, festive options ranging from upscale resort dining to relaxed brewery buffets. There’s no shortage of delicious brunch options with Chandler restaurants rolling out special menus and memorable experiences for the Easter 2026 weekend. Below, you’ll find some of the best Easter brunch offerings across the city, each with its own flavor, atmosphere, and signature dishes to enjoy during your Chandler visit. So hop on over to these best-loved neighborhood eateries for a delicious Easter brunch.

 

Resort-Style Brunch at the Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort

Experience a traditional resort-style 2026 Easter brunch at the Crowne Plaza resort in Downtown Chandler, featuring live music, bottomless mimosas, and a special visit from the Easter Bunny. Indulge in a variety of delicious pastries, fresh fruit, shrimp cocktail, and more.

Entrée options include Pan-seared Salmon, Apple-glazed Ham, and a Herb and Garlic-crusted Prime Roast. Finish off your meal with an assortment of desserts, including everyone's favorite: a chocolate fountain.

Seating times are available at 11 a.m., noon, 1 p.m., and 2 p.m. Please note that seats are limited; reserve your table on Eventbrite.com or by calling (480) 857-4435.

Location: One N San Marcos Pl., Chandler AZ 85225

 

Casual Easter Brunch Buffet at SanTan Brewing Company

Celebrate Easter 2026 at SanTan Brewing Company with a full Brunch Buffet featuring carving stations, breakfast classics, hearty lunch dishes, and family‑friendly sweets. Guests can enjoy everything from Garlic + Herb Prime Rib and CaraMellow Glazed Ham to Brioche French Toast Bake, Carnitas, Country Fried Chicken Strips, and Chef’s Mac & Cheese. Dessert favorites like Mini CinnaMaple Rolls and Bosa Donuts round out the feast. Reservations are recommended for this relaxed, festive holiday gathering, which starts at 8 a.m., with the regular menu resuming at 3 p.m.

Location: 8 S San Marcos Pl., Chandler AZ 85225

 

Lively Brunch at The Parlay Kitchen + Cocktails

The Parlay’s Chandler location is hosting its 2026 Easter Brunch Buffet, requiring a $50 deposit that’s applied to your bill on Easter Sunday. Guests can expect a spread featuring elevated American brunch offerings, which include Prime Rib, carved Honey Ham, an Egg & Omelette station with hearty shareables, salads, desserts, and an optional bottomless bubbly bar for purchase. The Chandler restaurant venue offers a lively, modern atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating, making it a popular spot for families and groups celebrating the holiday. Early reservations are strongly recommended due to high demand.

Location: 1245 S Price Road #1, Chandler AZ 85286

Weekend-Brunch Menu at Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar 

Located in West Chandler, Fleming’s Chandler is cooking up a 2-course Easter Weekend brunch menu. Start your meal with your choice of a Fleming's salad or Mushroom Brie soup, and entrees include Sliced Tenderloin & French Onion Frittata, Shellfish Louie Salad, and Surf & Turf selections. The 2026 Easter menu will start Saturday, April 4th, at 11 a.m., and on Sunday, April 5th, at 10 a.m. The dinner menu and a special children's 3-course menu are available all weekend long.

Reservations are strongly encouraged.

Map: 905 N. 54th Street, Chandler, AZ 85226 

 

Elevated Brunch at the Brickyard Downtown

In Downtown Chandler, the Brickyard Downtown is offering a refined all-day Easter brunch featuring a three-course menu showcasing seasonal, chef-crafted dishes. Guests can start with savory options like crab cakes with sweet corn purée, a Togarashi Caesar salad, or chorizo deviled eggs. For the main course, choices include elevated entrees such as chicken and biscuits, steak and eggs, or frittata Lorraine. To top off the meal, dessert options include a cinnamon waffle with brown butter and maple ice cream, or peaches and cream, featuring slow-roasted peaches and Irish cream. Optional cocktail pairings are available for an additional charge, making this brunch an ideal Easter outing for adult groups seeking a more upscale dining experience. Reservations are required and are best made by calling the restaurant directly at (480) 963-1373.

Location: 85 W Boston St., Chandler AZ 85225

 

Chandler offers an impressive lineup of Easter brunch experiences, from indulgent resort buffets to chef‑driven menus, lively, modern dining rooms, and expansive patios for outdoor dining. Whether you're craving comfort food, upscale cuisine, or a festive family outing, there’s a Chandler brunch option to match every style of celebration. With many restaurants filling up quickly for the Easter holiday, making reservations early is the best way to secure your spot. No matter where you choose to dine, Easter brunch in Chandler will offer great food, warm hospitality, and a memorable experience.

Chandler Restaurants Open on Christmas Day 2025
AJ's Cafe at the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort
Bonus: Sweet Treats for Christmas Day
The Best Bakeries in Chandler, AZ

bodyHtml:
Spending Christmas in Chandler? You’re in luck – it’s easy to find Christmas Day dining in Chandler with excellent options to make your holiday meal special. From sizzling hibachi and Brazilian steak to Chinese takeout with an Elvis twist, it’s all here, but reservations are crucial.

 

And if you’re feeling festive beyond the food, don’t forget to peek at Chandler’s holiday events page. The city really goes all-out this time of year.

Chandler Restaurants Open on Christmas Day 2025

 

Benihana

If your idea of Christmas dinner includes a little sizzle and flair, Benihana’s a hit. It’s dinner with a side of live entertainment as hibachi chefs flip shrimp and build onion volcanoes right in front of you. The filet mignon’s a classic, and the holiday cocktails don’t disappoint. Kids get a show, grown-ups get sake, everyone wins.

Location: 3025 W Chandler Blvd, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 769-6143

 

Chompie's Restaurant, Deli and Bakery

This place has strong comfort-food vibes. Think matzo ball soup, stacked pastrami sandwiches, turkey dinners, and a bakery that smells like pure holiday magic. If you want something casual but cozy, Chompie’s hits the spot. Chompie’s will be open from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m.

If you plan to bring dinner back to your hotel, this Chandler restaurant offers traditional turkey Christmas or Chanukah dinner to go (think brisket and roast chicken), but please order at least 72 hours in advance of pick-up.

Location: 3481 W Frye Rd, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 398-3008

 

Galeto Brazilian Steakhouse

Ready for a meat-lover’s holiday feast? Located in West Chandler, Galeto serves up the full Brazilian Christmas churrasco experience with endless cuts of slow-roasted meat carved right at your table. Add black bean stew, charcuterie or an assortment of cheeses, and you’ve got yourself a holiday to remember.

Location: 825 N 54th St, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 744-0130

 

 

Legends Showcase Bar & Grill

This family-friendly dining and entertainment venue serves a unique blend of casual American cuisine alongside free, nightly live “Las Vegas-style” tribute shows – and yes, that includes Elvis! The popular restaurant will be open from noon to 8 p.m.

Location: 2386 N Alma School Rd, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 777-2020

SanTan Brewing Company

For something more laid-back (and beer-forward), this iconic Downtown Chandler spot has got you covered. Local craft brews like Mr. Pineapple and MoonJuice IPA pair perfectly with pub grub favorites, including gourmet burgers, crispy chicken fingers, and fish and chips. It’s relaxed, walk-in friendly, and great for groups. For Christmas Day 2025, SanTan Brewing is an excellent option for dinner or a late-night gathering, open from 4 p.m. to midnight.

Location: 8 S San Marcos Pl, Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 917-8700

 

Singing Pandas Asian Restaurant & Bar

This place is a Chandler original. You’ve got Chinese-American classics—honey walnut shrimp, Mongolian beef, sizzling rice soup—in the dining room. And in the lounge? Live Frank Sinatra tribute shows and more. Singing Pandas is unique, wonderful and totally unforgettable.

Location: 757 E Chandler Blvd, Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 777-5050

 

SanTan Spirit House Coffee & Cocktails

Need a break from the holiday chaos? SanTan Spirit House Coffee & Cocktails is a cozy little escape. Their menu features pub-fare classics, and their winter cocktails are always on point. Think warm, spiced creations served under twinkling lights. It’s perfect for a low-key toast after a long day, and it's open from 5 p.m. – midnight.

Location: 8 S San Marcos Pl #106, Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 917-8700

 

Chandler Hotel Restaurants

 

AJ's Cafe at the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort

Staying near Downtown Chandler? The onsite restaurant, AJ's Cafe at the historic Crowne Plaza makes for a pretty and elegant Christmas setting. Expect a solid holiday menu, warm ambiance, and room for big family meals or intimate dinners. The restaurant will be open from noon to 8 p.m.

Location: One N San Marcos Pl, Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 812-0900

 

Marriott Phoenix Chandler

Modern, polished and a great choice if you’re looking for something a bit more upscale. The Marriott hotel’s restaurant offers a seasonal spin on contemporary American dishes. Ideal for travelers or anyone who wants a nice meal without the holiday kitchen mess.

Location: 1600 S Price Rd, Chandler, AZ 85286 or (480) 732-1600

Bonus: Sweet Treats for Christmas Day

Chandler’s got amazing bakeries—French pastries, gluten-free goodies, festive cookies, you name it. Whether you’re picking up dessert or dropping something off for the office, check out Chandler’s top bakeries for your last-minute sugar fix.

bodyHtml:
Start your new year with big experiences in Chandler, Arizona! From destination races and festivals to outdoor adventures, culture, food, and more, we've put together a list of 20 of the best things to do in Chandler in 2026. 

 

1. Run the AZ48 Half Marathon, 10K & 5K

Kick off your Chandler visit by racing on a flat, fast, USATF-certified course, perfect for runners chasing personal bests or qualifying for national marathons. Held each October in Downtown Chandler, this scenic run draws athletes from across the Southwest.

 2. Explore the Chandler Museum

Discover Chandler’s history and evolving community through engaging exhibits with free admission and free parking at the Chandler Museum.

 

 3. Attend the Fine Arts & Wine Festival

Each February, the Thunderbird Artists, in partnership with the Downtown Chandler Community Partnership, hosts this Downtown Chandler celebration, featuring 100+ artisans, wine tastings, and weekend fun.

 

 4. Play a Round at San Marcos Golf Course

Enjoy a round of golf at Arizona’s first grass course, the San Marcos Golf Course, which opened in 1913, or make your way to one of Chandler’s seven golf courses, each offering a distinctive experience.

 

5. Catch Live Music Around Chandler

From intimate patios to larger stages, Chandler’s vibrant live music scene keeps the sound going year-round. Downtown Chandler is a popular destination for live music, with many restaurants and bars offering a variety of options most nights of the week.

 6. Tour SanTan Brewing Company and Distillery

Sip locally crafted beers and spirits in Uptown Chandler with behind-the-scenes tours and tastings at Arizona's largest combined craft brewery and distillery.

 

 7. Find Thrills at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games

Indoor fun awaits with high-speed karting, arcade games, bowling, and more at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games in Chandler.

 8. Celebrate Chandler’s History at the Ostrich Festival

A fun March tradition that pays homage to Chandler’s early ostrich-ranching history with carnival rides, live music, and unique desert flair.

 9. Hike Veteran’s Oasis Park

Explore desert trails, birding hotspots, and a paved Solar System Walk in this scenic 113-acre park.

10. Raise a Pint of Local Craft Beer

Chandler’s growing craft beer scene pairs delicious brews with vibrant social spots.

11. Shop at Chandler Fashion Center

The second-largest mall in the Phoenix area, Chandler Fashion Center, features hundreds of stores, dining options, and entertainment for a full day of shopping and fun.

12. Enjoy 24/7 fun in West Chandler at Taroko Sports

Visit Chandler’s newest entertainment destination featuring realistic batting cages, darts, arcade games, mini bowling, and plenty of time for fun! Open all day and every day.

13. Board a Vintage Train at Arizona Railway Museum

See historic rail cars and locomotives at this hands-on museum, open seasonally on weekends. Admission of $15 per adult, $10 for children aged 2-12 ($40 per family) includes a self-guided tour, access to at least four passenger cars and the caboose, and artifact displays. Comfortable walking shoes are highly recommended when visiting the Arizona Railway Museum.

 

14. Sip Through Chandler’s Craft Cocktail Scene

From intimate lounges to lively bars, the city’s cocktail culture is perfect for evenings out and enjoying Chandler’s nightlife.

15. Horseback Ride Through the Sonoran Desert

Experience Sonoran landscapes with guided trail rides that highlight local history when you visit the KOLI Equestrian Center.

16. Enjoy Performing Arts & Concerts in Chandler

Catch shows and touring acts at the Chandler Center for the Arts, including Grammy-winning artists Joss Stone and Ledisi.

 

17. Feel the Need for Speed at Radford Racing School

Try high-performance driving courses or a thrilling hot lap experience.

18. Savor Chandler’s Diverse Culinary Scene

From brunch favorites to global flavors and Arizona specialties, eat your way through the city. Did you know that Chandler is home to Arizona's only fine-dining Indian restaurant? 

19. Take Photos with Must-See Chandler Murals

Chandler’s vibrant street art provides iconic photo ops throughout the city. Visitors will find a greater concentration of Chandler murals dotting the historic square in Downtown Chandler.

20. Visit the Chandler Tumbleweed Tree

This uniquely Arizona holiday icon is lit the first Saturday evening in December at one of Chandler’s largest festivals and stays lit through early January, offering a memorable seasonal photo backdrop. 

Plan Your Chandler, AZ Trip

Make plans to visit Chandler this year, and get a head start by visiting our Plan Your Visit page. You'll find lodging information, transportation tips, and a great list of things to do to help you make the most of your trip.

End it on a Sweet Note

bodyHtml:
Chandler is a treasure trove of kid-friendly activities, making it the ideal destination for a day of fun for the whole family. But if you’re looking for a wide variety of exciting things to do, spend a day in north Chandler, where there’s a good time waiting for you around almost every corner. Here’s a fun-filled itinerary to help you plan a memorable day with your kids and family.

Breakfast of Champions

Rise, shine and start your day on a high note with a delightful breakfast. Offering a warm and inviting atmosphere, BlackBerry Café is a perfect spot. Their kid-friendly menu includes fluffy pancakes, golden waffles, scrumptious French toast, and decadent crepes. Parents can enjoy hearty omelets, biscuits and gravy, and loaded skillets—ensuring everyone is fueled up for a day of adventure.

Another spot the kids will love is Chase’s Diner, a classic diner that serves up nostalgic vibes and delicious meals. Kids will love pancakes and waffles, while parents can indulge in a variety of breakfast burritos, panned omelets, and skillets piled high with home fries, eggs and all the fixings. The friendly staff and charming décor make it a great place to start the day.

Let the Fun Begin!

After a hearty breakfast, it’s time for some fun-filled activities. Begin with a visit over in Uptown Chandler to AMF Chandler Lanes, where—thanks to bumpers and lightweight balls—even the youngest family members can join in the fun. Arcade games add to the excitement, making it a perfect way to kick off the morning.

As the day heats up, cool off at the Desert Oasis Aquatic Center. This mini-water park features thrilling water slides, diving boards and interactive water play areas. With zero-depth play pools and a raindrop and water table, it’s perfect for kids of all ages. There are also plenty of shaded areas and ramadas for a picnic lunch or a quick snack break.

For more fun-filled excitement, visit Uptown Jungle Fun Park. This indoor playground offers a variety of activities including climbing walls, obstacle courses and giant slides. Kids can run, jump and play all in the comfort of this indoor entertainment venue, while parents can unwind in a relaxing lounge area.

End your day full of fun and excitement at USA's Skateland, where kids can take a spin around the 11,000-square-foot roller rink to fun music and creative lighting. With themed skating sessions and a friendly atmosphere, it’s a great place to have some fun and maybe even learn a new skill.

Family Dinner Time

After a day of non-stop fun, it’s time for a delicious dinner. Shane’s Pizza on 87 offers a family-friendly dining experience with a variety of mouthwatering pizzas. Kids will love creating their own pizza masterpieces, while parents can enjoy pastas, sandwiches and fresh salads. The casual setting makes it a great spot to unwind and enjoy a meal together.

For a down-home vibe, try American Way Smokehouse, known for its delectable barbecue dishes. The menu includes kid favorites like mac ‘n cheese and chicken sliders, while parents can savor ribs, brisket, and other smoked delights. The relaxed atmosphere and friendly service make it a perfect choice for a family dinner in Uptown Chandler.

End it on a Sweet Note

No day of fun is complete without a sweet treat. Head to Snowtime for a unique dessert experience. This spot offers shaved ice with a variety of toppings, as well as milk teas and golden fish buns topped with your choice of fruit, ice cream and other fun toppings.

For a thrilling twist, visit Spooky Swirls, a bakery and museum featuring gluten-free, horror-themed desserts and memorabilia. Kids will be thrilled by “creepy” cookies, “chilling” cakes, “scary” scones and much more.

Finally, stop by Bruster’s Real Ice Cream for a classic ice cream treat. Offering a selection of 30-plus premium flavors made daily from 150 rotating recipes, the shop’s handmade kettle ice cream is thick, creamy and fresh, making it a cool and refreshing way to end the day.

headings.text: Top 10 Reasons to Attend the Downtown Chandler Fine Art & Wine Festival
Reasons to Attend the Fine Art & Wine Festival in Downtown Chandler

bodyHtml:
The Downtown Chandler Fine Art & Wine Festival, hosted by the award-winning festival producer Thunderbird Artists, is a popular, recurring annual event in Downtown Chandler. The 2026 festival will be held at Dr. A.J. Chandler Park Stage Plaza bringing together juried artists, showcasing a diverse selection of fine art, including paintings, sculptures, photography, jewelry, and mixed media. Visitors can also enjoy wine tastings from international and local wineries, food, and live music performances in a vibrant atmosphere that makes this event stand out among Arizona festivals.

With its charming downtown setting and opportunities to meet talented artists, this Chandler AZ event offers an immersive experience for art lovers, wine enthusiasts, and festivalgoers alike. We’ve compiled a list of the top 10 reasons to attend the 5th Annual Downtown Chandler Fine Art & Wine Festival, occurring February 13-15, 2026.

Reasons to Attend the Fine Art & Wine Festival in Downtown Chandler

  1. Diverse Artistic Showcase: Explore works from more than 125 juried artists, featuring oil paintings, life-size bronzes, glass sculptures, pottery, metal creations, unique jewelry, photography, and mixed-media sculptures.
  2. Wine Tastings: Savor first-class wine tastings from notable regions including Germany, France, Italy, Chile, Australia, and Arizona.
  3. Live Music: Enjoy live musical performances that enhance the festival's vibrant atmosphere.
  4. Culinary Delights: Indulge in a variety of festival foods and explore nearby restaurants in Downtown Chandler’s diverse culinary scene, featuring everything from trendy gastropubs and Chandler AZ craft breweries to upscale dining, global cuisine, and cozy, local eateries.
  5. Cultural Immersion: Engage with talented artists to learn about their inspirations and techniques, deepening your appreciation for fine art.
  6. Scenic Venue: Experience the festival in the heart of Downtown Chandler, surrounded by unique architecture and charming local businesses in this historic and walkable district.
  7. Collector's Paradise: Discover a wide range of artworks, from paintings to sculptures, suitable for both new and seasoned art collectors.
  8. Affordable Admission: Enjoy all the festival has to offer with a modest $5 admission fee (cash only).
  9. Convenient Parking: Find plentiful and FREE Downtown Chandler public parking in nearby parking structures, making your visit hassle-free.
  10. Invitation to Recharge: February is a great time of year to enjoy a weekend getaway and offers the perfect opportunity to relax, explore things to do in Chandler AZ, indulge in great food and experiences, and recharge.  

This festival is just one more reason to spend spring in Chandler, AZ and enjoy a unique mix of art, wine, music, and delicious cuisine, making it a must-attend event for locals and visitors alike.

headings.text: Top Antique Shops & Secondhand Stores in Chandler, AZ

bodyHtml:
If you're on the hunt for antiques, vintage treasures, or unique secondhand finds, Chandler is a haven for eclectic shopping. You’ll find a diverse array of antique shops in Chandler, AZ, in addition to cozy boutiques and secondhand thrift stores brimming with hidden gems—all at prices that delight.

Hidden Treasures

In the Waterfall Shopping Center, Hidden Treasures is an all-volunteer-run nonprofit thrift store that sells exceptional, clean secondhand items. What you’ll find there is seemingly endless. They have household items like silverware, pots and pans, dishes, serving dishes, and storage containers. Search through an impressive collection of books covering many genres like science fiction, mystery, westerns, fiction, and children’s books.

Discover puzzles, games, yarn, needles, kids’ crafts, clothing, antiques, shoes, and linens. Different days have different discounts, from 25% to 50% off. Check out their website for more information on their weekly sales.

Merchant Square Antique Marketplace

Now, let’s dive into the crown jewel of antique stores in Chandler, AZ: Merchant Square Antique Marketplace, a must-visit destination nestled in Uptown Chandler. With over 400 local merchants under a single roof, Merchant Square is the largest antique store in Chandler and a paradise for antique lovers and pickers. Well known for its sought-after collection of enchanting antiques, gorgeous furniture, and to-die-for accessories, this is the spot to find what you need at a great price.

Across 48,000 square feet, hunt for treasures like hard-to-find vintage books, military surplus items, home décor, vintage signs, action figures, antiques, automobilia, dolls, and cool knickknacks. Explore The Garment District, attached to Merchant Square, to find vintage clothing and take home fashionable pieces to add to your wardrobe. While there, enjoy a meal at the American Way Smokehouse, a tasty joint celebrating antiques and vintage craftsmanship.

Highland Yard Vintage, a 6,000-square-foot home and garden market located directly behind Merchant Square, is open four days a month (the dates vary by month), where you can find irresistible home and yard pieces curated by Arizona designers, artisans, and vintage pickers.

My Sisters’ Charities

Located in The Promenade at Fulton Ranch, the thrift store My Sisters’ Charities is a certified 501(c)3 charitable organization supporting countless community nonprofits by donating 100% of its net profits. Here, in this South Chandler thrift store, you’ll find most items in the $1 to $10 range and enjoy zero sales tax! Shop for stunning clothing, home decor, and furniture. By doing so, you’ll support worthy causes like helping women who have left abusive relationships, protecting endangered animals, and helping rescue dogs and cats still in need of forever homes. 

Uptown Cheapskate

Uptown Cheapskate is your chance to sell used clothing, designer handbags, and other items you no longer need and pick up today’s fashions at wallet-friendly prices. They have a long list of coveted brands that are so gently used they seem like new. Among the big names to elevate your current wardrobe are J. Crew, Nike, lululemon, Obey, PacSun, The North Face, Zara, Gymshark, Vans, Coach, Express, New Balance, Michael Kors, Anthropologie, and Urban Outfitters.

Zia Records

Serving the Phoenix area since 1980, it’s safe to say that Zia Records is an Arizona music lover’s institution. Just mentioning Zia to an Arizona native brings a big smile and a flood of nostalgic stories—of hours spent sifting through vinyl, cassette tapes, and CDs, hunting for video games, posters, band merch, pop culture treasures, and an array of other awesome finds. As the top independent media retailer in Arizona and Nevada, Zia Records is 100% employee-owned, and you can tell by the expertise and attentive care of the staff.

Are you looking to sell your used music and other items for trade-in credit or cash? Look no further than Zia. With your new purchasing power in hand, you’re sure to stumble upon more finds than you can take home in one trip. Seriously, get to Zia Records ASAP!

headings.text: Top Choices for Comfort Food in Chandler AZ

bodyHtml:
Nothing is more soothing to the soul than a heaping dish of your favorite comfort food. Whether it’s the ooiest-and-gooiest mac ’n cheese or a hearty slab of oven-baked lasagna just like Grandma used to make, all your troubles will seem to melt away with each and every bite. For some of the best comfort foods in Chandler, stop by these restaurants for warm, cozy menu options.

Chase’s Diner

One of the pillars of the Southern breakfast table, buttery biscuits smothered in gravy makes a satisfying meal any time of the day. To get your fill of this classic, stop by Chase’s Diner, where their version is made with a homemade buttermilk biscuit smothered in a sausage cream gravy (the restaurant’s own secret recipe). While the half-order made with one biscuit will do the trick, the whole-order featuring two hearty biscuits will make your morning meal into a morning feast.

Map: 2040 S. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 855-3663

West Alley BBQ & Smokehouse

While everything on the menu at West Alley BBQ can soothe anyone’s appetite, the loaded smoked potato is true comfort on a plate. Imagine a whopping potato—fluffy on the inside and crispy-skinned on the outside—loaded with your choice of pork, chicken or brisket, and topped with cheese, chives, bacon bits, sour cream and a drizzle of barbecue sauce. Or, for a different spin on the potato, order the loaded smoked fries with all the same toppings.

Map: 111 W. Boston St., Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 248-8819

Hop Social Tavern

As we all know, no one makes meatloaf better than your mom. But Hop Social Tavern may give her a run for her money. That’s because the restaurant’s scratch made meatloaf is made with a combination of veal, pork, ground chuck and bacon, and served with a rich coffee stout gravy, creamy buttermilk mashed potatoes, and tender glazed carrots.

Map: 3405 W. Chandler Blvd., Chandler AZ 85226 or (480) 485-4677

Floridino’s Pizza & Pasta

A Chandler landmark, Floridino’s has been serving Italian comfort food at its finest since 1996. Think stuffed calzones, oven-baked sandwiches, and heaping plates of pasta. But for the ultimate feast, have the baked lasagna made with layers of lasagna noodles, marinara sauce, fresh Italian sausage, seasoned ground beef and the restaurant’s special three-cheese ricotta blend. And if you’ve managed to save room for dessert, indulge in the decadent Sicilian Sundae, featuring a warm chocolate chip cookie topped with vanilla ice cream, hot fudge and fresh whipped cream.

Map: 590 N. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 812-8433

Pedal Haus Brewery

Known for its award-winning beers (they won a gold medal at the Great American Beer Festival in 2018 and were named Best Brewery in The United States at the 2019 Copa Cerveza de Americas), it stands to reason this popular brewery would whip up fare that goes best with a good brew. And while the thought of a juicy burger may come to mind, try their take on buttermilk fried chicken instead. Made with lightly battered and fried boneless chicken tenders, it’s served with seasoned fries, coleslaw and honey hot sauce.

Map: 95 W. Boston St., Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 656-1639

Hash Kitchen

A humble and hearty dish, hash is made up of all the things you love: potatoes and chopped meat. The possibilities are endless with hash—it can be made with chicken, short rib, carnitas, and even shrimp. But for the ultimate classic hash dish, have it with corned beef. The folks at Hash Kitchen have perfected the dish, making theirs simply with corned beef, caramelized onions and Swiss cheese, tossed with crispy potatoes and topped with two eggs.

Map: 2855 W. Ray Road, Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 909-4270

Cuisine & Wine Bistro

There’s comfort food and then there’s French comfort food, from quiches and croquettes, to escargots and cheese boards piled high with brie, breads and raspberry jam. For the quintessential French dish, head to Cuisine & Wine Bistro and order a bowl of rich French onion soup—or soupe a l’oignon as it’s called at this south Chandler eatery owned by Chef Fabrice Buschtetz. Served with gruyere toast, this dish is guaranteed to warm your heart and soul.

Map: 4991 S. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 275-6700

Hidden House

As one of Downtown Chandler’s most iconic spots, Hidden House does not disappoint with its extensive menu filled with steak and chicken dishes, and seafood specials. But while these dishes may be the main attraction, the restaurant’s appetizers are often the real stars of the show. Case in point, the lobster mac ‘n cheese. Made with campanelle pasta, bottarga (salted, cured fish roe), breadcrumbs, baby celery leaf and Calabrian chilis, this dish alone is worth a visit.

Map: 159 W. Commonwealth Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 275-5525

bodyHtml:
The city’s caffeine scene is dripping with personality. It’s equal parts creative, cozy, and community-focused. Some spots offer a quiet place to settle in with a laptop, while others keep the conversation flowing over a seasonal treat (think lavender‑infused lattes). 

If you’re looking for some of the best coffee in Chandler, this guide features standout cafés that locals love and visitors seek out. Each brings its own atmosphere, but all share a welcoming energy that makes them easy to return to.

Bottle & Bean

In Downtown Ocotillo, Bottle & Bean combines the feel of a boutique with the polish of a bistro. Expect bright interiors, a gorgeous patio, and a well-curated menu that extends from signature espresso beverages to brunch staples to savory boards. Among the area’s best coffee shops, the fresh pastries at this one are worth the trip alone.

Coffee Rush

Set beside a lake in the heart of the city, Coffee Rush pairs scenic views with a laid-back atmosphere. Offering both indoor and outdoor seating, it’s a popular pick for residents looking to unwind with cold brews, blended specialties, and tiramisu mochas. It’s one of those cafés in Chandler where the setting is just as satisfying as the coffee.

Café 86

One of our city’s newest spots, Café 86, brings a bold twist to the local brew scene with its Filipino-American roots and ube drinks and desserts. Situated in the northern part of town, this contemporary joint blends bright, friendly energy with rich flavors, from traditional espresso offerings to unique creations like the ube matcha latte. Its first Arizona location is a favorite for both first-timers and loyal regulars. For a special treat, the ube leche flan cupcake is a must.

Grove Coffee

Tucked inside the Grove Church campus, Grove Coffee is a hidden gem with a modern edge. The open layout invites connection, and the menu caters to all, from traditional espresso purists to those seeking alternative milks or tea-forward options. They serve house-roasted coffee and a rotating menu with standouts like gingerbread cold brew and candy cane white mocha.

Kind Bean

With a strong focus on organic, health-conscious ingredients and plant-based options, Kind Bean shines for its inclusive menu and small-batch cooking ethos. Located southeast of downtown, it’s a go-to for botanical-infused drinks, traditional and specialty caffeine creations, and a warm, inviting setting. Their gluten-free baked goods are out of this world and popular even with non-restricted eaters. Want a closer look at its story? Learn more here.

Maple House

Housed in a charming former 1940s residence, Maple House combines a cozy ambiance with a modern touch, offering coffee during the day and craft cocktails by night. Guests can enjoy a curated menu of coffees, wine, craft beer and lower-ABV cocktails, along with its beautiful photo-worthy patio.

Momentto Caffe

Blending years of community presence with a refreshed, modern feel in West Chandler, Momentto Caffe offers an elevated experience in a sleek, minimalist space. Alongside expertly crafted espresso selections, you’ll find hand-whisked matcha, rotating specials, and well-presented lattes that are almost too pretty to sip. For more on what makes this café unique, read our spotlight article.

Palette Collective Coffee

Near Chandler Fashion Center, Palette Collective Coffee is where creativity brews alongside high-quality espresso-based drinks. Its communal tables and high ceilings make it ideal for remote workers, freelancers, and anyone chasing inspiration. Partnering with local roasters, Palette serves thoughtfully prepared cups with seasonal flavors and creative latte options.

Peixoto Coffee

A fixture in downtown, Peixoto Coffee is known for its crop-to-cup offerings and rich Brazilian heritage. The café roasts its own beans from the Peixoto family farm, resulting in a delightfully flavorful menu. Try the coconut cold brew or the creamy affogato for a unique treat.

Quiches & Pies

Quiches & Pies is a charming, cozy, French-inspired bakery and coffeehouse featuring handcrafted quiches, pies, pastries, and locally roasted coffee. The coffee shop offers a full range of espresso drinks that pair incredibly well with their French pastries - think pain au chocolat, croissants, and more.

Sagebrush Coffee

Sleek and stylish with mid-century touches, Sagebrush Coffee is a newer addition that has quickly developed a loyal following. Located in north Chandler, it serves single-origin cups, ceremonial-grade matcha, and a lineup of highly inventive menu highlights. It’s a great place to sip slowly and settle in for a while.

SoZo Coffeehouse

On the northern edge of the region, SoZo Coffeehouse offers more than just drinks: it’s a gathering space, live music venue, and art scene all in one. Comfy couches, open mic nights, and plenty of space to work make this a welcoming spot to recharge or connect. Don’t miss their espresso or the impressive herbal tea lineup for a slower-paced experience. 

Exploring Chandler’s cafés is one of the best ways to experience the city’s personality. All of them showcase why a cup here is worth savoring. Support local, try something new, or revisit a favorite haunt. Your next caffeine fix is just a few sips away. Start planning your visit today.

Best Hiking Trails When Staying in Chandler
Water Activities & Hot Air Balloon Rides

bodyHtml:
With more than 300 days of sunshine each year, stunning Sonoran Desert scenery, and ideal outdoor weather from fall through spring, Chandler, Arizona, is a premier destination for outdoor adventure. Fall, winter, and spring are especially popular times to explore Chandler's outdoor attractions. Comfortable temperatures make it easy to spend the day hiking, biking, horseback riding, or enjoying family-friendly parks and recreation areas.

 

Whether you’re looking to lace up your hiking boots, cruise along scenic bike trails, or float above the Sonoran Desert in a hot air balloon, the city offers seemingly endless ways to get out and explore. This guide covers some of the best things to do in Chandler for nature lovers, families, and adventurers alike.

 

Best Hiking Trails When Staying in Chandler 

You’ll love hiking in this Arizona gem for the desert scenery, wide open spaces, and clear blue skies. Start your exploration at Veterans Oasis Park, a 113-acre natural area with more than 4 miles of trails winding through desert habitat and wetlands. It’s a favorite among walkers, birdwatchers, and families.

 

Another standout, San Tan Mountain Regional Park, offers desert trails featuring saguaros and scenic ridgelines, perfect for a morning trek. Within the park, the popular Goldmine Trail offers a 4.7-mile moderate hike with some steep sections. With cooler temperatures and blooming wildflowers, fall through spring is the best time to hit the trails. 

Biking & Horseback Riding Adventures

Chandler is a haven for cyclists, with bike lanes, shared-use paths, and miles of scenic trails. The Paseo Trail is a local favorite, offering a flat, paved route along the Consolidated Canal that's ideal for a casual cruise or family ride. Visit San Tan Mountain Regional Park for mountain biking among classic Sonoran Desert landscapes.

 

Prefer exploring on four legs instead of two wheels? Saddle up for horseback riding at area stables and ranches. KOLI Equestrian Center at Wild Horse Pass offers guided rides for novice and advanced riders through open desert terrain. It’s a relaxing, memorable way to take in the sweeping desert views. Other exceptional horseback-riding options include MacDonald’s Ranch and Corral West Adventures.

Parks & Natural Areas to Explore

From scenic walking paths to expansive play spaces, parks in Chandler are a significant highlight of the outdoor scene. Veterans Oasis Park tastefully blends desert and wetland environments, birdwatching areas, and family-friendly trails. Paseo Vista Recreation Area boasts an archery range, dog park, disc golf course, fun playground, and walking trails.

 

Families visiting Chandler will love Desert Breeze Park for its Desert Breeze Railroad train rides and spray pad, while Tumbleweed Park has several play structures and covered pavilions.

Water Activities & Hot Air Balloon Rides 

When the Arizona sun heats up, Chandler’s water attractions are the place to be. Local aquatic centers like the Hamilton Aquatic Center and Desert Oasis Aquatic Center feature thrilling slides, lap pools, and shaded seating, all perfect for cooling down while keeping active. Don’t forget about the region’s spray pads. Chuparosa Park Spray Pad, Espee Park Spray Pad, and Desert Breeze Park and Spray Pad offer a perfect spot to cool down and relax.

 

For an unforgettable experience, take to the skies in a hot air balloon ride. Just outside Chandler, operators Rainbow Ryders and Aerogelic Ballooning feature sunrise flights that glide silently over the mighty Sonoran Desert. As the morning light spills across the rugged terrain, you’ll see cacti, wildlife, and mountain ranges stretching to the horizon. Ballooning is especially popular in the cooler months and makes for a fantastic celebration, whether you're celebrating a birthday, anniversary, or a bucket-list adventure

 

Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, family vacation, or outdoor adventure, Chandler offers countless ways to enjoy Arizona's sunshine and scenic desert beauty. Start planning your visit and discover why Chandler is a favorite destination for outdoor recreation year-round.

headings.text: Best Spots for a Picnic in Chandler, Arizona

bodyHtml:
One of the best ways to enjoy our 300 plus days of sunshine per year is with a picnic at a park in Chandler, Arizona. While you can spread a blanket and dine al fresco at any one of the city’s more than 60 neighborhood and community parks, for a full day of family fun, pack a basket and head to one of these four best picnic spots in Chandler, Arizona. Or make life simple and pick up a quick meal and go from your favorite Chandler restaurant.

Tumbleweed Park

Chandler’s largest park is also one of the East Valley’s most popular, thanks in part to Playtopia, a 2.5-acres playground divided into three themed played areas: Farm Land, City Land, and Critter Land. After a picnic, kids can climb and slide on a play set that resembles a barn at Farm Land, ride tricycles and small bikes past the mini street signs and lampposts of City Land, or hop on the back of a massive Gila monster in Critter Land.

Older kids and adults can play horseshoes, sand volleyball, Frisbee, or tag. There are plenty of trails for strolling through Tumbleweed Park, too. If you decided to explore the park by foot, don’t miss Tumbleweed Ranch, a collection of three historic buildings and farm equipment located in the southeast section of the park.

Tumbleweed Park has plenty of open space to picnic on the ground plus 18 pavilions available for rent. Most of these can accommodate 15 to 30 people although a few larger ones have room for up to 80 and a corporate pavilion can hold up to 330. Each pavilion has BBQ grills and access to electricity. At this time, park reservations are available with a Park Permit which may be obtained through the City of Chandler. For more information and assistance with a reservation, please call (480) 782-2727.

Address: 745 E. Germann Rd., Chandler, AZ 85286

Desert Breeze Park

Desert Breeze Park is another great picnic destination for a family picnic. Kids can play on the playground equipment, fish in the lake, or ride the 1950s-era carousel with 30 painted ponies. From April through October, they can also cool off at the park’s splash pad, open daily from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.

But, the main draw is the Desert Breeze Railroad Express, an open-top, 1880s train complete with a caboose that takes passengers on a ¾-mile tour of the park. Although it operates most weekends (except in July and August), you’ll want to check online before you plan a picnic around it to confirm hours and for weekday and holiday schedules.   

Great for dates or enjoying the moment, visit the Hummingbird Habitat, an intimate, shaded area of the park with a small waterfront bench providing a 360-degree opportunity to bird watch.

Desert Breeze Park has plenty of picnic spaces, including three lakeside pavilions and one barbecue pavilion with four grills. Each pavilion has 10 tables and is available for rent by contacting the City of Chandler Parks Department at (480) 782-2727. 

Address: 660 N. Desert Breeze Blvd. E., Chandler, AZ 85226

Veterans Oasis Park

Nature takes center stage at Veterans Oasis Park where you can enjoy views of the 5-acre lake as you picnic. Plan to walk the 4.5 miles of trails that wind past a lake, several wetland areas, and hummingbird and butterfly habitats. Along the way, watch for coyotes, jackrabbits, and the 153 species of birds that have been spotted here. Community fishing is available and the lake is stocked evert two weeks from September through the last week of May. An Urban Fishing License is required for residents and non-residents 10 years of age and older. For information on obtaining a license and fishing rules and regulations, visit the Arizona Game and Fish website.

Or, stick to the paved trail around the lake, where you’ll find a 2,500-hundred-foot solar system walk. The signage representing the sun, eight planets, dwarf planets, and more, is spaced to scale with every foot traveled on the walk representing 1.5 million miles.

Veterans Oasis Park also boasts the Chandler Nature Center with displays on the Sonoran Desert and the animals that live there.

Address: 4050 E. Chandler Heights Rd., Chandler AZ 85249

Dr. A.J. Chandler Park

Located in Downtown Chandler, Dr. A.J. Chandler Park—named for the city’s founder—is the original town square. While currently undergoing a major renovation, the park is surrounded by restaurants, galleries, boutiques, offices, and the historic Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort, which means there is plenty to do before or after your picnic.

The new Dr. A.J. Chandler Park plans feature picnic tables and bench seating, plus a flex lawn perfect to bring a blanket for your picnic. The good news is you don’t necessarily have to pack a picnic—you can get take out from some of the local restaurants, like a cheese board from Mingle and Graze or a health-focused dish from the Original ChopShop Co. Chandler's Dine-in-the-Park program allows for the consumption of alcohol purchased from local Downtown Chandler restaurants, available at this park only.

The Chandler park area hosts unique events throughout the year, including the famed Tumbleweed Tree, as well as a weekly farmers market (every Saturday from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.; October through May and from 7 - 10:00 a.m. June - September).

We hope you enjoy this roundup of the best picnic spots in Chandler, AZ.  Feel free to drop us suggestion in the comments below to help us build our list.

headings.text: Top Spots for Chandler’s Best Breakfast Burritos

bodyHtml:
Ah, the breakfast burrito. A mix of eggs, potatoes and fixings wrapped up in a warm and oh-so soft tortilla, it’s the perfect breakfast for those on-the-go-go-go mornings. Whether you’re looking for a convenient and portable all-in-one meal or want to stay a spell and savor the wonderful flavors only a breakfast burrito can offer, stop by these Chandler restaurants for some of the best offerings in town.

El Sol Mexican Café & Bakery

A Chandler favorite since 1988, El Sol Mexican Café & Bakery is all about family. Obed de la Cruz and his wife Panfila own and operate the restaurant, where Obed’s father bakes desserts for the shop, and the couple’s three children have also helped run the family business. Known for its homemade tacos, tortas, quesadillas and, of course, pastries, El Sol is also a favorite among the breakfast crowd. That’s because their breakfast burritos are filled to the brim with fresh ingredients befitting the most important meal of the day. Egg and potato can be paired with ham, chorizo or bacon. Or if your appetite is especially hearty, try the Super Bueno stuffed with ham, bacon, egg, potato, bean and cheese.

Map: 760 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 786-0811

Elmer’s Tacos

Celebrating nearly 50 years in Chandler, Elmer’s Tacos is an Arizona institution. Original owner Elmer Cuen opened the shop across from Chandler High School in 1974 and since then, it’s become a favorite spot for students, teachers and alumni—along with longtime customers who can’t resist the delicious dishes the restaurant is known for. If it’s a breakfast burrito you’re craving, you’ve come to the right spot. Elmer’s serves a variety of choices, including eggs with bacon, sausage or ham; chorizo and eggs; and eggs and machaca (add beans to any burrito free of charge). Make your burrito into a meal by adding a serving of fluffy rice and fresh-made beans.

Map: 355 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 963-6763

Birrieria Don Jose

Located inside the bright yellow building on the northeast corner of Arizona Avenue and Galveston, Birrieria Don Jose specializes in slow-roasted birria, a traditionally spicy and savory Mexican stew that’s slow cooked until the meat is tender. While you may be tempted to stop by for a birria taco, quesadilla, torta or burro, don’t miss the restaurant’s breakfast burritos. Stuffed with beans, cheese and country potatoes, take your choice of ham, chorizo, bacon, sausage or asada. Then treat yourself to something sweet by ordering a fresh-made churro on the go.

Map: 691 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 912-1879

Los Taquitos

Run—with love—by the five Ochoa sisters, Los Taquitos features authentic Mexican dishes made from family recipes passed down through the generations. For a delicious start to your day, indulge in a hearty breakfast burrito filled with eggs, cheese and potatoes. Then add bacon, chorizo, asada or pollo to take amp it up, or order the supreme burrito to take things to the next level. If you’re looking for a healthy alternative, you can substitute whole eggs for egg whites.

Map: 2855 W. Ray Road, Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 264-4371

Los Favoritos Taco Shop

Serving authentic Mexican cuisine since 2001, Los Favoritos lives up to its name. A favorite spot among Chandler locals and visitors, the restaurant uses the freshest ingredients in its authentic dishes. Breakfast is no exception. Their breakfast burritos are brimming with potatoes, eggs and cheese, but that’s just the beginning. Add your choice of chorizo, sausage, bacon, ham or machaca, as well as steak and longaniza, a Spanish sausage made from ground pork.

Map: 1900 W. Chandler Blvd., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 782-9400

Rita’s Burritos

We love a restaurant that does one thing and does it well. Case in point Rita’s Burritos, where the only thing on the menu is, you guessed it, burritos. While they offer a variety of options, their breakfast burritos are the perfect start to your day. Go with the traditional bacon and hash (browns, that is) or the chorizo and hash. Or be a little adventurous and order the Breakfast Barbacoa filled with eggs, barbacoa, cilantro and onion. For a healthy take, try the Whites & Turkey, made with egg whites, ground turkey and spinach.

Map: 4040 S. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 404-9128

A mix of eggs, potatoes and fixings wrapped up in a warm and oh-so soft tortilla, it’s the perfect breakfast for those on-the-go-go-go mornings. Whether you’re looking for a convenient and portable all-in-one meal or want to stay a spell and savor the wonderful flavors only a breakfast burrito can offer, stop by these Chandler restaurants for some of the best offerings in town. El Sol Mexican Café & Bakery A Chandler favorite since 1988, El Sol Mexican Café & Bakery is all about family. Obed de la Cruz and his wife Panfila own and operate the restaurant, where Obed’s father bakes desserts for the shop, and the couple’s three children have also helped run the family business. Known for its homemade tacos, tortas, quesadillas and, of course, pastries, El Sol is also a favorite among the breakfast crowd. That’s because their breakfast burritos are filled to the brim with fresh ingredients befitting the most important meal of the day. Egg and potato can be paired with ham, chorizo or bacon. Or if your appetite is especially hearty, try the Super Bueno stuffed with ham, b

headings.text: Hot Spots for Cold Brew Coffee in Chandler

bodyHtml:
It’s no surprise that Chandler is home to some of the best coffeehouses in Arizona.  And sometimes—especially in Arizona—coffee is a drink best served cold. And even-though iced coffee may be your first pick, consider a cold brew coffee. Iced coffee is essentially hot coffee poured over ice, whereas cold brew is made by soaking coffee beans in cold water for 12 hours or more. The result is a sweeter and smoother coffee that tastes more flavorful and less bitter. For some of the best cold brews in town, check out these Chandler coffee shops.

Peixoto Coffee Roasters

In the time this Downtown Chandler roastery and coffee shop has been open, it has made an indelible mark on Arizona’s coffee scene while making Chandler a must-visit destination for true coffee aficionados. While their menu is extensive (espresso drinks, pour-overs, drip coffee, lattes, ciders, matcha drinks, tonics, and iced teas), their cold brews are just the thing to satisfy your caffeine craving on warm day. For something different, try one of their specialty cold brews including the coconut cold brew, made with house-made coconut cream and sweetened condensed milk syrup and topped with toasted coconut flakes, or the peach cardamom, a peach nectar infused with cardamom simple syrup and topped with cold brew and a sprinkle of cardamom.

Map: 11 W. Boston St., Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 275-2843

SoZo Coffeehouse

Family-owned and operated, SoZo is a coffeehouse experience like no other. Owners Scott and Lori Morgan have created a true community gathering place, where you can relax with a cup of coffee in a comfortable leather chair, hang out and chat over tea and snacks with friends, meet a business colleague or co-worker, or enjoy live music and entertainment being played on a spacious stage. Whatever you’re doing, be sure to enjoy a cold brew coffee while you’re at it. SoZo’s version is brewed for 24 hours and topped with a flavored cold foam.

Map: 1982 N. Alma School Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 726-7696

Palette Collective Coffee Bar

Part studio space, part coffeehouse, Palette Collective is unique space designed for creatives, entrepreneurs, and small business owners. And what better way to fuel these enterprising titans of industry than with coffee? Complete with fully-stocked coffee bar, Palette’s offerings run the gamut from coffee and tea to specialty drinks and shakes. But if it’s a cold brew you’re wanting, Palette offers a cold brew made from coffee grounds that have been immersed in water for 18 to 20 hours, creating a bold and rich flavor. For an added bonus, pair it with a Nutella banana toast or mascarpone honey toast. It’s the breakfast of champions!

Map for Chandler/Village location: 505 S. Chandler Village, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (602) 386-0303

Ziggi's Coffee

With two locations in Chandler, in north Chandler at McQueen and Warner Roads and their south Chandler location at Arizona Avenue and Ocotillo Road, Ziggi's Coffee features easily accessible drive-thru stands with a walk-up window for a quick grab and go option. The coffee shop serves a traditional, customizable cold brew and a Gold Rush Cold Brew (caramel and half & half) alongside an assortment of breakfast snacks and assorted beverages.

Map for North Chandler location: 2120 N. McQueen Rd., Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 786-4551

Map for South Chandler location: 4044 S. Arizona Ave., Chandler, AZ 85248 or (480) 597-6418

Bottle and Bean

Downtown Ocotillo is home to a unique coffee shop and wine bar venue, Bottle & Bean. This local Chandler coffee shop offers a typical coffee and tea menu with five specialty drinks created by their staff. The eatery features a traditional cold brew and nitro cold brew option, each customized to your liking which may be enjoyed in the spacious dining room, private dining room or on the patio to enjoy the Arizona sunshine! 

Map: 2577 W. Queen Creek Rd. #100, Chandler, AZ 85248 or (480) 265-9996

ld.articleBody: When you mention Korean food, most people immediately think of kimchi, the fermented cabbage that’s a staple in Korean cuisine. While Korea’s signature side dish is a favorite around the world, these Chandler restaurants prove there’s much more to Korean food than its much-loved, salty undertones.

headings.text: Top Spots for Korean Food in Chandler AZ

bodyHtml:
When you mention Korean food, most people immediately think of kimchi, the fermented cabbage that’s a staple in Korean cuisine. While Korea’s signature side dish is a favorite around the world, these Chandler restaurants prove there’s much more to Korean food than its much-loved, salty undertones.

                            

Jin Shabu

The Korean-style shabu-shabu is an industrial chic spot located in central Chandler. Jin Shabu features an all-you-can eat lunch and dinner menu features an array of hot pots, from steamed hinoki boxes to traditional shabu (a Mongolian term for thickly sliced meats and vegetables cooked in spicy boiling water) options. Diners cook their own broth—such as sukiyaki and miso—table side and choose from an array of meats including lamb, beef and pork belly to build their simmering meal. A buffet with veggies, seafood, noodles, pot stickers and sauces help complete the dining adventure at this modern hot pot restaurant.

Map: 2055 N. Dobson Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (602) 396-2988

GOGI Korean & Sushi

The best of East Asian cuisine collides at this casual Korean-Japanese eatery. At GOGI Korean & Sushi, find shrimp tempura and kimchi pancake appetizers, as well as tofu and squid salad make up the lighter fare. Popular entrees include galbi, a sweetly-seasoned grilled short ribs, bulgogi hot stone bibimbap, a steamed rice and vegetable dish with thickly sliced, marinated grilled ribeye and pork katsu. In addition, diners can pick from a selection of bento box specials with meat, fried dumplings, shrimp tempura and rice side dishes for both lunch and dinner. And, of course, Korean fried chicken, from classic and sweet to spicy and garlic, is a signature dish. Plus, plenty of wine, sake and Asian beers are highlighted.

Map: 2095 North Dobson Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 812-2751

Two Hands Corn Dogs

Want something that is as delicious as it is visually appealing? Check out Two Hands Corn Dogs! This east Chandler spot features the famed Korean-style corn dogs with assorted topping and sauces at this counter-style restaurant. Customize your corn dog by selecting a mozzarella cheese base, sausage or 50/50 (cheese and sausage) and choose from various toppings like potato or crispy rice. You will absolutely need one for each hand!

Map: 1929 E Ray Rd Suite #7, Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 687-5436

Chodang Tofu & BBQ

This cozy spot on Arizona Avenue is the perfect place to try barbecued meats, bibimbap, dumplings and cold noodles—all the traditional fare one would expect to see on a menu in an authentic Korean restaurant. Chodang Tofu & BBQ's lineup is exhaustive with appetizers, salads and side dishes, but the selection of beef, chicken and pork barbecue, and soft tofu soup options—think bean paste, beef or seafood (with shrimp, oyster and clams)—might just hook you on Korean cuisine’s unique and culturally-rich flavors. Lunch specials are available daily from 11 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. and include choices such as galbi and bulgogi, which are served with side dishes and steamed rice.

Map: 501 N. Arizona Ave., Chandler, AZ 85225 or (460) 855-7712

Doshi Chicken & Cupbop

Want Korean on the go? Doshi Chicken & Cupbop serves up Korean BBQ in a bowl. Doshi Chicken & Cupbop ties Korean homestyle cooking with the convenience of a counter-serve chain for eat-in or takeaway. Doshi is short for Doshirak, which is means packed meal or lunchbox in Korean. Choose between several options, like the Dak-Bokkeum Cupbop (spicy Korean Style Chicken) or the Japchae Cupbop, which is a great vegetarian option. They provide a quick, healthy, and gluten-free option for lunch, dinner, or anything in between!

Map: 4960 S Alma School Rd B-10, Chandler, AZ 85248 or (480) 687-4112

headings.text: Top Spots for Waterfront Dining in Chandler

bodyHtml:
When in Chandler, why not dine with a waterfront view? Enjoy some delicious meals curated by some of the best restaurants in Chandler, AZ. Enjoy fresh ingredients and trendy dishes from hand tossed pizza and fresh pasta to avocado inspired dishes, all while relaxing by the water. These Chandler, AZ restaurants all have amazing patios with a waterfront view and are sure to leave you relaxed and ready for a nice bottle of wine or some hand-crafted cocktails. 

Stone & Vine

Located in south Chandler, Stone & Vine is that neighborhood spot that guarantees to make you feel right at home. While the restaurant’s interior feels like a cozy Italian bistro, the bright and colorful patio is the perfect place to dine “lakeside” thanks to a sprawling manmade water feature just below. As you dine on such Italian favorites as caprese, meatballs, bruschetta, panini, and hearty entrees like osso buco, ravioli and lasagna, the soothing sound of gentle running water fills the air. Stone & Vine is open of lunch, dinner and happy hour, and weekend brunch featuring hearty fare and specialty drinks, wines and beer.

Map: 1035 W. Queen Creek Road #103, Chandler, AZ 85248 or (480) 659-7438

Patent 139 Brewing Co.

Named for the patent number assigned to the famous Hass avocado, Patent 139 Brewing Co. is owned by descendants of the Hass family is nestled along a lake that surround neighborhoods off Ray and Dobson roads. As you enjoy the waterfront scenery, dine on the restaurant’s upscale canteen menu items, such as barbecue nachos, mesquite elote, and Thai green curry mussels. The can’t-miss dish, however, is the Origin Burger, made with Hass avocado, smoked cheddar, grilled onion, bacon slab and the brewery’s secret “shoosh” sauce. Wash it down with a brew from their draft list, which includes a few of the brewery’s own creations, as well as a selection of Arizona ales.

Map: 1949 W. Ray Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 597-7138

Valle Luna

If you’re in the mood for authentic Mexican fare with the same waterfront view, head next door to Valle Luna. Serving Sonoran-style cuisine for 40 years, this Arizona institution was started by Tia Rita, the family matriarch whose signature brand of Arizona-Sonoran recipes is the foundation of the restaurant’s menu. Feast on a few of Tia Rita’s favorites including the spinach enchilada, Sonoran-style carne asada, and the chimichanga dinner made with your choice of meat rolled inside a flour tortilla, deep fried and topped with a homemade Sonoran sauce.

Map: 1949 W. Ray Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 786-3100

Pita Jungle

Also offering dining with a lake view in the same restaurant and retail destination is Pita Jungle, an Arizona-founded eatery specializing in Mediterranean-inspired cuisine with a fresh and healthy take. In business since 1994, the restaurant is known for its salads, pitas and wraps. But since then, the menu has evolved to offer such signature offerings as wood-fired Norwegian salmon, chicken tikka masala, and organic red quinoa with cilantro jalapeno hummus. For the ultimate waterfront patio moment, stop in for happy hour, when you can nosh on a variety of tapas—including hummus, tzatziki, garlic dip and falafel—starting at $2, and sip on draft or bottled beers, and select wines and cocktails.

Map: 1949 W. Ray Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 855-3232

Hon Machi Sushi & Cocktails

Rounding out the list of waterfront restaurants at Ray and Dobson is Hon Machi Sushi & Cocktails. This cozy Japanese restaurant and sushi bar serves an assortment of sushi, from fresh sashimi and nigiri, to a wide assortment of rolls and specialty rolls. A few standouts include the fully loaded Chimichanga (tuna, salmon, albacore, white fish, yellow tail, avocado, cream cheese), King Kong (soft shell crab, spicy tuna, eel, avocado), and the Jalapeno Bomb (spicy tuna, cream cheese, crab meat, deep-fried jalapeno).

Map: 1949 W. Ray Road, Chandler, AZ 85224 or (480) 963-0400

bodyHtml:
When the sun sets in Chandler, Arizona, the city comes alive with a vibrant nightlife scene. Whether you’re in the mood for craft cocktails, wine, a night of big-time casino fun, or an evening at a lively brewery, Chandler has the place. From stylish, laid-back lounges to hidden gems, this guide details the best of Chandler’s nightlife. 

Craft Cocktails & Sports Lounges 

The Ostrich   

In Downtown Chandler, The Ostrich offers a speakeasy-style bar in the basement of Crust Simply Italian. Enjoy the unique ambiance, historical furniture, and top-of-the-line service as you sip on classic or innovative cocktails.   

Map to The Ostrich: 10 N San Marcos Pl #B1, Chandler AZ 85225

 

Hidden House    

Another must-hit downtown joint for craft cocktails is Hidden House. Within a charming 1939 cottage, this venue features decade-defining drinks, such as the Brooklyn, Hemingway Daiquiri, and Sidecar. Choose from a variety of on-site atmospheres to enjoy your bygone-era cocktail.  

Map to Hidden House: 159 W Commonwealth Ave, Chandler AZ 85225

 

Round1 Bowling & Arcade   

Round1 Bowling & Arcade packs bowling, arcade games—including exclusive Japan imports—crane machines, billiards, karaoke, and more under one roof. Guests can also enjoy pizza, wings, ice cream, Japanese favorites, and a full bar, making it a top spot for late-night hangouts in Chandler. 

Map to Round1 Bowling & Arcade Chandler: 3177 S Chandler Village Dr, Suite #4, Chandler AZ 85226

Breweries & Taprooms to Chill At 

The Perch Pub & Brewery  

Head downtown and pop into The Perch Brewery for great in-house-brewed beer and good times on the welcoming rooftop bar. This craft brewery delivers a night to remember for several reasons, including the exotic bird-filled garden.  

Map to The Perch Pub & Brewery: 232 S Wall St, Chandler AZ 85225

 

SanTan Brewing Company  

Among Chandler’s most celebrated breweries, at SanTan Brewing Company in Downtown Chandler, you’ll find award-winning craft beers and an electric energy. Regulars love the hardwood tables, stainless steel tanks, seasonal brews, and the popular MoonJuice IPA. 

Map to SanTan Brewing Company - Downtown Chandler: 8 S San Marcos Pl, Chandler AZ 85225

 

QuartHaus Drinkery 

Don’t miss the always exciting QuartHaus with its 25 craft beers and eight wines on tap. The roll-up garage-like doors and spacious courtyard with lawn games set the stage for another inspiring night downtown.  

Map to QuartHaus Drinkery: 201 S Washington St, Chandler AZ 85225

 

HELLUVA Brewing Company  

In West Chandler, head to the hidden gem HELLUVA Brewing Company. Within a gastropub with tasty plates, 22 big screens, and 20 beers on tap await. They have eight of their own ready for you to order, including an excellent IPA, a delicious light lager, and an amber red that will keep you smiling. 

Map to HELLUVA Brewing Company: 3950 W Ray Rd #5, Chandler AZ 85226

 

Wine Shops & Bistros  

Cooper’s Hawk Winery & Restaurant 

Located near Chandler Fashion Center, Cooper’s Hawk Winery & Restaurant pairs seasonally influenced dishes with award-winning, handcrafted wines. Experience the large, inviting dining room, private barrel-aging room, full-service bar, tasting room, and patio.  

Map to Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant Chandler: 3325 W Chandler Blvd, Chandler AZ 85226

 

Cuisine & Wine Bistro  

In Southwest Chandler, Cuisine & Wine Bistro serves up made-from-scratch French dishes that have a unique spin. With an impressive selection of wine, it’s easy to pair your favorite red or white with the exquisite food and often talented musicians to heighten the experience. 

Map to Cuisine & WIne Bistro: 4991 S Alma School Rd #101, Chandler AZ 85248

 

BlackSheep Wine Bar & Merchant

Stop by BlackSheep Wine Bar & Merchant in historic downtown for wine, food, and conversation in a stunning setting. It’s the kind of place that, once you visit, you’re sure to return.  

Map to BlackSheep Wine Bar & Merchant: 98 S San Marcos Pl, Chandler AZ 85225

 

Discover even more wine spots and bars around Chandler and pick the perfect place to sip and relax.

Casino Fun  

Feeling lucky? Chandler is home to a number of fine casinos for gaming, entertainment, music, drinks, food, and more. Lone Butte Casino has over 1,200 slot machines and table games like blackjack, roulette, and craps. Additionally, there are 30 poker tables with a private entrance and nearby parking.  

Another standout option is Wild Horse Pass Casino, which spans 100,000 square feet and offers a wide range of games including craps, blackjack, roulette, baccarat, and more than 1,100 slot machines. Twice named Arizona’s best casino, Wild Horse Pass offers several dining and lounge options and top-tier live entertainment.

Casino Arizona features fast-action keno, poker, blackjack tables, and over 1,500 slots. You’ll also discover mouthwatering dining options, lounges, and some of the best live entertainment in the state. 

Late-Night Eats & Hangouts 

Bar hopping, hitting the casinos, or the like can certainly work up an appetite. Check out these late-night spots to wind down after midnight.  

Hit up Jolie’s Place for a casual feel and irresistible late-night comfort food. You can’t miss the Cheesy Mac n Bacon Burger or Philly Cheese Steak. For more after-hours eats, Good Time Charli’s serves appetizers from 11 p.m. to 2 a.m., and Murphy’s Law Irish Pub offers a solid late-night menu to keep the evening going. 

Chandler’s nightlife scene is diverse—from craft cocktails, wine, and local brews to casino fun and late-night bites. Whether you’re a local or visiting for the first time, there’s always something new to explore, so start planning your Chandler nightlife adventure today and discover the energy that keeps the city buzzing after dark.

bodyHtml:
Arizona sunsets, starlit patios – it’s all so romantic here in the Valentine State. On February 14, 1912, Arizona became the 48th state to join the Union and since then, has been affectionately referred to as the Valentine State. Celebrate Valentine's Day in Chandler with dinner, and activities or find the perfect proposal spot because love is not only in the air but on the plate as Chandler restaurants keep the romance alive by offering special Valentine's Day 2025 meals!

From casual to fine-dining, we've put together a list of the best restaurants to enjoy Valentine’s Day with your sweetheart.

CHoP Chandler

Make reservations for CHoP Chandler in Downtown Ocotillo and choose from starters like Duck Fat Fries or Maui Grilled Beef Skewers before indulging in entrées such as a Bone-in Mesquite Grilled Ribeye, Tarragon Butter-Seared Sea Scallops, or Lobster Bucatini. Complete the experience with a Vanilla Bean Panna Cotta or Double Layer Dark Chocolate Cake. This special dinner menu is only available on February 14, 2025.

Map: 2625 W. Queen Creek Road, Chandler AZ 85286 or (480) 821-0009

Cuisine & Wine Bistro-Chandler

A top destination for traditional French cuisine in Arizona, Cuisine & Wine Bistro will feature a romantic, curated four-course, Valentine’s Day prix-fixe menu featuring French-inspired dishes crafted by Exeuctive Chef Fabrice Buschtetz.   A wine pairing option will be available with expertly selected wine by Sommelier Killian to accompany the decadent Valentine's Day menu.  Starters include your option of a lobster veloute with mascarpone mousse or whipped goat cheese with pistachio crumble and choux pastry. A salad is included with apples, kale, orange and sweet candied walnuts. Three entrées are available for selection, including a savory duck leg confit, Niman Ranch New York strip steak or Chilean sea bass. Save room for dessert, a dark chocolate Charlotte or pavlova with red berries and chantilly. Reservations are in high demand for Valentine's Day, so reserve today online or by phone.

Map: 4991 S. Alma School Road, Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 275-6700

DC Steak House

A popular choice for date night, this Downtown Chandler restaurant is known for mouthwatering steaks, seafood, chops and more. DC Steak House will be serving their regular menu in their warm and cozy restaurant – perfect for a romantic evening with your true love.  Enjoy dinner in their modern dining room or on the starlit patio. Following your meal enjoy a stroll along the trellis-covered walkways and murals found in Downtown Chandler for a perfectly romantic evening. 

Map: 180 S. Arizona Ave., Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 899-4400

The Living Room Chandler

Valentine's Day dinner at The Living Room Chandler starts with Filet Mignon Beef Skewers or a Fuji Apple Salad, followed by entrées like Honey Mustard Grilled Beef Short Ribs or Mary’s Organic Chicken Scallopini. End the evening with Vanilla Bean Cheesecake Crème Brûlée or a decadent Chocolate Torte. Call the restaurant to make your reservation.

Map: 2475 W. Queen Creek Road, Chandler 85248 or (480) 855-2848

Sea & Smoke

In South Chandler, savor an elegant three-course menu featuring appetizers like Butternut Squash Ravioli or Dynamite Roasted Market Oysters at Sea & Smoke Mesquite Seafood Grill. The cozy restaurant will feature a special Valentine's Day menu for February 14, 2025 and entrées include Lobster Bucatini Carbonara, Bone-in Wagyu Ribeye, and Chilean Sea Bass, paired with indulgent desserts such as Molten Chocolate Cake and New York-style cheesecake. Reservations are strongly encouraged.

Map: 2475 W Queen Creek Rd. Ste 5, Chandler, AZ 85248 or (480) 534-7621

Shimogamo

Savor a fine-dining dinner for two at Arizona's leading Japanese restaurant, Shimogamo which will be offering an exquisite meal for an unforgettable Valentine's Day dinner experience on Friday, February 14, 2025.  Reservations are recommended and may be booked on-line or by calling the restaurant directly.

Map: 2051 W Warner Rd, Chandler AZ 85224 or (480) 899-7191

The Sicilian Butcher

Celebrate your love with a five-course meal at The Sicilian Butcher with their Valentine's menu, Amore at First Bite. The finely crafted menu features rich and savory flavors, handcrafted pastas, and decadent desserts. Available February 12-16, 2025 for lunch or dinner - make your reservations today.

Map: 3151 W. Frye Road, Chandler AZ 85226 or (480) 573-8750

Thirsty Lion Gastropub

Enjoy a special Chandler Valentine's dinner with your sweetheart at Thirsty Lion Gastropub featuring their limited Valentine's menus, offered February 13-15, 2025. The restaurant offers two Valentine's Day menus, each featuring a selection of starters, main dishes, and desserts to customize your meal. Complement your dinner by adding a handcrafted cocktail, craft beer or wine to your meal. 

Map: 3077 W. Frye Road, Chandler AZ 85226 or (480) 786-5799

Crust Simply Italian

Located in Downtown Chandler, Crust Simply Italian serves New York-style pizza and entrees. Stop by for your very own Valentine's Day heart-shaped pizza with lunch starting at 11 a.m. and dinner service starting at 3 p.m. This is a great option for a casual bite or a family meal - but don't wait, as this special pizza is only available on Valentine's Day, February 14, 2025. 

Map: 10 N. San Marcos Place, Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 917-4903

Mountain Mike's Pizza

Nothing says love more than a heart-shaped pizza, right?! This 14-inch beauty is crafted from freshly made dough and their legendary crispy, curly pepperonis. Available all month long at Mountain Mike's Pizza in West Chandler.

Map:  800 N 54th St Suite 5, Chandler AZ 85226 or (480) 550-8141

Rock Lobster

On Valentine's Day, enjoy an Asian-inspired menu awaits you at Rock Lobster in south Chandler with first-course options like Korean Kimchi Pancakes or Bluefin Tuna Tataki Salad. Entrées include Bulgogi Ramen, Miso-Glazed Norwegian Salmon, and Vegetarian Bibimbap. Green Tea Matcha Crepe Cake and Chocolate Torte round out the meal.

Map: 2475 W. Queen Creek Rd., Chandler AZ 85248 or (480) 821-9000

The Taco Spot

Surprise your taco fanatic or be the family hero with an adorable heart-shaped tray full of tacos from The Taco Spot! Orders must be placed the day prior at both Chandler restaurant locations!

Map to central Chandler location:  698 E Chandler Blvd Suite B, Chandler AZ 85225 or (480) 917-7883

Map to West Chandler location: 885 N 54th St., Suite 3 Chandler, AZ 85226 or (480) 687-4687

Quiches & Pies

Make your way to Uptown Chandler for handcrafted beverages at Quiches & Pies including the Be My Matcha, an iced Matcha latte topped with a luscious raspberry cold foam or the White Chocolate Kiss - a raspberry white chocolate cold foam topped with fluffy, whipped cream. But we may be saving room for the fresh strawberry tarts - only available on Valentine's Day!

Map:  961 W Ray Rd, Chandler, AZ 85225 or (480) 465-7168

Slick City Action Park

Slide into fun with a special, Daddy & Daughter date night on Sunday, February 16th from 5-7 PM at Slick City Action Park in West Chandler. The event includes a 60-minute ticket, a kid-friendly dinner, a sweet dessert and Valentine's make-and-take crafts for a memorable night out.

Map:  845 N 54th St, Chandler, AZ 85226 or (602) 641-3888

 

Downtown Chandler Fine Art & Wine Festival

Immerse yourself in culture, wine, and fine art at this Chandler AZ festival featuring 125+ juried artists and an array of original artworks. The Downtown Chandler Fine Art & Wine Festival is a three-day event happening February 14-16, 2025.
