bodyHtml:
Breweries, patios, and local pours worth the trip

Chandler’s craft beer scene is one of the best-kept secrets in the Phoenix area, blending award-winning breweries with relaxed neighborhood taprooms and lively downtown energy. Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway or just looking for your next favorite pint, Chandler delivers with locally brewed beers, creative menus, and plenty of personality.

From walkable stops in Downtown Chandler to hidden gems off the beaten path, here’s where to sip your way through Chandler, AZ.

 

Downtown Chandler Breweries - Walkable, vibrant, and full of flavor

Downtown Chandler is the heart of the city’s craft beer scene, where multiple breweries sit just steps from each other, making it a perfect option for an easy, self-guided tasting tour.

 

SanTan Brewing Company

  • Why go: A true Arizona original with a lively downtown atmosphere
  • What to try: Devil’s Ale or Mr. Pineapple
  • Pair it with: Chipotle bacon burger or crispy chicken fingers

One of Arizona’s pioneering craft breweries, SanTan Brewing Company has been pouring locally loved beers since 2007. The brewpub is a go-to for both visitors and locals seeking bold flavors and a buzzing atmosphere, with a winning mix of indoor and outdoor dining options. And if time allows, plan a visit to the combined brewery and distillery in Uptown Chandler to see the brewing and distilling processes.

Location: 8 S. San Marcos Place, Chandler, AZ 85225

Pedal Haus Brewery

  • Why go: Bustling beer garden with games with laid-back, local vibes
  • What to try: Bierce Blanche (Great American Beer Festival gold medal winner)
  • Pair it with: Bavarian pretzel

Inspired by traditional German beer halls, Pedal Haus Brewery blends social energy with expertly crafted beers. The patio scene alone makes it worth the stop, especially for enjoying a sunny Chandler afternoon.

Location: 95 W Boston St, Chandler, AZ 85225

The Perch Brewery

  • Why go: A one-of-a-kind brewery with a tropical bird sanctuary
  • What to try: House brews or rotating guest taps
  • Don’t miss: Rooftop seating

Equal parts brewery and oasis, The Perch offers a unique experience. Surrounded by rescued tropical birds and lush greenery, it’s a relaxing, nearly tropical escape right in the middle of the city. In addition to its garden setting, the brewery offers an expansive rooftop dining experience and frequently hosts live music, making it a popular hot spot in the evenings and on weekends.

Location: 232 S. Wall St., Chandler, AZ 85225

Craft 64

  • Why go: Local ingredients, wood-fired pizza, and laid-back charm
  • What to try: House-brewed beers
  • Pair it with: Wood-fired pizza or bruschetta

Craft 64 brings an Arizona-first mindset to its menu, sourcing ingredients locally whenever possible. It’s a favorite for happy hour and a great stop when you’re craving something casual but elevated. And it doesn't hurt that the restaurant is recognized as serving some of the best pizza in the nation.

Location: 68 W. Buffalo St., Chandler, AZ 85225

West Chandler and Beyond: Chandler's Neighborhood Breweries

Patent 139 Brewing Co.

  • Why go: Family-friendly brewery with a unique Arizona legacy
  • What to try: House beers with avocado-inspired dishes
  • Setting: Lakeside patio

Founded by descendants of the Hass Avocado family, it’s named for the patent number assigned to the famous fruit. Patent 139 is a classic neighborhood brewery that offers a fun, locally rooted experience with a creative menu featuring avocado as a star ingredient.

Location: 1949 W. Ray Road, Chandler, AZ 85224

Helluva Brewing Company

  • Why go: Craft beer meets Arizona barbecue
  • What to try: Helle-weizen
  • Pair it with: Smoked barbecue sampler

With its wrap-around patio and open brewing space, Helluva Brewing is all about bold flavors and a relaxed, indoor-outdoor vibe that makes it a great option to catch all the action and enjoy a casual meal.

Location: 3950 W. Ray Road, Chandler, AZ 85226

Plan Your Chandler Brewery Crawl

Whether you opt to start your day in Downtown Chandler, where you can walk between multiple breweries, or head west to explore neighborhood favorites, you’re sure to experience a distinctive pour and personality at these Chandler breweries and taphouses.

Insider tip: Visit during happy hour (typically 3–6 p.m.) or on weekends when patios are lively and events are in full swing.

 

Make It a Weekend Getaway

Chandler’s craft beer scene is even better when you turn it into a getaway. Stay in a  Chandler hotel and explore more of the city’s dining, attend an event, and enjoy nightlife after your last pint.

Browse hotels, discover local restaurants, and plan your full itinerary at things to do in Chandler.

bodyHtml:
Business Travel in Chandler, Arizona

Business travel in Chandler centers on efficiency, accessibility, and sought-after amenities. The city offers a walkable downtown district, a strong mix of business-ready hotels, reliable transportation, and convenient access to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport and Mesa Gateway Airport. After meetings conclude, nearby dining, arts venues, and nightlife provide easy transitions into the evening.

Why Chandler Works for Business Travelers 

Major freeways connect the city to the Greater Phoenix area, allowing professionals to move between meetings, hotels, and regional business centers. This connectivity supports tighter schedules and shorter trip windows.

Downtown Chandler strengthens that efficiency. Its compact, walkable district brings together restaurants, galleries, shops, and performance venues within close reach. Instead of spreading activities across multiple areas, you can keep both business and downtime centralized.

Plan Your Visit Essentials

Planning your visit is straightforward. U.S. dollars are standard, and most establishments accept major credit cards and mobile payments. Your existing carrier typically handles mobile connectivity, with SIM cards or eSIM options available for international plans.

The ease of arriving in our city is a key advantage. We sit within driving distance of Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport and Mesa Gateway Airport. Our accessibility page can help travelers identify transportation options, attractions, and accommodations designed to support a range of needs.

Transportation & Getting Around

Getting around is practical and flexible through plenty of transportation options. Rental cars remain the most common choice, especially for those balancing multiple meetings across the metro area. Rideshare services such as Uber and Lyft operate across the city, as do traditional taxis, providing reliable point-to-point transportation.

Chandler is also one of the few cities where visitors can experience autonomous transportation firsthand. Waymo One provides fully driverless rides 24/7 within service areas, offering a convenient way to travel to popular destinations. Trips can be booked through the Waymo One app (or directly through the Uber app), making it easy to add stops and plan routes in a single ride.

Public transit is available through Valley Metro, which runs an extensive set of routes throughout the metropolitan Phoenix area. Additionally, a number of city routes have connections with the METRO light rail system, which runs in Phoenix, Mesa, and Tempe. For further information, visit our transportation page.

Work-Friendly Spots & Coworking

Spaces include Venture X Chandler, Regus San Tan Corporate Center II, and Workuity, each offering day passes, private offices, and meeting rooms suited to business travelers and remote professionals.

Chandler Public Library locations provide free Wi-Fi and quiet work areas, while Downtown Chandler Cafe and Bakery pairs reliable connectivity with great food for shorter work sessions.

Hotels such as Courtyard by Marriott Phoenix Chandler/Fashion Center also offer lobby table seating, business centers, meeting spaces, and in-room desks, giving you multiple ways to stay productive at your hotel.

After-Work Activities & Local Culture

Downtown anchors the after-work experience with a walkable mix of diverse restaurants, breweries and tap rooms, cocktail bars, and live music venues. SanTan Brewing Company and The Ostrich are two well-known spots offering casual dining and socializing.

Arts and culture add variety to the evening. Chandler Center for the Arts hosts performances throughout the year, while local galleries and public art installations provide additional choices for a quick outing between meetings or before dinner.

Hotel Highlights for Professional Visits

Our corporate travel offerings include a wide selection of properties designed to support your needs. Many feature in-room workspaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, meeting facilities, and flexible common areas that accommodate both individual work and group functions. Options range from full-service stays with conference capabilities to extended-stay properties.

Explore the variety of available hotels, then continue to plan your visit to finalize details and build a complete, business-ready itinerary.

bodyHtml:
Shopping in Chandler, AZ: A Shopper’s Paradise Itinerary

Whether you're looking for uniquely Arizona shops for a favorite souvenir, regional favorites, locally-made crafts, or national chains, you can find a shop to suit your mood.

Spend time walking Downtown Chandler's tree-lined streets. You'll find stores unique to Arizona with local merchants selling one-of-a-kind items. Eclectic art galleries, gathering spaces, a farmers market (the months of October through May), and many annual events which are a great addition to a local shopping experience.

Internationally known retail shops can be found at Chandler Fashion Center. The center welcomes groups with convenient motor coach parking and group services. Indoor and outdoor shopping nearby includes The Village, an outdoor entertainment pavilion with restaurants, a 20-screen movie theater, splash pad and much more. Out-of town visitors with an out-of-state ID are able to receive FREE visitor rewards with special offers, use password "thankyouforshopping". Be sure to plan for lunch or dinner at one of more than a dozen full service restaurants at Chandler Fashion Center or turn everyone loose at the food court.

Spectacular furnishings, jewelry, salons, and more are available at The Shoppes at Casa Paloma. Specialty boutiques are sprinkled throughout this upscale shopping destination. Here you'll find the latest fashions at the center's internationally known retail stores and privately owned boutiques.

Located in Chandler's backyard, is Phoenix Premium Outlets. One of Arizona's upscale outlet depot features designers like Armani, BCBG Max Azria, Perry Ellis, and Hugo Boss. Phoenix Premium Outlets is a shopping destination that is sure to impress your friends.

title: Superstition Mountain Itinerary | Things to Do East of Chandler
metaDescription: Plan a hike, museum visit, or lake cruise across Arizona’s eastern region with this well-rounded travel itinerary filled with fresh air.
ogTitle: Superstition Mountain Itinerary | Things to Do East of Chandler
bodyHtml:
Superstitions & East Itinerary

East of Chandler, enjoy spectacular scenery and outdoor adventure in the Superstition Mountains. Start with a morning hike at Boyce Thompson Arboretum. It has a stunning array of plants in its desert setting. The park has picnic facilities for groups that are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Next, take in an afternoon nature cruise on the Dolly Steamboat on Canyon Lake. Embark on one of their regularly scheduled Narrated Nature Cruises or charter it for a customized group outing or event. The Superstition Mountain Museum will give you a wealth of information about the area. Its exhibits tell the tale of Jacob Waltz, who many believe found a rich gold mine before he took the secret to his grave in 1891.

If you want to extend your stay in the Superstition Mountains, you can take an evening cruise with Dolly Steamboat. Their specialty cruises include the Twilight Dinner Cruise or the Astronomy Dinner Cruise.

ogTitle: Tucson and Southern Arizona Itineraries | Visit Chandler
bodyHtml:
Tucson & South Itinerary

Head south for an experience with wildlife, wine and the West. Start the morning with a tour of the Arizona Sonora Desert Museum in Tucson. Then head to either Willcox Wine Country or the Old West town of Tombstone.

Maybe you've tasted some Arizona wine while dining at Kokopelli Winery in Downtown Chandler. If you want to learn more, visit a tasting room or a vineyard, head to southern Arizona to Wilcox Wine Country. Just 2.5 hours from Chandler is the spectacular agricultural area where many of Arizona's up-and-coming wines are produced. headings.text: Professional Coworking Spaces for Business Travelers

bodyHtml:
Top Coworking Spaces in Chandler 

Chandler supports productivity far beyond the hotel room or cafe. The city’s coworking options include shared workspaces, private offices, and meeting-ready environments that help visitors stay focused throughout the day. Flexible access also lets business travelers and remote workers find workspace for rent without committing to a long-term lease, giving them more control over where and how they work.

Professional Coworking Spaces for Business Travelers 

Locations such as Venture X, Workuity, Expansive Cooper Crossing, and Workpliciti offer furnished lockable private areas, day offices, reservable meeting spaces, and professional settings to support calls or client-facing work. They also foster a community-driven environment, with shared work zones and opportunities for professional interaction. 

Flexible & Community Coworking Spaces 

Not every workday requires a private office. Chandler features coworking spaces built around flexibility and shared environments. Open coworking areas and dedicated desks create options for work trips, remote workers, solo professionals, and digital nomads who seek a more casual setup.

Many locations offer day-use access or short-term memberships, allowing visitors to plug in, connect, and move through the workday without long-term commitments. This flexibility supports a range of work styles while maintaining access to professional amenities. 

Libraries & Public Work-Friendly Spots 

Public spaces provide additional reliable options. Chandler Public Library locations offer free Wi-Fi, quiet seating, and reservable huddle spaces and meeting rooms (for library card holders), making them a practical choice suited to lighter work sessions or quick tasks between meetings. 

For a change of pace, several cafés and casual dining spots around the city also support short work sessions, offering Wi-Fi, comfortable seating, and easy access to coffee or meals between appointments.

The range of settings available throughout Chandler makes it easier to stay productive while moving between commitments and balancing work with the rest of your plans. Take a closer look below to compare available spaces and find an option that aligns with how and when you need to work.

More Ways to Stay Connected

Knowing that road warriors are often looking for a place with a strong Wifi signal, we have also included Chandler libraries which offer a strong Wifi signal  - providing a great place to log-on and catch up on email.

bodyHtml:
A warm and sunny hello to our Canadian visitors!

There's nothing quite like spending the fall and the holidays in the desert. With short-sleeve days and mild evenings, Chandler offers a unique combination of urban energy and relaxed Southwest living making it a prime destination for travelers.

Located 20 minutes from two major airports—Phoenix Sky Harbor International and Mesa Gateway - enjoy everything you love about travel with Chandler’s attention to convenience.

Escape the cold and make your way to blue skies and sunny days!  Book your stay at one of our conveniently located hotels and resorts and experience Chandler the local way.

Make your way through our local fare savoring the homegrown flavors and ethnic specialties that define our vibrant food scene.  Relish a starlit patio this fall with a local craft beer or linger over a handcrafted cocktail prepared by one of the top 15 mixologists in America.

From our burgeoning arts scene, 'hipstoric' culture, family attractions, engaging fall events and excellent shopping – it’s all a great complement to enjoying the outdoors.  From a round of golf at Arizona’s original grass golf resort to a sunrise hot air balloon ride or catching an Arizona sunset on horseback in the desert - Chandler makes it easy for enjoying the best of Arizona. 

Everything you need to connect and disconnect is here.

title: Cocktails & Wine Bars in Chandler | Drink Destinations
metaDescription: Featuring standout wine bars in Chandler and expertly curated cocktails for memorable evenings in stylish settings.
ogTitle: Cocktails & Wine Bars in Chandler | Drink Destinations
bodyHtml:
Cocktails & Wine Bars

Chandler certainly has spirit and offers dining and drinking experiences that are wildly popular.  Not to be outdone by Chandler's thriving brewery scene, talented bartenders are creating delicious handcrafted cocktails from high quality ingredients utilizing expert technique and exquisite presentation.  Whether the barkeeps are putting a spin on traditional favorites or innovating new cocktails, Chandler is home to a number of must-visit destinations for craft cocktail aficionados.  From a speakeasy-inspired craft cocktail bar located in the former basement of a 1912 hotel, to Arizona's largest self-serve Bloody Mary Bar to a lively industrial-chic bar and more - handcrafted libations and bites are easy to find in Chandler.  

If you have a preference for wine, rest assured that Chandler is a city that loves its wine.  Comfortable, well-styled wine bars and lounges celebrating the best of food and drink are plentiful.  Whether you are looking to nosh the day away with friends on a polished outdoor patio or enjoy a sophisticated, upscale dinner or looking to find a cozy bistro to enjoy that glass of Merlot after a crazy day, Chandler offers a number of wine bars and bistros that are worth a visit.

listings.description:
Welcome to the Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler. Our pet-friendly hotel boasts a convenient location off I-10, just a short distance from Arizona State University – Tempe Campus, Chandler Regional Medical Center, and Downtown Chandler. Following your fun-filled outing, kick back in comfort in our spacious rooms & suites. We provide modern amenities including plush Serta® Posturepedic beds, 55 in Smart TV that can connect to your personal apps, & mini fridge for a relaxing stay. For those looking to bring their pet along, we are a pet-friendly establishment. Need to host an event? Our flexible meeting space is great for accommodating business meetings and intimate social events. Active travelers can take advantage of our heated year-round outdoor pool and 24-hour fitness center to maintain a healthy lifestyle. From start to finish, fill your stay with fun at the Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler.
At Sonesta Select, we’ve designed a space where you can be yourself, one that fits your life on the road. Our generously sized rooms and well-crafted common areas let you spread out in, get work done, and let go when it’s time. From a great morning cappuccino to a well-earned evening cocktail or a late-night snack, we have you covered. Jump in the pool with kids, stay in to watch a movie or enjoy fresh air with a book on the patio. Sonesta Select helps make your time away from home personal, and uniquely you.

Our full-service kitchen freshly prepares and caters breakfast, lunch, dinner as well as mid-day snacks.

listings.description:
Some places become legendary. Some always have been! For Arizona, it all started in 1912 when the San Marcos celebrated it's grand opening and became Arizona's first and finest golf resort and a welcome respite for U.S. Presidents, dignitaries, Hollywood’s famous and infamous, and discriminating travelers for decades. 

Today, the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort anchors Downtown Chandler, a vibrant and historic square brimming with more than two dozen independent restaurants, boutique shops, entertainment and home to many annual events.  In addition, the sprawling property features 249 generously sized guest rooms and more than 30,000 square feet of flexible meeting and event space.  

With on-site dining, resort-style pool with cabanas and Arizona's first grass golf course, the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort is an excellent option for many travelers.

title: Pick Your Perks at the Cambria Phoenix Chandler-Fashion Center
metaDescription: Discover an elevated meeting experience at Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler – Fashion Center, where contemporary style meets Arizona‑inspired hospitality—all just 20 minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport and moments from Chandler’s premier dining, shopping, and entertainment. Perfect for small meetings and corporate gatherings, this boutique‑style hotel places your group close to major business campuses in the heart of Chandler's Price Corridor. For a limited time, planners can take advantage of an exclusive Pick Your Perks Group Promotion designed to add value and convenience to every stay. Groups with a minimum of 40 cumulative room nights can select two special perks, tailoring the offer to what matters most for their program. Benefits include options such as double planner points, complimentary suite upgrades, LCD package, a complimentary coffee break, waived parking, and more; all crafted to elevate the attendee experience. Incentives for qualifying bookings include: • Double Planner Points (6 per $1 spent) • 11% commission • One complimentary suite upgrade per 10 rooms booked • Complimentary LCD package • $100 Visa gift card • Waived daily parking fees ($9 per car/per day) • One complimentary coffee break This offer applies to new bookings made by December 31, 2026, for meetings completed by December 31, 2027, with meeting space and catering proportionate to contracted room nights. To claim this special offer, mention it to the Visit Chandler or Cambria Hotel Sales Team.

bodyHtml:
Spaziergang durch die Geschichte in Chandler

Mit ausgezeichneten Restaurants unterschiedlichster Restaurantküchen, erstklassigen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Kunst und Kultur sowie Familienattraktionen und einer großen Auswahl an Aktivitäten das ganze Jahr über, verkörpert Chandler einen aktiven und einfachen Lebensstil.

Profitieren Sie von erstklassigen Hotels, Familienattraktionen und Aktivitäten für Familien, wozu der neue Round1 Bowling & Arcade, der im Februar 2025 öffnet spannende Spiele für jedes Alter.

Verwöhnen Sie Ihre Geschmacksnerven mit einem Besuch bei einem der lokalbetriebenen Restaurants, Brauereien und Craft-Cocktail-Lounges in Ihrer Freizeit oder bei einem Gourmet-Dinner.

In Chandler gibt es eine Reihe von Wander-und Spazierwegen, auf denen ein perfekter Tag im Freien genossen werden kann. Ob auf den leichtzugänglichen Wanderwegen um den Veteran Oasisi Park oder auf den klassischen Wüstenpfaden – Besuchern können in Chandler leicht abschalten und Sonne tanken.

title: 16th Annual Arizona Balloon Classic
metaDescription: 16th Annual Arizona Balloon Classic Arizona's premier hot air balloon race & festival returns to the Wild Horse Pass Festival Grounds! Experience the magic of hot air balloons at this unforgettable three-day weekend event. Watch colorful hot air balloons fill the desert sky during morning ascensions and competition flights, then return after sunset for the spectacular Desert Glows, featuring illuminated balloons glowing against the Arizona night sky. What to Expect Balloons: Sport & recreational hot-air balloons in all shapes and sizes, including hot air balloon rides and tethered hot air balloon experiences Classic Car Show Family Fun Zone: free inflatables & BMX stunt shows Retail vendors Duncan FoodFest Experience: curated lineup of food and specialty vendors DJ and live entertainment With activities from morning through evening, the Arizona Balloon Classic offers something for the entire family and has become one of the Valley’s signature outdoor festival experiences. Kids 12 & under are FREE. Learn more about the event here. Find more to do on the Chandler Event Chandler when you're in the area!

host.description:
Located in Downtown Chandler, the Chandler Center for the Arts is a world-class performing arts center offering a unique setting for special program needs.  The venue is located steps away from the Crowne Plaza San Marcos Golf Resort and the many independent restaurants, art galleries and boutique shops located in the downtown square along with over 4,000 free parking spaces.  

The Main Stage is 64,000 sq. ft theater with seats from 840 to 1,500. 

The Hal Bogle Theater features seats for 350 and the Recital Hall seats 250. Foyer space is available for banquets; there is space as well for groups up to 250.

Discounts from the standard commercial rates are available for nonprofit organizations.

host.description:
Located in the heart of Queen Creek, the Queen Creek Olive Mill is Arizona’s only fully operational olive farm and mill, delivering a genuine tree-to-table experience inspired by Arizona’s agricultural heritage. This family-run, 100-acre property features more than 9,000 olive trees and produces premium, estate-crafted extra virgin olive oil right on site.

Guests are invited to stroll through the groves, discover the journey from harvest to pressing, and sample a variety of freshly milled olive oils and rich balsamic vinegars in the on-site marketplace. Beyond tastings, visitors will find artisan foods, unique gifts, and locally sourced specialties that showcase the flavors of Arizona. With guided tours, special events throughout the year, inviting dining options, and charming retail spaces, the Queen Creek Olive Mill offers an immersive taste of authentic Arizona farm life.


The Queen Creek Olive Mill is a 40- to 45-minute drive from most hotels in Chandler.

title: Tumbleweed Tree Lighting Ceremony & Parade of Lights

title: Annual Events in Chandler | Festivals, Food, Music & Traditions
metaDescription: Find Chandler events featuring film screenings, culinary gatherings, live music, and community traditions held across each season.
ogTitle: Annual Events in Chandler | Festivals, Food, Music & Traditions
bodyHtml:
Annual Events in Chandler 

Chandler, AZ events are perfect for creating lasting memories and shared experiences with loved ones and the community. Tradition and anticipation set these events apart, giving us something to look forward to year after year. In addition to the internationally recognized Chandler Tumbleweed Tree Lighting & Parade of Lights, here are some other unique Chandler events and festivals to enjoy during your visit.

Chandler Ostrich Festival

It's all about good times for the entire family with the Ostrich Festival taking place over two consecutive weekends in March. Each year, the Chandler Chamber of Commerce puts on this event celebrating Chandler’s early ostrich ranching history. Since the first Ostrich Festival in 1989, the annual event has been tons of fun for all. You can catch passionate live music from national and regional acts, enjoy popular carnival rides like the Zipper, Giant Wheel, and Wave Swinger, and visit attractions like the Ostrich Experience and OFF Axis Stunt Show. Of course, don’t forget to treat yourself to familiar and always tasty festival food!

Chandler International Film Festival

Each year, film lovers gather at the Chandler International Film Festival to watch over 100 films from a range of categories and dozens of countries. Shortly after its launch in 2016, the festival became Arizona’s fastest-growing film festival. Over 10 days, attendees watch films, observe and participate in discussion panels and workshops, and enjoy celebrity guest appearances and after-party celebrations. There is even a closing night awards ceremony. Anyone who appreciates the arts should hit up The Chandler International Film Festival. 

Chandler Innovation Fair

Each February, the Chandler community comes together to celebrate the exploration of invention at the Chandler Innovation Fair. The free event is entertaining for all ages and explores the importance of science in our daily life in this hand-on event which is a part of the Arizona SciTech Festival.

Chandler Jazz Festival

Typically a four-day event in April, the Chandler Jazz Festival in Downtown Chandler celebrates Jazz Appreciation Month through an impressive lineup of talented, innovative local jazz musicians. Whether you favor smooth jazz, traditional, or fusion, your ears will smile as expert musicians belt out those sweet and often improvised jazz notes. Throughout the festival, 40-plus hours of live performances will occur on the Main Stage, in the New Square development, and at designated points across Downtown Chandler.

Downtown Chandler Barbeque Festival

It’s hard to resist an annual Chandler event with a tasty food theme. The yearly Downtown Chandler Barbeque Festival brings the good times and the tasty eats each March. The event has multiple BBQ vendors, live music, and exciting games and competitions. Hosted by SanTan Brewing Company and SanTan Spirits, sip on delicious craft beer and cocktails, taste some stellar whiskey, and enjoy the weekend BBQ festival in Chandler!

title: Chandler 4th of July | Chandler's All-American Bash Event
metaDescription: Celebrate Chandler's All-American Bash in Downtown Chandler with free family activities, food vendors, live entertainment, and a July 4 concert.
ogTitle: Chandler 4th of July | Chandler's All-American Bash Event

headings.text: Top Things to Do with Kids

bodyHtml:
Chandler's All-American Bash

Summer traditions in include time at the pool, indoor activities, cooling off with a frozen treat and 4th of July events in Chandler. Come celebrate Independence Day with us for the 4th of July 2027! Join the celebration as we highlight America's independence at the Chandler's All-American Bash in Downtown Chandler for a classic summer evening celebrating freedom, food and family fun in Chandler.

Held on July 4, 2027 - this FREE 4th of July event will take place in Downtown Chandler with a slew of family-friendly activities and a selection of food and beverage vendors. There will be a 15-minute pyrotechnic show as part of the concert at the Dr. A.J. Chandler Park Stage Plaza.

The 2027 featured performer is has yet to be announced.

Things to Know

  • Admittance is FREE!
  • Please note, fireworks - of any kind, including sparklers - will NOT be allowed at the event, in the park or in the parking lots.
  • Restrooms will be available.
  • Select food and non-alcoholic vendors will be on-site. Attendees are permitted to bring waters, non-alcoholic beverages, snacks, and pre-made foods.
  • Attendees can bring coolers, canopies, umbrellas, blankets, lawn chairs, etc.
  • Dogs must be on a leash at all times, but it is recommended that they stay home.

Free Parking in Downtown Chandler 

  • Downtown Chandler parking map - including parking garages and street lots.
  • Disabled parking is available in all paved lots and Downtown Chandler parking garages.

Street Closures

  • Commonwealth Ave. at Arizona Place will be closed to all vehicular traffic July 3- 5, 2027.
  • Arizona Place from Boston St. to Buffalo St. will be closed to all vehicular traffic on July 4, 2027.

ADA Accessibility

The City of Chandler welcomes participation from all of its residents. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please allow five (5) days prior to the scheduled event. Contact the City's Special Event Coordinator at 480-782-2665 (or 711 via AZ Relay Service) or email Special Events.

headings.text: 5 Reasons to Attend the Chandler Multicultural Festival

bodyHtml:
Chandler Multicultural Festival

Held in January, the Chandler Multicultural Festival is a free annual event that celebrates the rich traditions of its residents by showcasing various cultures from around the world through dance, music, storytelling art, ethnic food, and an International Shopping Market featuring unique finds from around the world.

Join us at this year's 2026 Chandler Multicultural Festival, Saturday - January 17, 2026!

5 Reasons to Attend the Chandler Multicultural Festival

  1. Experience Diverse Cultures: The Chandler festival offers a unique opportunity to explore and celebrate the traditions, music, art, and cuisines of cultures from around the world, all in one convenient place - Downtown Chandler. 

  2. Enjoy Live Performances: With two stages, attendees will enjoy captivating live entertainment, including cultural storytelling, traditional dances, music performances, and ethnic demonstrations from various organizations highlighting a wide range of cultures. Performances on the Cross Cultural Stage start at 11 a.m. and continue till the day's last performance at 5 p.m. At the Unity Stage, the day starts with a Naturalization Ceremony at 10 a.m., followed by songs, stories and dances with performances just about every hour till the last performance at 4:30 p.m.

  3. Taste Global Cuisines: The Chandler Multicultural Festival features food vendors and Chandler food trucks offering authentic, global flavors and dishes from different countries, allowing visitors to indulge in a culinary journey without leaving Chandler.

  4. Engage in Family-Friendly Activities: With interactive cultural exhibits, games, and workshops, the festival provides fun and educational experiences for attendees of all ages.

  5. Foster Community Connection: The festival is a great way to meet people, connect with local organizations, and celebrate the unity and diversity that make Chandler a vibrant community.

This signature Chandler festival takes place in Downtown Chandler at the Stage Plaza in Dr. A.J. Chandler Park, just east of Arizona Avenue and south of Chandler Blvd (178 E Commonwealth Ave, Chandler AZ 85225). Downtown Chandler offers plenty of FREE parking options, including surface lots and Chandler parking garages conveniently located throughout the downtown district and near Downtown Chandler restaurants, shops, and the festival site. Visitors can easily access these free parking spaces for a hassle-free experience while exploring the festival and historic square.

Chandler Innovation Fair

Chandler dedicates a Saturday each February to the exploration of invention with the Chandler Innovation Fair, formerly known as the Chandler Science Spectacular. This event showcases Chandler's businesses, artists, students, and innovators, while highlighting how important science is to daily life in a fun and engaging way.

Now in its 16th year, the Chandler Innovation Fair is a free event that is part of the statewide Arizona SciTech Festival and offers unique opportunities for attendees to explore the discoveries of science engineered right here in Chandler.

Join us at the Chandler Innovation Fair on February 20, 2027 from 10 a.m. - 2 p.m for a day of innovative family-fun and exploration.

The Chandler festival takes place in Downtown Chandler with plenty of free parking close to the Downtown Chandler Stage Plaza. Plus, enjoy easy access to dozens and dozens of nearby restaurants for breakfast before or lunch after this exciting event.

For the full event schedule and list of vendors to expect, visit the Chandler's CIF page.

Chandler International Film Festival

One of Arizona's fastest-growing film festivals!

The Chandler International Film Festival returns with an expanded list of activities and events. 

January 23 - February 1, 2026

The 2026 Chandler International Film Festival will screen more than 125 films in a diverse range of categories and more than 35 countries. 

Founded in 2016, the film festival was launched with the desire to showcase international films in the local community. It quickly became the fastest-growing film festival in Arizona, and with its emphasis on international films, the festival is perfect for all who share a passion for film – from filmmakers to movie-goers. The 10-day event features several events including filmmaker workshops, Q&A panel discussions, red-carpet events, opening and award ceremonies, celebrity guest appearances, nightly after-parties, film market & expo, and more.

For 2026, the Chandler International Film Festival will take place from January 23 to February 1 at various locations. 

Head to the event website to purchase single event tickets, all access passes, and official Chandler International Film Festival merchandise.

Chandler Jazz Festival

April 9-12, 2026

Bourbon Street returns to Downtown Chandler this spring for the popular, FREE jazz-filled 4-day weekend highlighting the smooth sounds of live jazz music. The 2026 event is a must-attend event for jazz fans, and draws people from near and far to enjoy the smooth sounds of jazz with live performances from local and national performers. Visitors and residents alike have embraced the spring festival, celebrating jazz with a variety of music styles and taking in the local culture, arts, and food from the main stage in Downtown Chandler.

Gates for the main-stage performances will open an hour before the first band starting, and attendees are encouraged to bring a blanket or lawn chair to make themselves comfortable on the grassy park - perfect for enjoying the Arizona spring weather. It's not uncommon to see a bit of dancing at this music festival which is more like an event than an outdoor concert.

Visitors will find plenty of free parking options in Downtown Chandler and it's easy to extend your outing by including a visit to one of the many Downtown Chandler restaurants, cocktail bars, and boutique shops located in and around the historic square. Please note, this is an alcohol & smoke-free event.

Arriving from out-of-town, visitors will find that many Chandler, AZ hotels provide a courtesy shuttle to Downtown Chandler. However, there are two hotels situated in the downtown area, both located a short walk from the main stage - the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort and the Hilton Garden Inn Chandler Downtown.

Visitors and residents alike have embraced the spring festival, celebrating jazz with a variety of music styles and taking in the local culture, arts, and food from the main stage in Downtown Chandler. headings.text: Why does Chandler have an Ostrich Festival?
Ostrich Festival Main Stage Entertainment Lineup

bodyHtml:
Ostrich Festival

Big on family fun, the Chandler Chamber's Ostrich Festival is our city’s largest annual festival. The event takes place at Rawhide Western Town and Event Center in 2026 and is filled with a myriad of ostrich-themed activities, a carnival midway, national and regional performances, live music, a VIP Zone, and a fabulous selection of fair food.

When is the Ostrich Festival?

March 13-15, 2026 & March 20-22, 2026

Why does Chandler have an Ostrich Festival?

A tradition for more than 30 years, the Chandler Chamber Ostrich Festival returns to Chandler each March, paying tribute to Chandler's the area’s early ostrich ranching history with a bevy of family-friendly activities, entertainment, carnival rides, and daily Ostrich Festival concerts from national artists and more! 

WEEKEND ONE

Friday - March 13, 2026: 2 p.m. - Midnight

Saturday - March 14, 2026: 10 a.m. - Midnight

Sunday - March 15, 2026: 10 a.m. - 11 p.m.

WEEKEND TWO

Friday - March 20, 2026: 2 p.m. - Midnight

Saturday - March 21, 2026: 10 a.m. - Midnight

Sunday - March 22, 2026: 10 a.m. - 11 p.m.

The event will be at Rawhide Western Town and Event Center, at 5700 W. North Loop Road, Chandler AZ 85226.

Buy Your Ostrich Festival Tickets

The Chandler Ostrich Festival, owned by the Chandler Chamber of Commerce and produced by Steve LeVine Entertainment, offers affordable options for families and attendees of all ages.  

Single-day admission starts at $25 + $9.22 fees & tax for adults and $15 + $7 fees & tax for children ages 5-12. For those looking for a VIP experience with private space, bar, restrooms as well as, front of stage viewing, 1 meal and 2 drinks (alcoholic beverages for guests 21+, water & soda), VIP single-day admission is available, starting at $99 + $18.24 fees & tax for adults.

Ostrich Festival Main Stage Entertainment Lineup

Weekend ONE - March 13-15, 2026

  • KANSAS - Friday, March 13, 2026 at 9:30 p.m. and the Znora Band at 7:45 p.m.
  • Ravyn Lenae - Saturday, March 14, 2026 at 9:30 p.m. and Izzy Escobar at 8:00 p.m.
  • Jo Dee Messina - Sunday, March 15, 2026 at 8:30 p.m. and Matt Farris at 7:00 p.m.

Weekend TWO - March 20-22, 2026

  • Vanilla Ice - Friday, March 20, 2026 at 9:30 p.m. and Candyman at 8:30 p.m.
  • The Commodores - Saturday, March 21, 2026 at 9:00 p.m. and The Boogie Nights at 7:30 p.m.
  • Baby Bash - Sunday, March 22, 2026 at 8:30 p.m.and A Lighter Shade of Brown at 7:20 p.m. and NB Ridaz at 6:20 p.m.

PLEASE NOTE: ENTERTAINMENT LINEUP, ATTRACTIONS AND TIMES ARE SUBJECT TO CHANGE.

Ostrich Festival Parking

Details TBA!

Know Before You Go:

  • Can you use cash at the Ostrich Festival? When attending the Ostrich Festival, please note that food and commercial vendors, as well as parking, are cashless and require payment via your RFID wristband, credit card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. For those who prefer to use cash, RFID wristbands may be loaded at the ticket box office, carnival kiosks and reload tents. 
  • The Ostrich Festival is a rain-or-shine event, with no ticket refunds. All sales are final.
  • Ride tickets and unlimited-ride wristbands are not included with Chandler Ostrich Festival admission tickets and may be purchased for an additional fee.
  • For information on prohibited items and camera/drone/GoPro policy please visit the event website.
  • Event attendees can bring a lawn chair. Please note that storage lockers are not available.
  • The festival has a CLEAR BAG policy that limits the size and type of bags permitted. Bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5" must be clear. Clear bags must not exceed 20" x 15" x 9". Exceptions to the enforced Clear Bag Policy include diaper bags, medical, event staff, and artists/performers. Metal detector screening and an inspection of all items being carried in will take place at the festival gates.
  • Questions about the event? Text or call the Chandler Chamber Ostrich Festival at (480) 588-8497.

metaDescription: Join Chandler Rocktoberfest for Arizona craft beer, local bands, bratwurst, lawn games, and family-friendly fall festivities.
bodyHtml:
Uptown Chandler's Rocktoberfest

October 2-4, 2026

Celebrate fall with a fantastic lineup of live music, games, and of course bratwurst, pretzels and Arizona craft beer hosted by Chandler's very own SanTan Brewing Company. This annual Chandler fall festival will take place in Uptown Chandler at SanTan's brewing and distilling facility, SanTan Gardens, where festivalgoers can expect great music, contests, games, and more.

Event Times

Friday - October 2, 2026: 4:30 - 10 p.m.

Saturday - October 3, 2026: 2 -10 p.m.

Sunday - October 4, 2026: 2 - 8 p.m.

General admission tickets include festival entry only, with the option to add experiences to your visit, like participating in the wiener dog races. Tickets start at $15 plus fees if purchased in advance here, and go up to $20+ on the event day. No need to leave the kids at home, as this is a family-friendly event with fun for everyone!

Featured Activities

Whether you're ready to take on a little competition or prefer to watch the excitement from the sidelines, there is plenty of entertainment for everyone at Rocktoberfest. Popular activities include a brat-eating contest, wiener dog races, a stein-holding contest, a wiener toss with a partner, beer pong, and cornhole.

If you're looking to participate in one of the contests or races, make sure to add these to your cart when purchasing your tickets.

​

Throughout the three-day weekend, guests can also enjoy a fantastic line up of live music featuring local rock bands and tribute acts, creating a high-energy celebration from the afternoon into the evening.

bodyHtml:
Tumbleweed Tree Lighting & Parade

Dr. A.J. Chandler Park, Downtown Chandler
December 5, 2026 4:30 - 9 p.m.

You won't want to miss this Chandler, Arizona, holiday tradition. Schedule a visit to see Arizona's most iconic holiday tree, the famed Tumbleweed Tree - one of the many holiday events taking place in Chandler.

Located in the historic downtown square of Chandler, the tree has been a hallmark of the holiday season and a Chandler tradition since 1957. Chandler's beloved Tumbleweed Tree is lit on the first Saturday evening in December and is a unique southwestern tradition that draws holiday visitors from far and wide.

It all starts with the ‘holiday tree' that begins with nearly 1,200 tumbleweeds, a Christmas tree-shaped wire frame that is 33 feet tall and 18 feet wide, 25 gallons of paint and 20 gallons of fire retardant, and dusted with 50 pounds of glitter. The tree is then adorned with more than 1,200 LED Christmas lights that give it a spectacular holiday look, day or night. Lively entertainment, savory and sweet food vendors, and a charming parade are hallmarks of the annual lighting festival and are sure to put you in a festive, holiday mood.

While visiting the Tumbleweed Tree, bring the family and visit Santa for a FREE photo.

Santa will be at Santa's house on:

  • Saturday, December 5, 2026 from 4:30 - 9 p.m.
  • Saturday, December 12, 2026 from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
  • Tuesday, December 15, 2026 from 6 - 8 p.m.
  • Saturday, December 19, 2026 from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.

headings.text: Halloween Events & Activities in Chandler, AZ

bodyHtml:
Chandler Fall Events & Festivals

Fall in Chandler means crisp mornings, warm afternoons, outdoor dining, and the perfect backdrop for a season packed with festivals, food, culture, and family fun. Whether you’re here for frybread, polka, trick-or-treating, or 5Ks, our fall events calendar overflows with ways to make the most of the season and plan your visit. Many gatherings are free to attend, and the lineup reflects the city’s lively spirit, offering something for everyone, from families and foodies to music lovers and pet parents.

Uptown Chandler's Rocktoberfest - October 2–4, 2026

Chandler's Rocktoberfest returns this fall at new Uptown Chandler location for 2026. Enjoy three days of craft beer, exciting competitions, and live music at SanTan Gardens.

Programming includes a stein-holding contest, wiener toss, brat-eating competition, cornhole, beer pong, and wiener dog races. SanTan Brewing Company will be pouring throughout the weekend, alongside cocktails from SanTan Distilling and a selection of German fare.

Chandler #AZ48 Half Marathon, 10K & 5K - October 25, 2026

Lace up for the #AZ48 Chandler Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K, returning for yet another year of community spirit and energetic racing. This one draws runners from across the state with its fast, flat route that loops through the scenic streets of Downtown Chandler and beyond.

All finishers of the Half Marathon, 10K, or 5K will receive a custom medal. The top three male and female finishers in each distance will earn awards, with additional age group awards presented to the top three men and women in each age category.

Expect hydration stations, cheering spectators, and a festive post-run atmosphere. For those traveling in, the Hilton Garden Inn is offering special rates for the weekend. Learn more about those and how to register on the official #AZ48 race website.

Halloween Spooktacular - October 30, 2026

Looking for Halloween happenings with kid-friendly charm? Don’t miss the Halloween Spooktacular held at Dr. A.J. Chandler Park in Downtown Chandler. Families will find free trick-or-treating, carnival-style games, and costumed characters. Rounding out the evening is a parade, food vendors, and a ton of photo ops. No admission required, and costumes are highly encouraged for kids and grown-ups alike!

27th Annual Mariachi & Folklórico Festival - November 1, 2026

Celebrate Mexican music and dance at the Chandler Center for the Arts' 27th Annual Mariachi & Folklórico Festival featuring world-class mariachi, C.A.L.L.E de Arizona folklórico dancers and a special celebration in honor of Día de Muertos.

Chandler Golf Challenge - November 6, 2026

The annual golf event will take place at Bear Creek Golf Complex in South Chandler. The event combines casual tournament play with fundraising efforts and lighthearted competition. It’s a relaxed setting for players of all levels to connect on the course for a good cause.

Diwali: Festival of Lights - November 7, 2026

This annual Chandler festival returns to Downtown Chandler with a whole evening of dance, music, traditional food, and illuminated displays. Celebrate Indian culture through dance, music, food, and lights at Chandler's Diwali Festival of Lights, a welcoming, family-friendly event.

Sumo + Sushi Phoenix - November 13–15, 2026

Experience the excitement of Japan's 1,500-year-old national sport paired with delicious local sushi as Sumo + Sushi Phoenix returns to Rawhide. This immersive cultural experience will bring more than a dozen high-energy exhibition sumo matches, expert demonstrations, and curated sushi from Shimogamo, making it an unforgettable evening in Chandler this fall.

Woofstock - November 21, 2026

Woofstock is the perfect event for dog lovers and their "Very Important Pooches" (VIPs) happens each year in Chandler at Tumbleweed Park. This dog-friendly outing brings together adoptions, pet-related vendors, a photo contest, and pet caricatures.

Indian Frybread & Arts Festival - November 21, 2026

Returning for its 3rd year in Chandler, the Indian Frybread & Arts Festival at Rawhide brings together a vibrant celebration of Indigenous culture and community. Guests can experience the rich traditions of Native American culture through handcrafted art, live music, and captivating dance performances.


Alongside cultural showcases, the festival features traditional Indian frybread and carnival rides. With family-friendly fun and an atmosphere of celebration, this event offers an exciting way to enjoy Native American artistry, flavors, and entertainment all in one place.

bodyHtml:
Chandler Holiday Event Guide

In Chandler, Arizona, it really is the most wonderful time of year and is especially inviting to visitors with its mild winter weather and plenty of decorations, activities and festive events that feature holiday music, dazzling lights, amazing food, and tumbleweeds (it is Arizona, after all!).

In addition to great shopping and the wonderfully decorated hotels, spending the holidays in Chandler is sure to get you into the holiday spirit when you are attending one of the many uniquely, Arizona holiday traditions that are perfect for a family outing, a date night, or a fun outing with friends. Be sure to check out our Chandler hotel deals page for current discounts and special offers.

Chandler Tumbleweed Tree Lighting - December 5, 2026

Holiday traditions abound, but make plans to visit the most iconic tree in all of the Southwest - the Chandler Tumbleweed Tree. It is proudly displayed in the park square in Downtown Chandler and is hard to miss at more than 30 feet tall.

It's about as Arizona as it gets, and this uniquely Chandler tradition makes the perfect backdrop for your holiday photos. The official tree lighting takes place on the first Saturday in December and has been a tradition since 1956. The tree is officially lit immediately following Chandler's Parade of Lights, at approximately 8 p.m. The Tumbleweed Tree will be on display through early January 2027.

Chandler Chanukah Menorah Lighting

In partnership with the City of Chandler and The Chabad of the East Valley, a community Menorah is lit each year in Downtown Chandler and will be lit every night in Hanukkah. Enjoy live entertainment and activities for the whole family at this welcoming community event.

ZooLights at the Phoenix Zoo - November 25, 2026 through January 15, 2027

Each year, the Phoenix Zoo celebrates the holidays with ZooLights, a bright Arizona holiday tradition perfect for a family outing or a romantic stroll. Fun for all ages, ZooLights is a dazzling display featuring millions of lights and more than 700 dazzling light displays, 50 animal lanterns, a 170-foot-long immersive light tunnel, as well as several music and light shows synchronized to thousands lights.

The Phoenix Zoo also offers an exceptional Sensory Friendly ZooLights experience on select dates, which will feature quieter music, reduced flashing lights, smaller crowds, and more. General admission tickets for individuals aged 3+ can be purchased online or at the door.

Las Noches de las Luminarias at the Desert Botanical Garden

While visiting Chandler, be sure to plan to attend this amazing Arizona holiday celebration at the Desert Botanical Garden. This Arizona attraction features the popular southwestern holiday tradition, Las Noches de las Luminarias, where visitors make their way through the 140-acre garden, guided by 8,000 hand-lit luminarias, while enjoying live entertainment. The garden comes alive with art and live music played by local musicians staged throughout the garden trails for an event you won’t want to miss.

The Las Noches de las Luminarias will be held on select days, November 27, 2026 through January 3, 2027. The garden will close at 4 p.m. on each day of Luminaria. Advance reservations are required and have a specific entry time for a limited capacity. The last guest admission is 8 p.m. Adult admission tickets start at $39.95, and children's tickets start at $18.95 which are available for purchase online here.

Santa at Chandler Fashion Center

The magic of the holiday season comes alive with a visit to Santa’s winter wonderland at Chandler Fashion Center. Santa will be there starting in November and will be located at the Macy's Court. A visit with Santa is always free, and photo packages are available for purchase.

Schedule Your Spot to Meet the Big Guy

Pre-booking your visit is recommended to help reduce wait time, and it's easy. 

  • Pre-book and receive free perks!
  • Show up at your designated time.
  • Share your wish list with Santa and his helpers.
  • Make a lasting memory and get your photo taken with Santa.

Santa's House in Downtown Chandler - December 5, 12, 15 & 19, 2026

Hosted by the City of Chandler, stop by and see Santa in Downtown Chandler at Santa's House for a free family photo during select hours in Dr. A.J. Chandler Park.

Santa's House Photo Hours

  • Saturday, December 5, 2026 from 4:30 - 9 p.m.

Sippin' Santas Pub Crawl - December 12, 2026

The Sippin’ Santas Pub Crawl takes over Downtown Chandler featuring more than a dozen Downtown Chandler hot spots. Enjoy drink specials, food, and fun at Downtown Chandler's jolliest bars and restaurants in town. Celebrate the holiday season with festivities including live entertainment, endless Santa selfies, and the best specialty drinks in town on this self-guided pub crawl with your friends.

Please note that there are three sessions offering staggered registrations, and each features a unique wristband for enjoying specials at participating businesses. Must be 21+ to participate. Please drink responsibly.

bodyHtml:
Sports Events

The Valley of the Sun, with more than 300 days of sunshine a year, attracts some of the biggest names in fitness races. In Chandler, female runners participate each January in the SHE Power Half Marathon and 5K in Downtown Chandler. This event empowers women of all ages and abilities and celebrates that can-do-attitude shared by determined women. With sunny days, blue skies and mild winter temperatures, the SHE Power Half Marathon & 5K is an excellent add-on to a fantastic girls weekend in Chandler, AZ.

For competitive races, check out the #AZ48 Chandler Half Marathon, 10K, and 5K each October in Downtown Chandler or just minutes away from Chandler is the P.F. Chang's Rock-N-Roll Marathon each January finishing alongside Tempe Town Lake.

The great thing about participation sports, there are many 5K and assorted walks and runs that will put a spring in your step and maintain your active, healthy lifestyle. So if longer distances aren't your style, there are plenty of 5K running and walking events in Chandler. Annual events include the Run4Love 5K in February, the Hakuna Mimosa 5K in April, the Brew HaHa 5K in October and the Strut Your Stuffing 5K each November, held on Thanksgiving Day - perfect for 'turkeys' of all ages.

bodyHtml:
AZ48 Half Marathon, 10K & 5K in Chandler, AZ

The AZ48 Half Marathon, 10K & 5K return to Downtown Chandler on Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026. The half marathon and 10K start at 6:30 a.m. and the 5K follows at 6:45 a.m., with wave starts based on pace. All three distances begin and end at the Downtown Chandler Stage.

Each course is flat and USATF-certified. The measured distances give runners aiming for a personal record a benchmark, while the half marathon also offers a chance to test your pacing ahead of a full marathon.

Use the official AZ48 website to register and check current event details.

Plan Your Race Weekend in Chandler

A downtown stay keeps you close to the start/finish line. The Hilton Garden Inn Chandler Downtown serves as the host hotel and offers special race weekend rates. Compare other hotels to find a stay that best fits your plans and needs for the weekend.

Before race day, visit the expo and packet pickup in the Hilton Garden Inn ballroom on Saturday from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. A limited number of Sunday packet pickups are available by reservation only, so be sure to secure a spot in advance if you can’t make it on Saturday. Arriving Friday gives you time to pick up your race materials, locate the start and finish area, and get familiar with downtown before an early Sunday morning start.

Fuel up the night before with dinner at a locally loved downtown restaurant, or take in an early meal at a well-known city joint that serves a carb-loading favorite. On the morning of, stop at a coffee shop or breakfast spot for something familiar and a moment to gather yourself before the run. After crossing the finish line, meet friends for brunch, sip craft beer or enjoy a chef-driven meal overflowing with Arizona flavor. Savor the chance to refuel and celebrate your run.

An extra day in the city offers options beyond the race. Check out things to do in Chandler or browse the fall events calendar for activities during your stay. Our hotel deals and specials page lists more offers for an extended stay.

Tips for Race Day

The day before the race, lay out your gear and nutrition. Update yourself on aid station locations and check the forecast. Plan your hydration and sun protection. Remember, this is the desert.

On race morning, arrive early to park, make your way to the stage and settle into your assigned start wave. Before heading out, review any race-day updates and communications from event organizers.

Bring your bib to the starting area and keep it visible. Follow the organizer’s guidance on packet pickup, pacing requirements, course rules and event logistics.

Once you’ve crossed the finish line, take a second to appreciate the miles behind you. Cheer on fellow runners, collect your medal and enjoy the atmosphere downtown. A personal best deserves a toast, and so does showing up, putting in the work and finishing with a smile and sense of accomplishment. This is your moment. You’ve earned it.

bodyHtml:
Cactus League Spring Training

Batter up!  15 Teams + 10 Stadiums = 1 Fabulous Spring!

Make Chandler your home base for the 2026 Cactus League Spring Training Season.

Catch the boys of summer and bask in the warm, Arizona sunshine when spring training returns to greater Phoenix every February and March. Arizona spring training brings more than 200 MLB games all played in 30 days!  Fun fact: no two ballparks are more than a 45-minute drive from each other - that's a home run!

In Arizona, baseball season is never far away. As soon as the World Series ends, fans start their countdown to Cactus League spring training. For those who love spring training's intimate stadiums, it's a chance to escape snow-covered sidewalks, grab a bag of peanuts, and listen for the crack of the bat that means spring.

Located just 20 minutes from two Phoenix area airports, think of Chandler, Arizona as your own personal "dugout" and catch all the action as veterans and up-and-coming hopefuls vie for spots on the teams. You'll be minutes away from the best spring training venues while enjoying the comforts of Chandler's award-winning hotels and resorts.

Cactus League spring training starts at the end of February every year and continues through March and when added to your itinerary along with one of Chandler's engaging spring events - your Arizona getaway is sure to be a home run! 

Check the Cactus League schedule on the official website of the Cactus League to see when your favorite team plays. The AZ Spring Training Schedule 2026 season opens on Friday, February 20th, and runs through Tuesday, March 24th. 

Day games generally start at 1:05 p.m. or 1:10 p.m. and night games at 6:05 p.m. or 6:10 p.m. unless noted differently on the 2026 Spring Training schedule. Please note that the dates, times, and players are subject to change.

bodyHtml:
SHE Power 10K & 5K in Chandler

 

SHE Power brings an all-female running event to the heart of Downtown Chandler. Produced by 131 Event Productions, it is the largest all-female race in Arizona. The 2027 event pairs a 5K with a 10K, plus a race-day atmosphere that empowers women of all ages and abilities and keeps the focus on confidence, community, and forward motion.

 

Race Details & What to Expect

Plan for race weekend on Saturday, January 23, and Sunday, January 24, 2027. Packet pickup and the SHE Power open house run from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Saturday in the ballroom of the Hilton Garden Inn Downtown Chandler. On Sunday, packet pickup takes place from 6:30 to 7:30 a.m. at the starting area at Downtown Chandler Stage Park, then the 10K and 5K begin at 8 a.m. in pace-based waves. The course closes at 10 a.m., and the event lists a minimum 10K pace of 19.5 minutes per mile.

Both courses are USATF-certified. Expect water stops that offer water and Gatorade, plus a limited number of portable restrooms. After crossing the finish line, you’ll receive a stunning custom finisher medal, cake, and a long-stem rose. SHE Power also provides free professional race photos and a post-race celebration.

To register, visit the official SHE Power event website, which also features the current entry options, course links, and the full schedule.

Highlights & Tips for Runners

If you chase a finish-line moment that feels personal, this event delivers. Aim for an award: SHE Power recognizes the top three women overall in both races and also awards a commemorative SHE Power ceramic tile to the top three runners across multiple age groups (from 18 and under through 70+). If you’re running your first 10K or looking to topple your current record, you can treat the course-close time and pace requirement as a clear pacing target.

Race-day basics stay simple. Arrive early enough to park, pick up your packet, complete your pre-race routine, and line up in the correct wave. Don’t forget the fuel that works for you, since the event asks participants with additional nutrition needs to bring preferred items.

 

Hotels & Dining for Race Weekend

Stay close to the starting line. The Hilton Garden Inn, where pre-race packets are available Saturday, is conveniently located downtown. The Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort is another comfortable option.

For race-fuel meals, keep your plans downtown so you can walk, eat, and keep the day uncomplicated. Over Easy opens early and offers breakfast options that fit a pre-race meal window. Downtown Chandler Cafe and Bakery is another quick breakfast stop close to the event. After finishing, celebrate at The Perch Brewery or SanTan Brewing Company. Both of these local favorites are perfect for a relaxed meal and a drink. 

Make the most of your weekend and join the excitement; come cheer on or run in the SHE Power and experience Chandler at its best!

bodyHtml:
Spring Events

With near-perfect weather and great events to get you on the move…spring is the perfect time to plan your trip, book your Chandler hotel and celebrate the great outdoors!

From ostriches to shamrocks to finger-licking barbecue and jazz – Chandler AZ’s spring festivals and events have you covered. And with sunny days and warm weather, now is the time to explore the outdoors with leisurely park strolls, desert hikes, by bike throughout our bike-friendly community or with some great patio dining you'll find fun things to do in Chandler this spring!

Chandler International Film Festival - February 5–14, 2027

The Chandler International Film Festival is a non-profit, diverse and pioneering film festival that focuses on unique, creative and diverse films from passionate, independent global filmmakers bringing novel ideas and varied art forms to filmmaking. The star-studded festival includes red-carpet experiences, world premieres, film screenings, awards ceremonies, educational workshops, and exciting after-parties for filmmakers, celebrities, and event attendees. Held in February, the Chandler International Film Festival is a dynamic film festival screening more than 120 films and offering event attendees the opportunity to connect with filmmakers, film executives, networks, and most importantly, to enjoy a selection of incredible films!

SHE Power 10K & 5K - January 24, 2027

In January, Arizona's largest, all-female running event starts and finishes in Downtown Chandler - a downtown district brimming with local more than 40 eateries, boutique shops, entertainment and art. The SHE Power 10K & 5K event is designed to empower women of all ages and abilities with race finishers receiving a fabulous race medal, finish line cake celebration, and long-stem rose at the conclusion of their run.

Grab your girlfriends and make it a race-cation, staying at one of Chandler's hotels and enjoying the local attractions, shopping, and fantastic dining opportunities.

Chandler Innovation Fair - February 20, 2027

This celebration of science has been 100 years in the making as Chandler celebrates community innovators in and around Chandler, AZ at this Arizona SciTech Signature event. The free, one-day event is held each February in Downtown Chandler.

Cactus League Spring Training - February & March 2027

In addition to great events, did you know that Arizona is home to 15 Major League Baseball teams each spring? Chandler’s award-winning hotels are located minutes away from the Cactus League Spring Training stadiums, making Chandler, Arizona your personal “dugout “for all the action. Find all the details on when your favorite team plays on the Cactus League Spring Training schedule.

Downtown Chandler Barbeque Festival

Get your BBQ on at Chandler's two-day, barbeque festival where sunny days, live music, and the tantalizing aroma of barbeque come together in Downtown Chandler each March. Featuring delicious, family fun, competitions, games, mouth-watering BBQ, and an array of craft brews and spirits, you’re sure to have a finger-lickin’ good time at the Downtown Chandler Barbeque Festival! The festival is produced by one of Chandler's award-winning Arizona craft breweries, SanTan Brewing Company - so you know you'll find plenty of fantastic Arizona craft beer to enjoy at this annual Chandler festival.

Chandler Chamber Ostrich Festival

Celebrating Chandler’s early ostrich-ranching days, the annual Chandler Chamber Ostrich Festival held at Rawhide Western Town and Event Center features national and regional entertainment, carnival rides, upscale crafts, food and beverage vendors, and of course ostriches at this annual March festival! This is one of Chandler's largest special event and an event not to be missed.

Chandler Jazz Festival

Bourbon Street comes to Downtown Chandler with this jazz-filled 4-day festival highlighting local and national jazz groups and musicians at a variety of venues. Book your Chandler hotel and make a music-filled weekend getaway around this live jazz festival.

South Pacific Islands Festival

Each April, the South Pacific Islands Festival comes to Dr. A.J. Chandler Park bringing a day full of Pacific Island culture, food, and entertainment to Downtown Chandler. Enjoy family-friendly activities like husking cocunts and weaving palm tree baskets, along with live music and cultural performances throughout this free event. Don't miss the evening fire dances and memorable experiences the festival will bring to Chandler this spring.

title: Submit an Event to Chandler AZ's Calendar of Events
metaDescription: If you have an event up and coming in the Chandler area, submit your event to the official calendar of events for Chandler, Arizona.
ogTitle: Submit an Event to Chandler AZ's Calendar of Events

headings.text: What type of events are listed?

bodyHtml:
Submit Your Event

We want to spread the word about your event! Visit Chandler actively promotes events happening here and we're always searching for fun events for Chandler visitors to experience.  

What type of events are listed?

The event calendar on Visit Chandler is designed to appeal to visitors and locals seeking leisure activities. Before you submit your event, consider asking yourself - "Would I or someone I know, attend an event like this while on vacation?"

Examples include live music, performing arts shows, festivals, museum and art gallery exhibitions, culinary events, car shows, festivals and sporting events. Events must be held in Chandler or at large regional event venues within Maricopa County that do not compete with Chandler events. Events such as grand openings, pet adoptions, open houses, fundraisers and membership-only events will generally not be listed, as these typically fall outside the interest of a potential visitor to Chandler. Event submissions are evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Event Requirements

To make event listings appealing and easily accessible to all visitors, event submissions must include the following:

  • A full description of the event and what attendees can expect including contact information, location, admission fees, event website and more.
  • A landscape high-resolution photo from the actual event.

Event flyers, graphics, and images submitted with text overlays or logos will not be approved. Exceptions are made for first-time events.​ Events must be submitted no later than 1 week before the event date, but we encourage events to be submitted as early as possible.

bodyHtml:
Soak Up Summer in Chandler, AZ

Sunshine, splash pads, rooftop cocktails, family adventures, and vibrant downtown nights — Chandler is your home base for an unforgettable metro Phoenix summer getaway.

  • Explore Summer Events
  • Find Chandler Hotels
  • Family Fun
  • Indoor Activities

Summer Events Worth the Trip

Downtown Chandler Summer Market

Rise early and browse local vendors, fresh flavors, and handcrafted finds Saturday mornings from June to September, in Downtown Chandler at Dr. A.J. Chandler Park from 7-11 a.m.

Chandler's All-American Bash

Celebrate Independence Day on Sunday, July 4, 2027 at Chandler’s All-American Bash in Downtown Chandler. This family-friendly, July 4th celebration includes live music, food vendors, lawn games, and a stunning pyrotechnic show.

Summer Concerts & Community Events

From cultural celebrations to live music, Chandler keeps the calendar full all summer long. Explore the full lineup of events on our events calendar.

Family-Friendly Indoor Attractions

Cool off Chandler-style with plenty of ways to beat the heat indoors, where Chandler's indoor attractions keep the fun going.

  • Arcade adventures 
  • Indoor kart racing
  • Escape rooms
  • Family entertainment centers
  • Museums & galleries
  • Shopping escapes

The Round1 Bowling & Arcade at the Chandler Fashion Center is perfect for cool, competitive family fun with a range of activities. Indoor thrill seekers can also visit the Rush Xtreme adventure park. Check out Andretti Indoor Karting & Games for go-karting, virtual reality experiences, and arcade action. For immersive adventures, Makutu’s Island delivers nonstop fun that keeps little ones exploring for hours. 


Other popular spots are Taroko Sports, Big Air Trampoline Park, and Uptown Jungle Fun Park, both overflowing with energy-burning fun. Don’t forget about traditional indoor options like bowling alleys, roller rinks, escape rooms, and mini-golf centers scattered throughout the city—perfect for staying out of the heat while keeping the kids entertained.

Pool Days & Splash-Worthy Fun

This sunny locale is home to several family-friendly aquatic centers, each offering its own unique way to cool off and have fun. Hamilton Aquatic Center boasts thrilling slides and a relaxing current river, while Mesquite Groves Aquatic Center invites visitors to enjoy water slides and a lazy river perfect for a laid-back afternoon. A local favorite, Desert Oasis Aquatic Center combines exciting slides with a sand volleyball court for added outdoor fun.


Families especially love the Nozomi Aquatic Center for its interactive water features that provide endless entertainment for young visitors. In addition to its aquatic centers, the city also offers a variety of spray and splash pads ideal for younger children and casual play. Spots like the Desert Breeze Park and the Espee Park Spray & Splash Pad offer easygoing, free-entry fun during the warmer months.

Downtown Chandler After Dark

Downtown Chandler after dark transforms warm summer nights into something truly unforgettable. As the sun sets, the district comes alive with glowing patios, live music drifting from local restaurants featuring global flavors, and a relaxed energy that makes Chandler feel both vibrant and welcoming.

Whether you’re enjoying craft cocktails under string lights, exploring vibrant murals that become even more striking after sunset, or catching a performance at the Chandler Center for the Arts, the neighborhood invites you to stay just a little longer. It perfectly blends small-town charm with modern desert cool, creating an effortless summer vibe that is unmistakably Chandler.

Discover local downtown favorites, including: 

  • Born & Bred by Aftermath – Chef-driven menu with an elevated atmosphere
  • Craft 64 – Dine at one of the nation's top pizzerias. 
  • George & Gather – A seed-oil-free, full-scratch kitchen with unforgettable drinks. 
  • SanTan Brewing Company – Arizona-based, award-winning hand-crafted beer paired with delicious food.

Start Early. Explore More.

Chandler Parks & Outdoor Fun

Plan an early adventure before cooling off with brunch, shopping, or pool time later in the day. Early mornings and evenings are great for exploring local parks. Look to early mornings to hit the hiking trails. Parks like Tumbleweed Park and Desert Breeze Park are great for family picnics, playgrounds, and open green spaces. Both offer plenty of shade, walking trails, and summer events like movie nights.

Love a good hike? The region offers many scenic, accessible trails, many of which begin just minutes from the city. For a relaxed outing close to home, the Paseo Vista Recreation Area provides an easy loop trail that’s perfect for walkers of all ages. A short drive takes you to San Tan Mountain Regional Park, where you’ll find a mix of moderate to challenging trails ideal for those looking to break a sweat and soak in desert views.

Head to South Mountain Park and Preserve, one of the largest urban parks in the country, offering trails for all skill levels along with sweeping vistas of the Phoenix metro area. For a more leisurely experience, Tempe Town Lake features scenic lakeside paths that are perfect for a peaceful stroll or a family outing.

Where to Eat, Sip, & Savor Summer

Summer is tasty in this Arizona gem. Families can enjoy crowd-pleasing spots like Benihana and Hash Kitchen, or cool off with sweet treats from Snowtime and SomiSomi. Adults can also unwind at one of the many breweries. Try a handcrafted beer at SanTan Brewing Company, rooftop drinks at The Perch Brewery, or casual backyard vibes at QuartHaus.

Make Chandler Your Summer Home Base

From splash pads and family attractions to shopping and great local eats, Chandler is a great destination for enjoying a relaxed summer escape. Whether traveling with family or flying solo, you’ll find endless things to do in Chandler—indoors and out. Start planning your summer adventure today.
