headings.text: Add Your Chandler Location/Props/Picture Vehicles/Collections to the Statewide Library
Submit Your Chandler location, prop or picture vehicle

bodyHtml:
Add Your Chandler Location/Props/Picture Vehicles/Collections to the Statewide Library

Do you own or manage a Chandler property, props, or "picture vehicles" that should be seen on film? Perhaps a vintage sewing machine, a 1950s-style pick-up truck and a curated collection of vintage typewriters? The Arizona Film & Digital Office maintains a FREE database of statewide locations, props, and picture vehicles that are available for use in filming. From films to television shows to commercials and music videos - production companies are looking for a wide range of venues, sites, and props to be considered for production needs.

Location requests are vast and varied, with many seeking office buildings, restaurants, stores, parks, homes, strip malls, schools, churches, downtown areas and so much more. 

Standard film production industry practices include:

  • The property owners will be provided a location contract for the site being utilized and for allowing the business owner or designate to be on-site during production.
  • The production company will provide a certificate of insurance to the property owner to add the landowner as an additional insured holder on their insurance policy.

List your assets for FREE by completing the form and uploading your image (in JPEG format), Following your submittal, your photos and information will be reviewed and pending approval, will be added to the Arizona Film & Digital Media Program's digital library and available for viewing by location by film industry professionals worldwide. 

When submitting photo(s), consider including at least 5 to 10 different images to show the location's interior and exterior, and keep in mind, that producers and location scouts are likely to be more receptive to wide-angle and panoramic views that allow them to get the "big picture."

Before you submit your photos, keep these tips in mind:

  • Initial submissions are limited to a maximum of 10 photos during upload. Additional photos may be sent via email to the Arizona Film & Digital Media Office. 
  • Ensure you have full rights to the images submitted.
  • Opt for wide-angle shots to show the most expansive view.
  • Be sure to include multiple angles (Notate views: North, South, East, West)
  • Include interior and exterior views
  • Showcase site at day/night/seasonal
  • You will have the opportunity to indicate any usage restrictions for the location(time, utilities (i.e. no running water), exterior only, etc.)

Should there be interest in using your site or prop, you will be contacted by the Arizona Film & Digital Media Program's office and/or Film Chandler staff.

metaDescription: Learn about film permit requirements, fees, and timelines for filming on city-owned land in Chandler, Arizona.
ogTitle: Film Permits & Procedures in Chandler | Permit Timeframes

headings.text: Submit Your Chandler location, prop or picture vehicle

bodyHtml:
Chandler Film Permits & Procedures

Depending on when and where you are filming in Chandler, you may need a Chandler Film Permit. Permits are required when filming activities impact the public on city-owned land and assets. 

Each filming activity is reviewed on a case-by-case basis to determine if and when a permit is required. For quick assistance, submit the "who, what, why, and how" of your production needs by completing the Film Chandler form below and a Chandler staff member will contact you to discuss your proposed film shoot.

There are many filming situations in Chandler where a film permit is NOT required – as a rule, a Chandler Film Permit is required in situations when filming activities impact the public at large, for example – the use of a park, restricting street access, and other similar situations.

Depending on the city-owned assets and properties to be used, additional rental fees may apply. An example would be the use of a City of Chandler park pavilion.

Production crews must obtain proper permission from private land and business owners when filming on non-city-owned property.

The submittal of your film shoot form does not imply or approve your film shoot. Film Chandler office staff will respond to you as soon as possible.

Chandler Film Permit Timeframes

Permits generally take two weeks to be issued and permits are issued when filming impacts the community.

The Chandler filming permit fee for residents is $100 and $135 for non-Chandler residents.

Trade snow for sunshine and discover Chandler's warm, festive spirit this holiday season. Chandler’s mild weather, marked by sunny days and blue skies, offers a pleasant escape from the cold and snow, infused with plenty of holiday cheer. 

While you’ll enjoy fantastic holiday shopping, you’ll also have the freedom to engage in your favorite outdoor activities, such as hiking desert trails, golfing, swimming, and dining al fresco - day or night.

Chandler, AZ Hotels and Resorts

Find the perfect stay for your Chandler AZ visit! With more than 30 hotels in Chandler, you’re sure to discover a hotel that meets your preferences, budget, and expectations so you can rest easy.

Most Chandler hotels are located within a short 20-minute drive from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport with easy access to top attractions, activities, and outdoor recreation. From the comfort of a full-service Arizona resort for a relaxing vacation, a sophisticated conference hotel, a modern, all-suite property for your extended family vacation, or stylish hotel that is perfect for your next business trip - Chandler has you covered with a great place to stay. Find your perfect hotel near Chandler restaurants, attractions, and events.

Book a room in Downtown Chandler to enjoy a long weekend with a round of golf at the San Marcos Golf Course, Arizona’s first grass golf course, live music at more than a dozen hot spots and perhaps a special event or a performance at the Chandler Center for the Arts. Both the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort and the Hilton Garden Inn Downtown Chandler hotels anchor the downtown district with hotel lobbies that are steps away from more than 40 local restaurants and bars, boutiques, entertainment options and plenty of Downtown Chandler parking. 

In south Chandler, discover Chandler’s only lakeside hotel, the Residence Inn by Marriott Phoenix/Chandler South which offers a more boutique experience.  Find modern and stylish rooms at Chandler’s full-service Marriott hotel, the Marriott Phoenix Chandler featuring Chandler’s largest ballroom, desert views and some of the best cocktails in town at their Proof ’19 Bar.

Looking to treat yourself to a little retail therapy? You’ll find seven different hotels near Chandler Fashion Center mall offering a wide range of options making it easy to shop ‘til you drop. From the bright and modern décor at Element Chandler Fashion Center to the pool-side cabanas at the sleek, CAMBRiA Hotel Phoenix Chandler, you’ll find options that will turn your next business trip into a mini-vacation between meetings.

A stay in West Chandler, along Interstate 10, provides excellent access to regional attractions making it a prime spot for experiencing all of metro-Phoenix. Enjoy world-famous chocolate chip cookies at the recently renovated DoubleTree by Hilton Phoenix Chandler hotel or book a stay at the Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler, located steps away from more than a couple of dozen Chandler restaurants and shops.

If you plan to stay in Chandler more than a few days, make yourself at home at one of Chandler’s extended-stay hotels offering a home-away-from-home accommodations with kitchen facilities and more. 

Most hotels in Chandler, AZ feature an outdoor pool and no matter where you decide to stay when visiting, you’ll find Chandler to be an excellent home base for your Arizona getaway.

headings.text: Make the Most of Your Downtown Stay

bodyHtml:
Hotels in Downtown Chandler, AZ

Downtown Chandler is a natural choice for travelers planning to attend events or stay close to the city’s most active district. Hotels in our walkable downtown place you near a wide mix of local restaurants and bars, live music venues, boutique shopping, entertainment options, and attractions such as Arizona’s first grass golf course. 

Booking a stay is especially convenient during one of Chandler’s annual events, including the SHE Power 10K & 5K, Downtown Chandler Fine Art & Wine Festival, AZ48 Half Marathon, and the Tumbleweed Tree Lighting and Parade.

Where to Stay

For travelers seeking amenities and space, Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort is a standout choice. The establishment has extensive meeting and event facilities, on-site dining options, and a relaxed courtyard atmosphere that feels distinct from typical urban hotels. Guests have walkable access to a historic golf course located three minutes away, making this one a strong fit for leisure travelers, groups, and event attendees who want everything in one place.

Hilton Garden Inn Chandler Downtown is a modern hotel that caters to visitors seeking comfort and convenience. The property offers clean, contemporary rooms, an outdoor pool, a fitness center, and EV charging, along with the reliability many visitors expect from a national brand. Its location places restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues mere steps away; it’s a fantastic option for weekend getaways or more extended vacations. 

Nearby, The Aloha appeals to guests who prefer a boutique experience with personality. This smaller hotel features a retro-inspired design and a pool, blending midcentury style with modern updates. With its location along North Arizona Avenue, guests stay close to the action while enjoying a more intimate setting that stands apart from traditional hotels.

Dining, Shopping, & Things to Do  

Downtown Chandler makes it easy to build a full itinerary on foot. Popular restaurants include Hidden House, Brickyard Downtown, and Murphy’s Law Irish Pub. Coffee shops like Peixoto Coffee Roasters sit among a cluster of locally owned dining and retail spots, allowing a casual coffee break to fit naturally into a stroll around the area. Cultural stops such as the Chandler Center for the Arts and the Vision Gallery host exhibitions, performances, and happenings within walking distance, while Dr. A.J. Chandler Park holds special events throughout the year that bring the city to life day and night.

Make the Most of Your Downtown Stay

Plan one or two anchor activities, then leave room to explore. Downtown rewards wandering, whether that means stopping in a gallery, catching live music, or lingering over a late dinner. Check the event calendar before you arrive to see what’s happening during your stay, and choose a lodging that matches where you want to spend your time. With multiple downtown hotels, visitors can tailor their stay to walkability, atmosphere, and easy access to everything Chandler offers.

bodyHtml:
Pet-Friendly Hotels  

Those with pets understand that a getaway isn’t the same unless we bring our furry friends along. There are many pet-friendly hotels in Chandler, AZ. The perfect hotel awaits you and your best friend, ranging from resorts to extended stay all-suite hotels.  

 

Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler - Fashion Center

Traveling with your four-legged companion? The Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler - Fashion Center welcomes dogs, making it easy to enjoy a comfortable stay near shopping, dining, and entertainment at Chandler Fashion Center. This modern, upscale hotel features stylish guest rooms, convenient amenities, and a central location that puts visitors close to many of Chandler’s top attractions.

The hotel allows up to two dogs per guest room, with a maximum weight of 75 pounds and a nightly pet fee of $50. Service animals are always welcome and stay free of charge. Whether you're planning a weekend getaway or an extended stay in Chandler, the Cambria offers a pet-friendly option so every member of the family can come along for the adventure.

 

Crowne Plaza Resort Phoenix - Chandler Golf Resort

Located in Downtown Chandler, the stunning Crowne Plaza Resort Phoenix - Chandler Golf Resort offers dog-friendly hotel rooms that keep your little pal's tail wagging. The resort allows two dogs per room with a maximum weight of 40 lbs. each. There is a non-refundable $75 pet deposit per pet, per stay, and guests can enjoy a great dog-walking area.

On-site dining options include the AJ’s Restaurant for breakfast and the contemporary 1912 Bar & Lounge for lunch and dinner with many dog-friendly restaurants nearby. A three-minute walk from the resort, enjoy cold drinks, satisfying eats, and the unmatched company of your pooch on the SanTan Brewing Company patio. Check out other dog-friendly restaurants in Downtown Chandler and beyond.   

 

 

Fairfield Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler / Fashion Center

Another hotel in Chandler, AZ, that allows pets is the Fairfield Inn & Suites Phoenix Chandler / Fashion Center. A non-refundable $75 pet fee per stay is required, with a maximum of two pets per room. Both dogs and cats are permitted. The maximum pet weight is 60 lbs per pet. If you stay six nights or longer, the non-refundable pet fee increases to $125 per stay. 

Your pet is allowed in an on-site outdoor seating area where you can eat breakfast and enjoy your favorite four-legged friend’s company. About a 10-minute drive from the hotel, your dog can get those zoomies out and frolic with friends at the spacious dog park located within Shawnee Park.

 

Home2 Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler

Home2 Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler is a pet-friendly establishment that allows dogs and cats. Guests must pay a $75 non-refundable fee for up to 2 pets. The $75 fee applies to stays up to five days. If you plan to stay more than five days, the fee increases to $125.

Take your pup on a quick 10-minute drive from the hotel to Snedigar Sportsplex for a first-rate dog park. There is plenty of room to run around with other dogs, plus fun obstacles to enrich your dog’s experience and keep them engaged. This dog park is so entertaining that you’ll likely need to bribe your good boy or girl back to the hotel with treats. 

 

Wingate by Wyndham Chandler

Among other dog-friendly hotels in Chandler is Wingate by Wyndham Chandler. They allow two dogs, each up to 70 lbs, and charge a $35 fee per pet per night. The Wingate by Wyndham Chandler has a small gated dog park on the premises, so your furry bestie can get in some fun exercise whenever needed. Oh, and they even have complimentary dog treats at the front desk! 

A mere five-minute drive from the hotel is Good Time Charli's. This spot serves up all kinds of tasty stuff, like wings, pizza, steak, and salmon that you can enjoy on the dog-friendly patio.

title: Ironwood Golf Course | Pro Shops, PGA Instruction & More
metaDescription: If you are planning a golf outing or looking for a casual round of golf, visit the Ironwood 18-hole championship golf course in Chandler, AZ.
ogTitle: Ironwood Golf Course | Pro Shops, PGA Instruction & More
bodyHtml:
Ironwood Golf Club

The IronOaks community is home to Ironwood Country Club and an 18-hole golf course that is open to the public.  In addition, there are three additional 9-hole, Keith Foster designed courses you can play at IronOaks located across Alma School Road.  Golfers have flexibility in pairing each of these 9-hole courses to create a desired difficulty level of play.

The Ironwood Golf Club course is an 18-hole course with a Par 67.  Holes range from 111 yards with a Par 3 to 485 yards with a Par 5.  Golfers will wind through pristine greens highlighted with water hazards and sand traps providing challenging play.  At the end of play, golfers will wind their way back to the clubhouse which is home to the Grill on the Green, featuring more than 20 TVs telecasting the latest sporting events, a full service bar and a menu with tasty choices to satisfy your cravings.  The restaurant often has food and drink specials available.

The remaining three courses and combinations at Oakwood include:

Lakes/Palms – This pairing winds itself around more than 12 lakes, with a total yardage of 6,508 yards and a rating of 71.3 and a Par of 72.

Palms/Sonoran – The Sonoran course recently renovated to re-shape sand traps and will elevate golfers’ level of play.  With 6,567 yards of play, a rating of 71 and a Par 72; this combination creates a challenging course.

Sonoran/Lakes – This combination creates 6,577 yards of play featuring a variety of lakes and traps surrounding the beautiful fairways.   This 18-holes combination is a Par 72.

After the 18th hole, golfers can relax and relive the highlights of their game at the Stone & Barrel Taphouse. 

Any of the team members at either clubhouse will be more than willing to assist golfers with their clubs, clothing and/or accessories.  Ask about lessons or a clinic with the on-site golf pro, Scott Power.  When reserving tee times, golfers are invited to ask about specials as the facility offers specials throughout the year.  For Ironwood tee times, call, (480) 895-0614.  For reservations at the three Oakwood courses, call (480) 895-1159.

title: Large Cities Executive Forum

headings.text: Experience a Ride in an Autonomous Vehicle

bodyHtml:
Welcome to Chandler, Arizona! 

We're thrilled to have the Large Cities Executive Forum select Chandler as their home base for their spring meeting.

Located about 20 minutes from Sky Harbor International Airport, along I-10, Chandler, AZ is a vibrant city with a diverse community and thriving tech industry. The city of Chandler embodies an active lifestyle with easy access to outdoor recreation, a lively dining scene, a wide variety of shopping destinations, award-winning events, world-class golf facilities, and a vibrant downtown.

February 27 - March 1, 2025

Your host hotel for the weekend is the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort.

Experience a Ride in an Autonomous Vehicle

Have you wondered how autonomous vehicles are changing the world? While visiting Chandler, see and feel the future by experiencing a ride in a Waymo One autonomous vehicle. Waymo rides offer convenience like no other by operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Unlike other ride-sharing services, take your Waymo to popular spots like Chandler Fashion Center and make stops along the way, all in one booking.

Booking and routing a Waymo One, the autonomous vehicle service, works much like using Uber or Lyft. Simply download the Waymo One app, link your Google account and payment method, and enter your destination within the service area to request a ride. Shortly afterward, a sleek white Jaguar I-PACE will arrive, with your initials displayed on a rotating screen atop the vehicle. Alternatively, you can also book a Waymo One ride directly through the Uber app.

WHILE YOU ARE HERE...

We hope you will enjoy our diverse community and savor a meal or two at one of Chandler's fabulous restaurants featuring a variety of cuisines. Fun fact, there are 40 local restaurants and bars within walking distance of your host hotel, a collection of boutique shops, and plenty of entertainment options. Although we know the sunshine and pool may be calling your name.

title: Apache Trail and Superstition Mountains
metaDescription: The Apache Trail is forty miles of steep, winding and mostly unpaved roads past magnificent scenery of twisted igneous mountains with dense forests of saguaro and ferocactus (barrel cacti) and several deep blue lakes. Within the Superstition Mountains is the Lost Dutchman State Park. Here you can learn about the varied stories and legends associated with the Mountains, in particular about the Lost Dutchman Mine which was supposedly a tremendously rich gold mine worked by a lone prospector but its location was lost upon his death. Nearby is the starting point for the Dutchman Trail, one of the most well used trails into the Superstition Wilderness.

title: Arizona Opera
metaDescription: Arizona Opera produces fully-staged operas, concerts, and collaborative programs throughout the state of Arizona each season. We are among only a handful of companies in the United States that regularly performs in more than one city. Arizona Opera elevates the transformative power of storytelling through music—cultivating community and strengthening a state and people as adventurous and diverse as the place they call home. On stage, Arizona Opera presents artists of both international stature and emerging talent, and each season balances debut artists and the return of favorite performers. Arizona’s musical talent is showcased in its acclaimed orchestra and chorus. The Arizona Opera Orchestra, established in 2000, consists of members of symphony orchestras from Flagstaff, Phoenix, and Tucson, as well as faculty from local universities, and the chorus is comprised of Phoenix and Tucson community members and students from local universities. Performances take place a short drive from Chandler in downtown Phoenix.

title: Arizona Railway Museum
metaDescription: The Arizona Railway Museum features restored train cars from different time periods in our country’s rail history. The main building is a re-creation of the original Chandler depot, and showcases original rail company china and glass, rail cars, movie set rail cars and many others reside at this museum, and can be explored at your leisure. Rail cars can also accommodate meetings and small groups for events. The museum is open from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00pm on Saturdays and Sundays from Labor Day to Memorial Day. Tiered admission pricing for families, adults, children and seniors.

title: Arrowhead Pool
metaDescription: Discover all the splash-worthy features that make Arrowhead Pool a favorite summer destination: Arrowhead Pool is nestled within the Arrowhead Meadows neighborhood, just west of Downtown Chandler, at 1475 W Erie St. This premier aquatics facility showcases an L-shaped 50‑meter competition pool, with diverse depths ranging from a gentle 3 feet to a thrilling 12 feet—perfect for lap swimmers, casual paddlers, and diving enthusiasts alike. For families and young swimmers, the separate play area offers a zero‑depth entry, a 110‑foot water slide that curves into fun, a charming toddler slide, and a lazy “current” river that weaves through the pool, ensuring hours of joy and relaxation. Thrill‑seekers can test their skills on both a 1‑meter and a 3‑meter diving board, set above the deep end for added excitement. When it’s time to unwind, visitors can stretch out on lush turf areas, settle into comfy pool furniture, or relax under shaded ramadas and 20‑foot “Funbrellas” for sun-safe enjoyment. A well‑stocked concession stand provides refreshing snacks and beverages to keep you energized throughout your visit Whether you're perfecting your swim strokes, hosting a family outing, or seeking a fun-filled day in the sun, Arrowhead Pool delivers a refreshing mix of recreation, relaxation, and aquatic adventure. title: ATL Wings
metaDescription: Located in north Chandler, ATL Wings has been a staple for Arizona wing fanatics since it's doors opened in 2012. ATL Wings is dubbed the "King of Wings" with its continuous reign as winner of Wingstock Arizona for 2013, 2014 and 2015. ATL Wings features a variety of handcrafted sauces including traditional mild and hot varieties you may come to expect, but they also offer some unique options including Honey Habenoro, Citrus Chipotle, Garlic Parmesan and Sweet 'n' Tangy. In addition to their award-winning wings, be sure to save room for their made from scratch Mac n' Cheese or Sweet Corn bites, homemade coleslaw, fresh salads and tempting desserts. Wash it all down with a fountain soda, or a variety of on-tap Kool Aid flavors and iced teas.

ATL Wings features a variety of handcrafted sauces including traditional mild and hot varieties you may come to expect, but they also offer some unique options including Honey Habenoro, Citrus Chipotle, Garlic Parmesan and Sweet 'n' Tangy. In addition to their award-winning wings, be sure to save room for their made from scratch Mac n' Cheese or Sweet Corn bites, homemade coleslaw, fresh salads and tempting desserts. Wash it all down with a fountain soda, or a variety of on-tap Kool Aid flavors and iced teas.

title: Back Alley BBQ
metaDescription: Back Alley BBQ serves bold flavors with its championship barbecue and a Chef-driven menu guided by Executive Chef, Shaun O'Neale and pit poss Ken Davis. O'Neale is known to many BBQ aficionados as the winner of Season 7 of Fox's MasterChef in 2016 and as the author of his cookbook, My Modern American Table. Diners will find a great selection of smoked meats, including brisket and ribs, and classic, homemade barbecue side dishes, such as creamed elote, mac and cheese, potato salad, and more. The BBQ restaurant offers a robust cocktail menu, a daily happy hour with drink specials, and live music on weekends.

title: Backyard Taco
metaDescription: Originally from Mazatlan, Mexico - Ruben and Marisela Alvarez came to the east valley and began cooking out of their backyard. First it was just for friends and family but as the word grew they needed more space - everyone wanted a taste of their tacos al carbon. They opened their first location in Mesa, Arizona and have since opened five other locations across the east valley including one in Chandler, AZ. From the tacos and quesadillas to their signature papa loca and bueno bowls, you can top them with a variety of dips from their salsa bar. Don’t forget the unlimited chips and beans or the refreshing aguas frescas.

title: Baymont by Wyndham Chandler I-10
metaDescription: Baymont by Wyndham Chandler I-10 is conveniently located in West Chandler near the intersection of I-10 and the Loop 202 Santan. With 70 rooms boasting dozens of great amenities, this budget-friendly hotel is a great choice for those who want to balance practicality and comfort. Within a short drive from Downtown Chandler, the Tempe campus of Arizona State University, Wild Horse Pass Resort and Casino, Lone Butte Casino, and South Mountain Park, the largest municipal park in the US. Traveling for Business? This hotel is located near the corporate offices of Intel, Microchip, Tokyo Electron, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Honeywell, and PayPal. Every room enjoys the benefits of a microwave, a refrigerator, and a coffee pot. This property is 100% smoke-free and offers free wifi Internet access throughout. Whether business or pleasure, this hotel is very conveniently located and very comfortable for both long- and short-term stays.

title: Bear Creek Golf Complex
metaDescription: Chandler's Bear Creek Golf Complex is a 36-hole inland links golf facility consisting of both a championship course and an executive course. Both golf courses and practice area at Bear Creek Golf Complex were created by the Nicklaus Design Group and architect Bill O'Leary. In addition to our their golf courses they also have a full Practice and Learning Center,staffed by PGA Professionals who are available for both individual and group lessons. This family-friendly club also boasts the Bear's Den Bar & Grill includes a bar area with plenty of seating, comfortable shaded patio seating with beautiful views and three large flat screen televisions always tuned to sports.

title: Besh-Ba-Gowah Archaeological Park
metaDescription: Besh-Ba-Gowah Archaeological Park in Globe, Arizona features a 700 year old Salado Culture pueblo and typical furnishings of the era. Numerous artifacts of this remarkably advanced culture are also displayed in the Besh-Ba-Gowah Museum. Besh-Ba-Gowah has one of the largest single site archaeological collections in the southwest and is one of the most significant finds of Southwest archaeology. It is one of the largest and most complex of the Salado communities. Archaeologists consider Besh-Ba-Gowah a ceremonial, redistribution and food storage complex.

title: Big Air Trampoline Park
metaDescription: Big Air Trampoline Park is a premier family fun destination with ninja-warrior courses, interactive dodgeball courts, foam pits with plenty of excitement for the whole family. The 30,000 sq. ft. facility also features Battlebeam®, a zip-line, and ValoMotion - a new experience that tests speed, reaction, and hand-to-eye coordination. Climbers will enjoy unique climbing attractions: Challenge yourself to "The Wall" , a new attraction that is a stand alone climbing wall where you fall into a large foam pit if you miss a step. The park will also include Lil' Air and Lil' Ninja, an exclusive space for kids ages 6-and-under with trampolines, a foam pit and soft play elements. Parents and caretakers can relax in Big Air's Parents' Lounge, with access to comfortable seating, free WiFi, and food including pizza, wings, drinks and more from Big Eats Cafe.

title: Boba Tea House
metaDescription: Discover the world of Bubble Tea - a phenomenon that originated in Southeast Asia on the island of Taiwan. The Boba Tea House located in north Chandler is home to a large menu of bubble teas - tapioca balls added to tea in addition to milk teas, milk juices, slush's, snow's and mocha blasts - your are sure to discover hundred of tempting drinks. Home to traditional flavors like almond, and more "exotic" gems such as lychee. Boba Tea House also offers a variety of tasty snacks including popcorn chicken, mozzarella sticks, fried calamari, fish balls and more traditional fried snack foods. Boba Tea House also offers free Wi-Fi for their guests.

title: Boyce Thompson Arboretum
metaDescription: Experience the lush beauty of the Arizona Upland Sonoran Desert at the state's oldest and largest botanical garden. With breathtaking views of Picketpost Mountain, Boyce Thompson Arboretum is located in Superior, Arizona, just an hour's drive from Downtown Chandler. The Arboretum features 343-acres of beautiful landscapes with over 3,900 different species of plants, hidden gardens along miles of trails, and historic buildings, the Arboretum is on the National Register of Historic Places. A haven for wildlife, the Arboretum has been called "the most enchanting" Important Birding Area in Arizona.

title: Brooker's Founding Flavors Ice Cream
metaDescription: Step into Chandler’s newest ice cream tavern, celebrating Revolutionary‑era America with super‑premium, in‑house churned ice cream, drinking chocolate, and unforgettable atmosphere. Colonial music, décor, and costumed staff give this spot a theme park‑style dining vibe infused with early American history. Discover revolution‑themed treats: sundaes, banana splits, milkshakes, ice cream cakes, and the iconic Founding Flavors, 13 colony‑inspired flavors like John Hancock’s Mint Chocolate Truffle, Thomas Jefferson’s Declaration of Cookie Dough, Franklin’s Black Raspberry Republic, and Martha Washington’s Colonial Cotton Candy 31. The cafe also serves a selection of drinking chocolate: thick, rich, and historically authentic, and reminiscent of what the Founding Fathers enjoyed. Located near Chandler Fashion Center mall and many of Chandler's top family attractions, the ice cream shop is a great addition to your itinerary! The ice cream shop is open Monday through Saturday from 11 a.m. - 11 p.m. and on Sundays from 11 a.m. - 10 p.m.

metaDescription: Located in Downtown Chandler, Burst of Butterflies is a welcoming paint-your-own pottery and creative studio designed for all ages and experience levels. No experience is needed — their friendly team is there to help every step of the way. Burst of Butterflies is known for its relaxed, creative atmosphere where individuals, families, and groups can slow down, connect, and create something meaningful to take home. offers.medianame: Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler Fashion Center - Meeting Room
offers.title: Pick Your Perks at the Cambria Phoenix Chandler-Fashion Center
offers.description:
Discover an elevated meeting experience at Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler – Fashion Center, where contemporary style meets Arizona‑inspired hospitality—all just 20 minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport and moments from Chandler’s premier dining, shopping, and entertainment.

Perfect for small meetings and corporate gatherings, this boutique‑style hotel places your group close to major business campuses in the heart of Chandler's Price Corridor.

For a limited time, planners can take advantage of an exclusive Pick Your Perks Group Promotion designed to add value and convenience to every stay. Groups with a minimum of 40 cumulative room nights can select two special perks, tailoring the offer to what matters most for their program. Benefits include options such as double planner points, complimentary suite upgrades, LCD package, a complimentary coffee break, waived parking, and more; all crafted to elevate the attendee experience.

Incentives for qualifying bookings include:
• Double Planner Points (6 per $1 spent)
• 11% commission
• One complimentary suite upgrade per 10 rooms booked
• Complimentary LCD package
• $100 Visa gift card
• Waived daily parking fees ($9 per car/per day)
• One complimentary coffee break 

This offer applies to new bookings made by December 31, 2026, for meetings completed by December 31, 2027, with meeting space and catering proportionate to contracted room nights. To claim this special offer, mention it to the Visit Chandler or Cambria Hotel Sales Team.

title: Candeeland
metaDescription: Candeeland is a new Family Entertainment Center for the modern era. Truly the ultimate indoor playground- our park is bright, colorful, CLEAN, and filled with fun! With an emphasis on movement and inspiring creativity, we provide an engaging experience that gives children and toddlers the opportunity to explore, make friends, burn off energy, and have fun. Unlike other arcade-centered FEC’s, Candeeland is filled with attractions geared towards getting kids 1-10 years of age to be physically active. Ninja courses, slides, zip lines, tunnels, swings, rides, and jumpers abound, provide a plethora of ways for children to explore & exert themselves. Toddlers can play in a designated age-appropriate fun space, while kids ages 4-10 can crawl, jump, and slide in an interactive space all their own. Meanwhile, parents can relax, catch up on tasks, or even have a coffee or meal while their little ones play, secure in knowing their kids are having a blast in our state-of-the-art facilities. Our friendly and engaged staff members ensure that every child has a fantastic, safe experience that will leave them smiling ear to ear and excited to come back again and again.

title: Casa Grande Ruins National Monument
metaDescription: For over a thousand years, prehistoric farmers inhabited much of the present-day state of Arizona. When the first Europeans arrived, all that remained of this ancient culture were the ruins of villages, irrigation canals and various artifacts. Among these ruins is the Casa Grande, or "Big House," one of the largest and most mysterious prehistoric structures ever built in North America.

When the first Europeans arrived, all that remained of this ancient culture were the ruins of villages, irrigation canals and various artifacts. Among these ruins is the Casa Grande, or "Big House," one of the largest and most mysterious prehistoric structures ever built in North America.

title: Chandler Bike Park at Espee Park
metaDescription: This Chandler BMX/Freestyle bike riding facility opened in May 2007 and is the first public, bike-only park built by a municipality in Arizona. The 25,000-square-foot Bike Park features a jump box, double roller, mole hill, hubba ledge, and sub rail, while one of its most anticipated features is a 6-foot-tall wall with a 5-foot extension, creating a vertical surface taller than a basketball hoop. This park is for BMX riders only and is often cited as one of the best BMX parks in America. Summer Hours: 6:30 a.m. - 10:15 p.m. Winter Hours: 8 a.m. - 10:15 p.m. Maintenance Closure: This park is closed until 2:30 p.m. on the last Wednesday of every month for routine maintenance and repairs.

title: Chandler BMX Park
metaDescription: Chandler BMX Park is a high‑energy destination for riders of all ages, offering a premier racing experience right in the heart of Chandler. Located at 298 S. McQueen Road within the Chandler BMX facility, this USA BMX‑sanctioned track welcomes beginners, seasoned racers, and families looking for an exciting day outdoors. The track’s well‑maintained layout, friendly community, and regular race nights make it a standout spot for both local riders and visiting competitors. Riders can take advantage of structured practice sessions, coaching opportunities, and a full calendar of sanctioned races throughout the year. The facility is designed to support all skill levels, providing a safe and encouraging environment for anyone looking to build confidence, improve technique, or simply enjoy the thrill of BMX riding. Spectators will find plenty of space to watch the action, and the park’s welcoming atmosphere makes it a great place for families to spend an afternoon. Whether you’re gearing up for your first gate start or chasing a new personal best, Chandler BMX Park delivers fast‑paced fun and a strong sense of community.

events.description:
Jeffrey Osborne is Coming to Chandler

R&B icon Jeffrey Osborne is known for his smooth vocals and energetic 80s soul hits “Stay With Me Tonight,” “Only Human,” and “On The Wings of Love.” His musical career started in 1970 when he became the drummer of the soul band L.T.D.

His solo career brought him four GRAMMY nominations and five gold and platinum albums, cementing him as one of soul music’s leading vocalists and lyricists. In 2024, Osborne was inducted into the Rhythm and Blues Music Hall of Fame. The richly deep-toned vocalist displays as much vocal agility and ease with range as ever and promises a groovy, joyful evening.

metaDescription: Located in Downtown Chandler, the Chandler Center for the Arts is a world-class performing arts center offering a unique setting for special program needs. The venue is located steps away from the Crowne Plaza San Marcos Golf Resort and the many independent restaurants, art galleries and boutique shops located in the downtown square along with over 4,000 free parking spaces. The Main Stage is 64,000 sq. ft theater with seats from 840 to 1,500. The Hal Bogle Theater features seats for 350 and the Recital Hall seats 250. Foyer space is available for banquets; there is space as well for groups up to 250. Discounts from the standard commercial rates are available for nonprofit organizations.

title: Chandler Fashion Center
metaDescription: Enjoy the Chandler Fashion Center Shopping & Dining Experience! Chandler Fashion Center is a vibrant and family-friendly shopping destination. Comprised of more than 180 shops and restaurants, this indoor/outdoor mall is anchored by Dillard’s, Macy’s and SCHEELS. Chandler Fashion Center boasts a plethora of upscale shopping favorites including Apple, Coach, H&M, Kendra Scott, LEGO, Sephora and many more. Plan your day and enjoy an extensive selection of restaurants and eateries including The Cheesecake Factory, Wildflower Bread Company, Cooper's Hawk Winery & Restaurant, Firebirds Wood Fired Grill, Hop Social Grill, and more in addition to a dynamic food court. Additional amenities include a 20-screen Harkins theater, Round1 Bowling & Arcade, meetings rooms, tour group services and an outdoor lawn, a great outdoor event space featuring a splash pad by day and a dynamic mixture of water and light by night. Chandler Fashion Center is located at the southwest corner of Chandler Boulevard & Price/Loop 101 Freeway Chandler Fashion Center Shopping Center Hours are Monday – Saturday 10am – 9pm Sunday – 11am – 6pm (Holiday, Restaurant and Theatre Hours May Vary)

title: Chandler Museum
metaDescription: The Chandler Museum campus features both locally produced and nationally traveling exhibits exploring culture, history, and art; the East Valley History Center for researchers; educational programming in the new classroom; and more. Reopened in December 2018, the new museum boosts a new 10,000 square foot facility adjacent to the historic McCullough-Price House. The modern building is the centerpiece of the new museum campus and it was designed to complement the historic house, preserving and honoring the past while representing our progress as a community with a bright future. title: Chandler Skate Park
metaDescription: Chandler Skatepark has been a favorite hangout for skaters since the day it opened, drawing talent from across the globe to South Chandler. The park is free to enjoy and open to both skateboarders and in‑line skaters. title: Chandler Solar System Walk at Veterans Oasis Park
metaDescription: Have you or the kids ever wondered how large our solar system is? Or what the distance between Earth and Jupiter vs. Earth and Saturn would look like? The self-guided Chandler Solar System Walk at Veterans Oasis Park provides these answers and more! Utilizing a 2,500-foot-ling path, navigate your way around the lake along a series of monuments and signs representing the sun, planets and primary celestial objects - all placed at distances relative to the scale of the solar system. Each foot on the walk represents 1.5 million miles which means that the distance from the sun to Earth is 62 feet along the walk — equivalent to the actual 93 million miles between the two in space. The signs provide detailed information about the planets and references to ancient cultures who studied the skies, mythology, the asteroid belt, dwarf planets, and comets. The self guided tour is perfect for budding astronomers!

title: Chandler Tennis Center
metaDescription: The Chandler Tennis Center is a must-visit destination for travelers who love to stay active, offering 15 lighted courts, professional instruction, and a welcoming atmosphere perfect for both casual play and competitive athletes. Whether you’re visiting Chandler for a weekend getaway, a family trip, or a sports-focused adventure, this vibrant facility makes it easy to get out on the court and enjoy Arizona sunshine. Play Like a Local Located within Tumbleweed Park, the Chandler Tennis Center gives visitors a chance to experience one of the city’s most popular recreation hubs. With 15 well-maintained, fully lit courts, players can enjoy early-morning matches, afternoon drills, or cool evening play under the lights. Drop-in sessions and open court availability make it simple for travelers to jump into a game. Lessons, Clinics & Drop-In Play Traveling doesn’t mean your game has to take a break. The center offers: • Adult and youth lessons taught by certified pros • Drop-in play for easy matchups with local players • Clinics and drills to sharpen skills • Seasonal leagues and special events for those seeking friendly competition It’s an inviting environment where visitors feel instantly part of the community. Player Friendly Amenities The Chandler Tennis Center is designed for comfort and convenience, featuring: • A pro shop with racquets, accessories, and stringing services • Indoor restrooms and lounge areas • Shaded outdoor seating for relaxing between sets • Easy access to Tumbleweed Park’s walking paths and picnic areas Everything you need for a great day on the court is right at your fingertips. A Perfect Addition to Your Chandler Itinerary After your match, explore the surrounding Tumbleweed Park, grab a bite at a nearby restaurant, or enjoy Chandler’s vibrant shopping and entertainment districts. The Tennis Center’s central location makes it an effortless—and energizing—stop during your visit. For travelers who love to play, the Chandler Tennis Center offers a high-quality, friendly, and fun tennis experience that shows Chandler’s passion for recreation and community. Daily Admission Fees - Before 5 p.m., $3 for residents and $4.50 for non-residents - After 5 p.m., $4 for residents and $5.50 for non-residents

title: Chandler Tennis Center
metaDescription: The Chandler Tennis Center is one of the region’s premier venues for hosting tennis tournaments, offering 15 lighted courts, professional-grade amenities, and a layout designed to support smooth, efficient event operations. Located within Tumbleweed Park in south Chandler, the facility provides tournament directors with the space, flexibility, and infrastructure needed to deliver exceptional competitive experiences. Tournament Ready Courts & Layout The center features 15 well-maintained, fully lit hard courts, allowing for full-day scheduling and evening play. Courts are arranged to support easy player flow, clear sightlines for spectators, and convenient access to amenities. The facility’s consistent court conditions and high-quality surfacing ensure reliable play for athletes at all levels. Operational Support for Event Directors Tournament organizers benefit from a range of on-site amenities that streamline event management, including: • A full-service pro shop offering racquet stringing, equipment, and supplies • Indoor restrooms and lounge areas for staff, players, and officials • Shaded seating and gathering areas for spectators and teams • Ample parking within Tumbleweed Park • Access to additional park space for vendor booths, check-in stations, or hospitality zones The facility’s professional staff and year-round programming experience make it a strong partner for hosting both local and regional events. A Destination Players Will Love Situated inside Tumbleweed Park, the Chandler Tennis Center offers a scenic, welcoming environment that enhances the tournament experience. Between matches, players and families can enjoy walking paths, picnic areas, and nearby attractions throughout Chandler’s vibrant dining and entertainment districts. A Convenient, High-Capacity Venue With its combination of court quantity, quality, and operational flexibility, the Chandler Tennis Center is well-suited for: • USTA-sanctioned tournaments • Junior and adult competitive events • Team tennis competitions • Corporate or community tournaments Its location near major freeways and a wide selection of Chandler hotels makes travel easy for visiting teams and spectators. For tournament organizers seeking a dependable, professionally maintained, and player-friendly venue in the Phoenix metro area, the Chandler Tennis Center stands out as an exceptional choice. Contact Visit Chandler staff today for more information about planning a tennis tournament at the Chandler Tennis Center.

title: Chuparosa Park Spray Pad
metaDescription: Chuparosa Park is a beloved neighborhood hangout where families, friends, and outdoor enthusiasts can beat the desert heat and enjoy time outside. At the heart of the park is its popular spray and splash pad, where kids can cool off under the whimsical candy cane–shaped shower or dart between four lively spray zones. It’s a guaranteed warm weather favorite and a must-visit spot for little ones looking to play, laugh, and splash the day away. Set across 28 acres, Chuparosa Park offers plenty of room to roam. Visitors can explore walking trails, shoot hoops or bump volleys on the basketball and volleyball courts, play a pickup game on multipurpose fields, or enjoy the shade at one of the many picnic areas. Multiple playgrounds provide fun for all ages, and reservable picnic shelters make the park an ideal choice for birthday celebrations, family gatherings, and group meetups. For those looking to stretch their legs, the scenic .59 mile walking path is perfect for a leisurely loop—welcoming to joggers, strollers, and dog walkers alike. Chuparosa Park is open daily from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m., offering a full day of opportunities to relax, play, and enjoy Chandler’s beautiful outdoor spaces. title: Cien Agaves Tacos & Tequila
metaDescription: Cien Agaves Tacos & Tequila, located in West Chandler, brings bold Baja flavors and a lively, modern cantina atmosphere to the city's growing dining scene. Known for its handcrafted margaritas and vibrant menu of scratch-made Mexican dishes, this local favorite offers a fresh and approachable take on classic Mexican cuisine. Guests can enjoy a wide selection of premium tequilas and mezcals, signature cocktails, and popular sharable dishes like house-made guacamole and delicious nachos. The menu features a variety of street-style tacos, including Barbacoa (green chile beef), Carnitas (citrus-marinated pork), grilled shrimp, and vegetarian options, as well as hearty burritos, flavorful enchiladas, and fresh salads. Whether you're gathering with friends on the spacious patio, stopping by for a casual lunch, or starting your evening with their popular happy hour, available every day from 3-6 p.m., Cien Agaves provides a fun and welcoming atmosphere perfect for any occasion. With its mix of bold flavors, great drinks, and warm hospitality, it’s a go-to destination for both visitors and locals looking to experience Chandler’s vibrant dining scene. title: Cold Beers & Cheeseburgers
metaDescription: The name says it all at Arizona's original neighborhood burger joint - Cold Beers & Cheeseburgers are the featured items at this local dining establishment. The restaurant is largely known for its hand crafted, freshly formed beef burgers and homemade veggie burgers that are all cooked to order but diners may opt for one of their stadium style hot dogs, sandwiches or numerous macaroni and cheese entrees. title: Comfort Inn Chandler – Phoenix South I-10
metaDescription: The Comfort Inn® hotel is conveniently located off of Interstate 10 in the charming Phoenix suburb of Chandler, located within minutes of several popular attractions, including Chandler Fashion Center, Arizona Mills mall and Wild Horse Pass Motorsports Park. Tempe Diablo Stadium, home of the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, is also near this Chandler, AZ hotel. Positioned within walking distance of several restaurants, other nearby attractions include Intel Corporation, Arizona State University, Wild Horse Pass Casino, and Lone Butte Casino. Guests of the Comfort Inn hotel will want to take advantage of a variety of amenities, including the outdoor heated pool, fitness center, and business center, offering access to copy and fax services and a computer with Internet. There is one meeting room, with the hotel able to accommodate 40 people for banquets and conferences. Other amenities at this Chandler, AZ hotel include free high-speed Internet access and a free daily newspaper. Your Morning Breakfast is full of hot and delicious options, making breakfast at the Comfort Inn the perfect way to start your day. Enjoy our free hot breakfast featuring eggs, meat, yogurt, fresh fruit, cereal, and more, including your choice of hot waffle flavors! All well-appointed rooms at this non-smoking hotel offer a flat-screen television with high-definition programming, desk, coffee maker, refrigerator, hairdryer, alarm clock, iron, and ironing board. Suites also offer a wet bar and microwave. This is a pet-friendly hotel, with four-legged friends allowed to stay for a fee. Its perfect location and convenient access to area attractions make the Comfort Inn a great place for business and leisure travelers in the Chandler, AZ area. Book a room with us today; we look forward to your stay.

title: Courtyard by Marriott Phoenix Chandler/Fashion Center
metaDescription: Experience a fresh stay at the newly renovated Courtyard by Marriott Phoenix Chandler/Fashion Center, conveniently located off Loop 202 SanTan and just 20 minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport. Our modern hotel places you minutes from premier shopping and dining at Chandler Fashion Center, the vibrant entertainment scene in Downtown Chandler, and popular attractions like Wild Horse Pass Casino, Andretti Indoor Karting, Topgolf, and the Phoenix Premium Outlets. Outdoor enthusiasts can explore nearby Desert Breeze Park, enjoy hiking at South Mountain Park and Preserve, or tee off at local favorites including Ocotillo Golf Club and San Marcos Golf Course. On property, guests can relax in refreshed guest rooms featuring mini-fridges, microwaves, and spacious work areas with complimentary Wi-Fi. The Bistro serves breakfast, dinner, Starbucks® coffee, and evening cocktails, while additional amenities include a heated outdoor pool, whirlpool, fitness center, outdoor fire pit, and flexible gathering spaces designed for both business and leisure travelers.

title: Crowne Plaza Phoenix-Chandler Golf Resort
metaDescription: Some places become legendary. Some always have been! For Arizona, it all started in 1912 when the San Marcos celebrated it's grand opening and became Arizona's first and finest golf resort and a welcome respite for U.S. Presidents, dignitaries, Hollywood’s famous and infamous, and discriminating travelers for decades. Today, the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort anchors Downtown Chandler, a vibrant and historic square brimming with more than two dozen independent restaurants, boutique shops, entertainment and home to many annual events. In addition, the sprawling property features 249 generously sized guest rooms and more than 30,000 square feet of flexible meeting and event space. With on-site dining, resort-style pool with cabanas and Arizona's first grass golf course, the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort is an excellent option for many travelers.

Golf Resort is known for its legendary beauty. From the spectacular
lobby to the spacious guest rooms, the Crowne Plaza has regained her
place as Arizona’s first and finest golf resort. Our 32,000-plus square feet of
highly versatile indoor/outdoor meeting space is ready to accommodate all events,

conference rooms include three ballrooms, an elegant boardroom, amphitheater
and several other flexible meeting venues all equipped with the latest technology
and most with natural lighting. The Crowne Plaza is an exceptional venue for
meetings, weddings and corporate events, and our professional Crowne Meetings
Director will be there to assist your every need. Stroll along our 100-acre lushly
landscaped grounds, or enjoy a round of golf. Relax in Vaya, our Aveda salon, or
in our heated Jacuzzi spa and sparkling pool, followed by a drink in the 1912 Lobby
Bar. Located in Historic Downtown Chandler, we invite you to experience our
legendary resort and hospitality for your next event.

title: Desert Botanical Garden
metaDescription: Nestled amid the red buttes of Papago Park, the Desert Botanical Garden hosts one of the world’s finest collections of desert plants. One of only 44 botanical gardens accredited by the American Association of Museums, this one-of-a-kind museum showcases 50 acres of beautiful outdoor exhibits. Home to 139 rare, threatened and endangered plant species from around the world, the Garden offers interesting and inspiring experiences to more than 300,000 visitors each year.

title: Desert Breeze Park and Spray Pad
metaDescription: Desert Breeze Park is one of Chandler’s most cherished outdoor escapes, blending scenic beauty, family fun, and plenty of room to play. Centered around a picturesque lake and surrounded by vibrant green space, this 47‑acre park offers the perfect backdrop for a relaxing afternoon or an activity‑filled outing. Families especially love the Desert Breeze Railroad, a charming miniature train that loops through the park and delights riders of all ages. Just steps away, kids can cool off at the splash pad, explore multiple playgrounds, and enjoy hands‑on fun at the interactive spray features. Shaded ramadas and spacious picnic areas make it easy to settle in for birthday parties, weekend picnics, or casual gatherings with friends. Active visitors will find plenty of ways to stay moving, from lighted tennis courts and sand volleyball to baseball fields and open green space perfect for informal games. The park’s paved walking paths offer a scenic route for joggers, strollers, and dog walkers, while the lake provides a peaceful setting for a leisurely stroll. Whether you’re hopping aboard the miniature train, planning a family celebration, or simply soaking up Chandler’s sunny weather, Desert Breeze Park delivers a refreshing, family‑friendly retreat in the heart of the city. title: Desert Oasis Aquatic Center
metaDescription: Desert Oasis Aquatic Center is a favorite warm‑weather retreat in Chandler, offering a refreshing mix of water fun and relaxation for all ages. This vibrant community pool features a sparkling competition‑length lap pool, a zero‑depth entry play pool, and plenty of interactive water elements that keep families coming back all season long. Kids love splashing through the water slide, bubbling play features, and shallow areas designed for safe, carefree fun. Adults can unwind in the heated spa, enjoy open swim, or take advantage of designated lap‑swim times. Shaded seating areas and grassy spaces make it easy to settle in for an afternoon by the water. The center also offers swim lessons, water fitness classes, and seasonal programming, making it a great spot for both recreation and skill‑building. With its welcoming atmosphere and variety of amenities, Desert Oasis Aquatic Center is an ideal destination for cooling off, staying active, and enjoying sunny Chandler days. title: Desert Voyagers Guided Rafting Tours
metaDescription: Our scenic guided river tours are a perfect introduction to the beauty and wonder of the Sonoran Desert. Bring the whole family along on a mild rafting trip, pilot your own craft on a fun and exhilarating guided kayak adventure, or learn a new skill with a fun and challenging stand up paddle board tour. All of Desert Voyagers trips are designed to emphasize the unique beauty of the surrounding desert and the plants and animals who call this area home. You guides will introduce you to the mighty saguaro cactus, explain just how a beaver builds its home, and illuminate the rich human and natural history of the Salt River, all while teaching you the skills to be a confident paddler. Each tour can be made suitable for beginners, rafting float trips are suitable for all ages and ability levels. Our tours are offered on the Salt and Verde Rivers in the Tonto National Forest, 30 minutes east of the Mesa area. Groups and individuals welcome. Average trip is about two hours on the water. title: Dog Haus
metaDescription: Located in central Chandler, Dog Haus Biergarten is a welcoming, craft casual restaurant crave-worthy sausages, smash-style burgers, corn dogs, chicken sandwiches, wings and tenders, loaded sides, cocktails, beer and shakes. Sausage favorites include The Fonz, which partners a spicy Italian sausage with pastrami and mozzarella cheese, and Das Brat, which features a bratwurst topped with caramelized onions, sauerkraut and spicy brown mustard. All Dog Haus’ sausages and hot dogs are free from added nitrates and nitrites and made with hormone- and antibiotic-free certified Black Angus beef. Dog Haus is proud to serve burgers made with genetically tested, humanely-raised Creekstone Farms Black Angus beef that is hormone and antibiotic free. With the brand’s mission to sustainably feed everyone who walks through their doors, Dog Haus also offers plant-based burgers from Impossible™ Foods and sausage proteins from Beyond Meat®. The Chandler restaurant offers a great selection of breakfast burritos including plant-based options and a dog-friendly patio perfect for al fresco dining.

title: Dr. A.J. Chandler Park
metaDescription: Dr. A.J. Chandler Park sits at the heart of Downtown Chandler, anchoring the original town square envisioned by the city's founder, Dr. A.J. Chandler. Surrounded by charming shops, local galleries, inviting restaurants, office spaces, and the historic Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort, this central green space remains a vibrant gathering spot for residents and visitors alike. Throughout the year, the park transforms into a lively hub for community celebrations, cultural festivals, concerts, and special events that bring Downtown Chandler to life. Whether you’re strolling through the area, relaxing under the shade of mature trees, or joining in on a signature Chandler tradition, Dr. A.J. Chandler Park offers a welcoming backdrop in the city’s most historic setting. Currently, the park is closed and under renovation. Learn more about the project here: https://www.chandleraz.gov/explore/chandler-parks/projects-and-meetings/dr-aj-chandler-park-improvements

events.description:
Explore Local Art in Downtown Chandler

Downtown Chandler Third Thursdays is a monthly celebration of creativity, culture, and community in the heart of Downtown Chandler. Discover local art and enjoy an evening filled with entertainment at this exciting monthly event, held on the third Thursday of each month, October-May.

Event Highlights:

  • Local artists & handmade crafts
  • Live music
  • Interactive exhibits
  • Pop-up experiences

Come out to this free event, grab dinner at a nearby local spot, and watch the downtown streets transform into a vibrant, walkable gallery!

Before you attend, be sure to check out the free parking options in Downtown Chandler. For more Chandler events to explore when you're in the area, check out our event calendar.

Photos by Cameron Mace

Enjoy live music, yard games, food vendors and more. There is a 15-minute pyrotechnic show as part of the concert. Come early or stay late after the show and visit the local downtown businesses.

Featured 2027 Performer: TBA

Attendees are encouraged to bring blankets and lawn chairs for the concert.

Family-Friendly Activities

  • There will be yard games for all attendees to enjoy! Get the competitive spirit revved up and play Connect 4, Checkers, and more.
  • Balloon Art: Available for the kiddos free of charge.

Food, Beverage, and Snack Vendors

Enjoy a cold bottle of water, ice-cold lemonade, hot dogs, tacos and more! A variety of booths with choices for everyone to enjoy.

Raffle Baskets

Guests can come to the event information booth and pick up a raffle ticket for a chance to win one of the amazing raffle baskets. You must be present for the drawing to win.

Street Closures

  • Commonwealth Ave. at Arizona Place will be closed to all vehicular traffic July 3 - 5.
  • Arizona Place from Boston St. to Buffalo St. will be closed to all vehicular traffic on July 4.

Both the event and parking are FREE with plenty of Downtown Chandler parking.

Check out our event calendar for more Independence Day celebrations in Chandler.

title: d'Vine Gourmet
metaDescription: Experience Arizona Flavors at d’Vine Gourmet Discover d’Vine Gourmet, a charming Arizona‑made gift shop located in the heart of Downtown Chandler — a walkable district filled with boutique shopping, public art, and locally loved dining spots. Known for its handcrafted wine jellies, gourmet snacks, artisan foods and curated gift baskets, d’Vine Gourmet has grown into a community hub that celebrates Arizona flavors and craftsmanship. Step inside to explore products created by more than 150 Arizona makers, including local wines, chocolates, candles, coffee, salsa, and specialty foods, along with items from partners like Queen Creek Olive Mill. Whether you’re searching for a thoughtful gift, authentic Arizona souvenir, or something delicious to take home, you’ll find one‑of‑a‑kind treasures around every corner. For a deeper look at the shop’s story, from wine‑jelly beginnings to becoming one of Arizona’s signature gourmet retailers, read our full spotlight feature: Spotlight: d’Vine Gourmet https://www.visitchandler.com/blog/post/dvine-gourmet-arizona-gift-baskets/. Explore Downtown Chandler’s Art, Murals & Local Shops After visiting d’Vine Gourmet, enjoy more of Downtown Chandler’s vibrant atmosphere. Take a stroll to explore colorful murals, public art, and historic architecture featured throughout the district. These areas are highlighted in the city’s Downtown Chandler guide, which showcases galleries, gathering spaces, and charming walkways. If you’re in the mood to browse additional boutiques, handmade goods, artisan foods and other uniquely local finds, explore Chandler’s broader shopping scene through: • Shopping in Chandler — local boutiques, souvenirs, and specialty retailers. • Made in Chandler — curated listing of Chandler‑crafted gifts and artisan products. Finish your day by checking out upcoming community gatherings, tastings, art walks, and live music on the Chandler Events Calendar.

title: E+I @ACIC Coworking Space at the ASU Chandler Innovation Center
metaDescription: The ASU Chandler Innovation Center (ACIC) is located in Downtown Chandler just east of Arizona Avenue off of Chicago Street. The facility largely focuses on supporting the startup community with an innovative partnership between the City of Chandler and Arizona State University(ASU). ACIC offers classrooms, conference space and co-working space to foster a supportive and creative environment for entrepreneurs. Programming is available for the Chandler business community, ASU students and staff and youth aged 10 and older who are interested in developing their passion projects into a successful business. The site offers free onsite, uncovered parking.

title: ECHO Suites Extended Stay by Wyndham Chandler
metaDescription: Opening in December 2026, the ECHO Suites Phoenix-Chandler offers a modern extended-stay experience designed for travelers seeking comfort, convenience, and value. Located just off the Loop 202 Freeway, the new all-suite hotel provides easy access to Chandler’s shopping, dining, outdoor recreation, and business centers. Guests can settle into thoughtfully designed studio suites featuring fully equipped kitchen essentials, including a full-size refrigerator, cooktop, and microwave. Each suite also includes complimentary Wi-Fi, smart TVs with streaming capabilities, ample storage space, and flexible living areas ideal for longer stays. Hotel amenities include free parking, EV charging stations, a fitness center, on-site guest laundry, mobile check-in, and pet-friendly accommodations for travelers bringing their dogs along. The property is entirely smoke-free and designed to provide a comfortable home-away-from-home experience. title: Elliott's Steakhouse
metaDescription: Elliott's Steakhouse, offers an upscale fine-dining experience specializing in premium steaks and seafood. Housed in the historic Rowena Theatre building, originally constructed in 1912, the restaurant blends its rich heritage with modern elegance, featuring restored original brick walls and a 47-foot bar. The menu showcases dishes like the Truffle Porcini Ribeye and Crispy King Salmon, complemented by an extensive wine list and inventive cocktails that pay homage to the building's cinematic past. Elliott's Steakhouse is open Sunday and Monday from 3 p.m. to 9 p.m., and Tuesday through Saturday from 3 p.m. to 10 p.m., with daily happy hour at the bar from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m.

title: Galeto Brazilian Steakhouse
metaDescription: Looking for a dining experience that blends delicious food with rich cultural tradition? Look no further than Galeto Brazilian Steakhouse located in The Shoppes at Casa Paloma! As the only family-owned and operated Brazilian steakhouse in the Valley, they are proud to preserve the authentic ways of grilling straight from Brazil. Savor 14 different cuts of expertly cooked meats—beef, pork, chicken, lamb, and sausage—along with our extensive gourmet salad bar featuring smoked meats, cheeses, and authentic Brazilian dishes. Complete your meal with an extensive wine selection & decadent dessert menu. For a more laid-back dining experience, explore their a la carte menu featuring authentic Brazilian street food bites while enjoying their newly renovated outdoor patio or full-service indoor bar. Come dine at Galeto Brazilian Steakhouse and take a flavorful journey to Brazil and back!

title: Grove Coffee
metaDescription: Often described as a hidden gem, Grove Coffee is located on The Grove Church campus, making it a little harder to find - but it definitely makes up for it by serving up a great, local experience. Grove Coffee serves locally roasted organic coffee from Provision Coffee, home baked pastries from Sweet Things Bakery, and a menu that hosts a premium line of syrups and specialty drinks. Featuring new local artwork every month, this café is perfect for everything from artistic inspiration, to long days working on laptops, to settling in for an hours long discussion with a good friend. The coffee shop features ample parking, a grassy play area for kids, and plenty of seating. Open Monday-Friday 7 a.m.-9 p.m.; Saturdays 7 a.m.-7 p.m. and Sundays 7 a.m.-1 p.m.

title: Hamilton Aquatic Center
metaDescription: Hamilton Aquatic Center is a standout destination for summer fun in Chandler, offering a dynamic mix of water attractions and amenities for swimmers of all ages. This vibrant community hub features a competition‑length lap pool, a leisure pool with zero‑depth entry, and plenty of interactive features that make it a favorite for families and fitness‑minded visitors alike. Kids can zip down the water slide, splash through playful spray features, or explore shallow areas designed for safe, carefree fun. Adults can enjoy dedicated lap‑swim times, relax in the heated spa, or join one of the center’s popular water fitness classes. With shaded seating, grassy lounging areas, and convenient on‑site facilities, it’s easy to settle in for a full day by the water. The center also hosts swim lessons, team practices, and seasonal programming, making it a go‑to spot for building confidence in the water or staying active year-round. Whether you’re cooling off on a sunny afternoon or cheering on a swim meet, Hamilton Aquatic Center delivers a refreshing and welcoming experience in South Chandler. record.description:
The Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler/Fashion Center is located in the Southeast Valley of Phoenix, on a shared campus with Homewood Suites by Hilton.  Located adjacent to the Chandler Fashion Center and just minutes from numerous restaurants.  The Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Phoenix/Chandler Fashion Center is convenient to such businesses as Wells Fargo, Intel, Northrop Grumman, Microchip, Verizon, and Pearson.

Take advantage of our thoughtful amenities guaranteed to give you an enjoyable stay. Enjoy free high-speed internet access as well as a microwave and mini-fridge in each guest room and suite. Get some well-deserved rest on the clean and fresh Hampton bed® before waking up to Hampton's free hot breakfast. Our hotel in Chandler AZ provides a business center and meeting and event space for up to 40 guests. Reinvigorate with a workout in the fitness center or spend a day basking in the sunshine by the outdoor pool with whirlpool spa.

Amenities for the Hampton Inn & Suites:


Hampton's free hot breakfast
Clean and fresh Hampton bed® 
Free high-speed internet access in every room 
Fitness Center 
Business Center 
24 hour Suite Shop 
On-Site Laundry Facilities 
Free On-Site Parking 
Outdoor pool & hot tub

title: Hangar Café
metaDescription: Located in an aircraft maintenance hanger on the northwest side of Chandler Municipal Airport, the Hangar Cafe is a local favorite for breakfast and lunch. This casual, family run diner-style restaurant has limited indoor seating, but most prefer the large, covered patio that faces the runway for a complete experience. Flight enthusiasts of all ages will enjoy watching some of the more than 200,000 annual flight operations that take place at one of the nation's busiest general aviation airports.

title: Helluva Brewing Company
metaDescription: Located in west Chandler at McClintock and Ray, Helluva Brewing Company features 20 beers on tap including eight of their own: an American wheat, IPA, pale ale, light lager, amber, red, a Kölsch and will feature two seasonal brews. The gastropub offers a robust kitchen with many handheld and shareable plates and with 22 big screen TVs, it's a great place to catch sports games. Helluva also features a "Little Brewers" menu that is perfect for when traveling with the kids. Menu items include entrees, drink and dessert for a set price.

title: Hidden House
metaDescription: Located in Downtown Chandler in an intimate 1939 cottage - Hidden House offers a unique indoor/outdoor dining experience where every seat is a different setting. Blending fancy and friendly, the restaurant features a more casual dining experience in its front courtyard offering a mix of high and low tables and a 15-seat outdoor bar. A more upscale dining experience is inside the cottage, complete with white linen tables and the back patio features a second outdoor bar with ten seats and a number of tables under a wooden pergola. A little further behind and diners will uncover a hangar that offers a outdoor-that-is-indoor feel that is decked out with chandeliers, live trees, 14-foot garage-style windows and a mix of booths and tables and stage for bands and performers. Similar to their sister restaurant, The Brickyard Downtown, the chef-driven menu features New American cuisine with their own twist and the restaurant will feature a number of cocktails including around 100 wines and about three dozen options for beer drinkers.

Alternatively, Historic Downtown Chandler is close by, offering eclectic dining, shopping and galleries.

metaDescription: Hob Nob Sports Grill features favorite sport bar eats and drinks and hearty entrees. Burgers and sandwiches include your favorite side - select from french fries, tator tots and onion rings. For those that find it hard to choose, diners may opt for 50/50 of their two favorites! While this tends sports bar tends to be a favorite for Chicago sports based fans, Hob Nob Sports Bar is a great a place to watch a game, enjoy some live music or hang out with your friends.

title: Holiday Inn Phoenix-Chandler
metaDescription: The Holiday Inn Phoenix Chandler mixes business and pleasure with its relaxed, modern atmosphere and corporate savvy amenities. Guests are pampered in comfort when staying in one of the 106 rooms; each featuring quality room-service, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, free local phone calls, a 27” TV, refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, hair dryer, and ironing set. This Chandler, AZ hotel features a restaurant and bar, outdoor pool, whirlpool and shaded patio in addition to an on-site laundry facility, a fitness center and offers free shuttle service serving a 5-mile radius, based on availability. The hotel is situated alongside the gorgeous Ocotillo Golf Club and conveniently located near shops and businesses. The Holiday Inn Phoenix-Chandler provides a prime location for local major employers such as Intel, Microchip, Tokyo Electron, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Northrop Grumman, Honeywell, Healthways, Keap and PayPal. A great location for your Arizona meeting, the hotel features over 2,000 sq. ft. of flexible meeting space including a divisible ballroom which can accommodate events up to 150 people or its intimate boardroom for 12. The hotel is also a great fit for Arizona weddings, reunions and social gatherings.

Our hotel is adjacent to the Price Corporate Corridor and just 1.5 miles from Intel’s Ocotillo Campus and 3 miles from Chandler Fashion Center. A short drive to Chandler City Center provides opportunities to enjoy local restaurants, attractions like the Chandler Museum, and the Rawhide Western Town & Event Center. Full renovation completed in Fall 2024.

A free hot breakfast is served each morning as well as dinner and drinks Monday-Thursday evenings. Guests will enjoy other hotel amenities including the fitness center, business center, outdoor pool, 24-hour Suite Shop, and on-site laundry facilities.

title: Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix Chandler

title: Hot Air Expeditions
metaDescription: Breathtaking. Magical. Awe-inspiring. These are just a few words that have been used to describe Hot Air Expeditions' ballooning experiences. Your journey begins with the viewing of the inflation of the balloon, where you will get a glimpse of how large the balloons are as they come to life! From there, your pilot whisks you away in the basket for your approximate one hour flight. During the journey, you will enjoy floating at different elevations, from up to 5,000 feet in the air for a gorgeous overview of the Sonoran Desert, to within feet of the desert floor, to catch a glimpse of local wildlife, plant life and landmarks. It is common to see jackrabbits, quail, coyote and even javelina. Upon landing, you'll toast to the adventure that ensued with flutes of chilled champagne and gourmet cuisine from the award-winning Vincent's on Camelback, complete with tables, linens and china - truly, a toast to the perfect day. You're sent back to reality with a memento of your time in the sky, a commemorative flight certificate, to take home. Morning flights available daily, year-round, and sunset flights are available November-March. Roundtrip hotel transfers available // FAA Certified // Insured. "Best Balloon Flight in Phoenix" - Fodor's Travel. Seen on ESPN, Fox 10, Channel 12 & more.

title: i.d.e.a. Museum
metaDescription: The i.d.e.a. Museum is the place to explore your imagination through design in art, science and technology! We support "your child and the child within you" by providing interactive opportunities that engage your senses and encourage creativity. Please remember socks if you plan on visiting ArtVille. Activities include: -Building a new invention on Rigamajig -Designing a dream machine in Robot Corner -Developing a stop-motion film in Lights Camera Action -Acting out stories in ArtVille's Performing Arts Center -Playing pretend in Art's Vet Clinic, Library, Café and Garden -Building with soft blocks in ArtVille -Creating beautiful artworks throughout the museum -Exploring new fun activities in the Whiteman Family Exhibition Gallery (The Art of Healthy Living ends Jan. 21, 2018; Sonoran Safari exhibit opens Feb. 9 and runs through May 27.). There are three main exhibit areas (ArtVille - a socks-only space aimed at little ones, the HUB and Whiteman Family Gallery) and an outdoor atrium to explore during your visit. You may enjoy your own lunch in the Atrium or Snackery. Visitor service staff can provide you with a list of local eateries if you wish to eat out.

Offering youth and adult hockey and skating programs for all ages and levels. Public Skate sessions when offered, are traditionally held select Saturdays and Sundays. Special sessions are scheduled for designated holidays and occasionally on weekday afternoons during school breaks. The facility features two NHL regulation sized ice surfaces, full-service pro shop, concession style snack bar and OrthoArizona location.

We also provide a curated wine list and handcrafted cocktails, perfect for pairing with your meal or simply unwinding.

metaDescription: This trail picks up from the Beverly Canyon Trailhead, along the south side of South Mountain Park. The loop trail is approximately 3.5 miles and about 570 ft. in elevation. The trail is very popular March through October and has some rocky areas. Once you arrive at the Beverly Canyon Trailhead, look for signs directing you to the Javelina Canyon Trail.
