Shabu-shabu is Mongolian in origin, but translates to thinly sliced meats thinly sliced, steamed and cooked in a spicy broth. In addition to a regular assortment of beverages, the eatery also serves Korean cocktails, Asian beers and sake and soju, a Korean alcohol beverage made from rice or sweet potatoes.

title: Just Roughin' It Adventure Company
metaDescription: As featured in U.S. News and World Report, Just Roughin' It offers all-inclusive, guided day hikes in the desert around Phoenix and other Arizona destinations including the Grand Canyon. Our tour packages include round-trip transportation, hiking gear, lunch snacks and medically trained, expert guides. All you need are hiking shoes and the appropriate clothing; we will provide the rest. You choose the trip location and difficulty and we will create a trip that is just right for you. Just Roughin' It offers tours for corporate groups, family trips, and individual hikers. Visit our website to see if we have openings on existing tours or contact us to see if we can put together a tour for your group. Our goal is to create an experience you will remember for a lifetime.

title: Kind Bean
metaDescription: Kind Bean is a neighborhood coffee and sweets shop offering a great selection of drip coffee, espresso based beverages, tea, cold brews and non-coffee drinks including lemonades, Italian spritzers and more. You won't want to miss on the great eats at Kind Bean which feature home made biscuits, overnight oats. fresh salads with made from scratch dressings, a selection of sweet and savory bruschettas and assorted in-house baked goods made fresh daily. Kind Bean also offers a variety of sweet treats dipped in gourmet organic chocolate including home-made marshmallows and assorted gourmet organic chocolates available for purchase. If you stop by on a Saturday, the cafe also offers a number of frozen treats including their coconut cream soft serve gelato that are perfect for a weekend pick-me-up.

title: Legends Showcase Bar & Grill
metaDescription: Located near the northwest corner of Alma School and Warner roads, Legends Showcase is a unique entertainment-focused venue offering a diverse menu featuring Gold Canyon Premium Angus beef and Regal Crest Farms chicken, raised with no antibiotics. The menu also includes fresh, quality seafood, a premium wine selection, a full bar featuring a fantastic selection of bourbons and specialty beers on tap and expertly crafted cocktails to complement their meals. Guests can enjoy free live shows six nights a week, including regular performances by an Elvis Presley impersonator, creating an engaging and entertaining atmosphere for diners. Legends Showcase is open for lunch and dinner from Tuesday to Sunday, serving from 11 AM to 9 PM. Evening shows kick off at 5:30 PM, providing guests with a perfect way to unwind after a long day. In addition to Elvis, the family-friendly restaurant offers a variety of tribute acts including the music, movements and the allure of well known entertainers including Alan Jackson, Dwight Yoakam, The Blues Brothers, Frank Sinatra, Garth Brooks, Dean Martin, Buddy Holly and more.

title: Levante Coffee
metaDescription: Levante Coffee in Chandler, Arizona, is a warm, family-owned café known for its relaxed neighborhood vibe. The menu ranges from classic espresso drinks to unique creations like the Banana Pudding Macchiato, Dubai Chocolate Matcha, and inventive matcha blends, along with authentic teas and fresh daily pastries. Beyond serving great drinks, Levante focuses on community, hosting events and earning recognition as Chandler’s best coffee shop in 2025. Its cozy, open interior makes it ideal for studying, working, or catching up with friends. Open late into the evening, Levante has become a cherished local hangout.

title: Mesquite Groves Aquatic Center
metaDescription: Mesquite Groves Aquatic Center is a splash‑filled favorite in southeast Chandler, offering a vibrant mix of water attractions perfect for families, fitness swimmers, and anyone looking to cool off under the Arizona sun. This award‑winning facility features a competition‑length lap pool, a leisure pool with zero‑depth entry, and plenty of playful elements that keep visitors coming back all season long. Kids can zip down the water slides, dart through the lazy river, or explore the interactive spray features designed for safe, energetic fun. Adults can enjoy dedicated lap‑swim times, relax in the heated spa, or join one of the center’s popular water fitness classes. With shaded seating, grassy lounging areas, and convenient on‑site amenities, it’s easy to settle in for a full day by the water. The center also offers swim lessons, team practices, and seasonal programming, making it a go‑to spot for building confidence in the water or staying active year‑round. Whether you’re floating along the lazy river, cheering on a swim meet, or simply soaking up the sunshine, Mesquite Groves Aquatic Center delivers a refreshing escape for all ages. title: Mic Drop Comedy Chandler
metaDescription: Mic Drop Comedy Chandler is a "Boutique Comedy Experience" located in the walkable Historic Downtown Chandler entertainment district with plenty of free parking and without the pressure of a two-drink minimum. The club focuses on the Chandler community and concentrates on the use of local ingredients. Guests can expect excellent service, great comedy, and a unique ambiance! The Mic Drop Comedy Chandler team is excited to bring Arizona’s most extraordinary and unique comedy experience to Downtown Chandler. Boasting two intimate showrooms, indoors and outdoors, you will be blown away by the "Boutique Comedy Club" concept. With great attention to detail, Mic Drop Comedy Chandler is unlike any other Arizona venue. We provide a mix of traditional stand up and the award-winning improvisational shows that Chandler has come to know from the ImprovMANIA comedy troupe. We pride ourselves on stellar customer service and our dedication to providing laughter to the community. Whether traditional stand up or improvisation, the integrity of every show is a top priority, and we guarantee that every show on our stage is worth seeing. Come experience the magic of Mic Drop Comedy Chandler!

title: Moka & Co.
metaDescription: Enjoy the bold flavor of Yemeni coffee prepared in a selection of traditional and Western coffee-based beverages at Moka & Co. in Chandler. Visitors will find sweet and savory baked goods and a vast variety of beverages that blend Yemeni flavors and spices. The beverage menu includes non-coffee based drinks like matcha, frozen blended drinks, lemonades, fruit-based refreshers. Espresso-based drinks, and traditional coffee beverages like Mufawar, Maleki, Sana'ani, Jubani, and Qishr, each with its unique blend of spices and characteristics are popular choices. Find free parking near this Downtown Chandler location, including the Overstreet parking garage for quick and easy access.

Since opening its first location in Seattle in 2011, Mox Boarding House has expanded to Bellevue, WA, and Portland, OR, and now to Chandler, AZ. Each location offers a welcoming environment where friends, families, and gaming enthusiasts can come together to play, dine, and connect. With a vast game library, thousands of games available for purchase, and a full calendar of events, Mox Boarding House is a hub for gamers of all ages and skill levels.

title: North Italia
metaDescription: Opening November 11, 2026! Located in West Chandler, North Italia is a stylish gathering place where visitors can savor modern Italian cuisine made from scratch daily. From house-made pastas and artisan pizzas to seasonal specialties, handcrafted cocktails, and an extensive wine selection, every dish is thoughtfully prepared with fresh ingredients and bold flavors. Situated in The Shoppes at Casa Paloma along the I-10 corridor, North Italia is the perfect stop while exploring Chandler’s vibrant west side. Enjoy a leisurely lunch between shopping excursions, unwind with happy hour after a day of sightseeing, or gather with friends and family for dinner on the inviting patio. The restaurant’s contemporary atmosphere and warm hospitality make it a favorite destination for locals and visitors alike. While you're in the area, explore nearby shopping at Chandler Fashion Center, catch a spring training game at the Tempe Diablo Stadium, enjoy outdoor recreation at Desert Breeze Park, or discover the growing collection of dining, entertainment, and nightlife venues throughout West Chandler. Whether you're visiting for a weekend getaway, business trip, or local staycation, North Italia offers a memorable taste of Chandler’s dynamic culinary scene.

title: Nozomi Aquatic Center
metaDescription: Nozomi Aquatic Center is a favorite neighborhood destination in west Chandler, offering a refreshing mix of water play, lap swimming, and family‑friendly fun. This inviting community pool features a competition‑length lap pool, a leisure pool with zero‑depth entry, and plenty of interactive elements, making it a great spot to cool off on sunny Arizona days. Kids can splash through the water slide, explore playful spray features, or enjoy shallow areas designed for safe, carefree fun. Adults can take advantage of lap‑swim times, unwind in the heated spa, or join one of the center’s popular water fitness classes. With shaded seating, grassy lounging areas, and convenient on‑site amenities, it’s easy to settle in for a relaxing afternoon by the water. The center also offers swimming lessons, team practices, and seasonal programming, making it a go‑to spot for building confidence in the water or staying active year‑round. Whether you’re cheering on a swim meet, splashing with the kids, or simply soaking up the sunshine, Nozomi Aquatic Center delivers a welcoming aquatic experience for all ages. title: Nozomi Park and Dog Park
metaDescription: Nozomi Park is a well‑loved neighborhood destination in west Chandler, offering a wide mix of outdoor amenities perfect for families, athletes, and anyone looking to enjoy time outside. This spacious community park features lighted ballfields, open green space, and plenty of room to play, making it a popular spot for both casual recreation and organized sports. Families appreciate the park’s playground areas, shaded ramadas, and picnic spots ideal for weekend gatherings or relaxed afternoons in the sun. Active visitors can take advantage of the lighted softball and soccer fields and the walking paths that wind through the park, offering a scenic loop for joggers, strollers, and dog walkers. The park is also home to the Nozomi Aquatic Center, giving visitors easy access to even more ways to cool off and stay active. With its welcoming atmosphere, convenient amenities, and central role in the community, Nozomi Park is a go‑to outdoor escape for West Chandler residents and visitors alike. Nozomi Dog Park Hours Open: 6 a.m. - 10:30 p.m. Maintenance Closure: Mondays 6 a.m. - 2:30 p.m.

title: Papago Park
metaDescription: Located minutes from Chandler near The Phoenix Zoo and Desert Botanical Garden, The trails in Papago Park are typically very smooth with minimal elevation gain, providing fast and easy access for hiking , walking and running. The park itself is split into east and west sides by Galvin Parkway. On the west side is the 2.3 mile Double Butte loop and on the east-side there is an interpretive trail highlight local flora and fauna along with a short hike to the famous picture op, Hole-in-the-Rock. title: Paseo Trail
metaDescription: The Paseo Trail is one of Chandler’s most popular outdoor pathways, offering 6.5 miles of scenic recreation along the eastern edge of the Consolidated Canal. With a smooth, 10‑foot‑wide concrete path on the east side and an unimproved dirt trail on the west, this versatile route welcomes walkers, joggers, bicyclists, stroller‑pushers, and even horseback riders. The trail has been a community favorite since its first phase opened in 2001, providing a peaceful, car‑free corridor through east Chandler. Several major road crossings feature lighted signals—including pedestrian and horseback‑height activation buttons—making it easy and safe to continue your journey. Visitors arriving by car will find convenient parking and restrooms at two key access points: • Tibshraeny Family Park (270 N. Cottonwood St.) – the northern trailhead, located just north of Chandler Blvd. and east of Cooper Rd. • Tumbleweed Park (2250 S. McQueen Rd.) – accessible from the east side of the park via the Los Arboles connection, south of Germann Rd. Whether you’re out for a morning run, a family bike ride, or a leisurely stroll with your dog, the Paseo Trail offers a refreshing way to enjoy Chandler’s sunshine and open spaces.

title: Paseo Vista Recreation Area & Dog Park
metaDescription: Paseo Vista Recreation Area offers one of Chandler’s most unique outdoor experiences, transforming a former landfill into a scenic, elevated recreation space with sweeping 360-degree views of the East Valley. Most of the park’s amenities sit atop the hill—hidden from street level—so those who make the worthwhile walk, ride, or drive to the top are rewarded with a one‑of‑a‑kind setting to explore. This 64‑acre recreation area features an impressive mix of activities, including an archery range, a disc golf course, a playground, a dog park, and walking trails that wind through terraced landscapes. The elevated vantage point makes it a great spot for sunrise strolls, afternoon playtime, or simply taking in the panoramic desert scenery. Dog owners especially love the park’s spacious dog park, complete with unique training obstacles purchased through a Police Department grant. Pups can test their skills on a see‑saw, balance beam, tunnel, hurdles, and a large A‑frame, while humans enjoy shaded benches, doggy drinking fountains, and convenient waste‑bag stations. The entire area is enclosed by 6‑foot‑high fencing with a single main entrance to keep dogs safely contained. Getting here is easy: vehicle access is off McQueen Road, just ¼ mile north of Ocotillo Road, with more than 330 parking spaces available. The park also connects directly to the Paseo Trail along the Consolidated Canal, offering a seamless route for bicyclists, joggers, and walkers. Whether you’re practicing your aim, exploring the trails, enjoying time with your dog, or soaking up the views, Paseo Vista Recreation Area delivers a refreshing and unexpected outdoor escape in South Chandler. Open for public use from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Phoenix Police Museum

Exhibits include a mock up of a 1910 city street and an old jail cell.

title: Phoenix Raceway

The Indycars have made 58 visits to Phoenix Raceway and the annual NASCAR weekends held each March and November -- including NASCAR NEXTEL Cup, Busch, Craftsman Trucks and Featherlite Southwest Series races -- is one of the biggest events in the entire state. As a matter of fact, the Checker Auto Parts 500 NASCAR Winston Cup Series race is arguably the largest one-day sporting event in Arizona.

title: PIEfection
metaDescription: Arizona-based PIEfection has been in the valley since 2012 and has been named the #1 pie shop in Arizona by many organizations, including: Yahoo.com, MSN.com and Travel.com. The Chandler dessert shop features a wide selection of more than 70 dessert pies and savory pies including quiche and pot pies. Everything is made from scratch at this French patisserie-style bakery where you will find whole pies as pleasing to the eye as the palate. Their company mission is to “Help families and friends create memories together, around the table with amazing food!” Pie lovers will not be disappointed in any one of their varieties, including this summer seasonal favorite, Summer Berry Cheesecake. Summer local favorites include unique dessert pies like Arizona Orange made from locally grown sour oranges or other favorites including Lime in the Coconut, Boston Cream with Raspberry Filling, or a Turtle Cheesecake made with authentic homemade caramel, a feat most bakers won’t even try!

All of this, plus a blacksmith shop, sheriff's office and jail, complete ranch complex and costumed interpreters including cowboys, lawmen and lovely Victorian ladies can be seen at the Pioneer Living History Village.

metaDescription: This west Chandler restaurant serves traditional, Chicago-style and the twist - they are well known for their Asian-inspired pizzas featuring a number of Indian variations for crafting a 'truly authentic Indian' pizza. Indian toppings included desi meat (hamburger with spices), paneer (a fresh cheese) and naan (flatbread) pizzas. Diners may also opt for more traditional toppings including a number of vegetarian and vegan options or other items from the menu including calzones, samosas, wings (Buffalo, tandoori and tikka masala) and end their meal with tiramisu or Ras malai, a cheesecake-like Indian dessert.

title: Playtopia! at Tumbleweed Park
metaDescription: Playtopia! at Tumbleweed Park is one of Chandler’s most imaginative and beloved playground destinations, offering a whimsical world of themed play spaces designed to spark creativity and endless fun. Set within the expansive Tumbleweed Park, this 2.5‑acre playground invites kids to climb, slide, explore, and let their imaginations run wild. Playtopia! features three distinct themed zones—Farm Land, City Land, and Critter Land—each filled with custom play structures, towers, bridges, swings, and slides that encourage discovery at every turn. Children can pretend they’re tending to a farm, navigating a bustling town, or exploring the natural world, all within a beautifully shaded, family‑friendly setting. Parents appreciate the park’s thoughtful design, including ample shade canopies, picnic areas, and nearby restrooms, making it easy to settle in for an afternoon of play. The surrounding Tumbleweed Park adds even more to enjoy, with open green space, walking paths, sports fields, and plenty of room to roam. Whether you’re planning a family outing, meeting friends for a playdate, or exploring Chandler with little ones, Playtopia! delivers a joyful, adventure‑filled experience that keeps families coming back again and again. Open for public use from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Potato Corner
metaDescription: Often coined as home of the "World's Best Flavored French Fries" since 1992. What originally started as a small food cart in the Philippines as you'll find Potato Corner at Chandler Fashion Center mall. Serving a large variety of french fries and seasonings. Opt for Original, Loopy (curly) fries, Sweet Potato fries, Jo Jo chips or Tator Tots and pick a seasoning - BBQ, Cheddar, Sour Cream & Onion, Chili BBQ, Cinnamon & Sugar or Garlic & Parmesan for the full experience. You'll also find chicken, baked potatoes and cold beverages at the food stand. The eatery also runs a vegetarian fryer for those seeking a completely vegetarian snack.

title: Press Coffee Roasters
metaDescription: Specializing in high quality coffee that has been roasted in small batches, Press Coffee has been named Phoenix's best roasted for two years running. Press Coffee features a variety of espresso beverages, drip coffee, tea and assorted hot and cold food items. Every Saturday at 10 a.m., Press Coffee offers one-hour coffee tasting sessions that take you on a trip around the world as you explore four distinctly different coffees and a history on each and how the beans became the flavor you taste today. The Coffee Tastings require registration for $10 and after completing the class, participants receive a $10 gift card to use at Press Coffee.

title: Queen Creek Olive Mill
metaDescription: Located in the heart of Queen Creek, the Queen Creek Olive Mill is Arizona’s only fully operational olive farm and mill, delivering a genuine tree-to-table experience inspired by Arizona’s agricultural heritage. This family-run, 100-acre property features more than 9,000 olive trees and produces premium, estate-crafted extra virgin olive oil right on site. Guests are invited to stroll through the groves, discover the journey from harvest to pressing, and sample a variety of freshly milled olive oils and rich balsamic vinegars in the on-site marketplace. Beyond tastings, visitors will find artisan foods, unique gifts, and locally sourced specialties that showcase the flavors of Arizona. With guided tours, special events throughout the year, inviting dining options, and charming retail spaces, the Queen Creek Olive Mill offers an immersive taste of authentic Arizona farm life. The Queen Creek Olive Mill is a 40- to 45-minute drive from most hotels in Chandler.

title: Rainbow Ryders
metaDescription: Rainbow Ryders Hot Air Balloon Company has been creating unforgettable experiences in the sky for over 40 years. Take in Arizona’s stunning landscapes from a whole new perspective with sunrise flights offered daily, weather permitting, or enjoy the beauty of a desert sunset during select winter evening rides. Drift peacefully above the Sonoran Desert, soaking in panoramic views as you float effortlessly through the sky. After your flight, celebrate your adventure with a traditional toast and light refreshments. Whether it’s your first flight or a long-awaited bucket list moment, Rainbow Ryders invites you to rise above it all and experience the magic of hot air ballooning.

record.description:
Rebel & Rogue is an all-American tavern for those who love to live life a little too loud. Whether
you're here for live music, dancing, or a party in the USA. Our food is hearty and flavorful, our
drinks are strong and refreshing, and our staff is welcoming, rowdy, and ready to make your
night one to remember! We believe in Rock and Roll and are proud to be American badass. 

We serve a wide selection of Bourbons, whiskeys, local craft beer, and signature drinks.
We are full of history housed in the former Arrow Pharmacy and Reliable Hardware building,
built in 1918.

title: Rock Your World

Visitors can browse beautiful dreamcatchers, suncatchers, fossils, oil lamps, essential oils, and unique trinkets for any budget. Owner Jennifer Materniak, a longtime Arizona resident with years of experience in candles and jewelry, brings her passion for crystals and craftsmanship to every corner of the store. Customers can also book a session with Jen, a tarot reader with more than 20 years of experience offering guidance on love, career, family, and life paths.

title: Rodeway Inn & Suites Chandler – Phoenix South I-10
metaDescription: This beautiful 73-room, pet-friendly hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Chandler, just off the I-10 at Chandler Blvd. It boasts an outdoor pool, 24-hour coffee and tea service in the lobby and guest laundry. Their cozy rooms include free wifi, a microwave, and a fridge. Staying here you are a short drive from both Downtown Chandler, Chandler Fashion Center, downtown Tempe and the Arizona State University Campus, Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport, Wild Horse Pass Resort and Casino, and Lone Butte Casino. You are also within a few minutes drive from South Mountain Park, the largest municipal park in the US, where you can walk, hike and climb its 10 different trails covering 58 miles of the beautiful and majestic mountain preserve.

title: Rush Xtreme
metaDescription: Rush Xtreme is an indoor adventure park offering extreme entertainment for the whole family. The amusement center features 12,000 sq. feet of trampolines for freestyle open jump, a dedicated kids trampoline for those 42" and under, Xtreme Basketball trampolines and Xtreme Dodgeball courts for kids and adults. a performance trampoline set above a sea of foam where you can test your skills or challenge a friend over a large foam-pit where you maintain your balance on a beam all the while attempting to knock down your opponent. Other attractions include Bungees, Skywalk - the largest indoor adventure rope course in the country where you make your way through 12 adventure elements while suspended 18-feet in the air and the Xtreme Wall that features a state-of-the-art 30' indoor climbing wall that can support 12 climbers at a time. All together, Rush Xtreme features more than 10 attractions in a 40,000 sq. foot climate controlled facility that is an ideal setting for team building, corporate events, parties, and just to let loose with the kids. Some attractions have height and/or weight restrictions and the trampolines require grip socks to be worn, which may be purchased for an additional fee at the front desk. Rush Xtreme features an in-house, from scratch Italian kitchen featuring hand crafted calzones, stromboli, pastas and hand-tossed New York-style pizza along with a selection of sweets, coffee bar and assorted drinks.

Some attractions have height and/or weight restrictions and the trampolines require grip socks to be worn, which may be purchased for an additional fee at the front desk.

Rush Xtreme features an in-house, from scratch Italian kitchen featuring hand crafted calzones, stromboli, pastas and hand-tossed New York-style pizza along with a selection of sweets, coffee bar and assorted drinks.

title: San Marcos Golf Course
metaDescription: Located in Downtown Chandler, adjacent to the Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort, the San Marcos Golf Course has a rich, deep history as Arizona's first grass golf course which initially opened in 1913. Unlike, most Arizona courses, the San Marcos Golf Course is home to lush tree-filled fairways, large manicured greens, and a few water features. The par-72, 6,640-yard parkland style Arizona golf course was recently renovated to preserve its historic charm and offers a world-class golf shop and Grill60, an on-site bar and grill with plenty of covered patio dining - perfect for fueling up for a round of golf or recapping the day. Tee times may be booked on-line and both private and group instruction is available from the on-site golf pros by contacting the course by phone.

A highlight of the trail is a crested saguaro that is about 2.5 miles into the hike.

title: SanTan Gardens - Brewery & Distillery Tours
metaDescription: Experience a behind the scenes tour of Arizona's largest independent brewery & distillery, SanTan Gardens - Brewery & Distillery Tours and its 35,000 sq. ft. production facility in Uptown Chandler. Highlights include tours of the craft beer and spirits labs, tasting samples, a peek into the science and similarities behind the brewing and distilling process, and an intimate education about the history and future of SanTan Brewing Company. At the end of the tour, guests will be able to purchase packaged products to take home and enjoy. Tours will be offered three times per day on Saturdays and Sundays. Admission will be $15 per person with a percentage of each ticket sold to benefit Chandler Compadres, a non-profit organization with the sole mission of providing support for East Valley families in need. Please note, all tour attendees MUST be aged 21 and older and MUST wear closed toe shoes. Plan to arrive ten minutes before the tour start time. Attendees are invited to take as many photos as they like and the tours last about 75 minutes. Tour capacity is 16 attendees, contact SanTan Gardens - Brewery & Distillery Tours if you wish to arrange for a larger group tour.

title: Seafood City Chandler
metaDescription: Located in Chandler Fashion Center mall, Seafood City is a vibrant destination for authentic Filipino groceries, specialty ingredients, and freshly prepared cuisine. Browse aisles stocked with a variety of fresh seafood & meats, produce, pantry staples, and essentials from across the Philippines. Beyond the market, visitors can experience a lively food hall atmosphere with popular in-store dining options serving traditional Filipino food including grilled specialties, baked goods, desserts and handcrafted beverages. Throughout the year, the market will host special events honoring the culture and traditions through Pasko celebrations. Whether you're shopping for hard-to-find ingredients, discovering new flavors or enjoying a meal with family and friends, Seafood City offers a unique cultural and culinary experience that reflects Chandler's diverse international community.

title: S'edav Va'aki Museum
metaDescription: Formerly the Pueblo Grande Museum, the S'edav Va'aki Museum is located at a 1,500 year-old Hohokam village ruin in modern day Phoenix. For over 70 years the museum has been dedicated to the study and interpretation of the Hohokam culture. On the 102 acre park grounds, visitors explore the ruin of an 800 year-old platform mound possibly used by the Hohokam for ceremonies or as an administrative center. An excavated ballcourt, and to full-scale reproductions of prehistoric Hohokam homes can be viewed along the ruin trail. The site also includes some of the last remaining intact Hohokam irrigation canals.

title: Shawnee Park and Dog Park
metaDescription: Shawnee Park is a welcoming neighborhood retreat in North Chandler, offering a blend of open green space, play areas, and one of the city’s popular dog parks. Tucked within a quiet residential area, this community park is a favorite spot for families, dog owners, and anyone looking to enjoy a relaxed day outdoors. The park features a shaded playground, open turf for casual play, and plenty of room to unwind under the Arizona sky. Picnic tables and seating areas make it easy to gather with friends or enjoy a peaceful afternoon in the park. Dog lovers especially appreciate the Shawnee Dog Park, a fully fenced space designed for safe, off‑leash fun. With separate areas for large and small dogs, shaded seating for owners, and plenty of room for pups to run, socialize, and burn off energy, it’s a go‑to destination for four‑legged visitors. The park’s convenient layout and friendly atmosphere make it easy for both pets and their humans to feel right at home. Whether you’re stopping by for a playdate, stretching your legs on a sunny day, or giving your dog some well‑deserved outdoor time, Shawnee Park offers a relaxed and inviting escape in the heart of Chandler. Open for public use from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. Shawnee Dog Park Hours Monday 6 a.m. - 8 p.m. Wednesday through Saturday 6 a.m. - 8 p.m. Sunday 9 a.m. - 8 p.m. Maintenance Closure: All Day Tuesday

title: Snedigar Sportsplex
metaDescription: Snedigar Park is one of Chandler’s premier recreation destinations, offering 90 acres of sports fields, open space, and family‑friendly amenities in the heart of South Chandler. Home to the expansive Snedigar Sportsplex, this well‑loved park is a go‑to spot for athletes, dog owners, and anyone looking to enjoy a sunny day outdoors. Sports enthusiasts will find lighted baseball and softball fields, soccer fields, cricket fields, and plenty of room for practices, games, and weekend tournaments. The park also features a skatepark, playgrounds, walking paths, and shaded picnic areas, making it easy for families to settle in and enjoy the day. Dog lovers flock to the Snedigar Dog Park, one of Chandler’s most popular off‑leash areas. This fully fenced space offers separate sections for large and small dogs, giving pups plenty of room to run, socialize, and burn off energy. Shaded seating, doggy drinking fountains, and convenient waste‑bag stations make the experience comfortable for both pets and their humans. With its wide range of amenities, welcoming atmosphere, and convenient South Chandler location, Snedigar Park is a vibrant community hub where visitors of all ages—and their four‑legged friends—can play, relax, and enjoy the outdoors. Open for public use from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. Snedigar Dog Park Hours: Daily: 6 a.m. - 10:30 p.m. Maintenance Closure: Wednesdays 6 a.m. - 2:30 p.m.

title: Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler
metaDescription: Welcome to the Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler. Our pet-friendly hotel boasts a convenient location off I-10, just a short distance from Arizona State University – Tempe Campus, Chandler Regional Medical Center, and Downtown Chandler. Following your fun-filled outing, kick back in comfort in our spacious rooms & suites. We provide modern amenities including plush Serta® Posturepedic beds, 55 in Smart TV that can connect to your personal apps, & mini fridge for a relaxing stay. For those looking to bring their pet along, we are a pet-friendly establishment. Need to host an event? Our flexible meeting space is great for accommodating business meetings and intimate social events. Active travelers can take advantage of our heated year-round outdoor pool and 24-hour fitness center to maintain a healthy lifestyle. From start to finish, fill your stay with fun at the Sonesta Select Phoenix Chandler. At Sonesta Select, we’ve designed a space where you can be yourself, one that fits your life on the road. Our generously sized rooms and well-crafted common areas let you spread out in, get work done, and let go when it’s time. From a great morning cappuccino to a well-earned evening cocktail or a late-night snack, we have you covered. Jump in the pool with kids, stay in to watch a movie or enjoy fresh air with a book on the patio. Sonesta Select helps make your time away from home personal, and uniquely you.

title: South Mountain Park and Preserve
metaDescription: At more than 16,000 acres South Mountain Park and Preserve is America's largest municipal park and is actually collection of three mountain ranges, the Ma Ha Tauk, Gila and Guadalupe. With more than 51 miles of primary trails for hiking, mountain bike riding and horseback riding the park is suitable for all ability levels. From the park's main entrance, visitors may drive up the Summit Road 5.5 miles to Dobbins Lookout and enjoy grand views of the valley or continue on to the Gila Lookout for a view of the Gila River Valley. A special note: The scenic roads are shared by bikers and hikers alike and there are numerous steep sections and blind curves. Please drive with caution and obey all traffic signs. Trail head hours are from 5 a.m. - 7 p.m.

title: SoZo Coffeehouse
metaDescription: Located in north Chandler, SoZo Cffeehouse is a local favorite featuring a casual, laid-back vibe. Visitors will enjoy the local art that adorns their walls- available for purchase along with several couches dotting their lounge, ideal for relaxing and enjoying some time with friends. In addition to donating money from every purchase to a local or international cause, the coffee shop offers a large variety of traditional hand-crafted, espresso drinks including enticing flavors like the Cinnamon Toast Crunch latte as well as a weekly drink special. Looking for a fun, relaxing evening - enjoy an evening of live, local music, every Friday and Saturday from 7-10 p.m. and be sure to check their event calendar for open-mic nights held on their stage.

title: Springfield Golf Resort
metaDescription: Springfield Golf Resort is an 18-hole, executive facility in Chandler, Arizona. Hailed by locals as the “best-kept golf secret in Chandler”, the club prides itself on a fun, welcoming atmosphere, friendly staff, and beautiful course conditions. With four sets of tees to select from, the course is easy enough for a beginning golfer to enjoy their day while also being able to provide a challenge for even the most seasoned player. An average pace of play for 18 holes at Springfield is three hours, too, ensuring your day on the course will be a relaxing and enjoyable experience from start to finish. Be sure to stick around after the round to enjoy a delicious meal or a craft cocktail at Grill 61. With live music and entertainment several times a week, this is the perfect spot to end your day at Springfield Golf Resort.

Live music performances take place Friday through Sunday, and private dining is available in “The Vault” for special events.

title: Staybridge Suites Phoenix- Chandler
metaDescription: The beautiful, all-suite Staybridge Suites Phoenix Chandler is located just west of the Chandler Fashion Center in the heart of West Chandler. This all-suite hotel is located near Intel, Microchip, Tokyo Electron, Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Honeywell and PayPal. This property is a short drive from Downtown Chandler, ASU Research Park, the Tempe campus of Arizona State University, Wild Horse Pass Resort and Casino, Lone Butte Casino and South Mountain Park, the largest municipal park in the US. This beautiful hotel boasts a complimentary full hot breakfast buffet each morning, an evening social including a light meal every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evenings, a complimentary laundry facility, storage lockers, 24-hour fitness center, a business center and complimentary high-speed Internet access. Every one- and two-bedroom suite is designed with separate living and sleeping areas and a fully equipped kitchen. Other amenities include a pool and whirlpool, a fire pit and patio grills. The warm hospitality you’ll experience visiting this fine hotel will complete your travel experience to the Valley of the Sun.

title: Stone & Vine Urban Italian
metaDescription: Located in south Chandler, Stone + Vine serves authentic, family recipes and provides an inviting ambiance that is perfect for dinner with family and friends. Chandler's Stone + Vine features wood-burning pizzas, traditional Italian dishes including house specialties: spaghetti and meatballs, eggplant parmigiana and ravioli. The restaurant also offers a full bar, cocktails, selection of beers and a variety of wines available by the glass or bottle. Open daily at 11 a.m. with a daily happy hour from 3-7 p.m.

metaDescription: Looking for a tasty treat from the good old days? Housing over 75,000 pounds of candy and over 4,000 different types from more than 170 manufacturers, visitors of all ages will enjoy the newly expanded sweet shop for a trip down memory lane or to discover a new favorite at Arizona's largest and most comprehensive candy store and soda shoppe. Not only does Sweeties Candy of Arizona house the largest PEZ selection in the western half of America, but also offers more than 700 mix and match bulk candies and 80 sugar free items. Sweeties Candy of Arizona also offers 300+, pure cane sugar, glass bottled sodas for your drinking enjoyment. Whether you are looking for a classic drink like Bubble Up or are adventurous enough to try a Peanut Butter and Jelly Soda you'll have a great time exploring all the varieties!

title: Tacos Chiwas
metaDescription: Led by a husband and wife team, diners will discover what many taco aficionados claim to be the best tacos in the Valley. Select from a nine varieties of street-style tacos served on handmade corn tortillas including asada, pollo, lengua, pastor, barbacoa and a vegetarian option the calabacitas featuring Mexican squash, corn, onion and cheese. The Tacos Chiwas menu also includes a selection of gorditas, quesadillas and burritos and from 10 a.m. - Noon, breakfast burritos are available daily. Tacos Chiwas restaurant owners, Armando Hernandez and Nadia Holguin are semifinalists for the 2024 James Beard Awards for Outstanding Restaurateur.

title: Taliesin West
metaDescription: In late 1937, Wright purchased land in northeast Scottsdale, where he and his apprentices took on the task of building Taliesin West as a winter “camp.” The complex of buildings included residential spaces, theaters, gift shop and an architectural studio and drafting room. Visitors to Taliesin West will not see a museum, but rather a remarkably vital and active community of students and architects working together to maintain Wright’s vision.

title: Tempe History Museum
metaDescription: Tempe History Museum is a place where the community comes together to explore Tempe’s past, share its present and imagine its future. On display in our main gallery is information, photographs and artifacts focused on four themes: Surviving in the Desert, Building Our Community, College Town and Living Together. There is also a dedicated space for children to do hands-on activities in the gallery. Each year the museum produces a featured exhibit based on a topic of local interest and we have regular rotating exhibits in our Community Room Gallery. Visit the museum Tuesday – Saturday, 10 a.m. – 5 p.m. Sunday, 1 – 5 p.m. Admission is always free. The museum’s regular hours are extended for evening programs and events such as Performances at the Museum and Third Thursday programs. Check our website [www.tempe.gov/museum] for program information. Tempe History Museum is located at 809 E. Southern Ave., next to the Tempe Public Library.

title: Tempe Town Lake
metaDescription: Take a journey to Tempe Town Lake, one of Arizona's most popular outdoor destinations. More than 2 million people visit Town Lake each year for assorted water activities, attend concerts, fireworks and a variety of festivals. There is a 5.7 mile, loop walking path that offers a fast and virtually flat, paved path for biking, walking and running.

title: Terror Trader
metaDescription: When horror isn't just a season - but a lifestyle, make Terror Trader a must-do stop on your trip through Arizona. This is not your average Halloween pop-up; it's a destination that showcases Arizona's thriving local horror scene. Discover handmade items from local artists, featuring a diverse range of offerings that include horror movie props, jewelry, and unique collectibles for a one-of-a-kind souvenir. You'll find treasures here you can't get anywhere else. And throughout the store, you'll capture iconic photo-ops with life-sized monsters and unique horror-themed set pieces at the massive store.

title: The Gallery at CCA
metaDescription: The Gallery at CCA is located inside the Chandler Center for the Arts, and hosts exhibitions for visitors that feature regional and national artists. Exhibitions rotate out on a regular basis throughout the year. Visitors will discover a varied palette of original artworks from oil and acrylic canvasses, to ceramic works, sculpture, jewelry, photography, mixed media and textiles. The Gallery is also home to one of two of the only Art-O-Mat machines in Arizona; for $5 cash, visitors can choose a piece of art dispensed from a refurbished cigarette machine, featuring art by artists from across the country. The Gallery at CCA is one of two nonprofit galleries in Downtown Chandler, supported by the Chandler Cultural Foundation.

title: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar
metaDescription: Quality, comfort and value are three key ingredients that make the Keg experience unlike any other. When it comes to steak, The Keg serves only the finest cuts, aged for tenderness and seasoned with a unique blend. Classic cocktails, delicious appetizers, succulent seafood, and an outstanding wine list round out its classic menu. The Keg's friendly and knowledgeable staff creates an atmosphere that encourages guests to enjoy, relax and be themselves. Whether you're getting together with friends or celebrating with family, you'll always be welcomed with a smile. You don't need an excuse or an occasion to come to The Keg. Whether you join us for after-work drinks or a spontaneous date night, we'll always make you feel celebrated.

title: The Ostrich
metaDescription: Located in Downtown Chandler, directly under Crust Chandler, the Ostrich is a neighborhood craft cocktail lounge inspired by the rich history dating back to the city’s founding days of 1912. Once a watering hole for the nation’s traveling elite, the space has been remodeled and re-imagined into a trendy drinking destination housed in the forgotten basement tunnels running to the Crowne Plaza San Marcos golf course clubhouse and the old railroad station. Today- classic cocktails, historical furniture and timeless service come together to create a unique, craft cocktail destination that harkens back to yesteryear. As you would expect, cocktails are serious business and the Ostrich offers a great selection of traditional and inventive cocktail creations.

title: The Phoenix Zoo
metaDescription: The Phoenix Zoo opened in 1962 and has grown to 125 acres of land, 2.5 miles of walking trails and 1,200 animals. The Phoenix Zoo is Arizona’s largest collection of mammals, fish, invertebrates, birds and reptiles and one of the most successful zoos in the United States. A great place for groups and individuals alike, many picnic tables and rentable armadas help complete your zoo experience.

title: The Vision Gallery
metaDescription: Vision Gallery is a welcoming space for art aficionados and casual visitors alike to experience and interact with art. With an abundance of natural light, Chandler’s Vision Gallery is a clean and contemporary setting for ever-changing and engaging exhibitions. It is the only space of its kind in the Chandler area to feature a wide variety of media from local and regional artists, inspiring the community to discover art in a myriad of forms. The gallery features diverse and evolving exhibitions in a variety of media including: ceramics, printmaking, drawing, photography, textiles, painting, sculpture, and multi-media art. The Vision Gallery is a not-for-profit gallery managed by the Chandler Cultural Foundation. In addition to rotating exhibitions, Vision Gallery offers cards, jewelry, home goods, and other items created by local artists. You can also find Art-o-mat vending machines in both the Vision Gallery and the gallery at the Chandler Center for the Arts. Proceeds from sales are used to fund Vision Kids workshops, free art classes offered to the community. Vision Gallery is open Monday-Friday 10am-5pm and Saturdays 10am-4pm.

title: Tonto National Monument
metaDescription: Located within the northern range of the Sonoran Desert lie two cliff dwellings that were occupied from 1300-1450 CE (common era). They represent a vibrant culture that lived in the Tonto Basin and whose descendants still call Arizona home. Check in at the visitor center to begin your hike, see the museum, or visit the store. The Lower Cliff Dwelling Trail is a steep, ½ mile hike up to the dwelling, open from 8 am-4 pm September-May and 8 am-12 pm June-August. The Upper Cliff Dwelling is only available through guided tours from November-April, Friday-Monday by reservation. For the most up-to-date hours and information visit the National Park Service website. (Credits: Photo 1- NPS Photo, Photo 2- NPS Photo by M. Mora, Photo 3 & 4- NPS Photos by C. Maier)

title: Tumbleweed Park Pickleball Facility
metaDescription: The Tumbleweed Park Pickleball Facility is one of Chandler’s premier destinations for America’s fastest‑growing sport, offering 16 dedicated courts designed for players of all ages and skill levels. Located within the expansive Tumbleweed Park, this modern outdoor complex provides a vibrant, community‑driven atmosphere that welcomes recreational players, traveling enthusiasts, and competitive athletes alike. The facility features 16 lighted courts, allowing for extended evening play under the Arizona sky. With ample space, high‑quality surfacing, and a layout built to support both drop‑in games and organized play, it’s a favorite stop for visitors looking to stay active during their time in Chandler. Players appreciate the facility’s shaded seating, nearby restrooms, and easy access to Tumbleweed Park’s wide‑open green spaces, walking paths, and picnic areas—making it simple to turn a match into a full day of outdoor fun. The courts are conveniently located near the Tumbleweed Recreation Center, which offers additional amenities and programming year-round. Whether you’re traveling with your paddle, meeting friends for a friendly rally, or seeking a new place to play while exploring the Phoenix metro area, the Tumbleweed Park Pickleball Facility delivers a welcoming, high‑energy experience that reflects Chandler’s love for recreation and community. Open from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Tumbleweed Park
metaDescription: Tumbleweed Park is one of Chandler’s premier venues for hosting multi‑sport tournaments and outdoor athletic events, offering 205 acres of flexible, tournament‑ready space in a convenient south Chandler location. With expansive fields, wide‑open layouts, and easy access to major roadways, the park is well‑suited for soccer, flag football, cricket, football, cross‑country meets, and large community events. Tournament directors appreciate the park’s numerous multi‑use fields, open turf areas, and the ability to configure space to meet the needs of a variety of sports. The park’s generous footprint allows multiple games or heats to run simultaneously while still providing room for warm-ups, staging, and spectator viewing. The adjacent Tumbleweed Recreation Center adds valuable support for event operations, offering indoor meeting rooms, restrooms, and flexible space ideal for team check‑ins, staff headquarters, awards ceremonies, or vendor activation. Ample parking, shaded ramadas, and convenient pathways help keep events flowing smoothly throughout the day. Tumbleweed Park’s scenic layout also makes it a strong choice for running events, including cross‑country races, fun runs, and fitness challenges. The park’s trails, open fields, and wide corridors provide natural routes for courses of varying lengths. With its combination of size, versatility, and modern amenities, plus close proximity to Chandler’s hotels, dining, and entertainment districts, Tumbleweed Park offers a reliable, high‑capacity venue for tournaments and athletic events of all kinds. It’s a standout choice for organizers seeking a well‑equipped, athlete‑friendly setting in the Phoenix metro area.

Tumbleweed Park is one of Chandler’s premier venues for hosting multi‑sport tournaments and outdoor athletic events, offering 205 acres of flexible, tournament‑ready space in a convenient south Chandler location. With expansive fields, wide‑open layouts, and easy access to major roadways, the park is well‑suited for soccer, flag football, cricket, football, cross‑country meets, and large community events.

Tournament directors appreciate the park’s numerous multi‑use fields, open turf areas, and the ability to configure space to meet the needs of a variety of sports. The park’s generous footprint allows multiple games or heats to run simultaneously while still providing room for warm-ups, staging, and spectator viewing.

The adjacent Tumbleweed Recreation Center adds valuable support for event operations, offering indoor meeting rooms, restrooms, and flexible space ideal for team check‑ins, staff headquarters, awards ceremonies, or vendor activation. Ample parking, shaded ramadas, and convenient pathways help keep events flowing smoothly throughout the day.

Tumbleweed Park’s scenic layout also makes it a strong choice for running events, including cross‑country races, fun runs, and fitness challenges. The park’s trails, open fields, and wide corridors provide natural routes for courses of varying lengths.

With its combination of size, versatility, and modern amenities, plus close proximity to Chandler’s hotels, dining, and entertainment districts, Tumbleweed Park offers a reliable, high‑capacity venue for tournaments and athletic events of all kinds. It’s a standout choice for organizers seeking a well‑equipped, athlete‑friendly setting in the Phoenix metro area.

title: Tumbleweed Park
metaDescription: Tumbleweed Park is one of Chandler’s largest and most beloved outdoor spaces, offering 205 acres of wide‑open fields, shaded play areas, and family‑friendly amenities that make it a must‑visit stop for anyone exploring the city. Located in south Chandler, this expansive park blends recreation, relaxation, and community spirit in a setting that invites visitors to stay and play. Families are drawn to the park’s standout attraction, Playtopia!, a 2.5‑acre themed playground filled with imaginative structures, towers, slides, and shaded areas designed to spark creativity for kids of all ages. Beyond the playground, visitors will find walking and biking paths, picnic ramadas, sports fields, and plenty of open green space perfect for frisbees, kite flying, or a laid‑back afternoon under the Arizona sky. The park is also home to the Tumbleweed Park Pickleball Facility, featuring 18 outdoor courts with LED lighting, restrooms, and drinking fountains, along with plenty of parking. Tumbleweed Park is also home to the Tumbleweed Recreation Center, a modern facility offering fitness classes, indoor play spaces, and community programming, making it a convenient hub for both locals and visitors looking to stay active. With its spacious layout, family‑friendly amenities, and easy access to the Paseo Trail, Tumbleweed Park offers a refreshing escape for travelers seeking sunshine, outdoor fun, and a true sense of Chandler’s community charm. Whether you’re planning a picnic, letting the kids explore Playtopia!, or enjoying a scenic stroll, this park delivers a memorable experience for all ages. The park is located between McQueen Rd. to the east and Arizona Ave. to the west, and Germann Rd. to the north and Ryan Rd. to the south.

title: Tumbleweed Recreation Center
metaDescription: The City of Chandler celebrated the grand opening of its state-of-the art, multi-purpose Tumbleweed Recreation Center in April 2008. The 62,000-square-foot facility offers an assortment of athletic and educational activities for all age groups and features a fitness center, indoor track, group exercise studio, gymnasium, game room, art and ceramics studios, racquetball courts, teaching kitchen, room rentals, birthday party packages, computer lab, free wi-fi and more. The centerpiece of the facility is the 6,000-square-foot fitness area with 41 pieces of cardiovascular equipment and more than 44 strength pieces. Visitors are welcome and can purchase a daily pass: $4 for adults, $3 for active adults and teens, and $2 for children under 12.

title: Veterans Memorial: Field of Honor
metaDescription: The Field of Honor at Veterans Oasis Park is a powerful and visually striking memorial that honors the Southeast Valley’s past, present, and future veterans, offering visitors a meaningful place for reflection, remembrance, and learning. A Signature Veterans Memorial in Chandler Located on the southwest corner of Veterans Oasis Park, the Field of Honor is the first memorial of its size and scope in the Southeast Valley. It pays tribute to veterans from all branches of the U.S. military, highlighting their service through a thoughtfully designed space that blends symbolism, artistry, and American history. A Symbolic, Immersive Design The memorial features upper and lower levels, each rich with symbolism: Lower Level – The American Flag in Stone This area mirrors the exact ratio of the American flag, with stone plinths arranged to represent stars and stripes. Their varying heights emulate a flag rippling in the wind, while their formation symbolizes soldiers marching in unison. Some plinths disappear below ground—21 in total—representing a twenty‑one‑gun salute for those who did not return home. Upper Level – The Arizona Star Overlook An elevated plaza overlooks the memorial, featuring a star-shaped design inspired by the Arizona State Flag and the service flag displayed by families with loved ones in active service. From here, visitors can reflect as they look over the symbolic “soldiers” below. Honoring Local Veterans The Field of Honor includes a Veterans Recognition Wall, where names, ranks, and service branches of local veterans are displayed. Eligible honorees must have lived in the Southeast Valley and been honorably discharged. Nominations remain open as long as space is available. A Peaceful Setting for Reflection Set within the natural landscape of Veterans Oasis Park, the memorial’s recessed design creates a quiet, contemplative environment. Visitors of all ages can explore the space, learn about American history, and pay tribute to those who served. Chandler holds an annual Veterans Day celebration at the Veterans Oasis Park Field of Honor. Open from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

record.description:
The Field of Honor at Veterans Oasis Park is a powerful and visually striking memorial that honors the Southeast Valley’s past, present, and future veterans, offering visitors a meaningful place for reflection, remembrance, and learning.

A Signature Veterans Memorial in Chandler
Located on the southwest corner of Veterans Oasis Park, the Field of Honor is the first memorial of its size and scope in the Southeast Valley. It pays tribute to veterans from all branches of the U.S. military, highlighting their service through a thoughtfully designed space that blends symbolism, artistry, and American history.

A Symbolic, Immersive Design
The memorial features upper and lower levels, each rich with symbolism:

Lower Level – The American Flag in Stone
This area mirrors the exact ratio of the American flag, with stone plinths arranged to represent stars and stripes. Their varying heights emulate a flag rippling in the wind, while their formation symbolizes soldiers marching in unison. Some plinths disappear below ground—21 in total—representing a twenty‑one‑gun salute for those who did not return home.

Upper Level – The Arizona Star Overlook
An elevated plaza overlooks the memorial, featuring a star-shaped design inspired by the Arizona State Flag and the service flag displayed by families with loved ones in active service. From here, visitors can reflect as they look over the symbolic “soldiers” below.

Honoring Local Veterans
The Field of Honor includes a Veterans Recognition Wall, where names, ranks, and service branches of local veterans are displayed. Eligible honorees must have lived in the Southeast Valley and been honorably discharged. Nominations remain open as long as space is available.

A Peaceful Setting for Reflection
Set within the natural landscape of Veterans Oasis Park, the memorial’s recessed design creates a quiet, contemplative environment. Visitors of all ages can explore the space, learn about American history, and pay tribute to those who served.

Chandler holds an annual Veterans Day celebration at the Veterans Oasis Park Field of Honor.

Open from 6 a.m. to 10:30 p.m.

title: Veterans Oasis Park and Chandler Nature Center
metaDescription: Veterans Oasis Park is one of Chandler’s most scenic outdoor escapes, offering 113 acres of desert beauty, wildlife habitats, and family-friendly recreation. With its tranquil lake, miles of trails, and the engaging Chandler Nature Center, this east Chandler gem invites visitors to slow down, explore, and connect with the natural world. A Desert Sanctuary for Outdoor Lovers The park’s landscape blends Sonoran Desert vegetation, wetland habitats, and wide open green space, creating a peaceful setting for walking, birdwatching, photography, and picnicking. More than 4.5 miles of trails wind through the park, offering easy routes for families, runners, and nature enthusiasts. The 5-acre Community Fishing Lake adds another layer of relaxation, with opportunities to cast a line and enjoy the calm surroundings. Chandler Nature Center: Hands-On Discovery Located at the park’s entrance, the Chandler Nature Center serves as a hub for environmental education and exploration. Visitors can enjoy: • Interactive exhibits highlighting local wildlife and ecosystems • Nature-themed programs and workshops for all ages • Guided hikes, stargazing events, and seasonal activities • A gift shop with nature books, educational materials, and souvenirs It’s a welcoming stop for families, curious kids, and anyone looking to learn more about the Sonoran Desert environment. Scenic, Serene, and Full of Wildlife Veterans Oasis Park is a favorite among birders, with dozens of species spotted throughout the year. The park’s mix of wetlands and desert terrain attracts everything from herons and hawks to hummingbirds and migratory waterfowl. Sunrise and sunset offer especially beautiful views across the lake and along the surrounding trails. A Must Visit for Nature-Minded Travelers Whether you’re exploring Chandler with your family, seeking a peaceful morning walk, or looking for a place to immerse yourself in Arizona’s natural beauty, Veterans Oasis Park offers a refreshing blend of recreation and discovery. The Chandler Nature Center enhances the experience with immersive, hands-on learning opportunities, making it a place that encourages visitors to return.

title: Wrigley Mansion
metaDescription: The mansion maintains a well-deserved reputation as an exceptional location for social gatherings of all sizes as well as small and large corporate events. Built in 1932 by chewing gum magnate William Wrigley Jr., the mansion sits atop a 100 foot knoll with commanding views of the mountains and the city below. Embracing elements of Spanish, California Monterey and Mediterranean architecture, the mansion stands as a monument to an elegance and opulence seldom seen or experienced in one's everyday encounters.

title: Xeriscape Garden
metaDescription: Chandler's Xeriscape Demonstration Garden is a joint projects among the Water Conservation Division, the Arts Commission, and the Parks Division. It features community art, walking paths and water-wise plants and is designed to demonstrate a low maintenance landscape full of color and fragrance. The Xeriscape Garden is a functional, user-friendly demonstration space with mature trees, shrubs and plants found in the "Landscape Plants of the Desert Southwest" booklet available from the Water Conservation office. There is a granite path that flows between areas of the garden where themes include a children/pet friendly area, a wildlife garden and a low maintenance garden. Changes in grading help to reduce erosion and also highlight passive water harvesting techniques through the installation of berms and swales. Large signage explains design and landscaping techniques and smaller signs on many of the plants identify them by Latin and common name. New sculpture art in the park was created through a partnership with the Chandler Arts Commission and Chandler Unified School District’s Art Masterpiece program. Artist Juanita Hull-Carlson worked with 5th and 6th grade students from Erie Elementary School to create the artworks on display.

title: Lone Tree Golf Club | Chandler Golf Course & Relaxation
metaDescription: Spend the day at the Lone Tree Golf Course, golf with a view of the San Tan Mountains, and enjoy a delicious meal at The Grille at Lone Tree Golf Club
ogTitle: Lone Tree Golf Club | Chandler Golf Course & Relaxation
bodyHtml:
Lone Tree Golf Club

With its quiet mountain surroundings and full-service amenities, you'll enjoy a day of golfing and relaxation at Lone Tree Golf Club.  Golfers will appreciate the well-manicured greens which are especially enjoyable for golfers with mid to high handicaps.   

Golfers looking to step up their game may opt for one-on-one instruction for 1-hour sessions, or select from a 9-hole or 18-hole playing lesson with a PGA Professional.  

Whether you are looking for a bite after your round of Chandler golf or stopping by to unwind on the patio overlooking the golf course and the San Tan Mountains, The Grille at Lone Tree Golf Club is available with sports bar bites like a cheeseburger, the Lone Tree Club Sandwich or assorted quick eats.

bodyHtml:
Meetings in Chandler, AZ

 

Why Choose Chandler

There’s a reason Chandler, Arizona has been recognized as one of Cvents “Top 50 US Meeting Destinations.” The numerous meeting facilities, thriving business environment, world-class shopping, lively dining scene, outdoor recreation, and award-winning accommodations all come together making Arizona’s fourth-largest city the ultimate spot for your next corporate event. In addition, Chandler venues are located in metropolitan Phoenix, making logistics easy with only a 20-minute drive to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport. 

Planning Assistance & Resources

To start the planning process, check out the digital Chandler, Arizona Event and Meeting Planner Guide to learn more about hosting your next event in Chandler. Once you have your bearings, Chandler tourism staff is here to assist you from start to finish with our complimentary services. Our staff will work with you to find the best hotels and/or unique meeting venues for your specific needs. 

Site inspections may be arranged by staff who are available to accompany you on the site visit or you may elect to do your own site tour. Additionally, staff is also able to provide photos and destination guides to help increase attendance at your meeting as well as assist with activity ideas and sample itineraries. Contact us today to learn more about our complimentary services and make the most of your time.

Chandler Hotels and Offsite Venues

Chandler features an amazing selection of group-friendly hotels that feature great value, convenience, and excellent service. Whether you’re seeking the amenities offered at an Arizona golf resort or full-service, award-winning hotel or you’d prefer a small, upscale select-service property, Chandler offers excellent hotels and meeting space for groups from 10 to 200. Let our destination experts at the Visit Chandler tourism office assist you with creating a successful event.

Chandler also offers a number of unique meeting spaces for non-traditional meetings or off-site adventures. How about a private, boutique event facility located in the heart of Downtown Chandler or the main stage at the Chandler Center for the Arts? Find inspiration in the heart of a brewery amidst stainless steel tanks featuring extraordinary beer and craft food. What about a team-building moment on the tracks at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games? The Team at Visit Chandler will help you explore Chandler's unique meeting venues and find the perfect fit for your next event.

Explore Chandler Virtually

Check out Chandler’s venues with our virtual, interactive 360-degree tour. It all starts with a bird's eye view of the city and includes 360-degree panoramic photos, image galleries, text boxes, videos, and more to create an interactive, virtual map of Chandler. Jump from point to point with the click of your mouse to get a feel for the Chandler community. Then come and see us in person. We can't wait to welcome you!

headings.text: Find the Right Space for Your Event

bodyHtml:
Meeting Venues in Chandler, AZ

Chandler stands out as a premier conference destination with the perfect blend of location, amenities, and hospitality. Planning a high-level board gathering, a multi-day convention, or a training session with a view? Our diverse range of venues can match your function’s scale and purpose. From full-service hotels to dedicated event centers and creative off-site spaces, the city makes it easy to host a meeting that’s both productive and memorable.

Find the Right Space for Your Event

For larger gatherings, Chandler Center for the Arts offers theatres seating up to 1,500 with a state-of-the-art sound system included, as well as optional lighting and projection packages for enhanced presentations. The adjacent foyer accommodates receptions and banquets, and the downtown location puts additional entertainment options steps away.

Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort, Marriott Phoenix Chandler, Hilton Phoenix Chandler, Hilton Garden Inn Chandler Downtown, and Cambria Hotel Phoenix Chandler - Fashion Center have flexible venues featuring in-house catering, robust AV support, breakout space, and talented staff. Hilton provides 17,000 sq ft across 11 versatile areas, while Cambria has over 1,300 sq ft of meeting rooms. The Hilton Garden Inn offers approximately 1,700 sq ft of event space and has an additional 1,700 sq ft of meeting space and a 2,100 sq ft outdoor venue under construction with a fall 2025 opening.  Crowne Plaza boasts 32,000 sq ft among 16 venues, and Marriott delivers over 28,000 sq ft across 13 rooms, each perfectly suited for conferences, retreats, and multi-day sessions. 

When planning on a smaller scale, the Fairfield Inn & Suites at Chandler/Fashion Center includes two suites totaling 1,500 sq ft, while the Hyatt Place Phoenix/Chandler-Fashion Center provides nearly 1,500 sq ft. of event space across two rooms. Each location offers catering services and includes essential AV capabilities and Wi‑Fi.

The Chandler Community Center, with 17 conference rooms, is well-suited for seminars, exhibits, or family functions. Its variety of room sizes and configurations accommodates groups of all sizes. 

Our city also includes a collection of unique meeting venues, from boutique downtown event spaces and stylish breweries to team-building hubs like Andretti Indoor Karting & Games. These off-site options bring creativity and flair to corporate programming. Explore more options below and start planning your next gathering.

bodyHtml:
Top 5 Reasons to Meet in Chandler

So many reasons to meet in Chandler – our accessibility, innovative spirit, value, award-winning venues and culinary delights may just be the top five reasons to hold your next event in Chandler.

1. Location, location, LOCATION

Get to Chandler with ease, located 20 minutes from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport it’s a snap to get your attendees to Chandler.  Every day, people from all over the world come to Chandler for business and pleasure. America’s Friendliest Airport provides nonstop service to more than 100 domestic and 22 international destinations with more than 1,200 daily arrivals and departures!

Chandler has superb regional access for the drive market and is located within a day’s drive of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, Salt Lake City, Albuquerque, Denver and El Paso.

2. Connect and Do More in Chandler

Chandler is known as the “Innovation and Technology Hub of the Southwest” and it’s more than just a phrase, it’s a way of life.  That innovative energy runs through Chandler keeping attendees engaged and connected, but after hours and in between meetings – it’s easy to disconnect and unwind.   Attendees can work hard and play hard in Chandler with our lively dining scene, intriguing museums and attractions, fantastic shopping and rest well in our world-class hotels.

3. Affordability

Meeting in Chandler is a good value with affordable airlift and top-notch hotels.  Chandler is consistently recognized as a Top-Rated Vacation Destination in North America and recently received recognition as one of 2018’s Best Midsized Cities for Business Meetings – demonstrating what a great community Chandler is for small meetings and events.  

Many groups will find great value in shoulder and low seasons and weekend programs are extremely attractive in Chandler.

4. Award-winning Venues

Chandler offers 38 hotels and 4,366 hotel beds.  Chandler AZ hotels are recognized as being leaders in their respective hotel brands, offering excellent accommodations, high quality assurance scores and personable staff dedicated to your program’s success.

Whether you are looking to host a board meeting for 10, an annual meeting for 200, or a banquet for 650, our team can show you how Chandler’s facilities can be the right fit for your program.

5. Eat and Drink Well in Chandler

The actual meetings are always important, but it’s often those in-person connections over a great meal that we remember most.  Chandler is a melting pot of cuisines from around the world and offers local flavors worth exploring.

Meeting Services

And when you book your meeting through Visit Chandler - our staff can assist you with the following:

  • Assist you with connecting to local vendors and suppliers.
  • Provide suggestions and assistance for local, off-site venues.
  • Assistance with reviewing proposals and community information as well as assistance with arranging site visits.
  • Provide direction and assistance with local activities for attendees to enjoy during their Chandler visit.
  • Development of a custom microsite to promote your meeting to attendees that includes Chandler visitor information and hotel URL links when applicable.

Welcome to Chandler, Arizona!

We're thrilled to have the 2026 NAAIC host the 2026 National Summit on Artificial Intelligence, October 14-16, 2026.

This exciting event brings together leaders from education, industry, and government to discuss how AI is changing our learning and workforce development.

Waymo rides offer convenience like no other by operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Unlike other ride-sharing services, take your Waymo to popular spots like Chandler Fashion Center and make stops along the way, all in one booking.

By booking and routing a Waymo One, the autonomous vehicle service works much like Uber or Lyft.

  • Alternatively, you can also book a Waymo One ride directly through the Uber app.

bodyHtml:
Chandler is the Perfect Basecamp for your Arizona Getaway

Including a visit to Chandler when traveling to the Grand Canyon or one of Arizona’s famous national parks offers a unique contrast between Arizona’s stunning natural wonders and its vibrant urban culture. While the Grand Canyon showcases breathtaking landscapes and outdoor adventure, Chandler provides a dynamic city experience with great dining, shopping, and entertainment. Located in the Phoenix metropolitan area, Chandler is an ideal stop to unwind before or after exploring Arizona’s national parks and monuments. Enjoy award-winning hotels, outdoor recreation including championship golf courses, and family-friendly attractions like Round1 Bowling & Arcade or the thrill of Andretti Indoor Karting & Games, making it a perfect complement to your Arizona adventure.

Chandler, AZ, is a vibrant city that offers a perfect blend of modern amenities and rich cultural heritage. With its warm, sunny weather year-round, Chandler is an excellent destination for outdoor enthusiasts. You can explore the stunning Veterans Oasis Park, hike nearby South Mountain Park, or enjoy a round of golf at one of the city's top-tier courses. For those who love shopping and dining, Chandler is home to the large, regional upscale mall, Chandler Fashion Center featuring national and local retailers, entertainment and fantastic dining options. A few miles east of the mall, charming Downtown Chandler welcomes visitors with a mix of boutique shops, diverse restaurants, and lively entertainment options. Whether you're looking for relaxation or adventure, Chandler has something for everyone.

Beyond its recreational appeal, Chandler boasts a thriving arts and cultural scene. The city hosts iconic, annual events like the Ostrich Festival, celebrating Chandler’s unique ostrich ranching history, and the Chandler International Film Festival, attracting filmmakers from around the world. The Chandler Museum and the Arizona Railway Museum provide a fascinating glimpse into the area's past. Families can also enjoy thrilling rides at Andretti Indoor Karting & Games or make their way to Tumbleweed Park’s Playtopia! for an afternoon of play.

Chandler’s dining scene is a vibrant mix of Southwestern flavors, global cuisine, and locally owned eateries, offering everything from casual bites to upscale dining experiences including Arizona’s largest independent brewery, SanTan Brewing Company. Whether you're craving authentic Mexican cuisine, farm-to-table dining, or international flavors, Chandler’s restaurant scene offers a myriad of delicious options and styles.

With a convenient location near Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport and easy access to major highways, Chandler serves as an excellent gateway to explore both the natural beauty of Arizona and the conveniences of modern city life. Whether you're stopping by for a night or planning a longer stay, Chandler’s mix of relaxation, adventure, and cultural attractions make it a destination worth adding to your Arizona itinerary.

metaDescription: Relax at the casual club bar or challenge yourself with 27 holes at the Ocotillo Golf Course in Chandler, Arizona, an all-inclusive golf resort.
ogTitle: Ocotillo Golf Course & Resort | Chandler Golf Courses
bodyHtml:
Ocotillo Golf Club

Not your traditional desert course, the Ocotillo Golf Club features 27 unique holes amid scenic waterfalls, man-made lakes, and lush flower beds. The premier golf course was designed by Ted Robinson and is recognized as a Top 50 Resort by Golf World and has been awarded Golf Digest's 4 1/2 Star Best Places to Play Award.

The course's generous fairways with dramatic and beautiful cascading waterfalls and colorful flora for a lush Arizona golf experience that is unmatched. The facility has three nine-hole courses that may be played in combinations with yardages that range from 6,782 to 7,016 yards.  The most difficult course is the Blue-Golf combination with a PAR-72.2 rating and a slope of 133 from the back tees.

Ocotillo Golf Club has featured several tournaments for the PGA Tour, the U.S. Senior Open, and the U.S. Amateur and is a well-paced course for business meetings held on the course. This beautiful Arizona golf course is a short drive from Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

The facility also has an award-winning golf pro shop, provides golf instruction from PGA Professional staff, and a full-service restaurant and bar, the Tillo's Kitchen & Patio.  Many golfers and Chandler locals know to head to the patio for one of Chandler's most scenic happy hours on the waterfall patio for sunset views overlooking the Ocotillo waterfalls. 

In addition to arranging a couple of foursomes for a casual round of golf with friends or business associates, Ocotillo Golf Club is a great destination for tournaments, special events, and destination weddings for up to 250 guests.

Chandler, AZ, is a captivating desert city filled with exciting things to do, must-see attractions, welcoming hotels, and a rich history. Use this page to plan an unforgettable Chandler visit.

Learn About Chandler

Discover how Dr. Alexander J. Chandler arrived in the Valley in 1887 with a vision to create the state-of-the-art city that we know today as Chandler. Mesmerized by the heightened beauty of the surrounding desert, he saw land with boundless potential. Inspired, Dr. Chandler used the Native Americans’ existing canal system as a template and proceeded to create a cutting-edge irrigation system that turned the desert into farmable land.

Modern-day Chandler still resides on the cutting edge as innovation leads the way to an elevated quality of life for its residents and visitors.

Get Tips for Relocating

After a visit to Chandler, it’s not uncommon to begin dreaming of moving to our sunny paradise. Check out our relocation section to learn more about Chandler and how to plan your move. You’ll find helpful tips and resources to make your relocation a smooth one. 

And So Much More!

These days, getting to and from Chandler is easier than ever. Also, uncover all the first-rate ground transportation available during your visit and learn how the bus and METRO light rail are wonderful options depending on your needs.

When visiting ASU, Chandler serves as a great home base. Parents and future Sun Devils will love our tips for a campus visit. Learn about all that Chandler’s revitalized, vibrant downtown has to offer and how the city has everything you need.
