Compras

¿A quién no le gusta presumir los souvenirs de esas inolvidables vacaciones?

Chandler es el paraíso de las compras, ya sea para quien busque elegantes boutiques o outlets con tiendas de reconocidas y exclusivas marcas. Ir de compras a alguna de las muchas opciones que Chandler ofrece, es la mejor manera de encontrar ese regalo especial para esa persona especial. En Chandler también encontrará galerías de arte y tiendas especializadas, un outlet y el famoso centro comercial Chandler Fashion Center.

Chandler Fashion Center

Esquina suroeste de Chandler Boulevard y Loop 101

El centro comercial por excelencia. Chandler Fashion Center cuenta con grandes tiendas como Dillard's y Macy's. Aquí seguramente encontrará algo especial en alguna de sus más de 180 tiendas incluyendo Apple, Coach, H&M, Michael Kors, Banana Republic, Barnes and Noble y más. Cuando visite Chandler Fashion Center pase a servicio a clientes, ahí le proporcionarán una cuponera de descuentos en tiendas y restaurantes. También visite The Village, un área abierta en Chandler Fashion Center con tiendas y entretenimiento para disfrutar al aire libre. Este complejo comercial cuenta con restaurantes, 20-salas de cine y fuentes danzantes con un moderno espectáculo de agua, luz y sonido.

Downtown Chandler

Sur de Chandler Boulevard y Avenida Arizona

El centro de Chandler ofrece una experiencia diferente de compras, comenzando por una caminata por la plaza arbolada en el distrito histórico. Sienta el espíritu emprendedor de los comerciantes locales que ofrecen artículos únicos e irrepetibles en sus tiendas. El centro de Chandler está en constante movimiento. Ahí, se encuentra el edificio del ayuntamiento boutiques, galerías de arte, el Centro de las Artes y más de 35 tiendas locales, reconocidos restaurantes y bares. Las obras de arte públicas sirven de enlace para unir todos estos atractivos logrando armonía y belleza en toda el área. También podrá disfrutar de una variedad de eventos.

The Shoppes at Casa Paloma

Calle 56 y Calle Ray Boulevard

Definitivamente una lujosa experiencia. Es aquí donde encontrará exquisita decoración para el hogar, joyerías, salones de belleza y hasta clases de cocina en Sur La Table. Lo último de la moda lo encontrará en tiendas reconocidas como Ulta y la boutique Bath & Body Works. Este centro comercial también es reconocido por sus más de 20 restaurantes incluyendo Fleming's Prime Steakhouse & Wine Bar, Roy's y Pizzeria Grimaldi's.

Phoenix Premium Outlets

A un lado del Casino Wild Horse Pass Si le gustan los outlets, no querrá perderse del nuevo centro comercial Phoenix Premium Outlets con tiendas como Sax Fifth Avenue's OFF 5th, Tommy Hifilger, Armani Outlet, Lucky, DKNY, Nike, entre otras.

Comida

Durante su estancia en Chandler descubra experiencias culinarias bajo las estrellas, a la orilla de algún lago, en hermosos patios o en alguno de los muchísimos interiores con el confort y decoración que los distingue. Hay restaurantes en Chandler para todo tipo de paladares y para cualquier bolsillo. Los críticos culinarios recomiendan los restaurantes de Chandler. 

Arte y Cultura

Además del Chandler Center for the Arts, las galerías locales cuentan con una gran cantidad de obras de arte de artistas regionales y nacionales. También podrá disfrutar de artes escénicas con reconocidos cantantes, comediantes y músicos en el escenario del Chandler Center for the Arts, en alguna de las más de 150 presentaciones que se efectúan cada año.

El centro de Chandler cuenta con una amplia oferta de galerías de arte. En Vision Gallery el visitante descubrirá la obra de más de 300 artistas originarios de Arizona, mientras que los artistas latinos y Nativo Americanos los podrá encontrar en Xico.

Diversión Familiar

¿Qué puede hacer un niño en Arizona? ¡MUCHÍSIMO!

Chandler es sinónimo de diversión para todos los niños, desde los más pequeños hasta los adolescentes. Chandler tiene la ubicación perfecta para disfrutar de los 330 días soleados que Arizona tiene anualmente. Los pequeños podrán realizar actividades recreativas al aire libre, visitar un pueblo del viejo oeste de 1880, explorar el museo del niño, o realizar alguna otra divertida actividad. Además podrán jugar por horas en el parque de trampolines o en los muchos otros centros recreativos. Chandler es el lugar ideal para diversión familiar.

Vida Nocturna

¿Se siente con suerte? Visite uno de los tres casinos del área para vivir una diversión sin fin. Los casinos ofrecen juegos como blackjack, poker, maquinitas tragamonedas y bingo. Pruebe los ricos restaurantes y disfrute de los amplios espacios de entretenimiento.

Si busca una noche de diversión con los amigos, Chandler ofrece una gran variedad de restaurantes de moda con buena música, un ambiente agradable y con una fabulosa carta de vinos como The Living Room, The Brickyard Downtown, Hidden House y St. Amand Kitchen + Cocktails así como algunos de los bares más populares como Bourbon Jack's, Sandbar, y Tonic. Por supuesto, una visita a Chandler no estaría completa si no visita SanTan Brewing Co. la fábrica artesanal de cervezas de Chandler. 

Hoteles

Al final del día... descanse placenteramente en Chandler. Usted estará cerca del aeropuerto, de buenas compras, excelente comida, de los partidos de béisbol de entrenamiento de primavera, de fabulosos campos de golf y siempre, ¡con días soleados! Hospédese en Chandler y conozca la gran variedad de hoteles y resorts abanderados por el legendario Crowne Plaza San Marcos Golf Resort. Si su viaje es de negocios, y su familia le acompaña, podrán disfrutar de la piscina del hotel o de uno de los muchos parques mientras usted atiende sus juntas y posteriormente compartir juntos una deliciosa cena. Chandler ofrece hoteles para todo tipo de viajero, desde resorts de lujo, hasta hoteles con servicio completo y espaciosas suites para la familia.

title: Chandler Weddings | Venues, Planning & Celebration Ideas
metaDescription: Plan your Chandler wedding with beautiful venues, local vendors, accommodations, and memorable experiences for guests.
ogTitle: Chandler Weddings | Venues, Planning & Celebration Ideas
bodyHtml:
Weddings in Chandler  

Chandler offers a wide array of memorable wedding options that blend historic Southwest charm with modern luxury. From lavish resorts to sprawling gardens with farm-to-table cuisine to golf clubs and even castles, your dream wedding venue is in Chandler, AZ. You'll also find excellent venues for pre and post-wedding activities such as engagement parties, bridal showers, and the day after brunch.  

Chandler's thriving local wedding industry is full of talented and creative experts who will support you every step of the way to ensure your wedding day meets or exceeds the one in your dreams.

Wedding Venues 

Desert chic? Lavish elegance? Sprawling outdoor courtyards with a medieval theme? You’ll find wedding venues in Chandler, AZ with these and everything in between.

Step back in time at The Ashley Castle in Chandler, AZ where childhood dreams of fairytale weddings come true. At this enchanting stone castle, pass through 200-year-old entry doors to discover medieval-inspired interiors, a grand ballroom with soaring ceilings, marble floors, crystal chandeliers, and detailed hand-painted walls. Outdoors, the carefully manicured gardens add to the castle atmosphere. You'll feel nothing short of royalty as you exchange vows in the outdoor ceremony space in the embrace of a striking wrought iron structure.    

The lush, two-acre garden-style Bella Rose Estate has everything you need for a one-of-a-kind ceremony and reception. Among the enticing features of the outdoor venue are sweet-smelling flower beds, waterfalls, tranquil fountains, shade trees, and green grass. Saying "I do" in the gorgeous gazebo is a moment you'll remember forever. Indoors, the bridal suites cover 3,000 square feet for the bridal party, while the groom and his party can enjoy a private space with a poker table and flat-screen TV. The grand ballroom spans an impressive 5,000 square feet and seats 300 guests. 

For a laid-back, western-chic wedding venue, look no further than SanTan Gardens. This brewery and distillery seamlessly combines the classic with the modern for an authentic Arizona wedding. Wed at sunset on a gorgeous patio with shimmering lights and up to 65 guests. The on-site reception will be a lively party with unique photo ops around every corner.  

Wedding Planning 

Your wedding is among the most important events of your life. You can’t just send out an Evite and arrange for catering. There are numerous steps to planning your wedding and many moving pieces. Let’s take a look at some of the basics.

The wedding isn’t official without a marriage license. In Maricopa County, you can secure your license online or in person. Each has its pros and cons. The online route may be more convenient, but the county will take 7 to 10 business days to review your completed application. Applying in person will involve a trip to the courthouse or service center, which may require an appointment. That said, after you submit all the required paperwork, identification, and other documents, you’ll receive your marriage license the same day as your visit. You can even wed that day if you’ve made the necessary arrangements.

Many of the wedding venues in Chandler, AZ offer wedding planning services, but what if you want to enlist the help of an outside professional or do it yourself? You’ll need to make a checklist of what you require for your dream wedding venue, vendors, hotels or resorts for guests, and pre and post-wedding activities.

Whether you work with a professional wedding planner or not, it's crucial to determine your budget and work with your partner to ensure you're on the same page. Collaborating with your partner is a wonderful way to divide and conquer, as you each have unique talents that will come in handy when checking things off your to-do list.  

Pre and Post-Wedding Activities

One of the best things about weddings are the celebrations from the beginning and last long after the ceremony. Once you spread the fabulous news of your engagement, the engagement party isn't far behind. With all the suitable party venues in Chandler, you'll have no trouble finding one that meets your needs. Many take a different route altogether, with parties held at one of the parents' homes or at the home of a close friend.

Bridal showers are a lovely moment for the bride and her wedding party. This gathering of close friends (and often family) gives the bride-to-be a chance to discuss and toast the upcoming wedding and simply enjoy being with loved ones. During this joyous occasion, the bride will receive gifts for her new life as a married couple. The Ostrich is a charming choice in downtown Chandler with its speakeasy vibe, classic drinks, and craft cocktails. Look to The Crowne Plaza Phoenix - Chandler Golf Resort for another first-rate option. 

Finding the right spot or activities for bachelor and bachelorette parties in a town as vibrant as Chandler is easy. To get started, check out our listing of things to do and browse through Chandler nightlife ideas.

Depending on which wedding venue you choose, holding the rehearsal dinner there may be part of the overall package. If not, peruse Chandler’s restaurants to find the one for you. The rehearsal dinner is the perfect opportunity to thank those in your wedding party and spend quality time with loved ones before the big day.

Of course, don’t forget the traditional day after brunch. If you choose, you can invite a larger group and extend your heartfelt thanks and soak up this last bit of time together before everyone heads their separate ways, including you and your newlywed on your honeymoon.

Wedding Services

While many venues offer wedding services, this isn't always the case. To name a handful, you'll need wedding planners, caterers, bakers, florists, photographers, videographers, hair stylists, makeup artists, officiants, DJs or live music, and stationery designers.

headings.text: Where to Get a Marriage License

bodyHtml:
Wedding Planning

Wedding planning can be exciting and stressful, but you can dramatically reduce any stress by outlining a wedding plan. Knowing how to determine your budget, where to obtain a marriage license, and how to find and secure your dream Chandler wedding venue are all great starting points. Before you know it, the big day will be here, and your guests will be in awe of what an enchanting experience you have in store.

Where to Get a Marriage License 

Downtown Customer Service Center (appointment recommended)
601 W. Jackson St., Phoenix, AZ 85003

Northeast Regional Court (by appointment only)
18380 N. 40th St., Phoenix, AZ 85032

Northwest Regional Court (by appointment only)
14264 W. Tierra Buena Ln., Surprise, AZ 85374

Southeast Regional Court Center (by appointment only)
222 E Javelina, Mesa, AZ 85210

Setting the wheels in motion to acquire a marriage license should be at the top of your wedding checklist. If you need a marriage license quickly, you can apply in person at the above locations. An appointment may be necessary, and both parties must be present and bring the necessary paperwork, required documentation, and accepted forms of identification and payment. After following the necessary steps, you will receive your license the same day you apply. You can be wed on this day if you have made arrangements with your officiator.

In Maricopa County, Arizona, residents can apply for a marriage license online through the Clerk of the Superior Court. They review applications within 7 to 10 business days after submission. They will contact you by phone if your application is accepted for identity verification and payment processing.   

If a courthouse wedding is more your speed, look to the Justice Court.

Determine Your Budget 

With everything you need for a wedding, determining your budget is key. Through a quick online search, you can find several wedding budget calculators to help you decide how much you can spend on your special day. Many of these tools help you estimate expenses such as invitations, reception venue and rentals, wedding photography and/or videography, catering, entertainment, and services like bartending.

Find the Ideal Venue

There are numerous things to consider when you choose your wedding venue, but the first action item is to start your search as early as possible. Once you get things moving, ask these questions:

  • Does the venue match your wedding theme?
  • Is the price within your budget?
  • If outdoors, what is the backup plan if inclement weather hits?
  • Does the venue offer discounts for hiring vendors they recommend?
  • Is the space large enough to accommodate your guests?
  • Can the reception be held on-site?
  • Will there be expenses for out-of-town guests (or all guests if yours is a destination wedding)?
  • Does the venue have good reviews?
  • Are there any restrictions?
  • How long can you and your guests remain at the venue?

Work Together With Your Partner

Even if they are reluctant to assist with planning, you’ll want to discuss several topics with your partner when planning your wedding. Among them: What wedding theme works for both of you? Who will make the guest list, and who do you need to leave off? Do you both agree on the wedding party? If not, it’s important to compromise on this or anything else. After all, it’s a special day for all involved, but none more than the two of you.

A great way to approach your wedding checklist is to divide and conquer. Assign action items that play to your individual strengths. Most of all, have fun and grow together as you plan one of, if not the biggest day of your lives.

bodyHtml:
Wedding Services in Chandler 

Selecting vendors who align with your wedding vision is an exciting part of the wedding planning process. Reading reviews and looking through a vendor's portfolio of past wedding gigs provides a number of jigsaw pieces that offer glimpses into how your big day will look, feel, and taste. 

Wedding Cakes

Robert's Catering knows how to create beautiful wedding cakes you'll want to save them forever. Each cake has such detail they are indeed works of art. Robert's long list of repeat clients tells you everything you need to know about their masterful abilities. 

The family-owned K-Cakes Bakery in Chandler will create a custom, captivating wedding cake that will leave your guests in awe. K-cakes can also handle all of your baked goods needs. If you’re looking for a themed cake, give them a call. What they’ll cook up is sure to impress.

Florists

Create a backdrop of enchanting romance by enlisting an awards-winning florist from Arizona Flower Company in south Chandler. Not only will their talented Chandler florist take care of every last detail, but the company offers a wide selection of wedding bouquets, centerpieces and everything you need for a fabulous wedding. They could be your one-stop shop for the big day.

In addition to other wedding planning services, Simply Beautiful Wedding & Event Planning has an impressive menu of floral design services with Simple, Plush, and Extravagant packages. Each package is first-rate, and they even provide flowers for your cake if needed.

Transportation 

Pulling up to your wedding in style with your wedding party is a rite of passage, as is leaving your wedding with your beloved spouse. The Driver Provider has a suite of sweet rides from which to choose. The party starts long before you arrive at the venue, from chauffeured classic limousines to town cars to Mercedes Sprinter vans.

Arizona Black Tie Limousine boasts a fleet of opulent, fully-equipped limousines. Your only task is to relax, celebrate, and savor your special day while Arizona Black Tie handles all your transportation needs. 

Photographers 

Shea Brie Photography is all about capturing the intimate moments of an intimate wedding. A native of Arizona, Shea has an eye for catching desert details other photographers may miss. One look at her website portfolio, and you’ll understand why she is a sought-after wedding photographer in Chandler.

The extensive list of five-star reviews reveals so much about the quality and talent of Always TImeless Productions. They work with you closely to capture photo and video content that reveals the unique emotions felt throughout your wedding. Enlist them to tell the story of your wedding day in Chandler, AZ —a story you can revisit as often as you like.

Salons

Arrange for a studio visit or have Luxe Beauty bring the salon to you. Luxe Beauty specializes in wedding services and emphasizes the beauty that is unique to each person. They add a sense of fun and calm to the often nervous get-ready stage of a wedding. They even coordinate around your photographers so everything runs smoothly and according to plan.

With Chandler Salon Suites, you’ll feel and look your best on your wedding day. This team of experts offers in-salon and on-site makeup and wedding hair services in Chandler. Whichever you choose, you’ll walk down the aisle looking like a fairy tale.

headings.text: Pre & Post Wedding Activities in Chandler

bodyHtml:
Pre & Post Wedding Activities in Chandler

Before and after wedding activities are essential parts of the entire experience. Pre-wedding fun helps set the tone for the big day. Post-wedding events like the day after brunch help extend the experience while showing gratitude and saying heartfelt goodbyes to your guests. From engagement parties to once-in-a-lifetime honeymoons, pre and post-wedding activities are the beautiful bookends of your dream wedding. 

Engagement Parties

After spreading the exciting news of the proposal, the engagement party is the kickoff for all wedding festivities to follow. Often held by one or each set of parents or even close friends, engagement parties can be as intimate or elegant as preferred. Whether held at a loved one’s home, a rented-out section of an elegant restaurant, or a highly unique venue, the central theme is celebrating the engaged couple’s love and the beautiful life they will continue to create together.

Bridal Showers

Typically held by the maid of honor and/or bridesmaids, bridal showers give the bride a chance to celebrate her upcoming wedding with a smaller gathering of dear friends. A longstanding tradition, these showers usually take place in the comfort of the host’s home or at a restaurant or other venue where all can enjoy laughter, food, and games. Gifts are given to the bride to help prepare her for married life. In Chandler, two great venues for bridal showers are SoHo63 and The Living Room Wine Café & Lounge.

Bachelor & Bachelorette Parties

If you and your fiance want to save money by opting out of any destination bachelor and bachelorette parties, Chandler has numerous activities and exciting spots to celebrate your last night of freedom!

Get outside and enjoy the company of your closest friends on a Jeep or hiking excursion with Apache Trail Tours.

A spa day at Hawaiian Experience Spa is a wonderful way to bond with your wedding party while taking in muscle-melting massages, facials, and other services.

Explore Chandler's impressive list of breweries for a lively night on the town. 

Rehearsal Dinner 

After a successful rehearsal on the eve of your wedding day, gathering with loved ones for an intimate rehearsal dinner should be an evening you treasure forever.

An upscale, modern choice is The Brickyard Downtown. Your guests will love the historic building, craft cocktails, and tapas-style shareable plates. Another option is Stone & Vine Urban Italian, where you can thank those in attendance over authentic Italian fare. Finally, Firebirds Wood Fired Grill is the spot for delicious steak, huge salads, and martinis to continue the day’s celebration.

Day After Brunch 

The day after brunch is a relaxed atmosphere where you can bask in the warm company of your loved ones and thank them one final time, especially those who traveled great distances to attend.

Hold your brunch at the luxurious Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort for an elegant and classic affair. If something more laid back is in the cards, look to Hash Kitchen for a build-your-own Bloody Mary bar and DJ booth on the weekends. They even have a selfie station to capture these final beloved post-wedding moments.

Honeymoon

If you’re honeymooning outside of Chandler, that doesn’t mean you can’t squeeze in some romance before you embark on your getaway. Feel the love with your newlywed on a sunset walk in Veterans Oasis Park; book a couple’s spa day at Alvea Spa at Encanterra and be pampered after all the pre and post-wedding fun; or register for an evening of otherworldly stargazing at San Tan Mountain Regional Park.

bodyHtml:
Wedding Venues in Chandler  

You’ve spread the wonderful news of your engagement, and the congratulations are pouring in with each new day. Your wedding experience will entail several pre and post-wedding activities, such as your engagement party, wedding shower, and honeymoon destination. These will require a party venue, but none is more important than your wedding location.

Greenhouse Gardens
13103 E Chandler Heights Road
(480) 664-4220

Greenhouse Gardens is among the many fun and unique wedding venues in Chandler, AZ. Over four acres, this historic property offers all the advantages of a country wedding without driving to a rural location.

Imagine a small, boutique wedding in an urban garden where guests delight in farm-to-table cuisine. In addition to saying “I do” in a farm atmosphere, the photo ops will make your wedding stand out, as tractors, historic World War II buildings, and chickens serve as distinctive backdrops.

Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort
1 San Marcos Place
(480) 812-0900

The majestic Crowne Plaza Phoenix Chandler Golf Resort has been in the wedding hosting game since 1912, so it’s safe to say they know how to put on an elegant affair. On-site, the Chandler wedding venue has 16 unique spaces to hold your rehearsal dinner, ceremony, reception, and day after brunch.

From small casual ceremonies to black-tie affairs, the Crowne Plaza has it all. You can choose from three ballrooms, a rooftop terrace, and two outdoor venues, including welcoming seasonal greenery, vines over a century old, bistro lighting, and a stunning white garden arch where you and your fiancé will exchange vows.

The Ashley Castle
1300 S Price Road
(480) 857-8030

Talk about a fairy tale wedding! The Ashley Castle in Chandler, Arizona allows many to live out their childhood dream of marrying their prince or princess on castle grounds. Enter the stone castle through 200-year-old doors to find marble floors, a grand ballroom with hand-painted walls, 30-foot ceilings, and crystal chandeliers.

Garden rooms, fountains, and a statue garden surround the castle, and a captivating wrought iron structure with eye-catching curtains creates a romantic outdoor ceremony area. The venue offers a menu of wedding services, including cake and décor, catering, wedding planning, wedding invitations, flower arrangements, ceremony music, and DJs. As the only venue in the area permitted to shoot off fireworks, light up the skies after the ceremony as icing on the cake at the Ashley Castle in Chandler.

Bella Rose Estate
1380 S Price Road
(480) 477-7930

A breathtaking two-acre private venue, Chandler’s Bella Rose Estate offers indoor and outdoor garden spaces where you can wed in style against your choice of lavish backdrops. Inside, the 5,000-square-foot grand ballroom can seat 300 guests and accommodate ceremonies and receptions. Lighted brick stairs lead to the ballroom, where you’ll find saltillo-tiled walls, stunning chandeliers, enchanting lighting, and a large wooden dance floor.

Also, the bridal suites cover 3,000 gorgeous square feet indoors, and the bride and the wedding party can ensure every last detail is just right. Among the classy vintage-style furniture, full wall mirrors, and fireplaces, laugh any nerves away as you share this rite of passage with those closest to you. There’s also a space for the guys equipped with a poker table, mini fridge, and flat-screen TV. Like indoors, the outdoor Chandler wedding venue is hard to beat. Your guests will love the multiple waterfalls, tranquil fountains, granite bars, grand arches, intoxicatingly fragrant flower beds, and romantic gazebo.

Ocotillo Golf Club
3751 S Clubhouse Drive
(480) 917-6660

Surrounded by lush greenery, the Ocotillo Golf Club just may be your dream desert oasis venue. As you stand before family and friends to tie the knot in a picturesque private garden, those in attendance will sit in the warm embrace of rolling green hills and glistening lakes. It’s safe to say no matter where you look, the perfect photograph awaits.

In the Overlook Pavilion, a magical wedding celebration will unfold as your guests toast your love and the life ahead before taking to the dance floor to sway the night away.

Marriott Phoenix Chandler
1600 S Price Road
(480) 732-1600

Work with in-house wedding specialists to create the wedding of a lifetime with tailored designs and custom menus at the luxurious Marriott Phoenix Chandler. The expansive Chandler Ballroom boasts over 10,000 square feet, accommodating up to 860 guests for an upscale hotel wedding for the ages.

This contemporary wedding venue in a chic, modern hotel offers indoor and outdoor weddings and is equipped with cutting-edge AV systems to take your reception to the next level. With everything else happening on-site, have your guests stay comfortably at the hotel so you can squeeze in every last bit of quality time together.

SanTan Gardens
495 E Warner Road
(480) 534-7041

For a one-of-a-kind wedding conveniently located in uptown Chandler, look to SanTan Gardens. Here, you can have an intimate, casual, western-chic outdoor venue at a lively brewery and distillery. While you embrace the hands of your spouse-to-be before up to 65 guests, the timeless and contemporary come together for a truly Arizona wedding. With abundant greenery, twinkling lights, and an orange sherbet Chandler sunset above, this space is beyond magical.

After the ceremony, there will be no shortage of ways to celebrate with SanTan Brewing craft beer, craft spirits, and an overall atmosphere of celebration.

SoHo63
63 E Boston Street
(480) 878-5663

Located in Downtown Chandler, SoHo63 masterfully combines historic charm with modern elegance. With more than 12,000 square feet, the venue can host 20 to 200 guests and is a mesmerizing alternative to other Chandler wedding venues. Customize your wedding with catering and bar packages and seemingly endless design possibilities.

Hold your ceremony in an open-air courtyard with strung bistro lighting. This beautiful space can also serve as an outdoor extension of your reception area. Indoors, the Gramercy Ballroom has modern lighting, state-of-the-art technology, glass doors, chandeliers, and flexible floor plans for an unforgettable gathering.

A talented staff is available to help with every detail, and your wedding party will adore the private get-ready rooms to ensure they, and most importantly, you, look your absolute best.
